tei:titleStmt.tei:title: mgon po/khams pa shākya rdo rje/de sras chos grags/bla ma dar ma shākya/bsod nams dbang po/lo tsā ba mchog ldan/bla ma dpal ldan seng gethams cad mkhyen pa bu
mgon po/khams pa shākya rdo rje/de sras chos grags/bla ma dar ma shākya/bsod nams dbang po/lo tsā ba mchog ldan/bla ma dpal ldan seng gethams cad mkhyen pa bu

tei:div.tei:p: mgon po/ khams pa shākya rdo rje/ de sras chos grags/ bla ma dar ma shākya/ bsod nams dbang po/ lo tsā ba mchog ldan/ bla ma dpal ldan seng ge thams cad mkhyen pa bu ston rin po che/ khyung po lhas pa gzhon nu bsod nams/ bla ma bkra shis rin chen/ ngor chen kun dga' bzang po/ rgyal tshab dam pa kun dga' dbang phyug kun mkhyen bsod nams seng ge mus chen sangs rgyas rin chen/ 'jam dbyangs kun dga' bsod nams/ gnyan chen grags pa blo gros/ 'jam dbyangs sangs rgyas seng ge brang ti nam mkha' dpal bzang*/ de dbon nam mkha' rin chen/ hor nam mkha' dpal bzang*/ mkhan chen shes rab rgya mtsho/ mkhas btsun kun dga' chos 'phel/ chos rje dkon mchog rgyal mtshan/ 'jig rten dbang phyug bkra shis bzang po/ des bdag tshul khrims rin chen la'o// yang na 'jam dbyangs kun dga' bsod nams/ grags pa blo gros/ shar khang pa shes rab rgyal mtshan/ brang ti pa man 'dra'o// yang na gze pa don grub mgon po nas/ bar thang pa yab sras/ bsod nams dbang phyug lo tsā ba mchog ldan/ bla ma dpal ldan seng ge bu ston rin po che man 'dra/ kun mkhyen chen po'i yi ge'i lung ni gong 'jam rdor gyi skabs bzhin no// smras pa/ rjes chags sgyu 'phrul bkod pas 'khor ba'i chos// yang dag lam byed thabs rgyud gsang ba 'dus// 'phags pa'i lugs dang ye shes spyan ldan zhabs// mar me mdzad bkral bka' srol che gsum thos// zhes dam pa'i chos thos pa'i yi ge don gnyer gdengs can rol pa'i chu gter las/ dpal gsang ba 'dus pa'i chos skor thos pa'i brgyud rim gyi sarga ste bcu drug pa'o// //gnyis pa zhe sdang can gtso bor 'dul ba gshin rje gshed kyi skor la dmar nag 'jigs gsum las dang po la pha bla na med pa'i rgyud kyi rgyal po thams cad kyi snying po'i yang snying rgyud dang man ngag gi dgongs pa ji lta ba bzhin du/ grub pa'i 'khor los sgyur ba rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug dpal ldan chos skyong ngam bir+wa par zhes yongs su grags pa'i zhal snga nas legs par bkral ba'i dpal gshin rje gshed dmar po lha lnga'i ras bris kyi dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur ba/

ngor chen rdo rje 'chang chen pos mdzad pa'i mngon rtogs bdud rtsi'i bum pa/ shar chen gyis mdzad pa'i dkyil chog bdud rtsi'i rol mtsho/ thams cad mkhyen pa dkon mchog lhun grub kyis mdzad pa'i bkra shis/ ngor chen dkon mchog dpal ldan gyis mdzad pa'i dbang gi mtshams sbyor dang*/ paṇa chen nam mkha' dpal bzang gis mdzad pa'i mtshams sbyor sogs kyis bsdus pa rnams kyi steng nas dbang bzhi rdzogs par thob pa bka' babs gsum dang ldan pa las/ dang po chags lugs kyi brgyud pa ni/ bcom ldan 'das gshin rje gshed/ ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro ma/ rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug dpal ldan bir+wa pa/

so ma pū ri/ grub pa'i dbang phyug ḍom+bi he ru ka na dha ki ka grub chen bi ra ḍi pa/ de bi ko ṭa/ ma ti gar+bha/ dza gad+dhaḥ gam+bhi ra ma ti/ rdo rje gdan pa chen po niṣ+ka laṅka de wa/ rnyog pa med pa'i lha/ paṇa grub re hī ma ya/ wen+d+ra pra bhā/ chag lo tsā ba chos rje dpal/ go lung pha mdo sde dpal/ shong lo tsā ba blo gros brtan pa/ mang mkhar lo tsā ba mchog ldan/ legs pa'i blo gros/ bla ma bsod nams dbang phyug bya sder ba byang chub rin chen/ ra ga brag pa/ shākya seng ge rje btsun jo nang pa phyogs las rnam rgyal/ shar chen ye shes rgyal mtshan/ ngor chen rdo rje 'chang kun dga' bzang po/ mus chen 'khor lo sdom pa dkon mchog rgyal mtshan/ rgyal tshab kun dga' dbang phyug 'dren mchog dkon mchog 'phel ba/ rje lha mchog seng ge rje sangs rgyas seng ge thar rtse paṇa chen nam mkha' dpal bzang*/ rje dbon nam mkha' sangs rgyas/ 'jam dbyangs nam mkha' dpal bzang*/ mkhas grub chen po sangs rgyas phun tshogs/ bka' drin mnyam med rdo rje 'chang bkra shis lhun grub/ des bdag ban+de tshul khrims rin chen la lan gnyis su stsal to// yang na mkhan chen sangs rgyas phun tshogs nas/ rdo rje 'dzin pa kun dga' chos 'phel/ bstan pa'i srog zung bka' drin can bkra shis bzang po/ des bdag tshul khrims rin chen la'o// yang na mkhan chen bkra shis lhun grub nas/ rdo rje 'dzin dbang bkra shis bzang po/ des bdag ban+de tshul khrims rin chen la'o// yang na ngor chen nas/ kun dga' dbang phyug 'dren mchog rat+na war+dha man 'dra/ yang na mus chen sems dpa' chen po/ yongs 'dzin man 'dra/ yang na rdo rje 'chang yab sras gnyis ka las/ rgyal tshab dam pa kun dga' dbang phyug dang*/ kun mkhyen bsod nams seng ge gnyis kas gsan/ de gnyis ka las rat+na war+dhas gsan/ yang na lha mchog seng ge shar khang pa/ rje nam mkha' dpal bzang man 'dra/

yang na rat+na war+dha/ rje dkon mchog lhun grub/ shar khang pa man 'dra/ yang na rje dkon mchog lhun grub/ rje dkon mchog dpal ldan/ rje nam mkha' dpal bzang man 'dra/ yang na rje dkon mchog dpal ldan/ byams pa kun dga' bkra shis/ rje nam mkha' sangs rgyas man 'dra/ yang na chag lo nas/ rgyal mtshan dge ba/ shong lo tsā ba blo brtan/ lo mchog man 'dra/ yang na lo mchog dpal ldan seng ge bu ston rin po che/ lo tsā ba rin chen rnam rgyal/ sa bzang 'phags pa/ ngor chen rdo rje 'chang man 'dra/ yang na dpal ldan seng ge kun spangs chos grags dpal bzang*/ ma ti paṇa chen/ sa bzang 'phags pa man 'dra'o// yang chag lugs brgyud pa lugs gcig la/ chag lo nas/ bla brang pa gzhon nu/ bla brang pa blo gros dpal/ bla brang pa bzang po dpal/ bla brang pa nyi ma rgyal mtshan/ bla brang pa bsod nams dpal 'byor/ bla brang pa chos dpal bzang po/ chag lo rin chen chos rgyal/ sa lo 'jam dpal rdo rje/ thams cad mkhyen pa dkon mchog lhun grub/ rje shar khang pa shes rab rgyal mtshan/ thar rtse ba nam mkha' dpal bzang man 'dra/ bka' babs gnyis pa dpyal lugs kyi brgyud pa ni/ bcom ldan 'das gshin rje'i gshed/ rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug shrī bir+wa pa/ ḍom+bi he ru ka bī ra ḍi pa/ dge slong byi la'i sham thabs can/ byi la pa yang zer/ ma ti gar+bha/ gam+bhi ra ma ti/ niṣ+ka laṅka*/ dpyal chos bzang*/ rje btsun rgwa lo/ rong pa shes rab seng ge bla ma dpal ldan seng ge thams cad mkhyen pa bu ston rin chen grub/ dpal ldan bla ma dam pa bsod nams rgyal mtshan/ chos rje phyogs las rnam rgyal/ shar chen ye shes rgyal mtshan/ ngor chen rdo rje 'chang kun dga' bzang po man 'dra'o// bka' babs gsum pa dā na shī la lugs kyi brgyud pa ni/ 'jam gsar/ rje btsun rgwa lo rnam rgyal rdo rje/ rong pa shes rab seng ge skyi ston grags pa rgyal mtshan/ chos rje kun mkhyen chen po/ jo nang pa phyogs las rnam rgyal/

shar chen ye shes rgyal mtshan/ ngor chen rdo rje 'chang chen po man gong dang 'dra'o// ༈ /thar rtse pa nam mkha' dpal bzang gis mdzad pa'i gshin rje'i gshed dmar po'i shin tu spros med kyi khrid yig nges don rdo rje'i rnal 'byor them skas kyi steng nas/ gang zag mchog skal ba dang ldan pa cig car ba'i lam gyis bkri bar 'os pa'i don du gsungs pa shin tu spros pa med pa'i khrid kyi rim pa zab mo smin rgyas spros med kyi byin rlabs/ bdud rtsi'i byin rlabs dang bcas pa legs par thob nas rgyab brten lung la/ thog mar rnal 'byor dbang phyug bir+wa pas mdzad pa'i gshin rje mthar byed dmar po lha lnga'i mngon rtogs las tshogs dang bcas pa ston pa'i sgrub thabs che ba nyi ma'i dbang po'i 'od zer dang*/ chag chos rje dpal gyis bsgyur ba/ de'i sgrub thabs chung ba dā na shī la'i rang 'gyur/ gtor ma'i cho ga gnyis dang bskyed rim gyi gzhung gsum dang*/ spros med rdo rje'i tshig rkang*/ rdzogs rim shin tu spros pa med pa de kho na nyid kyi man ngag dar+pan ā tsār+ya dang*/ glo bo lo tsā ba shes rab rin chen gyis bsgyur ba/ des mdzad pa'i byin gyis brlabs pa'i man ngag 'od gsal 'char ba'i rim pa rgya gar gyi mkhan po re wen+d+ra dang*/ chag lo chos rje dpal gyis bsgyur ba ste rdzogs rim gyi gzhung gsum/ gshin rje'i gshed kyi 'khrul 'khor gyi phreng ba dang*/ der mi gsal ba'i sngags btu dang*/ las so so'i sngags gsal bar ston pa/ gshin rje'i gshed kyi 'khrul 'khor gyi cho ga ste bi rū pa'i gzhung brgyad/ des mdzad pa'i bdud rtsi byin rlabs kyi rim pa dar+pan dang lo tsā ba zhe sdang rdo rje'i 'gyur/ de'i khrid yig glo bo lo tsā bas mdzad pa/ spros med brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs rje rdo rje 'chang gis mdzad pa/ spros med rgyun gyi nyams len yongs 'dzin gyis mdzad pa dang sa los mdzad pa rnams dang*/

gshin rje'i gshed dmar po'i rgyud le'u bcu dgu pa rnams kyi lung dang bcas pa legs par thob pa las/ rdzogs rim zab mo shin tu spros med kyi byin rlabs dang khrid thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ bcom ldan 'das gshin rje'i gshed/ rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug dpal ldan bir+wa pa/ grub pa'i dbang phyug ḍom+bi he ru ka bī ra ḍi pa/ dge slong byi la'i sham thabs can/ grub pa'i 'khor los 'gyur ba bram ze dpal 'dzin/ sngon lha dang lha min 'thab pa'i tshe lha phrug gcig gi mgo chad par rang gi dbu sbyar bas gsos/ ma he shi ba'i mgo rang la sbyar bas dge slong gi lus la ma he'i mgo can/ blo bzang snying po/ paṇ+ḍi ta dar+pan ā tsār+ya/ krī ya sa muts+tsha mdzad pa po lo dgu stong dang nyis brgya bzhugs pa/ glo bo lo tsā ba shes rab rin chen/ sras bla ma sa pa/ lo tsā ba mchog ldan legs pa'i blo gros/ bla ma dpal ldan seng ge thams cad mkhyen pa bu ston rin chen grub/ bla ma bsod nams rgyal mtshan/ jo nang pa phyogs las rnam rgyal/ shar chen ye shes rgyal mtshan/ ngor chen rdo rje 'chang kun dga' bzang po/ mus chen sems dpa' chen po/ kun mkhyen bsod nams seng ge 'dren mchog dkon mchog 'phel ba/ rje lha mchog seng ge rje bud+dha singha*/ paṇa chen nam mkha' dpal bzang*/ rje nam mkha' sangs rgyas/ mkhan chen bsod nams rgya mtsho/ rje btsun sangs rgyas dpal bzang*/ mkhas grub sangs rgyas phun tshogs/ rdo rje 'dzin pa kun dga' chos 'phel/ rigs brgya'i khyab bdag chen po bkra shis bzang po/ des bdag tshul khrims rin chen la bka' drin du stsal to// yang na sems dpa' chen po nas/ bdag chen rdo rje 'chang*/ kun spangs pa/ tshar chen blo gsal rgya mtsho/ mang thos klu sgrub rgya mtsho/ mkhas grub ngag dbang chos grags/ dpal sa skya pa ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams/ rje bsod nams rgya mtsho man 'dra'o// yang na bla ma dam pa bsod nams rgyal mtshan nas/

theg chen chos kyi rgyal po/ 'jam dbyangs nam mkha' rgyal mtshan/ bdag chen rdo rje 'chang man 'dra/ yang na bu ston nas/ rin chen rnam rgyal/ sku zhang nam mkha' mchog grub/ mkhas pa tsan+d+ra shrī rat+na/ 'khrul zhig tshul khrims rgyal mtshan/ mkhyen rab rje/ rdo ring pa man 'dra/ yang na thugs sras nas/ bsod nams don grub/ bkra shis rgyal mtshan/ bka' bzhi pa rin chen rgyal mtshan/ mkhyen rab rje man 'dra'o// bir+wa pa'i gzhung brgyad kyi bdud rtsi byin rlabs dang tshig rkang lung gi brgyud pa ni/ gshin rje'i gshed/ bir+wa pa/ ma ti gar+bha/ bram ze dpal 'dzin/ shān+ta rak+ṣi ta/ dar+paṇa ā tsār+ya/ glo bo lo tsā sogs gzhan 'dra'o// yang nye brgyud byed na/ shar chen ye shes rgyal mtshan gyis mnal lam bzung nas sau ma pu rir rnal 'byor dbang phyug bir+wa pa dang dngos su mjal nas gsan pas/ rdo rje 'chang*/ bir+wa pa/ shar chen man sngar ltar ro// ༈ /rnam snang gi rigs su gtogs pa zhe sdang can gtso bor 'dul ba gshin rje'i gshed skor la rwa lo dge ba rgyal mtshan gyis mdzad pa'i sgrub thabs gshin rje kun 'joms dang*/ dkyil chog gzhon nu rnam rol/ de'i zur 'debs mkhas pa bkra shis dpal ldan gyis mdzad pa'i steng nas/ rwa lugs kyi dpal gshin rje gshed dgra nag lha bcu gsum ma ras bris kyi dkyil 'khor chen por dbang bzhi rdzogs par nos pa'i brgyud pa ni/ rdo rje 'chang*/ ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro ma/ tai lo pa/ nā ro pa/ pradzñā rak+ṣi ta/ bal po meñdza gling ngor pa'i gsan yig 'gar meñdze gling pa/ bal po thugs rje chen po zhes so sor byas 'dug pa thugs rje chen po/ sa dge ba'i mkhas grub mang po bal po bha ro dang gcig par mdzad kyang 'di ye rang ba dang bha ro yam bu ba yin zhing thugs rje chen po ni dus 'khor phag mo sogs la shin tu mkhas/ bha ro ni gshin rje gshed kyi grub pa thob pa tsam las mkhas par ma grags pas so sor ma 'dres par dgos par mngon no zhes rgyal dbang lnga pa chen po gsung ngo*//

rwa chen lo tsā ba rdo rje grags/ rab byung*/ rwa chos rab/ rwa ye shes seng ge sngags pa dkar chas lcang lo can/ rwa 'bum seng*/ sngags dkar co dreg can/ rgwa lo rnam rgyal rdo rje/ thar rtse sgrub khang pa shar pa gsum gyi gsan yig tu don yod rdo rje yin tshul 'dug pa gsang mtshan dang 'khrul lam dpyad/ de sras rong pa shes rab seng ge 'di man rab byung*/ bla ma dpal ldan seng ge thams cad mkhyen pa bu ston rin po che/ thugs sras lo tsā ba rin chen rnam rgyal/ sku zhang nam mkha'i mtshan can/ bla ma rin chen dpal grub/ rdo rje 'chang mkhyen rab chos rje/ mkhan chen rig 'dzin rgyal po/ bla chen chos rig rgyal mtshan/ bla ma bsod nams dpal 'byor/ rje byang gling pa bkra shis rgyal mtshan/ paṇa chen nam mkha' dpal bzang*/ mkhas grub dpal ldan don grub/ 'jam dbyangs shes rab 'byung gnas/ rgyud sde rgya mtsho'i mnga' bdag bkra shis dpal ldan/ rigs kyi 'khor los sgyur ba rdo rje sems dpa' bkra shis bzang po/ des bdag ban+de tshul khrims rin chen la stsal to// thams cad mkhyen pa dkon mchog lhun grub kyis mdzad pa'i sgrub thabs bdud 'joms snang ba/ dkyil chog rab gsal snang ba/ mkhan chen sangs rgyas phun tshogs pas mdzad pa'i dbang gi mtshams sbyor rnams kyi steng nas rdo rje 'jigs byed rwa lugs ro langs chen po brgyad kyis bskor ba'i ras bris kyi dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur ba thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rdo rje 'chang*/ rdo rje 'jigs byed/ ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro ma/ grub chen la li ta badz+ra/ paṇ+ḍi ta a mo gha badz+ra/ ye shes 'byung gnas sbas pa/ grub chen pad+ma badz+ra/ dī paṃ ka ra/ bal po bha ro phyag rdum yang zer/ rwa lo tsā ba rdo rje grags/ rab byung*/ rwa chos rab/ rwa ye shes seng ge sngags pa gos dkar lcang lo can/

rwa 'bum seng*/ glog skya dbang phyug grags/ ldong ston shes rab dpal/ 'gro ba'i mgon po 'phags pa/ zhang dkon mchog dpal/ brag phug pa bsod nams dpal/ chos rje bla ma dam pa bsod nams rgyal mtshan/ mkhan chen byang chub dpal/ chos rje ye shes rgyal mtshan/ rdo rje 'chang kun dga' bzang po/ paṇ+ḍi ta grags pa rgyal mtshan/ mkhan chen bsod nams lhun grub/ rje lha mchog seng ge rje bud+dha singha*/ rje nam mkha' dpal bzang*/ shar chen byams pa kun dga' bkra shis/ shar pa shes rab 'byung gnas/ rje dam chos bsam 'grub/ bstan pa'i snang byed mkhan chen thams cad mkhyen pa sangs rgyas phun tshogs/ dus dgra'i mgon po khyab bdag bkra shis lhun grub/ des bdag ban+de tshul khrims rin chen la bka' drin du yang yang stsal to// yang na dbu mdzad phrin las rgya mtsho/ bka' drin mnyam med mkhan po chen po thams cad mkhyen pa tshul khrims lhun grub/ des bdag tshul khrims rin chen la'o// yang na sangs rgyas phun tshogs nas/ mtshungs med bstan 'dzin lhun grub/ mkhan chen thams cad mkhyen pa dpal ldan chos skyong*/ des bdag la'o// yang na mkhas grub sangs rgyas phun tshogs nas/ rdo rje 'chang kun dga' bstan 'dzin/ des bdag tshul khrims rin chen la'o// yang na sangs rgyas phun tshogs nas/ dbu mdzad phrin las rgya mtsho/ rdo rje 'chang kun dga' bstan 'dzin/ des bdag la'o// yang na glo bo mkhan chen nas/ sa skya lo tsā ba/ rje dkon mchog lhun grub/ dkon mchog dpal ldan/ shar chen man 'dra/ yang na paṇa chen nam mkha' dpal bzang*/ rin po che dpal ldan don grub/ shes rab 'byung gnas man 'dra/ yang na sa lo 'jam dpal rdo rje nas/ gnyen chen grags pa blo gros/ chos rje shes rab rgyal mtshan/ paṇa chen nam mkha' dpal bzang man 'dra/ yang na rje nam mkha' dpal bzang las/ shar chen dang*/ nam mkha' sangs rgyas gnyis kas gsan/ de gnyis las rje dam chos pas so// snga ma gnyis char las gzar chen pas gsan/

de las rje dam chos pas so// yang na rwa 'bum seng nas/ rong pa rgwa lo/ rong pa shes rab seng ge rong pa rdo rje rgyal mtshan/ kun mkhyen bu ston/ mkhan chen rin rnam pa/ sa bzang 'phags pa/ ngor chen rdo rje 'chang man gong dang 'dra/ yang na rong pa rgwa lo/ rong pa shes rab seng ge bag ston/ bla ma tshul khrims rgyal mtshan/ kun mkhyen shes rab dpal/ bla ma dge ba rgyal mtshan/ bla ma shes rab zla ba/ sngags 'chang rin chen rnam rgyal/ mus chen sangs rgyas rin chen/ rje lha mchog seng ge rje sangs rgyas seng ge man 'dra'o// ༈ /mkhas grub sangs rgyas phun tshogs pas mdzad pa'i go don bdud rtsi'i nying khu dang rwa rtse sems 'dzin gyi khrid yig sku gsum lam byed snying gi thig le'i steng nas rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi rdzogs rim rwa rtse sems 'dzin/ mtshan mo rgyu ba/ mtshan ma gyen bsgreng rnams thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ gshin rje'i gshed/ ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro ma/ la lī ta badz+ra/ 'jam dpal gshin rje/ a mo gha badz+ra che chung gnyis/ skyo ston 'od 'byung*/ skyo ston ye shes 'byung gnas/ skyo ston bsod nams bla ma/ jo sras khams pa/ gnyen rin chen brtan/ gnyen 'od srungs/ gnyen chos rgyal/ 'dzim pa rin she/ 'jam dbyangs 'khon ston/ shar pa 'jam dbyangs

'dis sa skya'i gdan sa lo bco brgyad mdzad/ gzhi thog pa/ cha gan dbang rgyal/ klog skya grags chen/ klog skya dang grags chen so sor byas pa'ang snang*/ kun mkhyen gongs pa/ ma ti paṇa chen/ sa bzang 'phags pa/ ngor chen rdo rje 'chang*/ gu ge paṇ+ḍi ta/ mkhan chen bsod nams lhun grub/ ngor chen dkon mchog lhun grub/ rje dkon mchog dpal ldan/ shar chen byams pa kun dga' bkra shis/ dbon shes rab 'byung gnas/ rje nyang stod pa dam chos bsam 'grub/ mkhas grub sangs rgyas phun tshogs/ rmor chen ngag dbang kun dga' lhun grub/ skyor mda' bla ma bsod nams dbang phyug bka' drin mnyam med rdo rje 'chang dpal ldan chos skyong*/ des bdag tshul khrims rin chen la stsal to// yang na sangs rgyas phun tshogs nas/ bstan 'dzin lhun grub/ rdo rje 'chang dpal ldan chos skyong*/ des bdag la'o// sangs rgyas phun tshogs la gsan dus kyi khrid yig mkhan chen legs 'byung gi gsung las rje dkon mchog lhun grub pas zin bris mdzad pa las thos so gsung*// ༈ /dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi rgyud dang rgya gzhung rnams thos pa'i rnam grangs la/ sa ngor nas brgyud pa dang 'og nas 'byung ba gnyis phal cher zlos te 'byung yang dpe rgyun gyi sgrig rim mi 'dra ba dang*/ bla ma phyi mas mdzad pa'i kha 'gengs mang nyung la sogs pa khyad par mchis pa rnams so sor ma bkod na/ rjes 'jug pa dag brgyud tshul tha dad pa'i khungs zhib par dpyod mi nus pa sogs kyis rtogs dka' ba mchis par brten/ lung rgyun rgyas bsdus gcig go gcig chod du gyur na shin tu mi btub par snyam nas/ thog mar ngor nas brgyud pa ltar 'god pa la/ rtog bdun thugs rje chen po dang rwa lo'i 'gyur/ yang rtog bdun mal los bsgyur ba la sa skya pas gsan pa'i lugs mchan 'byar ba/ rtog bdun gyi dka' 'grel chos kyi shes rab kyi 'gyur/ rtog pa gsum pa mchan 'byar ba/

slob dpon shrī bha dras mdzad pa'i sgrub thabs/ phyag gnyis pa'i sgrub thabs 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyis mdzad pa rwa 'gyur/ a mo ghas mdzad pa'i sgrub thabs/ bstod pa/ dbang chog sbyin sreg zhi ba las bdun dang drag po las bdun a mo gha chung bas mdzad par grags pa/ gtam rgyud kyi rtog pa mdzad byang med pa/ gtor chog dang uṣ+ṇī ṣa'i srung 'khor bha ros mdzad pa/ tshogs 'khor shān+ti pas mdzad pa rnams rwa 'gyur/ ts+tshun dha ra'i sgrub thabs dang*/ rtog pa zhi ba mo rwa 'gyur/ ya ma rā dza'i rtsa sngags lo tsā ba rdo rje dpal gyi 'gyur/ ma mo brgyad bskor gyi sgrub thabs 'jam dpal ye shes kyis mdzad pa/ lha mo brgyad bskor gyi sgrub thabs zhi ba ye shes kyis mdzad pa/ des mdzad pa'i 'khor lo bskor ba'i las drag po/ dpa' gcig che ba'i sgrub thabs dpal 'dzin gyis mdzad pa ba ri ba chos grags kyis bsgyur ba ste rgya gzhung de rnams kyi lung dang*/ rwa pod du grags pa'i chos kyi rnam grangs ni/ rgyud kyi rgyal po rtog bdun la// nag 'grel mun pa'i mda' 'phen brtsams// dkar 'grel phyogs mthong 'bem la gtad// bcud kyi thigs pas phog par bsnun// gsod pa'i mtshon de snying la gab// kha brgyud yi ger mthong ba bkod// bsnyen sgrub las gshin sbrel ma yod// mngon rtogs rim pa lnga yang yod// las bzhi'i sbyin sreg cho ga yod// smin byed dkyil chog yig sna yod// dmar mo mda' gzhu 'gengs pa yod// 'di dag rnams ni mi legs na'ang*// ban chung rwa yi lugs su snang*// nga yi rjes 'brang thams cad kyis// bcos bslad ma byed nyams su long*// zhes pa ltar te/ de'ang thems yig nag 'grel gnyis/ dkar 'grel gnyis/ bcud kyi lag len khrigs bkod zer ba yod/ thigs pa/ ha la'i shog dril/ de'i gsal byed rgya ston gyis mdzad pa/ mngon rtogs dri med snang ba/ phyag drug pa'i mngon rtogs khams gsum za byed/

phyag bzhi pa'i mngon rtogs dri med chu rgyun/ phyag gnyis pa'i mngon rtogs rin chen don bsdus/ mngon rtogs yid bzhin gter mdzod/ las bzhi'i sbyin sreg dbang chog chos rab kyi don du mdzad pa/ rma bya dug dbang man ngag dang bcas pa/ las gshin gnad la dbab pa'i man ngag rnams rwa lo tsā ba rdo rje grags kyis mdzad pa rnams dang*/ gzhan yang 'khrul 'khor gyi man ngag sgrub pa'i zhal gdams bsnyen sgrub bsad gsum drag po'i sbyin sreg rnams mdzad byang med pa/ bsnyen sgrub kyi lag len dang spogs chog mdzad byang med pa/ yang gshin rje nyi ma bzhi pa dang de'i man ngag 'bum seng ges mdzad pa/ rtog bdun gyi bsdus don rwa sher rgyal gyis mdzad pa/ bsnyen sgrub kyi lag len rwa chos rab kyis mdzad pa/ phyag mtshan so gnyis kyi las tshogs zhes bya ba/ gri gug gis dgra gsad pa/ shāk+tis phung bar byed pa/ gtun shing gis rims dbab cing 'dre brdung ba/ chu gris grir 'gum pa/ rdo rje rtse gcig pas gdon bsrung ba/ dgra s+t+was dgra bo tshar gcod pa/ mdung gis cho 'phrul gtang ba/ mda' gzhus sgrub thabs rnams phyogs gcig tu bsdus pa gong du song zin/ lcags kyus mtshan ma dgug pa/ dbyug tos nor bsgrub pa/ kha ṭ+wāṃ gas nyams chag sel ba/ 'khor los bgegs bsrung ba/ rdo rjes klu bsrung ba/ tho bas bar chad bsrung ba/ ral gris dmag dpung bzlog pa/ cang te'us ḍā ki las la 'gyed pa/ thod pas nor bsgrub pa/ mgo bos 'gal ba cham la 'bebs pa/ phub kyis phyir bzlog pa/ rkang pa rlung gi dkyil 'khor gyis skrod pa/ zhags pas lha dang mi'i bu mo dgug pa/ rwa'i mda' gzhus bi ṣa gsad pa/ rgyu zhags kyis rims nad bzlog pa/ dril bus nyams chag bskang ba/ lag pas phrin las bsgrub pa/ ro ras kyi 'khor los las kun bsgrub pa/ gsal shing gi ros ro langs bsgrub pa/ me thab kyis sbyin sreg cho ga bsgrub pa/

thod tshal gyis dgra bo gnad la dbab pa/ sdigs mdzub kyis 'gal ba cham la dbab pa/ 'phan rtse gsum pas 'gro ba dbang du sdud pa/ 'phyar dar gyis phyogs skyong ba bsdu ba rnams/ shar du 'khrul 'khor/ lhor sbyin sreg nub tu tshogs 'khor/ byang du gtor ma la brten nas dgra bo bsgral ba'i man ngag uṣ+ṇi ṣa rwa lugs kyi yi ge rnying ma rwa los mdzad pa/ khro bcu'i srung bzlog srung bzlog gnyis kyi 'khor lo/ ming dang rnam shes sba ba sogs zhal gdams gnad kyi lde mig bsad las dam nyams gsod pa'i mtshon cha/ srung bzlog gnyis kyi man ngag srung 'khor gyi bstod bskul che chung gnyis rnams lo tsā ba ma ṇi ka shrīs mdzad pa rnams bla ma paṇ+ḍi tas phyogs gcig tu bsgrigs pa dang*/ 'khor lo'i dpe chung rnams dang*/ rtog bdun dang*/ rtog gsum gyi bsdus don re dang*/ de dag gi ṭī ka re dang*/ drug cu pa'i gtor chog rnams rgya ston gyis mdzad pa dang*/ yang ldong ston gyis mdzad pa'i las sna tshogs dgra gshed gsal ba'i rgyan/ sku gsung thugs kyi byin rlabs/ drag po'i rgyan rnams thob pa'i brgyud pa ni yan chad dbang brgyud ltar la/ de nas rdo rje 'chang kun dga' bzang po/ paṇa chen grags rgyal/ mkhan chen bsod nams lhun grub/ rje lha mchog seng ge rdo rje 'chang sangs rgyas seng ge paṇa chen nam mkha' dpal bzang man sngar bzhin no// yang dbus pa dpal 'dzin gyis mdzad pa'i rtog bdun gyi zhal shes man ngag lnga pa/ rtog gsum gyi 'khrul 'khor/ rtog gsum gyi sa bcad/ 'khrul 'khor gyi lung sbyor/ bsnyen sgrub kyi lag len/ bzlas yig drag gcod zab mo/ zhi rgyas kyi sbyin sreg zhi ba'i las kyi cho ga rgyas pa'i las sgrub pa'i cho ga dbang dgug gi sbyin sreg dbang dgug don yod zhags pa/ dgra phung ba'i man ngag de'i spogs chog sngags bzla tshul/ rdo rje'i mtshon cha 'bar ba/ dbye ba'i cho ga mnan bskrad rengs pa gsum/

srin pos 'dzin pa/ rims nad/ 'khrug pa/ smyo ba'i cho ga ga'u sro ba'i man ngag gzugs brnyan sreg chog drag po'i gtor chog de ma 'grub na gnad 'bebs/ bsad pa'i sbyin sreg 'khor lo'i dpe chung drug sngags spyi'i 'khor lo'i man ngag rtsa sngags kyi 'khrul 'khor/ bsad pa'i cho ga sngags btu/ 'khor lo rin po che'i mdzod/ las thams cad pa'i sbyin sreg rtog gsum gyi rgyas 'grel/ drag shul spyod pa'i cho ga dug ha la ha la rnams thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ 'bri khung dpal 'dzin/ sngags 'chang rin chen rnam rgyal/ rje btsun sangs rgyas rin chen/ rgyal ba lha mchog seng ge rdo rje 'chang sangs rgyas seng ge man sngar dang 'dra/ rje kun dga' bzang pos mdzad pa'i zhi ba las bdun dang paṇa chen gu ge ba grags rgyal gyis mdzad pa'i drug cu pa'i phyag len gyi yi ge'i lung yang thos so// ༈ /mthu stobs kyi dbang phyug rwa chen lo tsā ba rdo rje grags kyis mdzad pa'i mngon rtogs yid bzhin gter mdzod dang dbang gi chu bo gnyis la rdo rje 'chang tshar pa chos rjes mdzad pa'i sgrub dkyil gsal byed lhan thabs nyi gzhon gsar pa'i dga' ston dang*/ 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i dbang phyug gis mdzad pa'i ngag 'don phreng chags nag po 'gro shes rnams kyis rnam par brgyan pa'i steng nas bcom ldan 'das dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed rwa lugs thun mong ma yin pa lha bcu gsum gyi ras bris kyi dkyil 'khor du dbang bzhi yongs su rdzogs pa dang*/ thams cad mkhyen pa mkhyen brtse'i dbang phyug gis mdzad pa'i 'jam dpal khros pa'i zhal lung snying gi gzungs khrag mkha' 'gro'i kha rlangs can gyi steng du rdo rje 'chang dbang phyug rab brtan gyis mdzad pa'i sngon 'gro lo rgyus sbyar ba dang bcas te/ dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed chen po'i rdzogs pa'i rim pa rwa khrid mkha' 'gro'i snyan brgyud kyi nyams khrid zab mo smin rgyas/

'di dang 'og gi rma bya dug dbang gnyis sngon chad ma thob kyang de thob 'gyur gyis bris/ grub pa'i dbang phyug la lī ta badz+ra gyis mdzad pa'i khrid don gsal byed rgyal khams lo tsā ba ma ṇi ka shrī dzñā nas mdzad pa'i yi ge'i steng nas dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi rnal 'byor bzhi'i nyams khrid zab mo/ 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtses mdzad pa'i yi ge la brten nas bcom ldan 'das dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed dpa' bo gcig pa zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa'i rjes gnang*/ rje shar khang pa'i yi ge'i steng nas phyag mtshan mda' gzhu la brten pa'i bi ṣa bsad pa'i las tshogs dug dbang rma bya rgyas pa/ ngor chen dkon mchog lhun grub pas mdzad pa'i gtor chog rjes gnang gi yi ge la brten nas 'chi bdag las kyi gshin rje dam can chos kyi rgyal po lha bcu gsum gyi rjes su gnang ba/ 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i tho yig la brten nas las gshin dpa' bo gcig pa'i rjes gnang*/ tshar chen chos kyi rgyal pos mdzad pa'i gtor chog rjes gnang dang bcas pa'i yi ge la brten nas las kyi gshin rje dmar po bse bya bzhis bskor gyi rjes gnang*/ des mdzad pa'i gtor chog rjes gnang dang bcas pa'i yi ge'i steng nas gshin rje dmar po khrag mdog yab yum gyi rjes gnang rnams nos nas/ rgyab brten lung la rwa chen shes rab rgyal mtshan gyis mdzad pa'i dkar chag na gsal ba'i chos skor/ der ma 'khod pa'i rgya bod kyi yig sna'i skor/ bod kyi mkhas pa 'bri khung dpal 'dzin gyis mdzad pa'i skor dang gsum/ dang po la rwa lugs kyi gshin rje gshed nag po skor gsum du grags pa'i dkar chag rwa chen gyis mdzad pa'i tshigs bcad dang de'i rgyas bshad rwa dbon shes rab rgyal mtshan gyis mdzad pa/ der gsal ba'i yig sna la/ rgyud 'bum pa las la lī ta badz+ra gyis phyung pa'i dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed khros pa'i rgyal po'am rtsa (rwa)(kun)ba'i rgyud rtog pa bdun pa rgya gar gyi mkhan po ma hā kā ru ni ka dang bod kyi lo tsā ba rwa rdo rje grags kyis bsgyur ba/

'di'i 'gyur ye rang pa thugs rje chen po dang 'og nas 'byung ba'i a mo ghas mdzad pa'i dkyil chog 'gyur du bha ro'i mtshan smos pas kyang 'di gnyis tha dad par tshad mas grub bo// slob dpon chen po a mo gha badz+ra gyis mdzad pa'i rdo rje 'jigs byed lha bcu bdun ma'i dkyil 'khor (rwa)(kun)gyi cho ga dngos grub brnyes pa'i bla ma bha ro dang rwa lo tsā ba rdo rje grags kyis bsgyur ba/ rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi sbyin sreg gi cho ga mdzad pa po dang sgyur byed gong dang 'dra/ des mdzad pa'i rdo rje 'jigs byed lha bcu bdun ma'i sgrub thabs las su bya ba'i cho ga sems dpa' 'di rwas 'gyur bcos mdzad pa'i gsal kha ma byung yang rwa chen gyi gsung la kha cig gsar 'gyur kha cig bcos zhes pa ltar na 'gyur bcos mdzad par mngon/ bsdus pa rgya gar gyi mkhan po mañdzu shrī dzñā na dang bod kyi lo tsā ba rong sgom chos bzang rong zom chos bzang yin min brtag gis bsgyur cing 'gos lhas btsas dbang phyug rgya mtshos zhus te gtan la phab pa/ slob dpon rat+na ā ka ra shān+ti pas mdzad pa'i rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi (rwa)(kun)tshogs kyi 'khor lo rgya gar gyi mkhan po dī paṃ ka ra rak+ṣi ta bha ro phyag rdum/ dang lo tsā ba dge slong rdo rje grags kyis bsgyur ba/ rgyud 'bum pa nas phyung ba'i las mkhan te'u lo pa'i rtog pa dkar chag na rtog pa zhes pa las mi gsal ba gcig tu bsdoms pa 'dra'o// dang te'u lo pa'i cho ga'am rtog pa zhib mo dī paṃ ka ra dang rwa lo rdo rje grags kyis bsgyur ba/ slob dpon shrī bha dras mdzad pa'i dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed dpa' bo gcig pa'i sgrub thabs mdor bsdus pa/ 'gyur byang mi gsal yang rwa'i 'gyur yin nam snyam/ rwa chen rdo rje grags kyis mdzad pa'i rtog bdun gyi (rwa)(rdo rje)(kun)nag 'grel dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi tshig don rnam par bshad pa/

rgya ston kun dga' brtson 'grus kyis dbang phyug chen po 'dul ba'i ched du 'jigs byed sprul tshul gsungs par mkhas grub rjes ma dag ces gsungs pa ni/ rwa chen gyis/ rgyud kyi rgyal po rtog bdun la/ nag 'grel mun pa'i mda' 'phen brtsams// zhes pa'i 'grel pa 'dir gsal bar gsungs pa ma gzigs pa 'dra zhing*/ gal te gzigs na mngon pa'i nga rgyal gyi la brgal bar sems so// des mdzad pa'i dkar (rwa)(rdo rje)(kun)'grel rtog pa bdun pa'i man ngag gi gnad du grags pa/ dpe la lar dka' gnad kyi 'grel pa'i brda dag bris yod 'dug kyang*/ dkar 'grel phyogs mthong 'bem la gtad// bcud kyi thigs pas phog par bsnun// zhes pas shes so/ /des mdzad pa'i rtog bdun (rwa)(rdo rje)(kun)gnad kyi gdams ngag bcud kyi thigs pa/ de'i gsung ha la'i shog dril (rwa)(nub)(kun)dang po'i rtsa ba gcig las mang na khyod snying khos kyi mtha' can/ gnyis pa'i rtsa ba (rwa)(nub)(kun)khong pa'i nang nas snying drongs shig gi mtha' can/ gsum pa'i rtsa ba (rwa)(nub)(kun)rdzogs so'i mtha' can/ des mdzad pa'i rtog pa dang po bsnyen pa'i cho ga dang rtog pa gnyis pa sgrub pa'i cho ga gnyis la brten pa'i bsnyen sgrub dgra srog dbang sdud dam bsnyen sgrub las gshin sgrol ba/ des mdzad pa'i lha bcu gsum ma'i mngon (rwa)(kun)(mkhan)par rtogs pa yid bzhin gter mdzod/ des rgyal ba bkra shis kyi ngor mdzad pa'i gtso rkyang (rwa)(kun)zhal dgu phyag so bzhi ma'i mngon rtogs dri med snang ba/ des mdzad pa'i zhal gsum phyag drug (rwa)(kun)pa'i mngon rtogs khams gsum za byed/ des ston pa a gro'i don du mdzad pa'i zhal gcig phyag bzhi (rwa)(kun)pa'i mngon rtogs dri med chu rgyun/ des mdzad pa'i zhal gcig phyag gnyis (rwa)(kun)pa'i mngon rtogs rin chen don bsdus/ des rwa chos rab kyi don du (rwa)(kun)mdzad pa'i zhi ba'i sbyin sreg mi mthun kun sel/

rgyas pa'i sbyin sreg (rwa)(kun)'dod pa kun 'phel/ dbang gi sbyin sreg (rwa)(kun)gnad kyi lcags kyu/ des sngags 'chang khro rgyal dang blo ldan gnyis kyi don du mdzad (rwa)(kun)pa'i drag po'i sbyin sreg dgra bgegs kun 'dul/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa'i dug dbang lo rgyus dang (sher)bcas pa dbang bskur zhal gdams so'i mtha' can/ dbang dang zas tshad phan (sher)yon gsum bstan pa/ bstan pa 'dzin skyong spel zhing nad gso ba (sher)la gtsug tor 'khor los sgyur ba/ rdo rje 'jigs byed dmar po'i mngon rtogs sngon por bsgyur yod do'i mtha' can/ gu lang (rwa)(legs)gi mgo can la brten nas bzlas pa/ sngags kyi gnas pa/ dug brtag pa/ bsrung bya/ gso thabs rnams bstan pa (rwa)(legs)bi ṣa bzhi skor/ bshal (rwa)(legs)bya ba/ sngags kyis bi ṣa phyogs med (rwa)(legs)thub pa kha ri su/ rdzas dgus (rwa)(legs)bi ṣa phyogs med thub pa/ ser po (rwa)(legs)gsum sbyor/ rna ba mig sogs lus kyi cha gang la babs pa (rwa)(legs)sngags rdzas gtar kha sman la brten nas 'chos pa/ phyag mtshan mda' gzhu la brten nas bi ṣa bsad pa'i las bstan pa (rwa)(legs)lcags rtse zlum po 'jib pa gnad yin gsung ngo'i mtha' can/ dug khyer yod pa'i mi dang nad pa'i brtag (rwa)(legs)thabs nag por song na bi ṣa yin gyi mtha' can/ 'jigs byed glang mgo can gyi bi ṣa (rwa)(legs)gso bsrung badz+ra rak+ṣa kīrtis ā tsār+ya la zhus pa badz+ra bhai ra'i rak+ṣa'i mtha' can/ sngags thems u pa (rwa)(legs)tad+ya thā/ bya ra bsrung ba/ khyab 'jug karko tra'i 'jug pa la (rwa)(legs)brten nas brtag thabs/ tho rengs kyi dri chur (rwa)(legs)brtag cing bsrung ba/ dug (rwa)(legs)'breng*/ sngags (rwa)(legs)bshal/ khyi smyon gyis rmugs (rwa)(legs)par dug yod med blta ba/ be bum kha pa'i nang gi (rwa)(legs)shog dril gyi gdams pa shin tu gces pa'i skor dpe la dam par mdzod kyi mtha' can/

dmar po mda' gzhu 'geng pa la brten pa'i dbang sdud skal med rnams la sba ba shis kyi mtha' can/ rdo rje 'jigs byed dmar po phyag gnyis pa bsgom thabs/ rgyal po/ btsun mo/ blon 'bangs/ grong khyer sde brgyad sogs dbang du bya ba/ nag po mda' gzhu 'geng ba'i dug sngags 'di las lhag pa yod re skan gyi mtha' can/ rwa chen gyis (mkhan)mdzad pa'i dbang gi chu bo rnams so// gnyis pa dkar chag na ma 'khod pa'i rgya bod kyi yig sna'i skor la/ rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi rgyud rtog pa gsum pa rgya gar gyi mkhan po dī paṃ ka ra dang bod kyi lo tsā ba rdo rje grags kyis bsgyur ba/

'di la dngos grub kyi rtog pa dang 'gyur gcig pa zhig dang o ḍa ya shrī dang rong zam gyi 'gyur yang snang*/ rgyud kyi rgyal po'i las dngos grub kyi rtog pa zhes pa rtog pa bzhi par grags pa a mo gha dang mar do'i 'gyur/ gtam rgyus kyi rtog pa dang las mkhan te'u lo pa chu bya'i rtog pa gnyis bha ros rgyud 'bum pa la gtugs te rgya dpe la phyis bsgyur ba/ rgya ston kun dga' brtson 'grus kyis dge ba'i bshes gnyen yon tan dpal bzang gi ngor mdzad (shar)pa'i rgya bal gyi paṇ+ḍi ta lnga'i rnam par thar pa/ des mdzad pa'i la lī ta badz+ra gyis (shar)nag po skor gsum gyi rgyud au ḍ+yān nas gdan drangs tshul/ rgyud dang bla ma brgyud pa byon tshul gyi lo rgyus don gsum pa rgya ston gyi slob (shar)ma zhig gis mdzad pa/ rdzong lugs zab don bdud rtsi'i bcud (nub)kyi brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs sku bzhi'i ngo bo/ sngags 'chang gzungs kyi dpal bas mdzad pa'i sgrub thabs (nub)rab tu gsang ba yid bzhin gyi nor bu/ tshar chen chos kyi rgyal pos 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i dbang phyug gi ngor mdzad pa'i brgyud 'debs dngos grub rin po che'i snye ma/ des mdzad pa'i dpa' bo gcig pa'i sgrub thabs (mkhan)bdud las rnam par rgyal ba'i bzhad sgra/ des mdzad pa'i rdo rje 'jigs byed lha bcu gsum gyi bskyed rim dang rdzogs rim rwa khrid mkha' 'gro snyan brgyud kyi lam rim dang sbyar ba'i smon lam gyi rab byed lam zab sgrub pa'i dga' ston/ des mdzad pa'i 'jigs byed bcu gsum ma'i shis brjod 'chi med sprin gyi rnga dbyangs/ mkhan chen ngag dbang chos grags kyis mdzad (sa)pa'i bskyed rim gyi rnam bshad bdud rtsi'i bum bzang*/ chos kyi rgyal po 'phags pa rin po ches shing kun tu mdzad pa'i (ldong )dpal chen po'i dkyil 'khor du 'jug cing dbang blang ba'i cho ga

tshar chen rdo rje 'chang gis mdzad pa'i bcu gsum ma'i (mkhan)sgrub dkyil gsal byed lhan thabs nyi gzhon gsar pa'i dga' ston/ thams cad mkhyen pa mkhyen brtse'i dbang phyug gis (mkhan)(ma)mdzad pa'i ngag 'don breng chags nag po 'gro shes/ mthu stobs dbang phyug sngags 'chang bsod nams chos 'phel gyis mdzad pa'i (pu)rwa lugs lha bcu gsum gyi dbang gi chu bo ma nub par bskur ba'i mtshams sbyor gyi yi ge mthong ba don ldan/ rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi bzlas lung bsnyen (rwa)(rdo rje)pa'i man ngag bla ma snya nam pa'i gsung lhag chad med par rwa chos rab kyis gzhon nu 'od kyi ngor mdzad pa/ badz+ra bhai ra wa e ka mu kha bhū dza dī pa'i rjes (sgo)gnang gi zin bris rdo rje 'chang sgo rum pa'i gsung bzhin 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtses mdzad pa/ ngor shar khang shes rab rgyal mtshan gyis mdzad pa'i 'jigs byed dmar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa'i sgrub (a)thabs dang dug dbang bskur tshul gyi man ngag bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun/ paṇa chen ngag dbang chos grags kyis mdzad pa'i dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed chen po rwa lugs kyi dbang gi cho ga las (sa)brtsams pa'i dri ba rtog dpyod sprin gyi rnga gsang gi rang lan dpyid kyi rgyal mo'i dga' ston legs bshad khu phyug gi sgra dbyangs gsar pa/ des mdzad pa'i dbang gi cho ga'i dka' gnad las (sa)brtsams te dris pa'i rang lan snying po mdzub tshugs/ rtog pa bdun gyi gnad bstan pa rwa dharma (rgya)(shar)seng ges mdzad pa'i man ngag gnad bdun ma/ rdo rje 'bum dang rdo rje seng ge sogs kyi ngor rgya ston kun dga' brtson 'grus kyis (rgya)(rigs)mdzad pa'i rtog bdun gyi rnam bshad rdo rje'i tshig gi mdud 'grol/ des mdzad pa'i rtog gsum kyi ṭī ka (shar)dri med snang ba/ rwa dharma seng ges mdzad pa'i te'u lo (shar)pa'i rtog pa'i gsal byed/ rdzogs pa'i rim pa rgya che ba zab pa gnyis su med pa dang bcas par sems 'dzin pa'i man ngag rwa chen gyi gsung sgros/

de'i gsung sgros mtshan ma gyen bsgreng gi man ngag de'i gsung sgros rwa la sems 'dzin pa'i man ngag rje btsun rdo rje bai ta lis la li ta badz+ra la dngos su gnang (rgya)ba'i rwa khrid mkha' 'gro snyan brgyud kyi rtsa ba rdo rje'i tshig rkang*/ de'i gsal byed kun mkhyen mkhyen brtse'i dbang phyug gis mdzad (rgya)pa'i khrid yig 'jam dpal khros pa'i zhal lung snying gi gzungs khrag mkha' 'gro'i kha rlangs can/ grub pa'i dbang phyug la li ta badz+ra gyis mdzad pa'i khrid don (ma)gsal byed rgyal khams lo tsā ba ma ṇi ka shrīs mdzad pa/ phyag mtshan so gnyis kyi las tshogs zhes pa gri gug gis dgra bsad pa/ shāk+tis 'phung bar byed pa/ gtun shing gis rims dbab cing 'dre brdung ba/ chu gris grir 'gum pa/ rdo rje rtse gcig pas gdon bsrung ba/ dgra s+t+was dgra bo tshar gcod pa/ mdung gis cho 'phrul gtong ba/ mda' gzhus sgrub thabs phyogs gcig tu bsdus pa gong du song zin/ lcags kyus mtshan ma 'gugs pa/ dbyug tos nor bsgrub pa/ kha ṭ+wāṃ gas nyams chag sel ba/ 'khor los bgegs bsrung ba/ rdo rjes klu bsrung ba/ tho bas bar chad bsrung ba/ ral gris dmag dpung bzlog pa/ cang te 'us ḍā ki las la 'gyed pa/ thod pas nor bsgrub pa/ mgo bos 'gal ba cham la 'bebs pa/ phub kyis phyir bzlog pa/ rkang pa rlung gi dkyil 'khor gyis skrod pa/ zhags pas lha dang mi'i bu mo 'gugs pa/ rwa'i mda' gzhus bi ṣa bsad pa/ rgyu zhags kyis rims nad bzlog pa/ dril bus nyams chag bskang ba/ lag pas phrin las bsgrub pa/ ro ras kyi 'khor los las kun bsgrub pa/ gsal shing gi ros ro langs bsgrub pa/ me thab kyis sbyin sreg gi cho ga bsgrub la/ thod tshal gyis dgra bo gnad la dbab pa/ sdigs mdzub kyis 'gal ba cham la dbab pa/ 'phen rtse gsum pas 'gro ba dbang du sdud pa/ 'phyar dar gyis phyogs skyong bsdu ba rnams/

shar du 'khrul 'khor/ lhor sbyin sreg nub tu tshogs 'khor/ byang du gtor ma la brten nas (shar)dgra bo sgrol ba'i man ngag bsnyen pa sngags btu ba sgrub pa las sbyor gcig tu bstan pa rwa lo tsā ba rdo rje grags kyis mdzad (shar)pa'i 'jigs byed chen po'i man ngag mngon par rtogs pa'i rim pa lag len du bris pa/ bsod snyoms pa bud+dha shrīs mdzad pa'i gshin rje nag po'i 'khor lo'i gsal byed rgya gar gyi mkhan po jo bo dī paṃ ka ra shrī dzñā na dang lo tsā ba tshul khrims rgyal bas bsgyur ba la rwa chen gyis 'gyur bcos mdzad pa/ 'gor rnal 'byor pa mtshan ma cung zad skyes pas zhes yod pa'i rwa los mdzad pa'i kha sbyor dbye ba bzhi'i yi ge snya nam pa chen po'i thugs dam thun mong ma yin pa'o'i mtha' can/ 'gor rdo rje 'jigs byed chen po'i 'khor lo'i ling tshe bcu drug pa zhes yod pa'i 'khor lo'i gsal byed rwa chen gyi gsung sgros bla ma snya nam pa chen po'i thugs dam thun mong ma yin pa'i gdams pa'o'i mtha' can/ rtsa sngags/ snying po/ nye snying*/ rtsa sngags dang snying po spel ba/ rtsa sngags dang nye snying spel ba/ snying po dang nye snying sbrel ba/ sngags gsum ga sbrel ba ste 'khrul 'khor bdun gyi yi ge gzugs brnyan spel tshig shog dril man ngag dang bcas pa i thi'i mtha' can/ 'gor yan lag bcu gnyis dpe chung 'di zhes yod pa'i 'khrul 'khor bcu gnyis kyi spel tshig lteb tshul sogs kyi yig chung zhes pa'i tshul gyis dri ba'o'i mtha' can/ 'gor zhi ba brgyad la dbus su k+ṣe zhes yod pa'i 'jigs pa brgyad skyob dang sems myos par byed pa chu rba klong gi 'khrul 'khor gyi bar 'khor lo'i kha bsgyur bstan pa/ rwa pa'i man ngag 'di la mkhas grub rjes zur za mdzad pa ni shing gi rtse mor bsdad nas rtsa ba ste'us bsnun pa lta bu'o// 'gor thog mar nye snying gi 'khrul 'khor la zhes yod pa'i rtog bdun nas gsungs pa'i 'khrul 'khor rtsa ba'i dpe chung bri yig logs su shes par bya'o'i mtha' can/

'gor rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi sgrub thabs byed par 'dod pa zhes yod pa'i nyi ma bzhi pa'i gdams pa snyan ma rwa lo'i gsung sgros lo tsā ba phyi mas yi ger btab pa/ rwa chos rab/ des mdzad pa'i 'khrul 'khor gyi man ngag ni zhes 'gor yod pa'i yig chung des nges par 'grub bo'i mtha' can/ des mdzad pa'i 'gor yang dbus na sor brgyad ces yod pa'i 'khor lo'i yig chung bshang lam nas snying gi dkyil lo'i mtha' can/ des mdzad pa'i gtor ma'i phyag len de la gshegs su gsol lo'i mtha' can/ bsad pa las bcu'i gsal byed snya nam rwa'i gdams pa bstan pa bsrung ba ma gtogs gzhan su la'ang bstan par mi bya ba las mthar thug rwa 'bum seng gis mdzad pa/ des mdzad pa'i 'gor/ sku gsum dbyer med bla ma thugs rje can/ zhes yod pa'i gshin rje nyi ma bzhi pa'i man ngag bla ma chen po rwa ye shes seng ge'i gsung la brten pa/ 'gor 'jigs byed kyi 'khrul 'khor byed thabs chos rje rin po che'i zhal nas zhes yod pa'i zhi rgyas dbang gi 'khrul 'khor gyi lag len grangs su brtsi'i zlar mi bgrang gsung ba'i mtha' can/ rgya ston gyis mdzad pa'i rdo rje 'jigs byed kyis bsad pa mtshon cha lta bu'i (rwa)(rgya)(rum)man ngag shog dril dang po'i gsal byed/ des mdzad pa'i shog dril gnyis (rwa)(rgya)(rum)pa'i gsal byed/ des mdzad pa'i shog dril (rwa)(rgya)(rum)gsum pa'i gsal byed/ des mdzad pa'i rwa chen gyis bsad pa'i mtshon cha snying la gab pa'i srung bzlog bsad (rgya)gsum gyi las tshogs man ngag snying po'i don 'di la bcos bslad mi bya'o'i mtha' can/ chos kyi rgyal po 'phags pas rgyal bu byang chub sems dpa' go pe la'i ched du bskul ba la brten nas (ldong )(rigs)ldong shes rab dpal gyis mdzad pa'i zhi rgyas dbang drag gi 'khrul 'khor las tshogs drag po'i sngags gter/ thams cad mkhyen pa bu ston rin po ches mdzad pa'i 'khrul 'khor gyi lag (bu)len gsal bar byed pa gnad kyi man ngag

'khrul 'khor ltab pa'i zhal shes yig chung gsang ba'i gnad yig kun (grub)la med pa'i khyad chos rdo rje 'chang dbang phyug rab brtan gyi gsung rgyun 'di ni gshin rje mkhan po phal cher la ming tsam yang ma grags pa'i zab gnad can yin pas/ mjug tu/ e ma rwa lo'i thugs bcud mkha' 'gro'i gtam// snyan brgyud zab mo'i yang snying pad+mo'i gnyen// snod min kun+da'i phreng ba zum byed pa// skal bzang blo mtshor rol cig sa ma ya// zhes so// thugs sras lo tsā bas mdzad pa'i zhi ba'i (bu)sbyin sreg gi cho ga nyon mongs sreg byed rwa chen lo tsā ba'i bzhed pa thun mong ma yin pa dbyu gu drug cu rtsa bzhi lcags mkhar zur drug pa'i cho ga (gzungs)dpal ldan bla ma dam pa bsod nams rgyal mtshan gyis rat+na lak+ṣa'i ngor mdzad pa bdud sde 'joms pa zhes bya ba/ bdag chen rdo rje 'chang blo gros rgyal mtshan gyis mdzad pa'i 'jigs byed (kha)drug cu pa'i gtor chog dgra bo'i srog 'phrog rdzong chung pa ā nan+da ma tis rgya ston gyi yi ge la brten nas mdzad pa'i rwa pa'i man ngag (shar)thun mong ma yin pa lcags mkhar zur dgu pa'i 'jigs byed drug cu pa/ rdo rje 'chang pha bong kha ba'i phyag len dang mi gcig par snang*/ bzlas pa'i man ngag dang gtor ma drug cu rtsa bzhi'i phyag len (shar)rgya ston dang 'dzam gling mkhas pa'i khyad bcas/ 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtses mdzad pa'i (dpang )gtor ma drug cu rtsa bzhi zhal bsgyur ba'i man ngag yi ge bzhi pa la brten pa'i bsrung ba'i man ngag 'gor rang nyid 'jigs byed dmar po shin tu khros pa zhes yod pa gsol ba gdab bo'i mtha' can/ yi ge bzhi pa la brten nas 'gong po gdug pa can gnod na bsad pa rta shi'i kha bzhin sdoms kyi mtha' can/ 'gor rang nyid skad cig dran rdzogs la 'jam dpal khros pa zhes yod pa'i srung bzlog bsad pa gsum gyi man ngag zab mo i thi'i mtha' can/

'gor srung ba'i 'khor lo ni lte bar hūm̐ zhes yod pa/ 'gor mu khyud rdo rje phyed pa nang du 'khor lo rtsibs brgyad ces yod pa'i bzlog 'khor/ 'gor yang lte bar hūm̐ gsham nas g.yon skor du zhes yod pa'i srung 'khor bri yig 'gor rang nyid 'phags pa 'jam dpal du bsgom zhes yod pa'i yi ge bzhi pa'i srung bzlog bsad gsum gyi man ngag 'gor oṃ swasti/ sems bskyed pa ni bdag dang sems can thams cad mi dang mi ma yin zhes yod pa'i yi ge bzhi pa'i srung (rwa)(nub)bzlog rbad pa zhal gdams dang bcas pa khyad par du 'phags pa'o'i mtha' can/ yi ge bzhi pa'i srung bzlog bsad mnan bsam gtan nyal (nub)chog gi gdams pa theg mchog zla ba'i dbang pos mdzad pa/ rwa lo tsā ba rdo rje grags kyis bal po thugs rje chen po la gser srang lnga brgya phul (rwa)(nub)(rum)bar zhal gyis bzhes nas gnang ba'i drag po bzhi'i srung bzlog yi ger mi 'dri ba'i bka' rgya can/ 'gor bdag nyid 'phags pa 'jam dpal zhes yod pa'i yi ge (nub)bzhi pa'i man ngag nyi ma dang sprad do'i mtha' can/ 'gor rang nyid skad cig dran rdzogs la zhes yod pa'i yi ge bzhi pa'i (rwa)(nub)srung bzlog bsad gsum gyi man ngag zab mo'i mtha' can/ bha ya nā sa la brten pa'i byad bzlog thams cad kyis tshugs par mi 'gyur ro'i mtha' can/ btsan po'i mkhar du gzhug pa/ rno gsum mtshon la ngar btags pa/ gdos dang sha ba 'thab pa/ sgyogs rdo bar snang la gcag pa ste rwa rgan (shar)lo tsā'i khyad chos uṣ+ṇī ṣa'i srung bzlog mnan gsad rgya ston gyis bsgrigs pa/ des mdzad pa'i uṣ+ṇī ṣa'i (shar)gdams pa don lnga pa/ des mdzad pa'i man ngag thugs kyi nying khu (shar)zhes par nang gses bsam gtan sgra'i bzlas pa/ phrin las rnam bzhi'i bzlas pa/ ting 'dzin gnad kyi man ngag gdug byed phur pas ngag bcing ba/ rmi lam ngan pa bzlog pa/ mthu byed bsad pa/

ngag mnan dang bcas pa rwa lo'i man ngag byad ma phye mar 'thags pa (shar)rwa'i man ngag thod pa/ phur pa/ 'khor lo/ rang gshed la brten nas bsad pa'i dus man ngag nyams su len pa'i (shar)rim pa zhes bsgom pa/ sngags/ yungs kar/ khrag phur bus bsad pa gza' rgyu ba dang bstun no'i mtha' can/ rgya ston kun dga' brtson 'grus kyi dngos slob bod log dang star ma bye bzang gnyis kha mthun du byung ba'i man ngag (shar)dpal ldan grags pas tshigs bcad du bsdebs pa'i don gsal bar bstan pa/ rdzas la brten pa'i gtad (shar)rul/ ting nge 'dzin la (shar)brten pa'i gtad rul/ ngag (shar)'grol 'gor/ dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed khro bo'i rgyal po la phyag 'tshal lo// zhes (ma)yod pa'i uṣ+ṇī ṣa'i bsrung bzlog man ngag lag len dmar khrid phyogs med lo tsā bas gsal bar bkod pa/ des mdzad pa'i 'gor/ dpal khro bo'i rgyal po la phyag 'tshal lo// 'dir bdag gzhan thams cad kyi lus (ma)srung bar byed pa zhes yod pa'i srung 'khor gyi bri yig des mdzad pa'i 'gor gnyis pa bzlog pa'i 'khor lo ni snga ma lta bu la/ ming spel gyi mthar zhes yod pa'i bzlog 'khor bri yig des mdzad pa'i 'gor ṇi?ḥ dpal ldan khro bo chen po la phyag 'tshal lo// ming dang rnam shes sba ba la zhes yod (ma)pa'i uṣ+ṇī ṣa'i srung 'khor rmi lam ngan pa bzlog pa byad ma mkhan gyi bsod nams nyams thabs byas pas mi tshugs pa dang bcas pa/ des mdzad pa'i bzlog pa'i rnal 'byor khyad (ma)par can rngon pa nyi ma lde zhing gdos dang sha ba 'thab pa lta bu'i man ngag des mdzad pa'i uṣ+ṇī ṣa'i sgo (ma)nas dam nyams gsod pa'i mtshon cha/ des brag dkar chos sdings su bkod pa'i bsrung bzlog (ma)gnyis kyi man ngag sngags pa nang 'gras dang bsad pa gzhan du gsal ba'i mtha' can/ des mdzad pa'i uṣ+ṇī ṣa'i bskul (ma)rnam dag zhi ba ma/ des mdzad pa'i bstod pa (ma)thugs rje'i dbang khros ma/

las kyi gshin rje chos kyi rgyal po'i sgrub thabs la li ta badz+ra gyis mdzad pa bal po thugs rje chen po dang rwa lo rdo rje grags kyis bsgyur ba/ ro ras dang thod pa la brten nas las gshin sgrub cing bsnyen sgrub bsad pa'i man ngag lo tsā ba phyi mas yi ger btab pa/ las kyi gshin rje srid pa'i 'khor lo'i man ngag rwa chen gyis lcags sgom ras pa la gnang ba srid pa'i 'khor lo rdzogs byang gi mtha' can/ dge 'dun gtsug lag khang bsrung ba'i gshin rje srid pa'i 'khor lo bka' rgya dam po yod do i thi'i mtha' can/ las kyi gshin rje gnam lcags ur chung gi gdams pa zhes pa srung bzlog bsad pa'i sngags bzlog pa yin na sngags bzla zhing bsad pa l+h+wam mthu ma dang bcas pa sus kyang mi shigs pa'i man ngag lags so'i mtha' can/ las kyi gshin rje'i yig chung*/ drag sngags hur thum srog len dmar po snya nam pa'i man ngag yig chung zab mo rdzogs byang gi mtha' can/ dkon mchog gi bstan dgra ya ma rnams kyis 'dul bar khas blangs tshul/ 'chi bdag las kyi gshin rje gnad la phab nas dgra bgegs sgrol ba'i yi ge drag sngags kyi rgyan du dgos pa'i yig chung i thi'i mtha' can/ 'chi bdag sgrub (rgya)thabs gshes gnyen tshul khrims bla mas bskul ba'i ngor rgya ston gyis mdzad pa/ chos kyi rgyal po lha bcu gsum gyi mchod pa'i cho ga (rtsa)(bik+ṣu)khrom yon nam mkha' lhun bzang gis mdzad pa/ tshar chen chos kyi rgyal pos las dang po pa'i rig 'dzin rnams la phan pa'i ched du mdzad pa'i (mkhan)las kyi gshin rje 'khor dang bcas pa la mchod gtor 'bul ba'i cho ga 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i dbang phyug gis mdzad pa'i dam can gshin rje'i rgyal po'i mngon rtogs spyan 'dren (dbang )gtor 'bul bstod pa dang bcas pa'i chog sgrigs/ des mdo khams pa sbyin pa dpal bzang gi ngor mdzad pa'i 'chi bdag (mkhan)()gshin rje'i dbang phyug chos kyi rgyal po'i thugs dam bskang ba mi bzad 'jam dpal ma/

mkhan chen bslab gsum rgyal mtshan gyis mdzad (dbang )pa'i las gshin gyi bskang rdzas byin rlabs/ de'i rjes gnang gi yi ge rwa shes rab rgyal mtshan gyis bkod pa/ las gshin bcu gsum ma'i rjes gnang gi yi ge thar gling (bik+ṣu)ār+ya de was bkod pa/ las gshin dpa' bo gcig pa'i rjes gnang gi tho (dbang )kun mkhyen mkhyen brtse'i zhabs kyis mdzad pa/ gshin rje dmar nag gsum gyi rjes gnang gi (sa)cho ga'i lag len shin tu gsal ba rdo rje 'chang tshar pa chos rjes mdzad pa/ gshin rje dmar po ma ru tse bzhis bskor du (dzñā)grags pa snying la brten pa'i phyi sgrub/ spyang thod la brten pa'i nang sgrub/ nal gri'i thod par brten pa'i gsang sgrub/ ra spyang gi thod par brten pa'i gsang chen chig dril/ gtor chog bstod pa dang bcas pa rdo rje dbal ba'i don du rgya ston gyis mdzad pa/ las kyi gshin rje khrag mdog yab yum gyi bsnyen sgrub (dpal)las gsum gyi man ngag rwa dbon shes rab rgyal mtshan gyis mdzad pa dge bas bstan pa bsrung bar shog gi mtha' can/ de'i gtor chog rjes gnang dang bcas (dpal)pa'i cho ga rnams so// gsum pa bod kyi mkhas pa 'bri gung dpal 'dzin gyis mdzad pa'i skor la/ kun dga' dbang phyug gis bskul pa'i ngor mdzad pa'i rtog pa gsum pa'i rgyas 'grel rin po che'i snye ma/ rtog pa gsum pa'i tshig gis mtshams bcad cing don gyi go rim bsdu ba/ dpal rtog pa gsum pa'i 'khrul 'khor gyi cho ga khams gsum gyi 'khor los sgyur ba khrag skyugs kyi lo chos dkar nam mkha'i rdzong du mdzad pa/ de las drag shul spyod pa'i cho ga zhib mo gud du bstan pa zad pa'i lo nag pa zla ba'i dkar tshes bzhi la mdzad pa/ rtog pa gsum pa'i man ngag gi zhal shes lnga pa zhes pa snyan brgyud yi ge med pa'i zin bris mdangs dkar snying rje'i rdzong du mdzad pa/ rtog pa gsum pa'i 'khrul 'khor rdzong ri rtse dgu'i mgul du mdzad pa/

thar pa'i rgyal srid la gnas pa'i dge sbyong chen po'i bkas bskul ba la brten nas 'khrul 'khor gyi lung sbyor rin chen 'od kyi sgron ma/ dpal rtog pa bdun pa'i 'khrul 'khor gyi cho ga 'khor lo rin po che'i bang mdzod chos dkar nam mkha'i rdzong du mdzad pa/ de la mkho ba'i zin bris 'gor rtog bdun gyi rgyas 'grel slob dpon mi bskyod pas mdzad ces yod pa rang bzo med par 'gyur ro'i mtha' can/ bcom ldan 'das dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi bsnyen sgrub lag tu blang ba'i rim pa snying gtam glen pa'i tshig tu btsun pa kun dga' dbang phyug la gdams pa/ rtags kyi yi ge zhib mo khrag skyugs kyi lo lhun gyis grub pa'i rdzong du mdzad pa/ rtsa ba'i sngags kyi bzlas pa'i tshul nges pa seng ge'i nga ro me byi mtshur phu'i gtsug lag khang du mdzad pa/ drag po'i las kyi bzlas pa rdo rje 'bar ba'i mtshon cha me byi mtshur phu'i gtsug lag khang du mdzad pa/ 'di sngags sdebs yin 'dug pa gsar ma phyogs la grags chung bas dpal 'dzin rtsa ba gsang sngags rnying ma bar song gshis snga 'gyur bka' gter gyi man ngag zab mo nas rku thabs kyi tshul du bris par mngon no// mdo khams tre shod pa rtogs ldan bsod nams dpal gyis bskul ba la brten nas thang skya'i gtsug lag khang du mdzad pa'i las thams cad pa'i sbyin sreg dngos grub kyi gzi brjid rab snang*/ zhi rgyas kyi sbyin sreg nyes pa'i tshang tshing ma lus pa sreg par nus pa bsod nams kyi nyi ma bdun 'bar mtshur phu'i gtsug lag khang du mdzad pa/ rgyud rtog pa bdun pa'i 'khrul 'khor gyi skabs su khyim du bzhag na zhi bar 'gyur ro zhes pa'i man ngag zhi ba'i dngos grub bsgrub pa'i cho ga bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho/ de'i yan lag 'jigs pa zhi ba'i srung 'khor/ mtshon srung ba/ tshe sgrub dang bcas pa gtsang rong dmu lha sham+bhar gyi gtsug lag khang du mdzad pa/

yang gnas de nyid du mdzad pa'i rgyas pa'i las bsgrub pa'i cho ga yid bzhin gyi nor bu rin po che 'bar ba yan lag dang bcas pa/ dbang du bya ba'i cho ga don yod pa'i zhags pa rnam par g.yo ba/ de'i yan lag 'gugs pa'i cho ga lcags kyu 'bar ba/ bskyed rdzogs kyi rim pa gang rung gi lam gyi grogs su rig pa'i skyes bu 'gugs pa zhu ba'i bsam gtan rig ma mi bsrun pa 'dul thabs bu mo rengs pa'i sbyor ba rnams me byi sham+bhar dpal gyi yang dgon du mdzad pa/ dbang dang 'gugs pa'i cho ga 'jig rten gsum rnam par gnon pa mtshur phu'i gtsug lag khang du mdzad pa/ drag po'i cho ga gshin rje'i gzugs la brten nas dgra sde 'phung bar bya ba'i man ngag 'jig rten gsum gyi bshan pa chen po rnam par rol pa skal ldan sbyin pa rin chen gyi ched du mdzad pa/ 'jig rten gsum gyi bshan pa chen po rnam par rol pa ma grub na spogs pa'i cho ga 'jig rten gsum za ba me pho byi ba'i lor mdzad pa/ bsad pa'i phrin las ga'u sro ba'i man ngag sa gsum rnam par 'joms pa'i 'khrul 'khor me byi mtshur phu'i gtsug lag khang du mdzad pa/ yang gnas de nyid du mdzad pa'i sdig pa sbyong ba'i cho ga sbyin sreg dang 'khrul 'khor sbrags pa 'jig rten gsum phung bar byed pa/ mdza' ba dbye bar byed pa sham+bhar du mdzad pa/ yang gnas de nyid du mdzad pa'i sdang ba yul nas dbyung ba bskrad pa'i 'khrul 'khor/ gnas de nyid du mdzad pa'i g.yam pa la brten nas rengs pa'i cho ga 'jig rten gsum rnam par g.yo ba/ gnas de nyid du mdzad pa'i te'u lo pa'i pags pa la brten nas rengs pa'i cho ga 'jig rten gsum rnam par 'ching ba/ gnas de nyid du mdzad pa'i yan lag mtshon gyis 'bugs pa'i man ngag 'jig rten gsum pham par byed pa/ srin pos 'dzin pa'i cho ga las kyi srin po zhes bya ba mtshur phur mdzad pa/ yang de nyid du mdzad pa'i rims nad gtang ba'i man ngag rims nad chen po 'khrug pa/

yang gnas de nyid du mdzad pa'i smyo bar byed pa'i cho ga drag po'i bzhad gad chen po/ drag shul spyod pa'i gtor ma drug cu rtsa bzhi'i cho ga sdig can sgrol ba'i mtshon cha ngar ma mdangs dkar snying rje rdzong du mdzad pa/ lugs srol 'di la lcags mkhar mi rtsig pa'i phyogs su mdzad nas/ lcags mkhar zur dgu pa dang zur bcu drug pa sogs spro na byar rung gi 'on kyang rnying ma ba ltar blos btags nas byas pa yin pas rgyud rgya gzhung gi khungs ni med la zhes zur za ba ni/ spyir kun rdzob kyi chos thams cad blos btags nas byas pa kho na yin pas gzhung lugs dang 'gal zhing rgyud rgya gzhung gi khungs med bzhin du gsar ma ba rnams spro na byar rung ba'i dam bcar song bas ma thob pa'i gzhung cig 'dir shor bar gda'o// ma 'grub na gnad la dbab pa'i cho ga sa gsum nges par 'joms pa me byi mtshur phur mdzad pa/ yang de nyid du mdzad pa'i bsad pa'i sbyin sreg gi cho ga dus kyi me lce 'bar ba chen po'i phreng ba/ rtsa sngags kyi 'khrul 'khor bri ba'i zin bris bris pas chog go'i mtha' can/ rtog bdun 'khrul 'khor mchog gi man ngag rdzong ri rtse dgu'i mgul du brjed byang du mdzad pa/ las kyi gshin rje yab yum sbrags te bsgrub pa'i man ngag dug ha la ha la chen po zhes pa lhun gyis grub pa'i rdzong du sbyar ba rnams so// 'jigs byed kyi 'khrul 'khor gyi cho ga 'jig rten gsum las rnam par rgyal ba zhes pa dang gtor ma'i cho ga'i lag len bsod nams kyi 'od zer rnam par spel ba'i nyi ma zhes bya ba gnyis kyi lung rgyun deng sang mi 'dug gtor ma'i cho ga 'di la zhi rgyas dbang drag gi drug cu pa'i khyad par sogs legs bshad ngo mtshar ba snang*/ 'di gnyis gshin rje gshed skor la shin tu mkhas pas rgya gar gyi slob dpon dpal 'dzin dang 'dra zhes gleng bar brten mtshan de ltar thogs so// de ltar gong du smos pa'i smin grol rnams legs par thob pa las/

dbang gi brgyud pa dang po ni 'jam dpal dbyangs drag por khros pa dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed/ rgyal yum rdo rje ro langs ma/ grub chen la li ta badz+ra/ rdo rje gdan pa/ don yod rdo rje/ paṇa grub ye shes 'byung gnas sbas pa/ grub thob pad+ma badz+ra/ bal po bha ro phyag rdum/

dī paṃ ka ra rak+ṣi ta dang gcig mthu stobs dbang phyug rwa lo tsā ba rdo rje grags/ rwa lo tsā ba chos rab/ rwa ye shes seng ge rwa 'bum seng*/ rong pa rgwa lo rnam rgyal rdo rje/ khams pa rgwa lo'i skye bar grags pas de ltar du thogs/ de sras rong pa shes rab seng ge bag ston gzhon nu tshul khrims/ bla ma tshul khrims rgyal mtshan/ kun mkhyen shes rab dpal bzang*/ rwa lo gnyis pa dge ba rgyal mtshan/ grwa thang pa shes rab zla ba'i dbang po/ rje btsun rdo ring pa chen po kun bzang chos kyi nyi ma/ 'jam dpal dus dgra'i dbang po tshar pa chos rje/ kun mkhyen mkhyen brtse'i dbang phyug sngags 'chang dgon gsar ba bsod nams chos 'phel/ rdo rje 'chang dbang phyug rab brtan/ khyab bdag mgon po bsod nams mchog ldan/ mkhan chen ngag dbang rnam rgyal/ mkhan chen bzang po rgyal mtshan/ rdo rje 'chang ngag dbang kun dga' lhun grub/ gnas gsar ba ngag dbang kun dga' legs pa'i 'byung gnas/ rdo rje 'dzin pa chen po bla ma kun dga' rgya mtsho/ des bdag ban+de tshul khrims rin chen la stsal to// yang brgyud lugs gcig la/ tshar chen rdo rje 'chang*/ 'jam mgon mkhyen brtse'i dbang phyug de las mkhan chen bslab gsum rgyal mtshan/ sngags 'chang bsod nams chos 'phel/ rje bsod nams tshul khrims gsum gyis gsan/ yab sras lnga char las rdo rje 'chang dbang phyug rab brtan gyis gsan pa man 'dra/ yang na rong pa sher seng nas/ 'phags 'od yon tan rgya mtsho/ spang khang pa grags pa dpal bzang*/ kun mkhyen gangs khrod pa/ sa bzang ma ti paṇa chen/ de dbon sa bzang 'phags pa gzhon nu blo gros/ ngor chen rdo rje 'chang kun dga' bzang po/ gu ge paṇa chen grags pa rgyal mtshan/ 'jam dbyangs nam mkha' brtan pa/ rje btsun sgo rum pa kun dga' legs pa'i blo gros/ tshar chen rdo rje 'chang man 'dra'o// sa bcad dang po dang gnyis pa'i rwa rtags yod pa dang*/ rtags gang yang med pa rnams kyi lung gi brgyud pa ni/

mkhan chen bzang po rgyal mtshan yan dbang gi brgyud pa dang po dang 'dra la/ de nas rmor chen ngag dbang kun dga' lhun grub/ skyor mda' ba bsod nams dbang phyug mkhan chen thams cad mkhyen pa dpal ldan chos skyong*/ de nyid kyi mkhyen brtse nus pas rjes su bzung ba bdag tshul khrims rin chen la'o// yang na mkhan chen bzang po rgyal mtshan/ mkhas btsun nam mkha' dpal bzang*/ des bdag la'o// yang kun gyi rtags can gyi lung brgyud lugs gcig la/ rwa 'bum seng yan gong ltar la/ de nas rwa dkon mchog seng ge rgwa lo rnam rgyal rdo rje/ de sras shes rab seng ge 'phags 'od yon tan rgya mtsho/ brtse chen grub chen kun blo/ rig pa'i dbang phyug dge ba rgyal mtshan/ rje rin chen rnam rgyal/ mus chen sangs rgyas rin chen/ rje btsun kun dga' legs pa'i blo gros/ mkhyen brtse'i zhabs man 'dra/ dbang brgyud gsum pa gong dkar ba'i lugs dang ldong rtags can gyi lung brgyud ni/ rwa 'bum seng*/ klog skya dbang phyug grags/ ldong ston shes rab dpal/ chos kyi rgyal po 'phags pa blo gros rgyal mtshan/ shar gling pa rgyal mtshan bzang po/ sgo rum pa dkon mchog rgyal mtshan/ bla ma tshul khrims rgyal mtshan/ chos rje bsod nams rgyal mtshan/ mkhan chen seng ge dpal ba/ brag thog pa bsod nams bzang po/ kun mkhyen rdo rje gdan pa kun dga' rnam rgyal/ bla ma bsod nams mchog ldan/ 'bras spungs pa tshe dbang bkra shis/ tshar chen rdo rje 'chang chen po/ 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i dbang phyug man sngar dang 'dra/ yang na 'phags pa rin po che nas/ gan pa chos rgyal/ gan pa chos rin/ gan pa rin rgyal/ mkhan chen shes rab rdo rje/ chos sgo ba chos dpal shes rab/ brag thog pa man 'dra/ yang dbang gi brgyud pa lugs gcig dang*/ sa bcad dang po yongs rdzogs dang rigs kyi rtags can rnams kyi lung brgyud lugs gcig la/ rong pa shes rab seng ge nas/

mnyam med grags pa rgyal mtshan/ sngags 'chang gzungs kyi dpal ba/ chos rje dge legs bzang po/ bla chen chos dpal bzang po/ rtsa brgyad pa dbang ston bkra shis bzang po/ bya btang bsam 'grub rgyal mtshan/ sngags 'chang rdo rje rgyal mtshan/ rje nam mkha' dpal bzang*/ mang thos dpal ldan chos skyong*/ mchog gi sprul sku rig 'dzin legs ldan rje/ 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i dbang phyug man 'dra/ yang dbang brgyud lugs gcig la/ rwa 'bum seng nas/ rwa dharma seng ge rwa dkon mchog seng ge rwa chen shes rab rgyal mtshan/ rgya ston dbang phyug rgyal mtshan/ rgya ston kun dga' brtson 'grus/ khams pa yon tan 'bum/ bla ma brtson 'grus bzang po/ dmar ston rgyal mtshan 'od zer/ grub chen bzang po rgyal mtshan/ 'brom pa 'jigs byed pa ye shes rgyal mtshan/ rwa chen bsod nams rgyal mtshan/ kun mkhyen mkhyen brtse man 'dra/ yang na gu ge paṇa chen nas/ glo bo mkhan chen bsod nams lhun grub/ ngor chen lha mchog seng ge rwa chen bsod nams rgyal mtshan/ mkhyen brtse'i zhabs man 'dra/ yang dbang brgyud lugs gcig la/ khams ston yon tan 'bum nas/ mchod rten dkar po ba sangs rgyas skyabs/ lha rin po che bsod nams rin chen/ jo gdan khrom yon nam mkha' lhun bzang*/ rje rin chen rnam rgyal/ chos rje nor bu phun tshogs/ chos rje dpal ldan bkra shis/ chos lung shar gling pa 'khrul zhig kun bzang mthu stobs dpal 'bar/ 'jam mgon mkhyen brtse man 'dra/ yang rwa khrid mkha' 'gro snyan brgyud kyi nyams khrid dang rgya rtags can gyi lung brgyud ni/ rwa 'bum seng yan dbang brgyud ltar las/ de nas rwa dharma seng ge rwa dkon mchog seng ge rwa shes rab rgyal mtshan/ rgya ston dbang phyug rgyal mtshan/ rgya ston kun dga' brtson 'grus/ mkhan chen dang ma ba brtson 'grus byang chub/ nyan po ba slob dpon kun dga' rgya mtsho/ dbur stod pa yon tan chos rin/

yer pa ba brtson 'grus rgya mtsho/ mal gro ba grub chen chos skyong rgyal mtshan/ mdo khams pa bla chen yon tan rgya mtsho/ rdo rje 'chang tshar chen blo gsal rgya mtsho/ kun mkhyen mkhyen brtse'i dbang phyug mkhan chen bslab gsum rgyal mtshan/ rdo rje 'chang dbang phyug rab brtan/ khyab bdag gnas gsar ba mgon po bsod nams mchog ldan/ mkhan chen ngag dbang rnam rgyal/ mkhan chen bzang po rgyal mtshan/ dus dgra'i dbang po ngag dbang kun dga' lhun grub/ de nyid kyis bdag tshul khrims rin chen la nyams khrid smin rgyas su stsal to// rnal 'byor bzhi rim gyi nyams khrid kyi brgyud pa ni/ rwa 'bum seng yan dbang brgyud ltar la/ de nas rwa shes rab rgyal mtshan/ rgya ston kun dga' brtson 'grus/ mkhan chen dang ma ba/ mkhan chen shes rab rdo rje/ nyang stod ār+ya de wa/ brtse chen grub chen kun blo/ ra lo gnyis pa dge ba rgyal mtshan/ rje rin chen rnam rgyal/ mus chen sangs rgyas rin chen/ sa lo 'jam dpal rdo rje/ thams cad mkhyen pa dkon mchog lhun grub/ rdo rje 'chang sangs rgyas seng ge thar rtse pa chen po nam mkha' dpal bzang*/ ngag dbang mchog legs rdo rje/ 'khor lo'i mgon po mkhyen rab bstan 'dzin bzang po/ rdo rje 'chang mkhyen rab byams pa ngag dbang lhun grub/ ngag dbang kun dga' lhun grub/ des bdag tshul khrims rin chen la'o// yang ma rtags can gyi lung brgyud ni/ slob dpon ye shes 'byung gnas sbas pa nas/ kha che paṇa chen shākya shrī/ dbon chung bhū mi shrī/ paṇa chen bi ma la shrī/ paṇ+ḍi ta bi d+ya ā ka ra/ paṇ+ḍi ta sar+yā shrī/ lo tsā ba shrī māṃ bo dhi/ rgyal khams lo tsā ba ma ṇi ka shrī/ sa bzang 'phags pa gzhon nu blo gros/ ngor chen rdo rje 'chang kun dga' bzang po/ paṇ+ḍi ta grags pa rgyal mtshan/ 'jam dbyangs nam mkha' brtan pa/ 'gos ston rdo rje seng ge tshar chen rdo rje 'chang chen po/ 'jam mgon mkhyen brtse'i dbang phyug man 'dra'o//

༈ /dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed dpa' bo gcig pa zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa'i rjes gnang dang sgo rtags can gyi lung brgyud ni/ rje btsun sgo rum pa chen po yan ngor chen brgyud par bzhugs pa'i dbang brgyud ltar las/ de nas 'jam mgon mkhyen brtse'i dbang phyug thub bstan mkhan chen byams pa rab brtan/ rdo rje 'chang dbang phyug rab brtan/ mkhan chen rdo rje 'chang rin chen bsod nams mchog grub/ rdo rje 'chang mkhyen rab byams pa ngag dbang lhun grub/ bka' drin zla bral rmor chen ngag dbang kun dga' lhun grub/ des bdag ban+de tshul khrims rin chen la'o// nye brgyud ni/ dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed nas/ rje btsun sgo rum pa man 'dra zhing*/ rje dbang rab yan la bla ma bzhi yod pas oṃ āḥhūm̐ hoḥyin gsung ngo*// yang na mkhyen brtse'i zhabs nas/ byams pa rab brtan/ 'dren mchog snying rje bzang po/ mkhyen rab bstan 'dzin bzang po/ byams pa ngag dbang lhun grub/ rdo rje 'chang ngag dbang kun dga' lhun grub/ des bdag la'o// yang dug dbang rma bya rgyas pa'i dbang dang*/ ā'i rtags can gyi lung brgyud ni/ gtsug tor 'khor los sgyur ba/ dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed/ ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro ma/ la li ta badz+ra/ a mo gha badz+ra/ dzñā na ā ka ra gup+ta/ pad+ma badz+ra/ bal po thugs rje chen po/ rwa lo tsā ba rdo rje grags/ rwa chos rab/ rwa ye shes seng ge rwa 'bum seng*/ rgwa lo yab sras gnyis/ mnyam med grags pa rgyal mtshan/ mkhas grub gzungs kyi dpal ba/ bla ma seng ge dpal/ mkhas grub dge ba rgyal mtshan/ rje rin chen rnam rgyal/ rje sangs rgyas rin chen/ ngor chen lha mchog seng ge rje bud+dha singha*/ brang ti nam mkha' dpal bzang*/ ngag dbang mchog legs rdo rje/ rdo rje 'chang kun dga' lhun grub bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po/ mkhan chen thams cad mkhyen pa dpal ldan chos skyong*/ des bdag la'o// yang na mus chen sangs rgyas rin chen nas/

thams cad mkhyen pa dkon mchog lhun grub/ rje shar khang pa shes rab rgyal mtshan/ thar rtse paṇa chen nam mkha' dpal bzang man 'dra'o// mkhan rtags can gyi lung brgyud ni/ bo dong mkhan chen bslab gsum rgyal mtshan/ rdo rje 'chang dbang rab man 'dra'o// rdo rje'i rtags can gyi lung brgyud gcig la/ rwa shar ba ltar na/ rwa chos rab nas/ rdzong chung ba'i gsan yig na rwa dharma seng ge rwa dkon mchog seng ge shes rab rgyal mtshan gsum la rwa nub pa/ de sras dharma seng ge rwa dkon mchog seng ge rwa shes rab rgyal mtshan/ rgya ston rwa tsho shar pa yin zer ba 'dug dbang phyug rgyal mtshan/ rgya ston kun dga' brtson 'grus/ mkhas pa yon tan 'bum/ bsam yas mchod rten dkar po ba sangs rgyas skyabs/ lha bsod nams rin chen/ khrom yon nam mkha' lhun bzang*/ rje dpal 'dzin bzang po/ kun mkhyen rdo rje gdan pa/ bla ma bsod nams mchog ldan/ 'bras spungs pa tshe dbang bkra shis/ tshar chen rdo rje 'chang chen po man 'dra'o// rwa nub pa ltar na/ rwa chos rab nas/ rdzong pa'i gsan yig na ye shes seng ge dang 'bum seng gnyis la rwa shar pa/ rwa tsho nub pa zer ba 'dug sras ye shes seng ge rwa 'bum seng*/ rje btsun rgwa lo/ mang mkhar lo tsā ba mchog ldan/ bla ma dpal ldan seng ge bla ma seng ge rgyal mtshan/ zhang ston bsod nams grags/ 'bri khung dpal 'dzin gyi bla ma chos lung mkhan chen yin/ gnyan ston rdo rje grags/ khrom yon nam mkha' lhun bzang man 'dra/ mus rtags can gyi lung brgyud ni/ 'jam mgon mkhyen brtse yan dbang brgyud thog ma ltar las/ de nas drin chen sbas pa'i rnal 'byor/ khyab bdag dbang phyug rab brtan/ rje btsun bka' 'gyur ba man 'dra'o// ༈ /thams cad mkhyen pa dkon mchog lhun grub kyis mdzad pa'i sgrub thabs dang rjes gnang gi yi ge'i steng nas 'chi bdag las kyi gshin rje dam can chos kyi rgyal po lha bcu gsum gyi rjes gnang thun mong ma yin pa thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/

bcom ldan 'das rdo rje 'jigs byed/ ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro ma/ grub chen la li ta badz+ra/ a mo gha badz+ra/ ye shes 'byung gnas sbas pa/ pad+ma badz+ra/ dī paṃ ka ra rak+ṣi ta/ rwa lo tsā ba rdo rje grags/ rwa chos rab/ rwa ye shes seng ge rwa 'bum seng*/ rong pa rgwa lo/ lo tsā ba mchog ldan/ bla ma dpal ldan seng ge bla ma seng ge rgyal mtshan/ zhang ston bsod nams grags/ gnyan ston rdo rje grags/ jo gdan nam mkha' lhun bzang*/ sngags 'chang rin chen rnam rgyal/ mus chen sangs rgyas rin chen/ sa lo tsā ba kun dga' bsod nams/ ngor chen thams cad mkhyen pa dkon mchog lhun grub/ mtshungs med dkon mchog dpal ldan/ brang ti nam mkha' dpal bzang*/ dbon nam mkha' sangs rgyas/ rje dam chos pa/ mkhas grub chen po sangs rgyas phun tshogs/ dus dgra'i dbang po bkra shis lhun grub/ des bdag ban+de tshul khrims rin chen la bka' drin du stsal to// yang na mkhas grub sangs rgyas phun tshogs/ mtshungs med 'dren pa kun dga' bstan 'dzin/ des bdag ban+de tshul khrims rin chen la'o// ngor pa dpon slob sangs rgyas tshul khrims pa las kyang thob bo// yang na rje sangs rgyas rin chen nas/ rje dkon mchog lhun grub/ shar khang pa/ brang ti pa/ shar chen khu dbon/ khu bo bdag chen kun dga' bkra shis/ dbon shes rab 'byung gnas/ rje dam chos sogs/ yang na brang ti pa/ mkhas grub dpal ldan don grub/ de las nam mkha' sangs rgyas dang shes rab 'byung gnas gnyis kyis gsan/ de man 'dra/ yang na rje dkon mchog lhun grub/ dkon mchog dpal ldan/ byams pa kun dga' bkra shis man 'dra'o// ༈ /las gshin dpa' gcig yab yum gyi rjes gnang thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ rgyal ba rdo rje 'chang chen/ ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro rdo rje ro langs ma/ grub chen la li ta badz+ra/ a mo gha badz+ra/ ye shes 'byung gnas sbas pa'i dpal/ grub thob pad+ma badz+ra/ dī paṃ ka ra rak+ṣi ta/

bha ro phyag rdum dang gcig rwa lo tsā ba chen po rdo rje grags/ rwa chos rab/ rwa ye shes seng ge rwa 'bum seng*/ rje btsun rgwa lo/ rong pa shes rab seng ge bag ston gzhon nu tshul khrims/ bla ma tshul khrims rgyal mtshan/ kun mkhyen shes rab dpal bzang*/ chos rje dge ba rgyal mtshan/ grwa thang pa shes rab zla ba'i dbang po/ rje btsun rdo ring pa chen po/ tshar chen chos kyi rgyal po/ 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i dbang phyug rje btsun mthu stobs kyi dbang phyug bsod nams chos 'phel/ 'jam dbyangs ngag dbang chos grags/ byams pa ngag dbang chos grags/ byams pa ngag dbang rnam rgyal/ bdag chen kun dga' bkra shis/ mkhas grub sangs rgyas phun tshogs/ rdo rje 'chang kun dga' bstan 'dzin/ mkhas grub chen po sangs rgyas dpal bzang*/ des bdag tshul khrims rin chen la'o// yang na sangs rgyas phun tshogs nas/ mkhas pa bkra shis dbang phyug rdo rje 'chang kun dga' bstan 'dzin/ mkhas grub sangs rgyas dpal bzang*/ des bdag la'o// ༈ /yang las gshin dmar po khrag mdog yab yum gyi rjes gnang thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ rwa 'bum seng yan dpa' gcig yab yum ltar la/ de nas rwa dharma seng ge rwa dkon mchog seng ge rwa shes rab rgyal mtshan/ rgya ston dbang phyug rgyal mtshan/ kun dga' brtson 'grus/ mkhan chen dang ma ba/ de nas thog ston shes rab rdo rje/ rin po che shes rab grags/ lung pa dkon mchog rdo rje/ khrom yon nam mkha' lhun bzang*/ brag thog pa dpal 'dzin bzang po/ gong dkar rdo rje gdan pa/ thugs sras kun dga' rgyal po/ 'bras spungs pa drin chen tshe dbang bkra shis/ thams cad mkhyen pa tshar pa chos rje/ 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i dbang phyug rdo rje 'chang bsod nams chos 'phel/ rje bla ma dbang phyug rab brtan/ mkhas grub ngag dbang chos grags/ 'jam dbyangs ngag dbang rnam rgyal/ dpal sa skya pa ngag dbang kun dga' bkra shis/ mkhas grub chen po sangs rgyas phun tshogs/
ri khrod pa bsod nams chos 'byor/ mkhas pa bkra shis dbang phyug dbang bla kun dga' bstan 'dzin/ mkhan chen sangs rgyas dpal bzang*/ des bdag tshul khrims rin chen la'o// ༈ /las gshin dmar po bse

ma ru tse bzhis bskor kyang zer/ bya bzhis bskor gyi rjes gnang thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ rwa 'bum seng yan dpa' gcig yab yum ltar la/ de nas rwa dharma seng ge rwa dkon mchog seng ge rwa shes rab rgyal mtshan/ rgya ston dbang phyug rgyal mtshan/ kun dga' brtson 'grus/ mkhan chen dang ma ba/ de nas rim bzhin rdo rje 'chang mkhyen rab chos rje/ rdo ring pa/ tshar chen rdo rje 'chang*/ gnas gsar rje drung mkhyen brtse'i dbang phyug sngags 'chang bsod nams chos 'phel/ rje dbang phyug rab brtan/ ngag dbang chos grags/ mkhan chen ngag dbang rnam rgyal/ ngag dbang kun dga' bkra shis/ mkhas grub sangs rgyas phun tshogs/ ri khrod pa bsod nams chos 'byor/ mkhas pa bkra shis dbang phyug dbang bla kun dga' bstan 'dzin/ mkhan chen sangs rgyas dpal bzang*/ des bdag tshul khrims rin chen la'o// ngag dbang chos grags kyis mdzad pa'i las gshin rigs gsum gyi mchod gtor 'bul tshul rjes gnang gi tho dang bcas pa dang*/ tshar chen gyis mdzad pa'i rjes gnang gi chings kyi steng nas thos shing yig cha de dag gi lung yang thos so// rtse'i rtags can gyi lung brgyud ni/ mkhan chen dang ma ba yan rwa khrid mkha' 'gro'i snyan brgyud ltar las/ de nas mkhan chen shes rab rdo rje/ bla ma ār+ya de wa/ brtse chen grub chen kun blo/ khrom yon nam mkha' lhun bzang*/ rje dpal 'dzin bzang po/ mthu chen kun dga' rnam rgyal/ rje bsod nams mchog ldan/ rje tshe dbang bkra shis/ tshar chen rdo rje 'chang man 'dra'o// sa bcad gsum pa dpal 'dzin nyi 'od bzang pos mdzad pa'i glegs bam pod chung gi lung ni/ rgwa lo rnam rgyal rdo rje yan dbang brgyud dang po ltar las/ de nas mang mkhar lo tsā ba mchog ldan legs pa'i blo gros/ bla ma dpal ldan seng ge bla ma seng ge rgyal mtshan/ thams cad mkhyen pa zhang ston bsod nams grags pa/ gangs ri'i khrod kyi dpal 'dzin nyi 'od bzang po/

rgya mtsho sprin gyi 'brug sgra glog gi phreng ba can yang zer/ bla ma stag lung pa/ zhwa lu pa chen po/ stag lung pa ngag dbang grags pa/ mi nyag paṇa chen grags pa rdo rje/ mkhan chen dkon mchog tshul khrims/ 'gos ston rdo rje seng ge tshar chen chos kyi rgyal po/ 'jam mgon mkhyen brtse'i dbang phyug mthu stobs dbang phyug dgon gsar ba bsod nams chos 'phel/ khyab bdag dbang phyug rab brtan/ khyab bdag bka' 'gyur ba chen po mgon po bsod nams mchog ldan/ mkhan chen ngag dbang rnam rgyal/ mkhan chen bzang po rgyal mtshan/ rmor chen kun dga' lhun grub man 'dra/ rmor chen pas mkhan chen bzang po rgyal mtshan gyi drung du zhus pa'i dus rwa pod sa skya'i phyag dpe'i nang ltar ma tshang ba med par zhus pas 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse khu dbon gsum brgyud par bzhugs pa thams cad/ de yan gsan yig gaṅgā'i chu rgyun ltar bris pa yin zhing*/ mkhan chen bzang rgyan pas lung gsan dus kyang phyag dpe de kha yin 'dug gsung ngo*// smras pa/ sdang bas zil mnan skye bo byang chub cher// bkri phyir khro bo'i rgyal por zlos pa'i gar// gshin rje mthar byed dmar nag 'jigs gsum gyi// dbang dang grol byed lam skor phal cher mnos// zhes dam pa'i chos thos pa'i yi ge don gnyer gdengs can rol pa'i chu gter las/ gshin rje'i gshed skor te pha rgyud kyi chos skor thos pa'i brgyud rim gyi sarga ste bcu bdun pa'o// //gsum pa gti mug can gtso bor 'dul bar byed pa rnam snang sgyu 'phrul drwa ba'i smin byed nyid ni sngon du thos pa ma byung ngo*// ༈ /gnyis pa shes rab bla na med pa'i rgyud kyis bstan pa'i skor la/ dpal 'khor lo bde mchog sbyang gzhi sgong skyes sbyong byed ltar legs par bkral ba'i he ru ka'i rigs dpal 'khor lo sdom pa lha drug cu rtsa gnyis kyi ras bris kyi dkyil 'khor chen por kun mkhyen bsod nams seng ges mdzad pa'i sgrub thabs dang*/

'dren mchog gis mdzad pa'i mchod phreng*/ rje btsun rin po ches mdzad pa'i dkyil chog ngor chen dkon mchog lhun grub kyis mdzad pa'i gsal byed khyad par bzhi ldan dang*/ shar chen pa dang mkhan chen bud+dha lak+ṣ+mīs mdzad pa'i dbang gi mtshams sbyor rnams la brten nas brgyud pa'i bka' babs dgu ldan gyi dbang bzhi rdzogs par nos pa'i bka' babs dang pos lugs kyi brgyud pa ni/ ngor chen dang mkhyen brtse'i gsan yig na bka' bab bdun las mi 'dug kyang jo bo lugs gnyis so sor bgrangs gnyos lugs bsnan pas dgu byung ngo*// khyab bdag rdo rje 'chang*/ dpal phyag na rdo rje/ bram ze chen po sa ra ha/ mda' bsnun/ 'phags pa klu sgrub/ grub chen sha ba ri pa/ phag ro khur/ slob dpon lū hi pa/ dha ri ka pa/ bud med can/ rdo rje dril bu pa/ rus sbal zhabs/ kurma pā da/ shrī dzā lan+dha ra/ nag po spyod pa/ gu h+ya pa/ rnam rgyal zhabs/ tai lo pa/ nā ro ta pa/ kun tu bzang po/ nam mkha'i snying po/ snyan grags bzang po/ ye shes dngos grub/ rtsa bshad pa rnams mtshan gyi rnam grangs yin zhes zer yang dpyad do// pham mthing pa gcen 'jigs med grags pa/ gcung ngag gi dbang phyug klog skya shes rab brtsegs/ pradzñā ku ṭa/ mal lo tsā ba blo gros grags/ rje btsun brtse ba chen po/ slob dpon rin po che/ rje btsun rin po che/ sa skya paṇ+ḍi ta/ 'u yug pa bsod nams seng ge dbus pa sangs rgyas 'bum/ lo tsā ba mchog ldan legs pa'i blo gros/ bla ma dpal ldan seng ge thams cad mkhyen pa bu ston rin po che/ khyung po lhas pa gzhon nu bsod nams/ shar chen ye shes rgyal mtshan/ rdo rje 'chang kun dga' bzang po/ mus chen dkon mchog rgyal mtshan/ mus chen sangs rgyas rin chen/ ngor chen sangs rgyas seng ge thar rtse paṇa chen nam mkha' dpal bzang*/ dbon nam mkha' sangs rgyas/ rje btsun dam chos bsam 'grub/

bstan pa'i sgron me sangs rgyas phun tshogs/ rdo rje 'dzin pa'i dbang phyug kun dga' bstan 'dzin/ des bdag ban+de tshul khrims rin chen can la stsal ba'i chos kyi thog ma nyid do// yang na sangs rgyas phun tshogs nas/ mtshungs med bsod nams dpal ldan/ drin chen mkhas btsun grub pa nam mkha' dpal bzang*/ des bdag tshul rin la'o// yang na sangs rgyas seng ge nas/ thar rtse pa nam mkha' dpal bzang dang*/ mus chen nam mkha' dpal bzang gnyis kyis gsan/ de gnyis ka las sgrub khang pa dpal ldan don grub/ de nas nam mkha' sangs rgyas man 'dra/ yang na mus chen yan gong ltar la/ de las kun mkhyen go bo rab 'byams pa dang grub chen dkon mchog blo gros gnyis kyis gsan/ gnyis ka las mus chen sangs rgyas rin chen gyis gsan pa man gong ltar ro// yang na rje sangs rgyas rin chen nas/ 'jam dbyangs dkon mchog lhun grub/ shar khang pa shes rab rgyal mtshan/ thar rtse pa man 'dra/ yang na rje sangs rgyas rin chen/ 'jam dbyangs sa lo/ ngor chen dkon mchog lhun grub man 'dra/ yang na rje sangs rgyas rin chen nas/ rje dkon mchog lhun grub/ shar khang pa brang ti paṇa chen/ shar chen kun dga' bkra shis/ dbon shes rab 'byung gnas/ rje dam chos man 'dra/ yang na dpal ldan don grub las/ nam mkha' sangs rgyas dang shes rab 'byung gnas gnyis kyis gsan pa man 'dra/ yang na rje dkon mchog lhun grub/ dkon mchog dpal ldan/ byams pa kun dga' bkra shis man 'dra/ yang na sa paṇa nas/ dmar chos rgyal/ mi nyag chos rgyal/ mi nyag rdor grags/ lce mdo sde seng ge ston shāka lce blo ldan/ 'phags 'od/ bu ston man 'dra/ yang na sa paṇa nas/ bo dong rin po che/ khro phu rin po che/ bla ma dpal ldan seng ge kun mkhyen bu man gong bzhin no// yang na sa paṇa nas/ bo dong rin po che/ nyan chen bsod nams brtan pa/ dpal ldan bla ma dam pa bsod nams rgyal mtshan/ chos rje dpal ldan tshul khrims/

shar chen ye shes rgyal mtshan man gong bzhin no// yang na sa paṇa nas/ 'phags pa rin po che/ zhang dkon mchog dpal/ rgyal ba brag phug pa/ dpal ldan bla ma dam pa/ ri khrod pa blo gros brtan pa/ chos rje dpal ldan tshul khrims/ shar chen man 'dra'o// bka' babs gnyis pa bskyed rim gtso bor ston pa'i bshad rgyud a bhi dha na'i le'u sum cu rtsa gsum pa nas gsungs pa'i mar do lugs kyi brgyud pa ni/ bde mchog lū hi pa sbyangs pa'i yon tan lha bcu gsum ma'am bde mchog la wa pa'ang zer/ rdo rje 'chang*/ ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro ma/ lū hi pa/ ḍheṃ ki pa/ 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i gsan yig tu lū hi pa dang 'di gnyis gcig par mdzad 'dug paṇa grub dbang pa la wa pa/ rgyal po in+d+ra bhū ti/ ka tsa ṭa pa/ bu ston dang rje btsun btsong kha pa'i gsan yig na ka tsa pa rdo rje gdan pa'i gsan yig na ka tsa tra pa zhes snang*/ grub chen dril bu pa/ bu rje btsong kha pa ngor gong dkar thar rtse shar pa rnams kyi gsan yig na mi gsal yang 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i gsan yig na 'dir rus sbal zhabs snang ba brtag dzā lan+dha ri pa/ nag po spyod pa/ ku sha la nā tha/ bu dang gong dkar ba'i gsan yig tu 'di dang dge ba'i mgon po so sor 'dug pa rgya skad bod skad kyi khyad par las don gcig pas yig skyon shor ba 'dra/ ngor mkhyen brtse thar rtse shar pa sogs kyi gsan yig dang dkyus mthun/ tai lo pa/ nā ro pa/ ma na ka shrī dzñā na/ bu'i gsan yig na ma na ka dang shrī dzñā na zhes 'dug pa yig skyon byung ngam snyam/ bal po bha dan+ta/ su ma ti kīrti dang gcig yin skad/ bu'i gsan yig na bha ran dang*/ ngor chen gyi gsan yig tu bha tan zhes snang ba gcig la yig skyon byung 'dra/ lo tsā ba mar pa do pa chos kyi dbang phyug gze pa blo ldan seng ge gze pa jo bde/ rje btsun btsong kha pa rdo rje gdan pa thar rtse pa gsum gyi gsan yig tu bde mchog rdo rje zhes snang*/
