slob dpon khu pa/ khams pa lho tshad pa kun dga' rin chen/ lo tsā ba mchog ldan/ bla ma dpal ldan seng ge thams cad mkhyen pa bu ston rin po che/ khyung lhas pa/ shar chen/ ngor chen/ mus chen/ rje sangs rin pa/ rje dkon mchog lhun grub/ sangs rgyas seng ge de las thar rtse pa dang mus pa nam mkha' dpal bzang gnyis kyis gsan/ gnyis ka las sgrub khang dpal don pa man gong sa lugs dang 'dra/ yang na rdo rje 'chang*/ ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro ma/ grub chen la wa pa/ la ki mi pa/ 'bar ba'i gtso bo/ dge ba'i gtso bo/ ku sha la nā tha man gong ltar ro// yang na khyung lhas pa nas/ chos rje bkra shis rin chen/ ngor chen man 'dra/ yang na gze pa blo ldan nas/ gze pa don grub ye shes/ sa phug pa shākya rdo rje/ lo tsā ba mchog ldan man 'dra/ bka' babs gsum pa jo bo lugs kyi brgyud pa ni/ rdo rje 'chang*/ ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro ma/ grub chen lū hi pa/ slob dpon dha ri ka pa/ tai lo pa/ nā ro pa/ rat+na ā ka ra shān+ti/ thar rtse pa'i gsan yig na 'di jo bo'i rjes su 'dug pa yig nor byung 'dra/ jo bo rje dpal ldan a ti sha/ rong pa 'gar dge dge bsnyen yin/ lha rje stod pa tshul khrims dpal/ sngags dkar/ steng pa thugs rje zla gsal/ rje btsun btsong kha pa dang rdo rje gdan pa'i gsan yig na steng shod zhabs gnyis zhes snang*/ shod nyi ma kha dro/ gcen shes rab rgyal po/ 'di gnyis kyi tshab tu rje btsun btsong kha pa dang rdo rje gdan pa'i gsan yig tu rje che ba dang chung ba zhes pa 'dug cing zhwa lu tsan+d+ra pa'i gsan yig tu rje che chung gi 'og tu so so'i mtshan brgyab 'dug pa don la gcig pa 'dra/ gcung shes rab gtsug tor/ lha rje chen po dharma tsakra sngags pa se bo/ thang stod pa chos 'od/ rab byung se bo/ zhing chen grags pa dpal/ bod btsun grwa ther se bo/ bde gshegs dpal/

bod btsun/ bla ma sgom btsun pa/ pa ye shes/ gyer phug pa sgom ye dang gcig pa 'dra/ bla ma grags chen/ btsun pa byar bu ba/ bla ma 'phags 'od/ bu ston rin po che/ khyung lhas pa/ shar chen/ ngor chen/ sems dpa' chen po/ sangs rin pa/ sangs rgyas seng ge de las thar rtse pa dang mus pa nam mkha' dpal bzang gnyis kyis gsan/ gnyis ka las sgrub khang pa man 'dra'o// bka' babs bzhi pa kha che lugs kyi brgyud pa ni/ tsakra saṃ wā ra/ badz+ra wa ra hī/ grub chen lū hi pa/ ri khrod zhabs/ 'di gong dkar ba'i gsan yig na mi 'dug pa chad dam dpyad/ kan+ta pa/ 'dren mdzad zhabs/ bik+ṣa ta de wa/ kha che paṇa chen shākya shrī/ bi bhū ti tsan+d+ra/ g.yag sde lo tsā bsod nams bzang po/ mnga' ris ze dmar ba sangs rgyas ye shes/ bu ston thams cad mkhyen pa/ mkhas grub gzhon nu bsod nams/ chos rje ye shes rgyal mtshan/ rdo rje 'chang kun dga' bzang po man jo lugs dang 'dra/ yang na bi bhū ti tsan+d+ra nas/ mnga' ris pa sangs rgyas ye shes man 'dra/ yang na kha che paṇa chen nas/ spyi bo lhas pa seng ge dpal/ zhang phya ru ba/ 'bro lung pa/ rin po che khro phu ba/ yang rtse ba rin chen seng ge bu ston man 'dra/ yang na rdo rje 'chang*/ rdo rje phag mo/ slob dpon dril bu pa/ dha ri ka pa/ dga' ba'i rdo rje/ yan lag med pa'i rdo rje/ a bha yā de wa pūr+ṇa/ kha che paṇa chen man 'dra/ yang nye brgyud ni 'khor lo sdom pa/ paṇa chen shākya shrī man gong bzhin no// bka' babs lnga pa pu rangs lo chung lugs kyi dbang bshad gnyis ka'i brgyud pa ni/ rdo rje 'chang*/ rdo rje phag mo/ grub chen lū hi pa/ ḍheṃ ki pa/ dha ri ka pa/ rdo rje dril bu pa/ dza lan+dha ri pa/ slob dpon nag po spyod pa/ dge ba'i mgon po/ rus sbal zhabs/ gu h+ya pa/ rje btsong kha pa dang gong dkar ba sangs rgyas phun tshogs pa gsum gyi gsan yig na bhu ba pa zhes snang*/

rnam rgyal zhabs/ tai lo pa/ nā ro ta pa/ ma na ka shrī/ pra dzñā rak+ṣi ta/ pham mthing pa gsum/ 'jigs med grags pa/ ngag dbang grags pa/ bha dan+ta/ pu rangs long chung grags mchog shes rab/ 'di las stod sribs kyi gad logs su lus ma spangs par mkha' spyod du byon pa yin/ dmar chos kyi rgyal mtshan/ mnga' ris kyi ston pa dkon mchog 'bar/ thur la ba tshul khrims skyabs/ thang spe ba 'phags pa skyabs/ gser sdings pa gzhon nu 'od/ bla ma chos sku 'od zer/ kun mkhyen 'phags 'od/ bu ston rin po che/ mkhas grub gzhon nu bsod nams/ chos rje ye shes rgyal mtshan/ rdo rje 'chang kun dga' bzang po man jo bo lugs bzhin no// yang na dmar chos rgyal nas/ mi nyag chos rgyal/ mi nyag rdor grags/ lce mdo seng*/ bla ma ston shāka blo ldan seng ge 'phags 'od man 'dra/ yang na ma na ka dang pradzñā rak+ṣi ta gnyis las ka na ka shrīs gsan/ de dang pham mthing pa gnyis ka las bha dan+ta/ de nas pu rangs lo chung man bshad ma thag pa ltar ro// bka' babs drug pa mar lugs kyi brgyud pa ni/ gsan yig tshor 'di bzhin 'dug kyang mar lo sogs ma byung bas dmar lugs zer rgyu yin nam dpyad/

pham mthing pa yan sa lugs dang 'dra ba la/ de nas bal po bha dan+ta/ lo chung grags mchog shes rab/ dmar chen po chos kyi rgyal mtshan/ dbon po shes rab rdo rje/ thub pa shes rab/ brtson 'grus rdo rje/ dmar chos kyi rgyal mtshan/ bla ma shākya gzhon nu/ lce blo ldan seng ge bla ma 'phags 'od/ kun mkhyen bu ston/ mkhas grub gzhon nu bsod nams/ chos rje ye shes rgyal mtshan/ rdo rje 'chang kun dga' bzang po man jo lugs dang 'dra/ bka' babs bdun pa dpyal lugs kyi brgyud pa ni/ grub chen lū hi pa/ rgyal po dha ri ka pa/ mnga' bdag mai tri pa/ n+ya ka pa/ kan+dha pa/ bik+ṣa ta de wa/ paṇa chen shākya shrī/ grub thob rdo rje gdan pa/ paṇ+ḍi ta k+ṣi ti gar+bha/ dpyal lo tsā ba chos bzang*/ rgwa lo rnam rgyal rdo rje/ de sras shes rab seng ge gru ma chos skyong dpal/ khyung po lhas pa/ chos rje ye shes rgyal mtshan/ rdo rje 'chang kun dga' bzang po man jo bo lugs bzhin no// bka' babs brgyad pa sbal spang sna lugs kyi brgyud pa ni/ gong dkar ba'i gsan yig na 'di jo lugs brgyud pa'i rnam grangs su mdzad 'dug cing thar rtse dang shar pa'i gsan yig na dkyus bzhin du so sor snang*/ sangs rgyas/ ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro ma/ slob dpon chen po tsan+d+ri ka pa/ bram ze chen po me ko pa/ slob dpon lū hi pa/ dha ri ka pa/ bram ze sdom pa bzang po/ jo bo rje a ti sha/ de las lo chen rin chen bzang po dang nag tsho lo tsā ba gnyis kyis gsan/ gnyis ka las 'phan yul 'al pa ston mgon dang 'al pa jo btsun gnyis kyis gsan/ de gnyis las sgom sngags dkar lcang lo can/ pa mang sgom/ 'phan yul rgyal ba/ sbal spang drang srong srin po ri pa/ sna pa/ 'di gnyis sku mched yin/ me reg dar ma byang chub/ spang zho brag nag pa/ de dbon rin chen rgyal po/ bla ma don ri ba grags pa dpal/ bod btsun phyar bu ba/

bla ma 'phags 'od/ kun mkhyen bu ston/ khyung po lhas pa/ shar chen ye shes rgyal mtshan/ ngor chen rdo rje 'chang kun dga' bzang po man jo lugs bzhin no// bka' babs dgu pa gnyos lugs kyi brgyud pa ni/ rdo rje 'chang*/ ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro ma/ gsan yig 'ga' zhig tu 'di'i rjes su nag po pa 'dug gu h+ya pa/ rnam rgyal zhabs/ tai lo pa/ nā ro pa/ de las rak+ṣi ta/ nag po lha las dad pa/ pham mthing pa ste gsum gyis gsan/ gsum ga las bal po bha dan+ta/ de nas nag po lha las dad pa'i slob ma/ gnyos lo tsā ba/ gnyos bla ma/ gnyos dpal le/ phug ka ba jo bo 'bum/ sngags dkar lcang lo can/ gtsang pa lha steng pa/ sngags dkar lcang lo can/ lce mdo sde seng ge bla ma ston shāka bod btsun/ bla ma blo ldan/ sngags dkar lcang lo can/ bla ma 'phags 'od/ bu ston gong dkar ba'i gsan yig na'ang mtshan gsal mi 'dug rin chen grub/ mkhas grub khyung po lhas pa gzhon nu bsod nams/ shar chen ye shes rgyal mtshan/ ngor chen rdo rje 'chang kun dga' bzang po man jo lugs dang 'dra'o// ༈ /grub pa'i khyu mchog dpal ldan spyod pa'i rdo rje brtul zhugs grub pa'i zhabs kyis dpal 'khor lo sdom pa rtsa ba'i rgyud kyi zab don sbyang gzhi mngal skyes ltar sbyong byed du bkral ba'i bde mchog lha drug cu rtsa gnyis kyi ras bris kyi dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur ba/ kun mkhyen bsod nams seng ge dang mus chen sangs rgyas rin chen gyis mdzad pa'i sgrub thabs ma nor gsal ba'i sgron me/ rje btsun rin po ches mdzad pa'i nag po dkyil chog de'i gsal byed ngor chen dkon mchog lhun grub kyis mdzad pa'i gsal byed khyad par bzhi ldan/ shar chen dang mkhan chen sangs rgyas phun tshogs pas mdzad pa'i bde mchog lū nag gnyis kyi dbang gi mtshams sbyor rnams la brten nas dbang bzhi legs par nos pa'i brgyud pa ni/

yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas/ rdo rje 'chang*/ phyag na rdo rje/ sa ra ha/ klu sgrub/ sha ba ri/ lū hi pa/ dha ri ka pa/ grub chen rdo rje dril bu pa/ rus sbal zhabs/ shrī dza lan+dha ra/ grub chen spyod pa'i rdo rje/ nag po par grags pa gsum byon te/ nag po spyod pa ba/ nag po dam tshig rdo rje/ nag po lha las dad pa gsum gyi dang po gnyis la nag po pa che ba dang chung bar grags pa las 'di nag po pa che ba kah+na pa ste spyod pa bar grags so// slob dpon gu h+ya pa/ rnam par rgyal ba'i zhabs/ tai lo pa/ paṇa chen nā ro pa/ pham mthing pa gcen 'jigs med grags pa/ gcung ngag gi dbang phyug klog skya shes rab brtsegs/ mal lo tsā ba blo gros grags/ sngags pa gos dkar can/ rje btsun brtse ba chen po/ slob dpon rin po che/ rje btsun rin po che/ chos rje paṇa chen/ chos kyi rgyal po 'phags pa/ zhang dkon mchog dpal/ rgyal ba brag phug pa/ ri khrod pa blo gros brtan pa/ bla ma dpal ldan tshul khrims/ shar chen ye shes rgyal mtshan/ ngor chen rdo rje 'chang*/ chos rje gzhon nu seng ge rdul tshon gyi brgyud pa 'di man nas byung skad/ rje sangs rgyas dpal grub/ ngor chen lha mchog seng ge rje sangs rgyas seng ge de las brang ti paṇa chen nam mkha' dpal bzang dang mus chen nam mkha' dpal bzang gnyis kyis gsan/ snga ma las dbon nam mkha' sangs rgyas kyis gsan/ de las rje dam chos bsam 'grub/ mkhas grub sangs rgyas phun tshogs/ khyab bdag 'khor lo'i mgon po bkra shis bzang po/ des bdag ban+de tshul khrims rin chen la bka' drin du stsal to// yang na rje bkra shis bzang po nas/ mkhan chen rdo rje 'chang sangs rgyas dpal bzang*/ des bdag tshul khrims rin chen la stsal to// yang na rje sangs rin nas/ rje dkon mchog lhun grub/ shar khang pa/ brang ti pa/ shar chen khu dbon/ rje dam chos bsam 'grub man 'dra/ yang na brang ti pa/

mkhas grub dpal ldan don grub/ de las nam mkha' sangs rgyas dang shes rab 'byung gnas gnyis kyis gsan pa man 'dra/ yang na rje dkon mchog lhun grub nas/ dkon mchog dpal ldan/ byams pa kun dga' bkra shis man 'dra'o// yang na ngor chen rdo rje 'chang nas/ kha char ba bsod nams rgyal mtshan/ rje sangs rgyas dpal grub man 'dra/ yang na ngor chen nas/ mus pa grub chen dkon mchog blo gros/ rje btsun sangs rgyas rin chen/ rje lha mchog seng ge rdo rje 'chang sangs rgyas seng ge paṇa chen nam mkha' dpal bzang*/ dbon nam mkha' sangs rgyas/ rje dam chos bsam 'grub/ 'jam dbyangs sangs rgyas phun tshogs man gong ltar ro// yang na ngor chen nas/ mus chen sems dpa' chen po/ grub chen dkon mchog blo gros man 'dra/ yang na rje sangs rgyas rin chen nas/ chos rje dge legs bshes gnyen/ shar khang pa shes rab rgyal mtshan/ thar rtse nam mkha' dpal bzang man 'dra/ yang na 'phags pa rin po che nas/ stag ston shes rab gzhon nu/ bla ma brag dkar ba/ mkhas grub gzhon nu bsod nams/ shar chen ye shes rgyal mtshan/ rdo rje 'chang kun dga' bzang po man 'dra/ bu ston rin po che'i gsan yig dang 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtses tshar chen dang grol mchog las gsan pa tshang mar rnal 'byor ma'i rjes su grub chen dril bu pa 'dug na'ang*/ ngor chen rdo rje gdan pa thar rtse sgrub khang shar pa khyab bdag bka' 'gyur ba rnams kyi gsan yig ltar na/ rdo rje 'chang*/ phyag na rdo rje/ sa ra ha/ klu sgrub/ sha wa ri pa/ lū hi pa/ dha ri ka pa/ dril bu pa man mthun pa 'di bzhin no// ༈ /grub pa'i 'khor los sgyur ba'i slob dpon rdo rje dril bu pas legs par bkral ba'i 'khor lo sdom pa'i zab don dril bu pa'i lugs kyi phyi dkyil ras bris kyi dkyil 'khor chen por rgyal dbang thams cad mkhyen pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtshos mdzad pa'i dkyil chog gi steng nas dbang bzhi legs par nos pa'i brgyud pa ni/

rdo rje 'chang*/ rdo rje phag mo/ slob dpon rdo rje dril bu pa/ laṅka li pa/ nag po spyod pa/ dge ba'i mgon po/ tai lo pa/ nā ro pa/ ma ṇa ka shrī/ 'di gnyis rmor gyi gsan yig na ma byung bar lnga pa'i gsan yig tu yod pas dgos mi dgos brtag ka ṇa ka shrī/ pham mthing pa 'jigs med grags pa/ bal po bha dan+ta/ su ma ti kīrti yang zer/ mar do lo tsā ba chos kyi dbang phyug sngags pa gos dkar can/ gze pa blo ldan seng ge gze pa jo bde/ khams pa shākya rdo rje/ rong pa chos mgon/ lo tsā ba mchog ldan pa/ bla ma dpal ldan seng ge bu ston thams cad mkhyen pa/ mkhan chen rin chen rnam rgyal/ khyung lhas pa gzhon nu bsod nams/ rje ye shes rgyal mtshan/ ngor chen rdo rje 'chang kun dga' bzang po/ mus chen 'khor lo sdom pa/ kun mkhyen bsod nams seng ge yongs 'dzin dkon mchog 'phel ba/ thams cad mkhyen pa dkon mchog lhun grub/ rje dkon mchog rgya mtsho/ she'u lo tsā ba kun dga' chos grags/ rmor pa grub chen kun dga' rnam rgyal/ mkhyen rab bstan 'dzin bzang po/ byams pa ngag dbang lhun grub/ ngag gi dbang phyug kun dga' lhun grub/ ngag dbang kun dga' legs pa'i 'byung gnas/ rdo rje 'dzin pa'i dbang phyug kun dga' rgya mtsho/ des bdag ban+de tshul khrims rin chen la'o// yang na rdo rje 'chang*/ rdo rje phag mo/ slob dpon rdo rje dril bu pa/ rus sbal zhabs/ 'bar ba 'dzin/ kah+na pa/ gu h+ya pa/ rnam rgyal zhabs/ tai lo pa/ nā ro pa/ pham mthing pa sku mched/ klog skya shes rab brtsegs/ mal gyo lo tsā ba blo gros grags/ rje btsun sa skya pa chen po/ slob dpon rin po che/ rje btsun chen po/ sa paṇ+ḍi ta/ 'phags pa rin po che/ khro phu rin po che/ yang rtse ba rin chen seng ge bu ston thams cad mkhyen pa/ khyung lhas pa gzhon nu bsod nams/ shar chen ye shes rgyal mtshan/ ngor chen rdo rje 'chang kun dga' bzang po man 'dra/

yang na sa paṇa nas/ bo dong rin chen brtson 'grus/ khro phu rin po che man 'dra/ yang na sa paṇa nas/ tshogs sgom pa/ khro phu ba man 'dra'o// ༈ /slob dpon dril bu pa'i bzhed srol dpal 'khor lo bde mchog lus kyi dkyil 'khor du dbang bzhi legs par nos pa'i bka' babs gnyis ldan gyi dang po sa lugs kyi brgyud pa ni/ rdo rje 'chang*/ yum rdo rje phag mo/ grub chen rdo rje dril bu pa/ rab byung gi mtshan blo gros snying po/ kurma pā da/ 'bar ba 'dzin pa/ kah+ṇa pa/ gu h+ya pa/ rnam rgyal zhabs/ tai lo pa/ paṇa chen nā ro pa/ pham mthing pa gcen 'jigs med grags pa/ gcung ngag gi dbang phyug klog skya shes rab brtsegs/ mal lo tsā ba blo gros grags pa/ rje btsun kun dga' snying po/ slob dpon bsod nams rtse mo/ bla ma rje btsun chen po/ chos rje paṇ+ḍi ta/ de las 'gro ba'i mgon po chos rgyal 'phags pa dang*/ tshogs sgom kun dga' dpal/ bo dong rin chen gsum gyis gsan/ 'phags pa nas zhang dkon mchog dpal/ brag phug pa bsod nams dpal/ bla ma dam pa bsod nams rgyal mtshan/ chos rje dpal ldan tshul khrims/ shar chen ye shes rgyal mtshan/ rdo rje 'chang kun dga' bzang po/ mus chen dkon mchog rgyal mtshan/ rje btsun sangs rgyas rin chen/ ngor chen dkon mchog lhun grub/ shar khang pa shes rab rgyal mtshan/ de las thar rtse paṇa chen nam mkha' dpal bzang dang mus pa nam mkha' dpal bzang gnyis kyis gsan/ gnyis ka las ngag dbang mchog legs rdo rjes gsan/ de nas mkhyen rab bstan 'dzin bzang po/ byams pa ngag dbang lhun grub/ 'jam pa'i dbyangs sangs rgyas phun tshogs/ mtshungs med bstan 'dzin lhun grub/ 'khor lo sdom pa dpal ldan chos skyong*/ des bdag tshul khrims rin chen la stsal to// yang na mus chen nas/ kun mkhyen bsod nams seng ge 'dren mchog dkon mchog 'phel ba/ ngor chen dkon mchog lhun grub/ spyan snga dkon mchog rgya mtsho/

she'u lo tsā ba byams pa kun dga' chos grags/ rmor pa grub chen kun dga' rnam rgyal/ mkhyen rab bstan 'dzin bzang po man 'dra'o// yang na rje sangs rgyas rin chen nas/ ngor chen lha mchog seng ge dang sangs rgyas seng ge thar rtse nam mkha' dpal bzang man 'dra/ yang na ngor chen nas/ gu ge paṇa chen/ glo bo mkhan chen legs pa'i 'byung gnas/ 'jam dbyangs sa skya lo tsā ba/ rje sangs rgyas seng ge man 'dra/ yang na sa paṇa las/ 'phags pa rin po che/ tshogs sgom rin po che/ bo dong rin po che gsum gyis gsan/ de gsum ga las khro phu rin po che bsod nams seng ges gsan/ de las bla ma dpal ldan seng ge dang yang rtse ba rin chen seng ge gnyis kyis gsan/ de gsum ga las thams cad mkhyen pa bu ston rin chen grub/ de nas khyung po lhas pa/ gzhon nu bsod nams/ shar chen ye shes rgyal mtshan/ ngor chen rdo rje 'chang kun dga' bzang po man 'dra/ yang na khyung lhas pa las/ mkhas grub nor 'od zer ba'ang byung*/ bzang rin chen/ bka' bzhi pa rin chen rgyal mtshan/ sku zhang mkhyen rab chos rje/ mkhan chen rig 'dzin rgyal po/ lcags sgog lung pa bkra shis dpal 'byor/ tshar chen gyis ku su li'i bla ma dang lam du mjal gsung ba de yin/ byang gling pa rin chen bkra shis rgyal mtshan/ thar rtse nam mkha' dpal bzang man 'dra/ bka' babs gnyis pa kha che lugs kyi brgyud pa ni/ badz+ra dha ra/ badz+ra wā ra hī pa/ badz+ra ghaṇ+ḍa pa/ dga' ba'i rdo rje/ yan lag med pa'i rdo rje/ a bha yā ka ra gup+ta/ de wa pur+ṇa/ paṇa chen shākya shrī/ spyi bo lhas pa seng ge dpal/ zhang phya ru ba/ byang sems 'bre lung pa/ thar rtse pa dang shar pa'i gsan yig na zhang 'bre lung pa zhes 'di dang gong ma gnyis bla ma gcig tu mdzad 'dug kyang bu ston dang mkhyen brtse'i gsan yig tu dkyus ltar so sor snang ngo*// khro phu rin po che/ yang rtse ba rin chen seng ge

bu ston thams cad mkhyen pa/ mkhas grub khyung po lhas pa/ shar chen ye shes rgyal mtshan/ ngor chen rdo rje 'chang man 'dra/ yang na rdo rje dril bu pa/ de wa pūr+ṇa/ kha che paṇa chen man 'dra/ nye brgyud ni/ 'khor lo sdom pa/ kha che paṇa chen man gong bzhin no// ༈ /mkhan chen ngag dbang chos grags kyis byin rlabs 'di de sngon ma thob kyang thob rgyu'i dbang gis bris so// mdzad pa'i byin rlabs kyi cho ga dang khrid yig gi steng nas 'khor lo bde mchog gi rdzogs rim shin tu zab pa dril bu rim lngar grags pa'i byin rlabs dang nyams khrid legs par thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ khro phu bsod nams seng ge yan gong gi dbang brgyud le tshan ltar las/ de nas yang rtse ba rin chen seng ge bla ma gnyan mkhar ba bkra shis bzang po/ mkhas grub khyung po lhas pa gzhon nu bsod nams/ chos rje ye shes rgyal mtshan/ ngor chen rdo rje 'chang kun dga' bzang po/ mus chen 'khor lo sdom pa dkon mchog rgyal mtshan/ rdo rje 'chang mkhyen rab chos rje/ kun mkhyen shākya don grub/ de dbon kun dga' legs grub/ she'u lo tsā ba byams pa kun dga' chos grags/ rmor pa grub chen kun dga' rnam rgyal/ mkhyen rab byams pa ngag dbang lhun grub/ ngag dbang kun dga' lhun grub/ skyor mda' ba rje btsun bsod nams dbang phyug mkhas grub chen po dpal ldan chos skyong*/ des bdag tshul khrims rin chen la stsal to// 'gro ba'i mgon po 'phags pa rin po ches mdzad pa'i rim lnga'i khrid kyi lung thob pa'i brgyud pa sa skya bka' 'bum dang 'dra la/ thams cad mkhyen pa ngag dbang chos grags kyis mdzad pa'i byin rlabs dang khrid kyi lung ni/ mkhan chen ngag dbang chos grags/ dpal sa skya pa ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams/ mus chen bkra shis lhun grub/ mkhan chen bzang po rgyal mtshan/ ngag dbang kun dga' lhun grub/ skyor mda' ba man 'dra'o// ༈ /dpal 'khor lo sdom pa dus kyi 'khor lo dang mthun par bshad pa mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho lha stong dang lnga brgya rig byed kyis

gong dkar ba'i gsan yig na lha stong phrag gcig dang brgya phrag dgur brgyad kyis lhag pa'i bcu phrag gcig yod par bshad cing*/ lo pa'i gsan yig na stong dang bdun brgya zhes dang rgyal dbang lnga pas stong dang lnga brgya zhe lnga zhes snang ngo*// lhag pa'i ras bris kyi dkyil 'khor du rdo rje 'chang kun dga' bzang pos mdzad pa'i sgrub thabs dngos grub rin po che'i mdzod/ des mdzad pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga yon tan rin po che'i mdzod/ mchod phreng bsod nams rin po che'i mdzod/ sngags phreng ngor chen gyis zhus dag mdzad pa rnams mkhan chen sangs rgyas phun tshogs pas mdzad pa'i gsung sgros phyag len yid kyi mun sel dang dbang gi mtshams sbyor dam pa'i zhal lung dbang gi dngos gzhi'i sdom bcas kyi dbang bzhi legs par nos pa'i brgyud pa ni/ khyab bdag rdo rje 'chang*/ yum rdo rje phag mo/ 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs/ byang sems blo gros rin chen/ grub chen sha wa ri pa/ mnga' bdag mai tri gup+ta/ rgya gar phyag na rdo rje/ slob dpon ka ma la badz+ra/ paṇa chen gos dkar po/ paṇa grub dza ya sa na/ sum pa lo tsā ba dar ma yon tan/ rje btsun rin po che grags pa rgyal mtshan sa skya paṇ+ḍi ta/ rin po che skyob pa dpal/ rgyal tsha lung mang po chos kyi dbang phyug lo tsā ba mchog ldan legs pa'i blo gros/ bag ston gzhon nu tshul khrims/ bla ma tshul khrims rgyal mtshan/ bla ma ngag gi dbang phyug grags pa/ mkhan chen byang chub seng ge sa bzang 'phags pa gzhon nu blo gros/ rdo rje 'chang kun dga' bzang po/ mkhas grub gung ru sher bzang*/ kun mkhyen go rams pa bsod nams seng ge byas 'gyur ba bsod nams seng ge mkhan chen dkon mchog tshul khrims/ zhwa lu dang dpal 'khor chos sde'i gdan sa pa/ rje btsun sgo rum pa kun dga' legs pa/ jo nang mkhan po/ thams cad mkhyen pa mkhyen brtse'i dbang phyug

zhwa lu'i mkhan po/ rgyud sde'i mnga' bdag zhwa lu pa byang gling pa/ rin chen bkra shis rgyal mtshan/ mus chen 'jam pa'i dbyangs nam mkha' dpal bzang*/ rin po che dpal ldan don grub/ rdo rje 'chang dpal mchog rgyal mtshan/ khams ston bsod nams rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po/ chos rje mtshungs med don grub rgyal mtshan/ drin chen 'khor lo sdom pa bkra shis bzang po/ des skal ba dang ldan pa'i ban+de tshul khrims rin chen la stsal to// yang na ngor chen nas/ mkhas grub dpal ldan rdo rje/ byas 'gyur ba bsod nams seng ge man 'dra/ yang na ngor chen rdo rje 'chang nas/ kun mkhyen bsod nams seng ge man 'dra/ yang na rdo rje 'chang*/ phyag na rdo rje/ tai lo pa/ nā ro pa/ rdo rje gdan pa/ dha byang chub sems dpa'/ jo bo rje'i dbon po yin/ a bha yā ka ra/ mkhyen brtse'i gsan yig na a bh+ya rak+ṣi ta zhes gcig tu bsdoms 'dug kyang gong dkar ba dang thar rtse pa'i gsan yig na dkyus ltar snang ngo*// rat+na rak+ṣi ta/ paṇa grub dza ya se na/ sum pa lo tsā ba man gong ltar ro// yang na sum pa lo tsā ba nas/ mkhas pa sa mu dra/ seng ge rgyal mtshan/ lo tsā ba grags pa rgyal mtshan/ ngor chen dang thar rtse pa'i gsan yig na grags pa dpal zhes pa dkyus su bris par rdo rje yin nam 'di ma dag zer ba'i mchan 'dug kyang rdo rje gdan pa'i gsan yig na 'di ltar snang ngo*// bag ston gzhon tshul man 'dra/ yang na sum pa lo tsā ba nas/ rgya thams cad mkhyen pa/ srin po ri pa'am sbal spang sna pa/ bsgrad ston rdo rje dpal/ gong dkar ba'i gsan yig na sgrag ston zhes snang*/ mtshur phu ba tshul khrims rin chen/ rje rang byung rdo rje/ snye mdo kun dga' don grub man 'dra/ yang na rdo rje 'chang*/ phyag na rdo rje/ pad+ma badz+ra che chung gnyis/ in+d+ra bhū ti/ lcam lak+ṣ+mī ka ra/ tai lo pa/ nā ro pa/ rdo rje 'dzin pa/

a bha yā ka ra/ rat+na shrī/ rgyal ba'i sde/ sum pa lo tsā ba/ rje btsun grags pa man gong bzhin no// yang na sum pa lo tsā ba/ sgang dar snying*/ gnyan ras/ a k+ṣo bh+ya badz+ra/ sgom pa shes rab/ bde ba can ye shes mgon po/ bsam gtan grub/ bla ma gzhon nu rgyal mtshan/ 'dzam gling paṇ+ḍi ta man 'dra'o// ༈ /gu ge paṇa chen gyis mdzad pa'i sgrub thabs phrin las mtha' yas dang dbang chog bdud rtsi gaṅgā'i klung rgyun gnyis kyi steng nas dpal 'khor lo sdom pa bong zhal can lha so bdun gyi ras bris kyi dkyil 'khor du dbang bzhi legs par nos pa'i ring brgyud ni/ yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas/ rdo rje 'chang*/ ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro ma/ 'jigs med 'byung gnas sbas pa/ a nu pa ma rak+ṣi ta/ dar+paṇa ā tsār+ya/ kun tu bzang po/ ye shes kyi glog dpal yid kyi 'gram pa/ 'jam dpal bzang po/ dpal bzang*/ chos kyi glog bzang po/ yid 'tsho ba bzang po/ ngag gi dpal bzang*/ dpal rnam rgyal bzang po/ dpal myos byed bzang po'i zhabs/ dpal phun tshogs bzang po'i zhabs/ nam mkha' bzang po/ rgyal ba'i 'tsho ba bzang po/ dpal 'phrog byed bzang po'i zhabs/ ye rang paṇ+ḍi ta skal ldan bzang po/ skye dgu kun dga'i 'tsho ba bzang po/ de sras bal po ma hā bo dhi/ bla ma bsam gtan 'od zer/ paṇ+ḍi ta grags pa rgyal mtshan/ glo bo mkhan chen legs pa'i 'byung gnas/ 'jam dbyangs sa lo kun dga' bsod nams/ 'jam dbyangs dkon mchog lhun grub/ ngor chen sangs rgyas seng ge brang ti paṇa chen nam mkha' dpal bzang*/ rnal 'byor dbang phyug byams pa ngag dbang mchog legs rdo rje/ rdo rje 'chang mkhyen rab bstan 'dzin bzang po/ mkhyen rab byams pa ngag dbang lhun grub/ mkhan chen bzang po rgyal mtshan/ 'jam pa'i dbyangs grub pa bkra shis bzang po/ de las bdag ban+de tshul khrims rin chen gyis mnos so// yang na nam mkha' bzang po/ de sras byang chub chen po/ bla ma bsam gtan 'od zer/

paṇ+ḍi ta grags pa rgyal mtshan man 'dra/ nye brgyud ni/ grub chen bsam gtan 'od zer gyis dbang gsan pa'i tshe brgyud pa zhus pas ngas a pha/ de'i a phas tsakra saṃ wa ra dang yo gi gnyis las thob gsungs pa ltar/ bde mchog yab yum gyis byin gyis brlabs pa sha stag gi nye brgyud ni/ dpal 'khor lo sdom pa/ yum rdo rje phag mo/ bal po ye rang gi paṇ+ḍi ta skal ldan bzang po man gong bzhin no// ༈ /chos kyi rgyal po 'phags pa rin po ches mdzad pa'i mngon dkyil gyi steng nas dpal sgyu ma chen po lha lnga'i ras bris kyi dkyil 'khor du dbang bzhi legs par thob pa'i jo bo lugs kyi brgyud pa ni/ khyab bdag rdo rje 'chang*/ ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro ma/ ku ku ri pa/ grub thob khyi mo phyag rgyar bsten pa/ jo bo nā ro ta pa/ shān+ti pa/ jo bo rje dpal ldan a ti sha rong pa 'gar dge klog skya ston pa/ stengs pa thur bsam/ 'phar lung pa rgyal sras/ rkyang po nyi she/ 'dar tsha dar rgyal/ 'dar tsha grags she/ spen phug pa bsod nams mdzes/ grags chen pa/ 'phags 'od yon tan rgya mtsho/ thams cad mkhyen pa bu ston rin chen grub/ thugs sras lo tsā ba rin chen rnam rgyal/ sa bzang 'phags pa gzhon nu blo gros/ ngor chen rdo rje 'chang kun dga' bzang po/ gu ge paṇa chen grags pa rgyal mtshan/ glo bo mkhan chen bsod nams lhun grub legs pa'i 'byung gnas/ sa skya lo tsā ba 'jam dbyangs kun dga' bsod nams/ thams cad mkhyen pa dkon mchog lhun grub/ rje byang gling pa rin chen bkra shis rgyal mtshan/ mus pa nam mkha' dpal bzang*/ byams pa ngag dbang mchog legs rdo rje/ 'khor lo'i mgon po mkhyen rab bstan 'dzin bzang po/ mkhyen rab byams pa ngag dbang lhun grub/ bka' drin mnyam med rmor chen thams cad mkhyen pa ngag dbang kun dga' lhun grub/ des bdag tshul khrims rin chen la'o// yang rngog lugs kyi brgyud pa ni/

rdo rje 'chang*/ ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro ma/ slob dpon ku ku ri pa/ mtsho skyes rdo rje/ ḍom+bi pa/ tai lo pa/ nā ro pa/ paṇ+ḍi ta zhi ba bzang po/ mar pa lho brag pa chos kyi blo gros/ rngog chos sku rdo rje/ rngog jo sras mdo sde/ rngog chos sku/ rngog tsha dkon mchog dpal/ klog skya dbang phyug grags/ ldong ston shes rab dpal/ chos kyi rgyal po 'phags pa blo gros rgyal mtshan/ mkhan po gzhon nu 'bum/ bla ma spang sgang pa grags pa dpal/ kun mkhyen gangs pa/ sa bzang ma ti paṇa chen 'phags pa gzhon nu blo gros/ ngor chen rdo rje 'chang chen po man 'dra/ yang na chos kyi rgyal po 'phags pa nas/ khro phu rin po che/ 'jam skya nam mkha' dpal ldan/ bla ma dpal ldan seng ge bu ston thams cad mkhyen pa/ thugs sras lo tsā ba/ sa bzang 'phags pa/ ngor chen rdo rje 'chang man 'dra/ yang na rngog chos sku rdo rje nas/ sba lba ba can/ rngog zhe sdang rdo rje/ gtsang lha steng pa/ kun mkhyen 'phags 'od/ bu ston thams cad mkhyen pa/ thugs sras lo tsā ba/ ngor chen man 'dra'o// 'di'i mngon dkyil khrus khang lo tsā bas mdzad pa'i steng nas mdzad song*// ༈ /nā len+d+ra pa mkhan chen rin chen dpal bzang gis mdzad pa'i mngon dkyil gyi steng nas dpal 'khor lo bde mchog sangs rgyas thod pa lha nyi shu rtsa lnga'i ras bris kyi dkyil 'khor du dbang bzhi rdzogs par thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ khyab bdag rdo rje 'chang*/ dzñā na ḍā ki nī ye/ byang sems blo gros rin chen/ dpal sa ra ha pa/ dpal mgon 'phags pa klu sgrub/ grub chen sha ba ri dbang phyug mnga' bdag mai tri pa/ mar pa lo tsā ba chos kyi blo gros/ rgya rnal 'byor pa/ ro mnyam rdo rje/ yon tan grags/ khams pa sa phug pa shākya rdo rje/ gnyal ba jo sras chos grags/ khams chen rgan mo lhas pa/ bla ma bsod nams 'phel/ bag ston gzhon nu tshul khrims/ g.yung ston rdo rje dpal ba/ rin po che grags pa tshul khrims/

bla ma byang chub seng ge sa bzang 'phags pa gzhon nu blo gros/ ngor chen rdo rje 'chang kun dga' bzang po/ paṇ+ḍi ta grags pa rgyal mtshan/ mkhan chen legs pa'i 'byung gnas/ sa lo 'jam dpal rdo rje/ ngor chen thams cad mkhyen pa dkon mchog lhun grub/ rje byang gling pa bkra shis rgyal mtshan/ mus pa nam mkha' dpal bzang*/ ngag dbang mchog legs rdo rje/ mkhyen rab bstan 'dzin bzang po/ mkhyen rab byams pa ngag dbang lhun grub/ 'khor lo'i mgon po ngag dbang kun dga' lhun grub/ des bdag tshul khrims rin chen la bka' drin du stsal to// yang na rgan mo lhas pa nas/ bla ma ye shes rin chen/ bla ma 'jam dbyangs chen po/ rgya ston thams cad mkhyen pa/ bag ston gzhon nu tshul khrims/ g.yung ston rdo rje dpal/ grags pa tshul khrims/ byang chub seng ge sa bzang 'phags pa/ ngor chen man 'dra'o// yang na bla ma ye shes rin chen nas/ bla ma smon lam mgon po/ zhu ston pa/ dmar byang chen pa/ bag ston gzhon nu tshul khrims man 'dra'o// yang na rdo rje 'chang*/ ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro ma/ phyag na rdo rje/ sa ra ha/ klu sgrub/ ār+ya de wa/ nag po zhabs/ de wa ā ka ra tsan+d+ra/ a mo gha badz+ra/ mnga' bdag mar pa lo tsā ba/ mtshur dbang gi rdo rje/ 'khon gad pa kīrti/ yar klungs kyi snyigs dmar po/ 'gos ri khrod dbang phyug bal po dbang mgon/ rin chen bzang po/ gan pa rin chen rgyal mtshan/ bla ma kun bsod pa/ bag ston gzhon nu tshul khrims/ g.yung ston rdo rje dpal ba/ mkhan chen grags pa tshul khrims/ bla ma byang chub seng ge sa bzang 'phags pa gzhon nu blo gros/ ngor chen rdo rje 'chang chen po man 'dra'o// ༈ /ngor chen rdo rje 'chang kun dga' bzang pos mdzad pa'i sgrub thabs byin rlabs kyi yi ge'i steng nas kha che paṇa chen gyi thugs dam bzhi'i nang tshan bcom ldan 'das dpal 'khor lo sdom pa dkar po lhan cig skyes pa'i byin rlabs/ bde mchog dkar po la brten nas byang chub bsgrub pa/

'jam dpal dkar po la brten nas shes rab bsgrub pa/ yang dag me gcig thod gcig la brten nas ras grub pa/ dzam+bha la nag po la brten nas nor bsgrub pa'o// dpyal a mo ghas mdzad pa'i khrid yig gi steng nas bskyed rdzogs kyi nyams khrid zab mo dang*/ rgyal dbang gis rdo rje 'chang dbang rab pas mdzad pa'i khrid yig yin gsung 'dug mus chen sangs rgyas rin chen gyis mdzad pa'i yi ge'i steng nas tshe khrid bcas legs par thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ khyab bdag rdo rje 'chang chen po/ rgyal yum rdo rje phag mo/ rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug lū hi pa/ dha ri ka pa/ mai tri pa/ nā ya ka pa/ kan+dha pa/ kha che'i paṇ+ḍi ta shākya shrī bha dra/ dpyal chos kyi bzang po/ dpyal a mo gha/ rong pa rgwa lo rnam rgyal rdo rje/ de sras rong pa shes rab seng ge bag ston gzhon nu tshul khrims/ bla ma tshul khrims rgyal mtshan/ mkhan chen ngag gi dbang phyug bla ma byang chub seng ge sa bzang 'phags pa gzhon nu blo gros/ ngor chen rdo rje 'chang kun dga' bzang po/ mus chen 'khor lo sdom pa dkon mchog rgyal mtshan/ rgyal tshab kun dga' dbang phyug 'dren mchog rat+na war+dha/ ngor chen lha mchog seng ge rdo rje 'chang sangs rgyas seng ge thar rtse paṇa chen nam mkha' dpal bzang*/ khri chen kun dga' bsod nams lhun grub/ rdo rje 'chang mkhyen rab bstan 'dzin bzang po/ mkhyen rab byams pa ngag dbang lhun grub/ thams cad mkhyen pa ngag dbang kun dga' lhun grub bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po/ des bdag ban+de tshul khrims rin chen la stsal to// yang na kha che'i paṇ+ḍi ta nas/ sa skya paṇ+ḍi ta kun dga' rgyal mtshan/ g.yag sde lo tsā ba bsod nams bzang po/ grub chen ze dmar ba sangs rgyas ye shes/ mkhan chen bsod nams grags pa/ mkhan chen grags pa tshul khrims/ bya sder ba byang chub seng ge sa bzang 'phags pa gzhon nu blo gros/ ngor chen rdo rje 'chang kun dga' bzang po/

mus chen sems dpa' chen po/ grub chen dkon mchog blo gros/ mus chen sangs rgyas rin chen/ thams cad mkhyen pa dkon mchog lhun grub/ rje sangs rgyas seng ge man 'dra'o// yang na ngor chen nas/ mus chen 'khor lo sdom pa dkon mchog rgyal mtshan/ glang thang spyan snga blo gros rgyal mtshan/ stong rwa ba kun mkhyen shākya don grub/ de dbon 'jam dbyangs kun dga' legs grub/ she'u lo tsā ba byams pa kun dga' chos grags/ rdo rje 'chang mkhyen rab bstan 'dzin bzang po man 'dra'o// ༈ /mkhan chen sgrub khang pa dpal ldan don grub kyis mdzad pa'i sgrub thabs dang byin rlabs bya tshul gyi yi ge la brten nas rje btsun rdo rje phag mo shes rab gsal byed kyi byin rlabs legs par thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ khyab bdag rdo rje 'chang*/ rgyal yum rdo rje phag mo/ grub thob kaṅka dat+ta/ a bha yā ka ra/ su tsa ri pā da/ rat+na rak+ṣi ta/ ma nā ka shrī dzñā na/ chag lo tsā ba chos rje dpal/ go lung pa mdo sde dpal rgyal mtshan/ shong ston rdo rje rgyal mtshan/ lo tsā ba mchog ldan legs pa'i blo gros/ dpang lo tsā ba blo gros brtan pa/ chos rje bla ma dam pa bsod nams rgyal mtshan/ rje dpal ldan tshul khrims/ shar chen ye shes rgyal mtshan/ ngor chen rdo rje 'chang kun dga' bzang po/ gu ge paṇa chen grags pa rgyal mtshan/ glo bo mkhan chen mnyam med bsod nams lhun grub/ thams cad mkhyen pa dkon mchog lhun grub/ ri khrod pa kun dga' mchog ldan/ mus pa nam mkha' dpal bzang po/ ngag dbang mchog legs rdo rje/ mkhyen rab bstan 'dzin bzang po/ rdo rje 'chang mkhyen rab byams pa ngag dbang lhun grub/ khyab bdag 'khor lo'i mgon po rdo rje 'chang ngag dbang kun dga' lhun grub/ des bdag tshul khrims rin chen la stsal to// yang na yan chad btsal dgos/ de nas mtshungs med kun dga' chos 'phel/ bka' drin rmad byung dbang bla kun dga' bstan 'dzin/

des bdag tshul khrims rin chen la'o// yang na dpal ldan bla ma dam pa bsod nams rgyal mtshan nas/ dbang rnon rgyal ba mchog grub/ bka' bzhi pa rin chen rgyal mtshan/ rdo rje 'chang mkhyen rab chos rje/ kun mkhyen shākya don grub/ 'jam dbyangs kun dga' legs grub/ she'u lo tsā ba byams pa kun dga' chos grags/ mkhyen rab bstan 'dzin bzang po man 'dra/ yang na dpang lo tsā ba nas/ sa bzang ma ti paṇa chen/ sa bzang 'phags pa gzhon nu blo gros/ ngor chen rdo rje 'chang man 'dra'o// ༈ /mkhan chen rdo rje 'chang ngag dbang chos grags kyis mdzad pa'i sgrub thabs byin rlabs kyi yi ge la brten nas dpyal lugs kyi phag mo bden gnyis zhal/ phag mo dbu bcad ma/ phag mo don grub ma rnams kyi byin rlabs thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ rdo rje 'chang*/ rdo rje phag mo/ lcam legs smin ka ra/ brag ze bir+wa pa/ a wa dhū ti pa/ ldong ngar ba bstan 'dzin bzang po/ bal po bha ren+d+ra ru tse/ dpyal kun dga' rdo rje/ zar ston ā tsār+ya/ gtsang yang dag rdo rje/ dbus pa shes rab rdo rje/ lce ston mdo sde seng ge lce blo ldan seng ge lce btsun bsod nams dpal/ sprul sku dbang phyug rdo rje/ 'jam dbyangs rin chen rgyal mtshan/ kun mkhyen dga' ba gdong pa chos rgyal dpal bzang*/ mkhan chen 'khrul zhig tshul khrims rgyal mtshan/ rdo rje 'chang mkhyen rab chos rje/ rje btsun rdo ring pa kun bzang chos kyi nyi ma/ tshar chen rdo rje 'chang blo gsal rgya mtsho/ 'jam mgon mkhyen brtse'i dbang phyug rdo rje 'chang dbang phyug rab brtan/ grub mchog ngag dbang rnam rgyal/ dpal sa skya pa chen po ngag dbang kun dga' bkra shis/ ngag dbang kun dga' lhun grub/ thams cad mkhyen pa dpal ldan chos skyong bkra shis grags pa'i rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po/ des bdag la stsal to// yang na dpyal nas/ rgya gar gyi mar pa bsod nams rdo rje/ gtsang shes rab rdo rje/ skyid khud pa mar ston seng ge rgyal mtshan/

lce mdo sde seng ge man 'dra/ yang na dpyal lo/ zar ston/ de gnyis ka las zhang 'od de/ dbus pa gzi ston/ dbus pa shes rdor/ lce mdo sde seng ge man 'dra/ yang na mar pa bsod nams rdo rje/ khams pa zhang ston/ phug ston/ lha steng pa 'byung gnas seng ge lce mdo sde seng ge man 'dra/ yang na zar ston/ snar ston/ grag pa tshul khrims/ mkhas btsun kun rdor/ bla ma tshul khrims dpal bzang*/ bu ston thams cad mkhyen pa/ khyung po gzhon nu bsod nams/ spos khang pa 'jam dbyangs rin chen rgyal mtshan man 'dra'o// ༈ /paṇa chen nam mkha' dpal bzang gis mdzad pa'i yi ge'i steng nas/ dpal 'khor lo sdom pa'i rgyud mngon par brjod pa 'bum pa las gsungs pa'i mgon po tshe dpag tu med pa lha gcig bum gcig tshe zan la brten pa rig 'dzin dbang mo grub pa'i rgyal mo'i lugs kyi byin rlabs dbang bzhi'i tshul du bskur ba legs par thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ mgon po tshe dpag tu med pa/ ma gcig grub pa'i rgyal mo/ ti phu gsang sngags sdom po/ ras chung rdo rje grags pa/ mid la bzhad pa rdo rje/ dwags po lha rje bsod

sgam po zla 'od gzhon nu yang zer/ nams rin chen/ bde gshegs phag mo khams pa rdor rgyal/ grub pa/ 'bri khung pa 'jig rten mgon po'am mtshan dngos rin chen dpal/ spyan snga grags pa 'byung gnas/ yang dgon pa thugs kyi rdo rje zer ba'ang byung*/ rgyal mtshan dpal bzang*/ thugs sras spyan snga rin ldan/ zur phug pa rin chen dpal bzang*/ 'ba' rwa ba rgyal mtshan dpal bzang*/ 'di yang dgon pa'i sprul pa/ chos rje bde legs rin chen/ gangs can pa kun dga' dpal bzang*/ dbu ma pa dpal ldan bzang po/ chos rje dpal ldan mgon po/ mus chen sangs rgyas rin chen/ rgyal ba lha mchog seng ge 'jam dbyangs sangs rgyas seng ge paṇa chen nam mkha' dpal bzang*/ byams pa kun dga' bkra shis/ rje nam mkha' sangs rgyas/ rje nam mkha' dpal bzang*/ mkhas grub sangs rgyas phun tshogs/ tshe dpag med dngos mkhan chen bkra shis lhun grub/ des bdag tshul khrims rin chen la stsal to// yang na paṇa chen nam mkha' dpal bzang nas/ 'jam dbyangs kun dga' bsod nams lhun grub/ byams pa kun dga' bkra shis/ sku dbon shes rab 'byung gnas/ mkhas btsun kun dga' legs pa/ 'jam dbyangs sangs rgyas phun tshogs/ mkhan chen bkra shis lhun grub/ des bdag la'o// yang na rje sangs rgyas rin chen nas/ sa lo thams cad mkhyen pa/ thams cad mkhyen pa dkon mchog lhun grub/ rje sangs rgyas seng ge 'dren mchog kun dga' lung rigs/ nags dgon pa sbyin pa grags pa/ sa skya pa sngags 'chang kun dga' bsod nams yab sras/ sa skya pa sngags 'chang ngag dbang kun dga' bkra shis/ mkhas grub chen po sangs rgyas phun tshogs/ bka' drin zla bral bkra shis lhun grub/ des bdag ban+de tshul khrims rin chen la stsal to// yang na sa skya pa kun dga' bkra shis nas/ sngags 'chang kun dga' bsod nams rin chen/ mkhan chen bkra shis lhun grub man 'dra/ yang na sangs rgyas phun tshogs nas/

mtshungs med bstan 'dzin lhun grub/ 'chi med mgon po dpal ldan chos skyong*/ des bdag la'o// yang na sa lo nas/ sngags 'chang kun dga' rin chen/ sras 'jam dbyangs sku mched/ a mi lags man 'dra/ yang na sangs rin nas/ rje dkon mchog lhun grub/ she'u ri pa blo gros rgyal mtshan/ sbyin pa grags pa man 'dra'o// yang na 'ba' rwa ba rgyal mtshan dpal bzang yan gong ma ji lta ba bzhin la/ de nas grub chen rin chen 'phel ba/ zhwa lu mkhan chen 'khrul zhig tshul khrims rgyal mtshan/ sku zhang rdo rje 'chang mkhyen rab rin chen mchog grub/ kun mkhyen shākya don grub/ 'jam dbyangs kun dga' legs grub/ byams pa kun dga' chos grags/ rdo rje 'chang mkhyen rab bstan 'dzin bzang po/ mkhyen rab byams pa ngag dbang lhun grub/ ngag dbang kun dga' lhun grub/ grub dbang sangs rgyas rgya mtsho/ des bdag ban+de tshul khrims rin chen la stsal to// yang na 'ba' rwa ba nas/ chos rje bde legs rin chen/ lha do rtogs ldan yang zer/ nam snying pa rin chen rgyal mtshan/ kun mkhyen gangs khrod pa kun dga' dpal bzang*/ chos rje rin chen rgyal mtshan/ rdo rje 'chang mkhyen rab chos rje man 'dra/ yang na rdo rje 'chang mkhyen rab chos rje/ rje btsun rdo ring pa chen po/ tshar chen blo gsal rgya mtsho/ kun mkhyen mkhyen brtse'i dbang phyug sngags 'chang bsod nams chos 'phel/ rdo rje 'chang dbang phyug rab brtan/ mkhan chen ngag dbang chos grags/ mkhan chen ngag dbang rnam rgyal/ dpal sa skya pa chen po sngags 'chang ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams/ de sras 'jam dpal rdo rje bsod nams dbang phyug sngags 'chang thams cad mkhyen pa ngag dbang kun dga' bkra shis/ yab sras de gsum char las ngag dbang kun dga' lhun grub/ grub dbang sangs rgyas rgya mtsho man 'dra'o// mkhan chen bkra shis lhun grub pas paṇa chen brang ti pas mdzad pa dang*/ sngags 'chang chen pos mdzad pa'i yig cha so so'i steng nas ma 'dres par tha dad du gnang byung ngo*//

༈ /rong ston chen po la ti phu pas dngos su gnang ba'i tshe sgrub zhag bdun ma'i nyams len zab mo'i gdams pa tshar chen rdo rje 'chang chen pos gsal bar mdzad pa'i 'chi med bdud rtsi'i bcud len dang brgyud 'debs dngos grub mchog stsol gyi lung dang dmigs khrid bcas legs par thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ bcom ldan 'das mgon po tshe dpag med/ ma gcig grub pa'i rgyal mo/ ti phu gsang sngags sdong po/ kun mkhyen rong ston shākya rgyal mtshan/ thugs sras nye gnas nam mkha' dpal ldan/ rje btsun rdo ring kun spangs pa chen po/ tshar chen chos kyi rgyal po/ kun mkhyen mkhyen brtse'i dbang phyug 'di nas yin nam man chad cung zad brtag dgos/ mkhan chen bslab gsum rgyal mtshan/ rdo rje 'chang dbang phyug rab brtan/ sngags 'chang bsod nams chos 'phel/ mkhan chen ngag dbang chos grags/ ngag dbang bsod nams rgyal mtshan/ mkhan chen rgyal ba lhun grub/ spro lung bsod nams chos 'phel/ grub chen sangs rgyas bstan pa/ mkhan chen 'jam pa'i dbyangs sangs rgyas dpal bzang*/ des bdag tshul khrims rin chen la bka' drin du stsal to// rje btsun sangs rgyas rin chen gyis mdzad pa'i tshe sgrub zhag bdun ma'i yi ge'i lung yang thos so// ༈ /'phags pa'i yul gyi ma hā paṇ+ḍi ta ā tsār+ya dmar pos rje btsun sa skya pa chen po la gnang ba'i rdo rje nam mkha' lding gser mig 'khyil ba 'byung po 'ur 'ded ces shin tu thugs gtsigs che ba'i zab chos kyi skor la/ yig rnying gi dgongs pa bzhin du mkhas grub sangs rgyas phun tshogs kyis mdzad pa'i khyung nag gser mig 'khyil ba'i sgrub thabs rjes gnang gi yi ge'i steng nas legs par nos nas/ gdams pa shar sbu chu ba dpal ldan grags kyis mdzad pa'i lo rgyus/ bsnyen pa/ sgrub pa/ las sbyor gyi nang gses khyad par gyi las sbyor ser ba dang char gcod pa/ mid 'byar 'chos pa/

dug bsrung ba/ dug 'bred pa/ sri'u gso ba/ gdon bgegs bskrad pa/ smyo ba 'dul ba/ bcud len/ mdze gso ba/ spyi 'gro'i las sbyor dang bcas pa legs par thos pa'i brgyud pa ni/ rdo rje 'chang*/ bla ma ā tsār+ya dmar po/ gsang ba shes rab kyang zer/ bod du lan gsum byon pa'i dang po khri srong lde'u btsan gyi dus/ bar pa bstan pa phyi dar gyi 'go rjes ma sa chen dang mjal ba ste sku tshe'i rig 'dzin brnyes pa dmag zor ma'i bla brgyud na yod pa de dang gcig go/ rje btsun sa skya pa chen po/ slob dpon bsod nams rtse mo/ rje btsun grags pa rgyal mtshan/ rong mi grags pa dpal/ rong mi lba ba can sangs rgyas dpal/ rong mi dar ma grags/ rong mi sangs rgyas rgyal mtshan/ rong mi bsod nams rgyal mtshan/ shar sbu chu ba dpal ldan grags/ grags pa dpal mgon/ jo stan khrom yon nam mkha' lhun bzang*/ bla ma dpal ldan grags pa/ mus pa 'jam dbyangs dkon mchog rgya mtsho/ bla ma bsod nams chos 'phel/ mkhan chen ngag dbang chos grags/ byams pa ngag dbang bsod nams rgyal mtshan/ chos rje sangs rgyas dpal bzang*/ mkhas grub sangs rgyas phun tshogs/ mtshungs med bstan 'dzin lhun grub/ mkhan chen 'jam mgon bkra shis lhun grub/ de las bdag ban+de tshul khrims rin chen gyis thos so// yang na sangs rgyas phun tshogs nas gsan nam cung zad brtag de nas mkhan chen thams cad mkhyen pa tshul khrims lhun grub/ de nyid nas rjes gnang dang las tshogs kyi lung bcas ban+de tshul khrims rin chen bdag gis mnos so// yang na bstan 'dzin lhun grub nas/ mkhan chen dpal ldan chos skyong*/ des bdag la'o// yang na sbu chu ba dpal ldan grags pa/ mkhan chen nam lhun pa/ chos rje nam mkha' legs pa/ chos rje wā gī shwa ra/ ngag dbang grags pa dpal bzang*/ dkon mchog rgya mtsho/ sangs rgyas rgyal mtshan/ sa skya'i sngags 'chang a mi lags nas kyang zhabs drung bdag pos gsan pa man 'dra'o//

༈ /smras pa/ srid gsum ro gcig lhan skyes bde ba che'i// 'khor lor sdom pa'i dbang bskur gser ri'i grangs// tshe dang shes rab skyed byed byin rlabs dang*// tshe dbang grub rgyal lugs sogs legs par mnos// zhes dam pa'i chos thos pa'i yi ge don gnyer gdengs can rol pa'i chu gter las/ rnal 'byor ma rgyud kyi chos skor thos pa'i brgyud rim gyi sarga ste bco brgyad pa'o// //bstan pa'i mnga' bdag rje btsun sa skya pa yab sras la dpal kye rdo rje'i bka' srol mi 'dra ba chen po bzhi babs pa la/ dpal kye rdo rje'i chos skor 'di rnams/ rnal 'byor ma rgyud kye rdo rje// zhes pa'i dgongs don ltar ma rgyud du bkral ba dang*/ thabs dang shes rab gnyis med rgyud// ces pa'i dgongs don gnyis med du bkral ba'i lugs gnyis las ngor chen rdo rje 'chang chen po gnyis char 'gal med du bzhed pas 'dir byang chub sems dpa' rdo rje snying pos/ rnal 'byor thabs kyis ma yin zhing*// rnal 'byor shes rab gcig pus min// thabs dang shes rab gnyis med pa'i// dges rdor 'di ni phyogs gcig min// zhes bya ba la sogs pa rgyu mtshan du ma'i sgo nas thabs dang shes rab gnyis su med pa'i rgyud du bzhed pa'i nang nas man ngag lugs ni 'og gser chos skabs su 'byung zhing*/ 'dir rnal 'byor dbang phyug bir+wa pa dang*/ ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro ma gnyis kyis dngos su byin gyis brlabs pa'i grub pa'i slob dpon chen po ḍom+bi he ru ka'i zhal snga nas legs par bkral ba'i dpal kye rdo rje 'grel pa lugs sam/ ḍom+bi lugs su grags pa lha dgu'i ras bris kyi dkyil 'khor chen por thams cad mkhyen pa dkon mchog lhun grub kyis mdzad pa'i sgrub dkyil ḍom+bi mdzes rgyan gyi steng nas dbang bzhi rdzogs par thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rdo rje 'chang*/

rje btsun rdo rje bdag med ma/ rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug bi rū pa/ grub pa'i slob dpon ḍom+bi he ru ka a la la badz+ra/ nags khrod pa/ gar+bha ri pa/ dza ya shrī dzñā na/ slob dpon mi thub zla ba/ dge slong dpa' bo rdo rje/ 'brog mi lo tsā ba shākya ye shes/ mnga' ris pa gsal ba'i snying po/ 'khon sgyi chu ba dgra lha 'bar/ bla ma sa skya pa chen po kun dga' snying po/ slob dpon rin po che bsod nams rtse mo/ rje btsun rin po che grags pa rgyal mtshan/ 'jam mgon sa skya paṇ+ḍi ta/ rong pa rgwa lo rnam rgyal rdo rje/ de sras rong pa shes rab seng ge zhang grags 'byor/ bla ma bsod nams lhun grub/ bla ma ngag gi dbang phyug grags pa/ bla chen kun dga' rgyal mtshan/ ngor chen rdo rje 'chang kun dga' bzang po/ mkhan grub dpal ldan rdo rje/ rwa ston yon tan dpal bzang*/ mkhan chen bsod nams lhun grub legs pa'i 'byung gnas/ 'jam dbyangs kun dga' bsod nams/ gnyen chen grags pa blo gros/ shar khang pa shes rab rgyal mtshan/ mus chen nam mkha' dpal bzang*/ mkhas grub dpal ldan don grub/ 'jam dbyangs shes rab 'byung gnas/ mkhan chen lhun grub dpal ldan/ mkhas grub sangs rgyas phun tshogs/ ngag dbang bkra shis dbang phyug rdo rje 'chang bkra shis bzang po/ mkhas btsun grub pa'i dbang po chos kyi rje bstan 'dzin rdo rje pa/ des bdag tshul khrims rin chen la stsal bar 'gyur ba nyid do// ༈ /grub pa'i slob dpon chen po a naṅga'i rjes su 'brang ba au ḍ+yān gyi slob dpon pad+ma badz+ra gyis legs par bkral ba'i dpal kye rdo rje mtsho skyes lugs sam nas gling mar grags pa lha dgu'i ras bris kyi dkyil 'khor du thams cad mkhyen pa dkon mchog lhun grub kyis mdzad pa'i sgrub dkyil mtsho skyes mdzes rgyan gyi steng nas dbang bzhi rdzogs par thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ khyab bdag rdo rje 'chang*/ bi lā s+ya badz+ra/

yan lag med pa'i rdo rje/ slob dpon mtsho skyes rdo rje/ rgyal po in+d+ra bhū ti/ lcam lak+ṣ+mī ka ra/ slob dpon nag po spyod pa/ bram ze dpal 'dzin/ paṇa chen ga ya dha ra/ 'brog mi lo tsā ba shākya ye shes/ bla ma se mkhar chu ba/ zhang dgon pa ba chos 'bar/ bla chen sa skya pa chen po/ rta stag so ba rin chen don grub/ de dbon chos kyi shes rab dang*/ la kha ba rgyal mtshan grags pa/ dpal gong dkar ba'i gsan yig na mi 'dug kyang thar rtse pa'i gsan yig na bzhugs pas chad dam snyam/ chu bo ri pa/ zhang dkon mchog dpal/ rgyal ba brag phug pa bsod nams dpal/ ri khrod pa blo gros brtan pa/ bla ma dpal ldan tshul khrims/ ngor chen rdo rje 'chang kun dga' bzang po/ mus chen sems dpa' chen po dkon mchog rgyal mtshan/ kun mkhyen bsod nams seng ge rje btsun sangs rgyas rin chen/ rje lha mchog seng ge rdo rje 'chang sangs rgyas seng ge paṇa chen nam mkha' dpal bzang*/ byams pa kun dga' bkra shis/ 'jam dbyangs shes rab 'byung gnas/ 'jam mgon lhun grub dpal ldan/ mkhas grub sangs rgyas phun tshogs/ mkhas dbang bkra shis dbang phyug mkhas btsun bkra shis bzang po/ mkhan chen sangs rgyas dpal bzang*/ rdo rje 'chang dpal ldan chos skyong*/ des bdag tshul khrims rin chen la stsal bar 'gyur ro// ༈ /grub pa'i slob dpon chen po nag po dam tshig rdo rjes legs par bkral ba'i dpal kye rdo rje sku gsung thugs snying po kye rdo rje dang bcas pa'i lha dgu so so'i ras bris kyi dkyil 'khor du thams cad mkhyen pa dkon mchog lhun grub kyis mdzad pa'i sgrub dkyil nag po mdzes rgyan gyi steng nas dbang bzhi rdzogs par thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rdo rje 'chang*/ rje btsun rdo rje bdag med ma/ nag po dam tshig rdo rje/ bram ze nag po shān+ti bha draḥ 'gos khug pa lhas btsas/ mnga' ris pa gsal ba'i snying po/

'khon sgyi chu ba dgra lha 'bar/ dpal ldan brtse ba chen po kun dga' snying po/ slob dpon rin po che bsod nams rtse mo/ rje btsun rin po che grags pa rgyal mtshan/ dkar ston shākya grags/ bde lung pa kun bzang dpal/ 'di dkar gyi dbon po yin/ bla ma gung pa dar ma ye shes/ bag ston gzhon nu tshul khrims/ bla ma tshul khrims rgyal mtshan/ bla ma dpal ldan don grub/ sa bzang 'phags pa gzhon nu blo gros/ ngor chen rdo rje 'chang kun dga' bzang po/ mus chen dkon mchog rgyal mtshan/ kun mkhyen bsod nams seng ge rje lha mchog seng ge bud+dha singhaḥbrang ti nam mkha' dpal bzang*/ rtse gdong khri chen kun dga' bsod nams lhun grub/ mkhan chen ngag dbang chos grags/ 'di gnyis ka thub bstan yangs can pa/ byams pa ngag dbang rnam rgyal/ sa skya pa bdag chen bsod nams dbang phyug mkhan chen lhun grub dpal ldan/ mkhas grub sangs rgyas phun tshogs/ mkhas dbang bkra shis dbang phyug rdo rje 'chang bkra shis bzang po/ bka' drin can chos rje bstan 'dzin rdo rje/ des bdag tshul khrims rin chen la stsal bar 'gyur ro// yang na bla ma tshul khrims rgyal mtshan nas/ bla ma ngag gi dbang phyug mkhan chen byang chub seng ge sa bzang 'phags pa man 'dra'o// ༈ /kun mkhyen bsod nams seng ges mdzad pa'i sgrub thabs dngos grub rgya mtsho dkyil chog bde chen rgya mtsho/ ngor chen dkon mchog lhun grub kyis mdzad pa'i sgrub dkyil gsal byed rab gsal snang ba/ paṇa chen thar rtse pas mdzad pa'i lhan thabs rnams la brten nas dpal kye rdo rje'i rgyud rgyas pa 'bum phrag lnga pa dang brtag pa gnyis pa ste gnyis char gyi bshad pa'i rgyud thun mong ma yin pa rdo rje gur gyi rgyud nas bshad pa'i mkha' 'gro lnga rigs bsdus pa lha bzhi bcu rtsa dgu'i ras bris kyi dkyil 'khor du dbang bzhi rdzogs par thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rdo rje 'chang*/

rje btsun rdo rje bdag med ma/ rnal 'byor dbang phyug bir+wa pa/ grub pa'i dbang phyug ḍom+bi pa/ a la la badz+ra/ nags khrod pa/ gar+bha ri pa/ bsod snyoms pa dza ya shrī dzñā na/ slob dpon mi thub zla ba/ grub chen pradzñā

shes rab dbang po mdzes pa ste dpa' bo rdo rje'ang zer/ in+d+ra ru tsi/ 'brog mi lo tsā ba shākya ye shes/ mnga' ris pa gsal ba'i snying po/ 'khon sgyi chu ba dgra lha 'bar/ rje sa skya pa chen po kun dga' snying po/ khams pa ne tso sbal ston/ rta stag so ba rin chen don grub/ gan pa ston dar/ gan pa so ston/ gan pa chos rgyal/ gan pa chos rin/ gan pa rin rgyal/ thar rtse pa sogs kyi gsan yig na mi 'dug kyang 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i der snang bas chad dam snyam/ dpal ldan bla ma dam pa bsod nams rgyal mtshan/ bla ma dpal ldan tshul khrims/ shar chen ye shes rgyal mtshan/ ngor chen rdo rje 'chang kun dga' bzang po/ rje sangs rgyas dpal grub/ 'jam dbyangs nam mkha' brten pa/ thams cad mkhyen pa dkon mchog lhun grub/ rje shar khang pa shes rab rgyal mtshan/ de las thar rtse nam mkha' dpal bzang dang*/ mus chen nam mkha' dpal bzang gnyis kyis gsan/ snga ma las byams pa kun dga' bkra shis/ mkhas grub dpal ldan don grub/ shar chen shes rab 'byung gnas/ mtshungs med dam chos bsam 'grub/ mkhas grub chen po sangs rgyas phun tshogs/ rigs brgya'i 'khor los sgyur ba chen po rdo rje sems dpa' tshul khrims lhun grub bkra shis grags pa'i rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po/ des bdag ban+de tshul khrims rin chen can pa'i skal ba mchog gi snod du legs par stsal to// yang na ngor chen nas/ kha char ba/ kun mkhyen bsod nams seng ge 'dren mchog dkon mchog 'phel ba/ ngor chen lha mchog seng ge rje sangs rgyas seng ge thar rtse nam mkha' dpal bzang man 'dra'o// de dag gi rgyab brten du dpal kye rdo rje'i rtsa ba'i rgyud brtag pa gnyis pa paṇ+ḍi ta ga ya dha ra dang shākya ye shes kyis bsgyur ba/ ngor chen dkon mchog lhun grub kyis mdzad pa'i tshul gsum mdzes par byed pa'i rgyan dang*/ ljon shing mdzes par byed pa'i rgyan rnams kyi lung yang thos so//

༈ /bde dgyes sogs rgyud sde bdun cu rtsa gnyis sogs thun mong ba'i bshad rgyud sam+pu ṭa nas gsungs pa'i rdo rje dbyings lha sum cu rtsa bdun gyi ras bris kyi dkyil 'khor du ngor chen rdo rje 'chang kun dga' bzang pos mdzad pa'i sgrub thabs dngos grub snye ma/ dkyil chog dbang gi snye ma/ mchod phreng tshogs gnyis snye ma/ thar rtse nam mkha' dpal bzang gis mdzad pa'i zin bris pad+ma kha 'byed rnams la brten nas dbang bzhi legs par thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ khyab bdag rdo rje 'chang*/ rje btsun rdo rje bdag med ma/ rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug dpal ldan bir+wa pa/ grub chen ḍom+bi he ru ka a la la badz+ra/ dpal ldan nags khrod pa/ gar+bha ri pa/ dzā ya shrī dzñā na/ slob dpon mi thub zla ba/ pradzñā in+d+ra ru tsi/ bla chen 'brog mi shākya ye shes/ mnga' ris pa gsal ba'i snying po/ 'khon sgyi chu ba dgra lha 'bar/ rje btsun sa skya pa chen po kun dga' snying po/ rje btsun grags pa rgyal mtshan/ 'jam dbyangs sa skya paṇ+ḍi ta/ tshogs sgom pa kun dga' dpal ba/ gnyags snying po rgyal mtshan/ zhang bkra shis dpal/ spang sgang pa grags pa dpal/ sa bzang ma ti paṇa chen/ sa bzang 'phags pa gzhon nu blo gros/ ngor chen rdo rje 'chang kun dga' bzang po/ kun mkhyen bsod nams seng ge mus chen sangs rgyas rin chen/ chos rje dge legs bshes gnyen/ rje shar khang pa shes rab rgyal mtshan/ paṇa chen nam mkha' dpal bzang*/ mkhas grub dpal ldan don grub/ zhabs drung shes rab 'byung gnas/ mkhan chen lhun grub dpal ldan/ mkhas grub sangs rgyas phun tshogs/ mtshungs med bsod nams dpal ldan/ drin chen rdo rje 'chang phun tshogs rgya mtsho/ des bdag tshul khrims rin chen la'o// rje bla mas chos rje bstan pa rgyal mtshan las kyang gsan gsung*/ yang na sangs rgyas rin chen nas/ dkon mchog lhun grub/ thar rtse paṇa chen man 'dra'o// ༈ /kye rdo rje'i rtsa ba dang bshad pa'i rgyud gsum ste/

de dag gi dgongs 'grel gtso che'i chos sna sum cu rtsa dgur grags pa thog mar bir+wa pa'i rjes su 'brang ba grub chen ḍom+bi he ru ka'i skor la/ bdag med ma'i sgrub thabs bdud rtsi'i 'od ḍom+bi he ru kas mdzad pa paṇ+ḍi ta ga ya dha ra dang*/ 'brog mi shākya ye shes kyis bsgyur ba/ rdzogs rim lhan cig skyes grub ḍom+bi pas mdzad pa rgya gar gyi mkhan po su bhū ti shrī shān+ti dang*/ dge slong dge ba'i blo gros kyis bsgyur ba/ tshogs kyi 'khor lo mdzad pa dang 'gyur gong 'dra/ yang tshogs 'khor 'du ba bsgrag pa mdzad pa bdag gis thob dus kyi dpe la ni 'di yan 'brog mi'i 'gyur gyi steng nas byung*/ dang 'gyur gong dang 'dra/ de nyid bcu pa mar me mdzad dang dge ba'i blo gros kyi 'gyur/ sku rdo rje lha dgu'i mngon rtogs phyag gnyis pa'i sgrub thabs zhes bya ba a la la badz+ras mdzad pa rgya gar gyi mkhan po pradzñā in+d+ra ru tsiḥdang 'brog mi shākya ye shes kyis bsgyur ba/ sku rdo rje dpa' bo gcig pa'i mngon rtogs dran pa gcig pa gar+bha ri pas mdzad pa dang bdag med ma'i sgrub thabs bsod snyoms pas mdzad pa 'gyur gong 'dra/ dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga bzang po yongs bzung mi thub zla bas mdzad pa rgya gar gyi mkhan po ga ya dha ra dang*/ 'brog mi shākya ye shes kyis bsgyur ba slob dpon bsod nams rtse mos 'gyur bcos mdzad pa/ gur rigs bsdus mkha' 'gro lnga'i sgrub thabs sbyang dka' zla bas mdzad pa'i rgya gar gyi mkhan po tī la ya dang*/ bod kyi lo tsā ba 'bro shes rab grags kyis bsgyur ba/ kye rdo rje'i mngon rtogs yan lag drug pa mi thub zla bas mdzad pa ga ya phyag dper 'gyur mi snang yang rnam bshad zla zer las bshad/ dha ra dang 'brog mi shākya ye shes kyi 'gyur/ 'dir bdag med lha mo bco lnga'i sgrub thabs zhig la yum gyi sgrub thabs zer ba byung yang dpe ma 'byor pas lung ma byung*/

yang gur rigs bsdus kyi sgrub thabs mi thub zla bas mdzad pa dang ga ya dha ra dang 'brog mi'i 'gyur/ des mdzad pa'i gtor ma'i cho ga 'byung po thams cad kyi gtor ma'i cho ga 'gyur gong dang 'dra/ de rnams kyi rgyab brten du dka' 'grel kau mu ti mi thub zla bas mdzad pa pradzñā in+d+ra ru tsi dang 'brog mi'i 'gyur/ dkyil chog bskyed rim/ rdzogs rim/ rab gnas/ sbyin sreg ro sreg tshogs 'khor/ gtor ma'i cho ga rnams ston pa dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga rin chen 'bar ba pradzñā in+d+ra ru tsi'am dpa' bo rdo rje'ang zer/ shes rab dbang po mdzes pas mdzad pa/ paṇ+ḍi ta de nyid dang 'brog mi shākya ye shes kyis bsgyur ba rnams so// ༈ /gnyis pa slob dpon yan lag med pa'i rdo rje'i rjes su 'brang ba/ grub chen pad+ma badz+ra gyi skor la/ dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga nas gling ma slob dpon mtsho skyes kyis mdzad pa 'brog mi'i bsgyur ba/ dpal kye rdo rje'i sgrub thabs mtsho skyes kyis mdzad pa 'brog mis bsgyur ba/ mar me'i rtse mo rmor chen pa'i gsan yig tu 'di ma byung ba brtag lta bu'i rdzogs rim tshogs 'khor dam tshig lnga pa mtsho skyes kyis mdzad pa ba ri lo tsā bas bsgyur ba/ sbyin sreg gi cho ga mdzad pa gong 'dra/ bstod pa nyi shu pa mtsho skyes zhabs kyis mdzad pa ga ya dha ra dang 'brog mis bsgyur ba/ de dag gi rgyab brten du dka' 'grel pad+ma can mtsho skyes zhabs kyis mdzad pa rgya gar gyi mkhan po tri ti gar+bha dang khu ston dngos grub kyis bsgyur ba/ skabs kyi 'grel chung brgyad du grags pa la/ gleng gzhi'i 'grel pa che chung nag po brtul zhugs spyod pas mdzad pa/ ga ya dha ra dang 'brog mis bsgyur ba/ glu'i 'grel pa che chung slob dpon sgrol ma can gyis mdzad pa 'gyur gong 'dra/ yang glu'i de kho na gsal ba'i 'grel pa pad+ma'i zhabs kyis mdzad pa 'gyur gong 'dra/

rtsa'i 'grel pa mngon par rtogs pa'i rim pa zhes byung brtag che chung 'gyur gong 'dra/ yang rtsa'i 'grel pa kye rdo rje'i de kho na nyid kyi rim pa zhes byung*/ mdzad byang med pa 'gyur gong 'dra/ dur khrod kyi 'grel pa che chung mdzad byang med pa rgya gar gyi mkhan po rat+na shrī dzñā na dang*/ bod kyi lo tsā ba dge slong shākya ye shes kyis bsgyur ba/ dur khrod kyi 'grel pa che ba sam+pu ṭa las bsdus par bshad snang ngo*// brda'i 'grel pa rnam par nges pa ye shes rgyal mtshan gyis 'gyur bcos pa rnams so// gsum pa slob dpon dam tshig rdo rje'i rjes su 'brang ba nag po shān+ta bha dra'i skor la/ dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga nag po gzhung 'grel paṇ+ḍi ta nag po zhabs kyis mdzad pa paṇ+ḍi ta de nyid dang lo tsā ba 'gos khug pa lhas btsas kyis bsgyur ba/ dpal kye rdo rje'i sgrub thabs de kho na nyid gsal ba nag po dam tshig rdo rjes mdzad pa paṇ+ḍi ta de nyid dang nag tsho lo tsā ba tshul khrims rgyal bas bsgyur ba/ kye rdo rje phyag bcu drug pa dpa' bo gcig pa'i sgrub thabs nag po zhabs kyis mdzad pa paṇ+ḍi ta de nyid dang 'gos los bsgyur ba/ bdag med ma'i sgrub thabs mdzad pa dang 'gyur gong 'dra/ bar 'dir tshogs 'khor gyi cho ga 'gos 'gyur dang phyag gnyis pa dpa' gcig tshul khrims grags kyi 'gyur zer ba gnyis sangs rgyas bstan pa'i gsan yig tu 'dug kyang dpe ma 'byor bas lung ma byung*/ rmor chen pa'i gsan yig na'ang mi 'dug pas ma dgos pa yin nam brtag sbyin sreg gi cho ga mdzad pa dang 'gyur gong 'dra/ rab gnas kyi cho ga mdzad pa dang 'gyur gong 'dra/ gshin gyi cho ga nag po zhabs kyis mdzad pa paṇ+ḍi ta rgyal ba'i gnyen dang thar lo nyi ma rgyal mtshan gyis dben gnas thar pa gling du bsgyur ba/ ro sreg gi cho ga dang mchod rten gyi cho ga nyi ma rgyal mtshan gyis bsgyur ba ste gzhung de rnams dam tshig rdo rje'i slob ma nag po shān+ta bha dras mdzad pa rnams so// dka' 'grel

'di lung ma byung*/ rnal 'byor rin po che sbyor ba'i phreng ba nag po zhabs kyis mdzad pa paṇ+ḍi ta de nyid dang 'gos khug pa lhas btsas kyis bsgyur ba rnams te/ de ltar gtso che ba'i chos sna so dgur grags pa'i lung thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ rdo rje 'chang yan chad gsan yig rgya mtsho ltar dang*/ de nas rdo rje 'chang kun dga' bzang po/ mus chen dkon mchog rgyal mtshan/ rgyal tshab kun dga' dbang phyug mkhas grub dpal ldan rdo rje/ de gnyis kas rjes su bzung ba 'dren mchog dkon mchog 'phel ba/ chos rje dge legs bshes gnyen/ rje shes rab rgyal mtshan/ thar rtse nam mkha' dpal bzang*/ sngags 'chang kun dga' bsod nams/ dpal sa skya pa kun dga' bkra shis/ 'khrul zad bsod nams chos 'phel/ khyab bdag sangs rgyas bstan pa/ rigs kun khyab bdag sangs rgyas dpal bzang*/ des bdag tshul khrims rin chen la bka' drin stsal to// ༈ /chos kyi rgyal po 'phags pa rin po che'am sgrub khang dpal ldan don grub pas mdzad pa'i yi ge'i steng nas rje btsun ma sgrol ma lha bcu bdun gyi ras bris kyi dkyil 'khor chen por dbang bzhi legs par thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ rje btsun ma sgrol ma/ slob dpon nyi ma sbas pa/ tsan+d+ra gar+bha/ dze tā ri dgra las rnam rgyal/ wā gī shwa ra kīrti/ shrad+dhā ka ra warma/ ta thā ga ta rak+ṣi ta/ paṇ+ḍi ta dā na shī la/ mañdzu shrī/ mal lo blo gros grags pa/ rje btsun sa skya pa chen po/ khams pa ne tso sbal ston/ gnam pa rwa chos she/ mngon pa ba byang chub brtson 'grus/ paṇ+ḍi ta rdo rje shes rab/ zhang dkon mchog dpal ba/ rgyal ba brag phug pa chen po/ bla ma dam pa bsod nams rgyal mtshan/ bla chen kun dga' rgyal mtshan/ ngor chen rdo rje 'chang kun dga' bzang po/ paṇa chen grags pa rgyal mtshan/ mkhan chen legs pa'i 'byung gnas/ sa skya lo tsā ba 'jam dbyangs kun dga' bsod nams/ thams cad mkhyen pa dkon mchog lhun grub/

rje btsun byang gling pa bkra shis rgyal mtshan/ mus pa nam mkha' dpal bzang*/ ngag dbang mchog legs rdo rje/ mkhyen rab bstan 'dzin bzang po/ rdo rje 'chang mkhyen rab byams pa ngag dbang lhun grub/ g.yung drung nas g.yung drung gi rtags bar 'di bas 'og ma 'di btsan/ rmor chen 'jam pa'i dbyangs ngag dbang kun dga' lhun grub/ mkhan chen rdo rje 'chang dpal ldan chos skyong*/ des bdag tshul khrims rin chen la stsal bar 'gyur ro/ /yang na mkhyen rab bstan 'dzin bzang po/ byams pa 'di mi 'dug chad dam snyam/ ngag dbang lhun grub/ mtshungs med chos rje kun dga' chos 'phel/ mkhas btsun chen po nam mkha' dpal bzang*/ des bdag ban+de tshul khrims rin chen la stsal to// yang na mal lo nas/ pu cer lo tsā ba/ la stod dbang rin/ mchims chos seng*/ mchims blo brtan/ mchims nam mkha' grags/ chos kyi rgyal po 'phags pa rin po che/ bla ma ye shes rin chen/ bla ma mkhan chen pa/ bla ma klu byang pa/ lo tsā ba mchog ldan/ bla ma dpal ldan pa/ thams cad mkhyen pa bsod nams rgyal mtshan/ bla chen kun dga' rgyal mtshan/ ngor chen rdo rje 'chang man 'dra/ yang na 'phags pa rin po che nas/ bla brang pa gzhon nu rgyal mtshan/ bla brang pa blo gros rgyal mtshan/ bla brang pa bzang po dpal/ rje btsun dpal chen bzang po/ ye shes dpal 'byor/ bzang po'ang byung*/ rgyal sras blo bzang dpal 'byor/ chag lo rin chen chos rgyal/ sa lo 'jam dpal rdo rje man 'dra'o// ༈ /ngor chen rdo rje 'chang chen pos mdzad pa'i yi ge la brten nas rdo rje gur nas gsungs pa'i las rgyas pa'i lha shes phyin dkar mo'i rjes su gnang ba thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ ston pa thub pa'i dbang po/ badz+ra pā ṇi/ dze tā ri/ rdo rje gdan pa che chung*/ ba ri rin chen grags/ rje btsun sa skya pa chen po/ slob dpon bsod nams rtse mo/ rje btsun grags pa rgyal mtshan/ kun mkhyen sa skya paṇ+ḍi ta/

tshogs sgom kun dga' dpal/ nyan chen bsod nams brtan pa/ chos rje bsod nams skyabs/ rje gzungs kyi dpal ba/ chos rje dpal ldan tshul khrims/ shar chen ye shes rgyal mtshan/ ngor chen rdo rje 'chang kun dga' bzang po/ rgyal tshab kun dga' dbang phyug mkhan chen legs pa'i 'byung gnas/ sa lo 'jam dpal rdo rje/ ngor chen dkon mchog lhun grub/ thar rtse nam mkha' dpal bzang*/ ngag dbang mchog legs rdo rje/ mkhyen rab bstan 'dzin bzang po/ mkhyen rab byams pa ngag dbang lhun grub/ grub mchog kun dga' lhun grub/ des bdag tshul khrims rin chen la yig cha de nyid kyi lung bcas stsal to// ༈ /grub pa'i dbang phyug thang stong rgyal pos 'jigs byed mun pa tshal gyi dur khrod du bram ze mchog sred las mgon po'i rgyud dang man ngag rnams gsan zhing khyad par rdo rje gur nas bshad pa'i mgon po 'di nyid kyi rjes gnang gsan pa'i tshe/ nam srod kyi cha la sprin nag du ba'i mdog can gyi dbus na zhabs pus man chad nub pa'i sku'i snang ba gsal bar bstan pas gur mgon sprin gseb mar grags pa'i rjes gnang ting 'dzin nyi zla bzang pos mdzad pa'i dgra bgegs tshar gcod kyi yi ge bzhin thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ slob dpon bram ze mchog sred/ grub pa'i dbang phyug thang stong rgyal po/ rje btsun rdo ring pa chen po/ rje btsun kun dga' grol mchog bstan 'dzin nyi zla bzang po/ de dbon ngag dbang nyi ma/ sprul pa'i sku mchog kun dga' bsod nams dbang phyug rdo rje 'chang drin chen bsod nams mchog grub/ mkhyen rab byams pa ngag dbang lhun grub/ grub pa'i 'khor los sgyur ba ngag dbang kun dga' lhun grub/ des bdag tshul khrims rin chen la stsal to// yig cha de nyid kyi 'gor/ na mo bīr+ya bha drā ya zhes dang*/ dam med lag tu mi sbyin bka' rgyas thob saṃ māp+ta mi thi'i mtha' can gyi lung yang nos// ༈ /bstan pa'i mnga' bdag rje btsun sa skya pa'i shin tu thugs gtsigs che ba nor gyi lha mo dbyu gu ma mched gsum gyi chos skor gyi lung man ngag phyag bzhes dang bcas legs par thob pa ni/

klu sgrub kyis sha za'i gnod sbyin mo mkha' 'gro kun nas 'khyil ba'i rtog pa las phyung ba'i sgrub thabs bla ma rdo rje gdan pa dang ba ri lo tsā bas bsgyur ba/ rdo rje gdan pas mdzad pa'i gnod sbyin mo kun nas 'khyil ba'i don bsdus 'grel pa ba ri lo tsā bas bsgyur ba la slar pa tshab lo tsā bas 'gyur bcos mdzad pa/ de'i snying po sa paṇa gyis mdzad pa bla ma ba ri ba rgya gar du bzhugs dus shin tu bkren par rdo rje gdan pas gnang nas zas gos nor gsum tshegs med du 'ong gsungs pa'i lo rgyus dang bcas pa'i gdams ngag chos brgyags su bya'o'i mtha' can/ 'gor bla ma dam pa rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// man ngag 'di bla ma rdo rje gdan pas ba ri lo tsā ba la gnang ba'i zhes yod pa'i lo tsā ba bod du 'byon dus rdo rje gdan pas skyel thung mdzad nas gnang ba'i thugs dam mkha' 'gro ma'i dngos grub lag bcangs i thi'i mtha' can/ 'gor na mo gu ru/ dpal rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma la phyag 'tshal lo// zhes yod pa'i spun gsum gyi mngon rtogs gsal byed btsal sla ba yin no'i mtha' can/ 'gor bla ma dam pa rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// dbyu gu spun gsum gyi man ngag 'di zhes yod pa'i gtor ma gtang thabs phun sum tshogs par byed do'i mtha' can/ 'gor bla ma dam pa rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// bla ma rdo rje gdan pas bla ma ba ri lo tsā ba la gnang ba'i gdams pa zhes yod pa'i rten bca' thabs/ zab thig snying gi gdams pa i thi'i mtha' can/ 'gor bla ma dam pa rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// man ngag 'di bla ma rdo rje gdan pas ba ri lo tsā la bu khyod bod du 'gro na zhes yod pa'i mkha' 'gro ma'i lag bcangs 'dra min rdzogs byang gi mtha' can/ 'gor rnal 'byor pa gang zhig ces yod pa'i bsgrub pa bya thabs rdzogs byang gi mtha' can/ chang bu bsngo lugs dang tshigs bcad mkha' 'gro chen mo la/ 'gor na mo gu ru/

'jig rten 'dren pa phyag gi lhung bzed dbus// zhes yod pa'i brgyud pa'i lo rgyus/ rten bca' thabs/ bsnyen sgrub las sbyor bcas ston pa'i man ngag rgyas par bstan pa bla ma gsung ngo'i mtha' can/ de'i zhar byung du rab gnas bya thabs/ bla rdo bcangs thabs i thi'i mtha' can/ 'gor na mo gu ru badz+ra ḍā ki ni/ dbul ba sel ba'i gter chen mi zad pa// zhes yod pa'i man ngag bla rdo bcangs thabs dang bcas pa rgyas par bstan pa bkra shis sogs bya'o'i mtha' can/ sa skya pa chen po sngags 'chang ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams kyis dge tshul byams pa bzang po'i don du mdzad pa'i sgrub thabs bsam don kun 'grub/ shākya'i dge slong rat+na'i mtha' can gyis bskul ba'i don du tsakra la brten pa'i dbang sdud zab mo'i lag len gsal bar bkod pa bsam 'phel nor bu rnams thob pa las/ rgya gzhung yig rnying rnams kyi lung gi brgyud pa ni/ thub pa'i dbang po/ rje btsun 'jam pa'i dbyangs/ dze tā ri/ rdo rje gdan pa/ ba ri lo tsā ba rin chen grags pa/ sa chen kun dga' snying po/ slob dpon rin po che bsod nams rtse mo/ rje btsun rin po che grags pa rgyal mtshan/ 'jam mgon sa skya paṇ+ḍi ta/ bla ma khang ston pa/ skyi ston grags pa rgyal mtshan/ jo nang kun mkhyen chen po/ bla ma byang chub seng ge shar chen ye shes rgyal mtshan/ ngor chen rdo rje 'chang kun dga' bzang po/ gu ge paṇa chen grags pa rgyal mtshan/ glo bo mkhan chen bsod nams lhun grub/ sa lo 'jam dpal rdo rje/ ngor chen dkon mchog lhun grub/ mus chen dkon mchog rgya mtsho/ mus chen sangs rgyas rgyal mtshan/ dpal sa skya pa chen po sngags 'chang kun dga' bsod nams/ mkhan chen nam mkha' rin chen/ grub brtson kun dga' bzang po/ khams ston sangs rgyas dpal bzang*/ mkhas grub sangs rgyas phun tshogs/ chos kyi rje kun dga' chos 'phel/ mkhan chen sangs rgyas dpal bzang*/

des bdag la'o// yang na sa skya pa kun dga' bsod nams kyis mdzad pa'i yig cha rnams kyi lung brgyud ni/ yan chad rgya gzhung ltar las/ de nas sa skya pa kun dga' bsod nams nas/ mkhan chen sangs rgyas dpal bzang*/ des bdag la'o// yang na bod gzhung rkyang pa'i lung ni/ sangs rgyas phun tshogs par 'dra/ de nas bstan 'dzin lhun grub/ mkhan chen bkra shis lhun grub/ des bdag la'o// yang na ba ri lo tsā ba/ sa skya pa chen po/ rje btsun rin po che/ sa skya paṇ+ḍi ta/ 'phags pa rin po che blo gros rgyal mtshan/ tshogs sgom kun dga' dpal/ nyan chen bsod nams brtan pa/ rgyal ba brag phug pa bsod nams dpal/ bla ma blo bzang pa/ bla ma seng ge dpal/ bla ma dam pa bsod nams rgyal mtshan/ chag lo rin chen chos rgyal/ sa lo 'jam dpal rdo rje man 'dra/ yang na ngor chen rdo rje 'chang*/ mus chen sems dpa' chen po/ rje bsod nams seng ge de sras bya btang rje/ 'jam dbyangs nam mkha' sangs rgyas/ rje chos kyi dbang phyug mus chen sangs rgyas rgyal mtshan man 'dra'o// ༈ /bla ma g.ya' bzang pa nas brgyud pa'i gza' srung thos pa/ gnubs 'dul 'dzin chen po rgyal ba g.ya' bzang par drang srong gzas dngos su phul ba'i gza' nyi ma mdung gang ma'i skor la/ rang skor man ngag la dgos pa'i sgom lung*/ rang gi skor le tshan gnyis/ g.ya' bzang yang dkon gyi skor/ sham po rtsal gyi skor/ gzims chung ma'i skor dang drug dang po phyag rdor sgom

sgom lung zur du 'bogs pa zhig ma byung yang lung gis thus sam/ lung sogs/ brgyud pa rgyal ba g.ya' bzang pa/ chos smon lam 'od pa/ khams sgom bya bral nyi ma rgyal mtshan/ thar pa bde rgyas pa don yod dpal/ bla ma dam pa bsod nams rgyal mtshan/ mdo stod pa brtson 'grus dpal/ gtsang nyeg pa rin chen zhwa lu'i phu shar bsam gtan sgang nas yin/ rgyal mtshan/ dben pa bla ma rin chen dpal grub/ zhwa lu'i phu nub pa/ chos rje ston dge ba/ srad pa/ chos rje bka' bcu dar bzang*/ snar thang pa/ chos rje don grub grags pa dpal bzang*/ srad pa/ slob dpon bka' bcu bsod nams grags pa/ lo chen chos skyong bzang po/ bar 'dir bla ma gcig gnyis shig ma rnyed/ byang gling pa dbang rab la sogs/ yang na gtsang nyeg pa rin chen rgyal mtshan nas/ snar thang byang chen pa bsod nams blo gros/ chos rje don grub grags pa/ bka' bcu bsod grags man 'dra/ yang na bla ma dam pa/ gtsang nyeg pa man 'dra/ skor rnams mi 'dra ba mang du snang*/ yang na g.ya' bzang pa nas/ nyi ma rgyal mtshan don yod dpal/ bla ma dam pa/ mkhan chen byang seng*/ theg chen chos rje/ bla ma chos grags pa/ rin chen bzang po/ gangs can kun dga' dpal/ rin chen legs 'phel/ o rgyan dpal 'byor/ g.ya' bzang pa rin chen phun tshogs/ rin chen dar rgyas sogs/ yang theg chen nas/ mar ston rgyal mtshan 'od zer/ brag nag pa rin chen rgyal mtshan/ paṇa chen shākya mchog ldan/ lha btsun grags pa byang chub/ kun spangs rin chen/ khrab chen sangs rgyas dpal bzang*/ nam mkha' sangs rgyas/ chos dbang phyug mus chen sangs rgyas rgyal mtshan/ a mi lags/ tshogs gsog pas 'di nas gsan nam brtag tshogs gsog pa nas rje bud+dha ba/ mkhas grub sangs rgyas phun tshogs/ gtsang gsar chos rje/ gter dbon bsod nams lhun grub/ des bdag tshul khrims rin chen la'o// smras pa/ rtsa bshad rgyud kyis nyer bstan kye rdo rje// bka' babs rnam gsum gur dang kha sbyor dbang*// shes rab pha rol phyin ma mgon rkyang bcas// kun 'khyil la sogs bkas gnang skal ba sbom// zhes dam pa'i chos thos pa'i yi ge don gnyer gdengs can rol pa'i chu gter las/

thabs shes gnyis med dgyes pa rdo rje'i rgyud gsum gyi chos skor thos pa'i brgyud rim gyi sarga ste bcu dgu pa'o// //gnyis su med pa'i rgyud kyi rgyal po dang po'i sangs rgyas dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i skor la/ rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas nyi ma'i gnyen nyid shing pho rta'i lo sa gas nya ba'i tshes la zag pa med pa'i bdud rtsi mchog brnyes pa'i go 'phang bla na med pa mngon du mdzad nas bgrang gzhi bzhi bcu rtsa drug 'das pa lcags 'brug nag pa'i zla bar shrī dha n+ya ka ṭa ka'i mchod rten gyi nang gi steng du dpal ldan rgyu skar gyi dkyil 'khor spros te sprul pa'i chos rgyal zla ba bzang po la sogs pa skal ldan gyi gdul bya rnams smin par mdzad/ de'i phyi lo chos rgyal zla ba bzang pos dus 'khor rtsa ba'i rgyud bsdus/ byang phyogs sham bha lar chos rgyal drug dang rigs ldan bcu bdun 'das shing rigs ldan rnam gnon gdong lnga'i dbang pos sgeg pa'i chos kyi khrir phebs shing*/ dam pa'i chos bstan nas lo sum cu rtsa lnga pa/ me mkha' rgya mtsho la 'das lo drug cu skor bdun dang nyag ma lnga bcur slebs pa/ rab byung bcu gsum pa'i khyu mchog co zhes pa'i gnam lo shar ba/ sgrol byed bu mo dbos nya ba'i zla ba/ dkar po'i phyogs kyi rdzogs pa gsum pa'i tshe sa ga la bar/ res gza' pa sangs/ skar ma phug ron/ sbyor ba las bzang*/ byed pa snga cha biṣ+ṭi/ phyi cha gdab pa rnams shar ba'i dus su mdo khams phyogs kyi dbyig 'dzin thig le shrī se na shu bha'i rigs kyi chos ldan gyi sa'i tshangs pa chen pos phun tshogs stobs kyi 'khor los legs par bsrungs pa'i gdan sa chen po lhun grub steng gi gtsug lag khang chen por khams gsum 'gro ba'i bla ma khyab bdag 'khor lo'i mgon po dang po'i sangs rgyas kā la tsakra nyid ngur smrig bla gos gsar pa'i lang tshos mngon par sgeg pa'i blo gsal kun dga' ster byed phun tshogs mdzad pa'i chu gter skyong ba gang de dus kyi 'khor lo'i ting nge 'dzin la bzhugs pa'i rdo rje'i slob dpon chen po gang gis dpal dus kyi 'khor lo sku gsung thugs yongs su rdzogs pa'i rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor chen por thams cad mkhyen pa bu ston rin po ches mdzad pa'i mngon par rtogs pa rgyas pa dngos grub 'dod 'jo/

dkyil chog yon tan kun 'byung*/ mchod phreng mchod sprin rgya mtsho/ mkhyen rab rjes mdzad pa'i zin bris bkra shis rab rgyas/ gzhan yang slob ma yang slob dang bcas pa'i zin bris thor bu bzhugs pa rnams kyi steng nas rdo rje'i slob bu ngag dbang tshul khrims rin chen du bod pa la byis pa 'jug pa'i dbang bdun gyi dbang bskur ba la brten nas 'og min srid pa'i mthar thug pa'i 'jig rten pa'i dngos grub 'grub pa dang*/ sems can thams cad kyi bden pa nyid kyi bsod nams dang ye shes kyi 'bras bu thob pa'i slad du lung bstan cing rjes su gnang ba dang*/ zab lam rdo rje'i rnal 'byor mchog gi nges don gyi dkyil 'khor rnams su dbang gong ma bzhi gong chen dang bcas pa bdag po chen po'i dbang rnams brgyud pa'i bka' babs bzhi dang ldan pa legs par nos pa'i dang po 'bro lugs kyi brgyud pa ni/ khyab bdag dang po'i sangs rgyas/ chos sku rdo rje 'chang*/ longs sku dus kyi 'khor lo/ sprul sku shākya thub pa/ chos rgyal zla ba bzang po/ lha'i dbang po/ gzi brjid can/ zla bas byin/ lha'i dbang phyug sna tshogs gzugs/ lha'i dbang ldan te chos rgyal bdun/ rigs ldan 'jam dpal grags pa/ pad+ma dkar po/ bzang po/ rnam rgyal/ bshes gnyen bzang po/ phyag na rin chen/ phyag dmar ba yang zer/ khyab 'jug sbas pa/ nyi ma grags pa/ shin tu bzang po/ rgya mtsho rnam rgyal/ 'di nas me mkha' rgya mtsho'i dbu tshugs/ rgyal dga'/ nyi ma/ sna tshogs gzugs/ zla ba'i 'od/ mtha' yas/ sa skyong*/ dpal skyong*/ grub chen dus 'khor zhabs pa che chung*/ che ba tsor yang sha'i pho brang du 'khrungs/ chung pa nā len+da pa/ rgyal sras nā len+da pa/ bu ston rje btsun btsong kha pa gong dkar thar rtse lo pa spyan snga sgrub khang pa rnams kyi gsan yig na mi 'dug kyang mkhan chen ngag dbang chos grags pa'i gsan yig na kha che zla mgon dang gcig par mdzad/

ngor chen/ rdo rje 'chang sngags rams pa/ rje mkhyen brtse gsum gyi gsan yig na dkyus ltar snang ba dpyad do/ /kha che zla ba mgon po/ paṇa dkar/ 'bro lo tsā ba shes rab grags/ grab sgom dkon mchog srung*/ 'phan yul ba bod btsun/ rnal 'byor bzang po sgro ston rnams la brtsegs/ sngags dkar co breg can/ grub chen yu btsun rgan mo bu ston rje btsong kha pa ngor chen gong dkar thar rtse ngag chos lo pa rnams kyi gsan yig na mi snang bas dpyad/ dad pa gsang mtshan mi bskyod rdo rje/ rgyal po/ sras chos kyi dbang phyug sngags dkar co breg can/ grub thob nam mkha' 'od/ sprul sku jo 'bum/ se mo che ba nam mkha' rgyal mtshan/ 'jam gsar shes rab 'od zer/ phyam rtse ba/ kun mkhyen chos sku 'od zer/ kun spangs thugs rje brtson 'grus/ se ston kun rig gi skye bar grags/ bod btsun yin/ byang sems rgyal ba ye shes/ 'phags 'od yon tan rgya mtsho/ thams cad mkhyen pa bu ston rin chen grub/ thugs sras rin chen rnam rgyal/ 'jam dbyangs grags pa rgyal mtshan/ shar pa ye shes rgya mtsho/ rdo rje 'chang mkhyen rab chos rje/ sku zhang bsod nams mchog grub/ chos rje don grub rgyal mtshan/ byang gling 'jam dpal bkra shis rgyal mtshan/ 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i dbang phyug rdo rje 'chang dbang phyug rab brtan/ mgon po bsod nams mchog ldan/ mkhan chen tshe dbang lhun grub/ khyab bdag klu sgrub rgyal mtshan/ mtshungs med smon lam lhun grub/ rdo rje 'dzin dbang brtson 'grus bzang po/ stobs bcu mnga' ba mchog gi bstan pa rin po che'i snang byed/ gsang chen dkyil 'khor rgya mtsho'i mnga' bdag gnas gsar mkhan po ngag dbang kun dga' legs pa'i 'byung gnas bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po nga*/ khyab bdag 'khor lo'i mgon po dpal ldan dang po'i sangs rgyas ngur smrig 'chang gi rnam par rol pa'i dus 'khor ba rdo rje slob dpon chen po kun dga' phun tshogs pa/

des bdag ban+de shī la rat+na'i ming can la bka' drin du stsal to// yang na 'jam gsar nas/ rje btsun rong pa rgwa lo/ de sras shes rab seng ge skyi ston grags pa rgyal mtshan/ kun mkhyen shes rab rgyal mtshan man 'dra/ yang na 'jam gsar nas/ kun mkhyen chos sku 'od zer/ kun spangs thugs rje brtson 'grus/ byang sems rgyal ba ye shes/ 'phags 'od yon tan rgya mtsho/ bu ston thams cad mkhyen pa rin chen grub/ thugs sras lo tsā ba rin chen rnam rgyal/ 'jam dbyangs shākya gzhon nu/ gzhon nu rdo rje/ kun mkhyen shākya don grub man 'dra/ yang na kun mkhyen shes rab rgyal mtshan/ gnyags phu ba bsod nams bzang po/ paṇa chen byams pa gling pa bsod nams rnam par rgyal ba/ kun mkhyen rdo rje gdan pa kun dga' rnam rgyal/ mkhas grub rnam rgyal rin chen/ yongs 'dzin shākya kun dga'/ dam chos gling pa ye shes dbang po/ nyi ma gling pa tshul khrims bkra shis/ rje rin chen rgya mtsho/ rdo rje 'chang chen po kun bzang pad+ma phrin las/ kun mkhyen bstan pa'i sgron me ngag dbang kun dga' lhun grub man 'dra'o// yang bu lugs kyi 'bro'i brgyud pa ltar na/ 'phags 'od yon tan rgya mtsho yan gong ltar las/ thams cad mkhyen pa bu ston rin chen grub/ thugs sras sems dpa' chen po rin chen rnam rgyal/ 'jam dbyangs grags pa rgyal mtshan/ shar pa ye shes rgya mtsho/ rdo rje 'chang mkhyen rab chos rje/ sku zhang rin po che bsod nams mchog grub/ yang na kun mkhyen chos sku 'od zer nas/ 'phags 'od yon tan rgya mtsho/ bu ston man 'dra/ thar lo lugs kyi ring brgyud ni/ 'jam gsar ba yan gong ltar las/ de nas nyeg po chos ldan/ go lung pa gzhon nu dpal/ thar lo nyi ma rgyal mtshan/ bu ston rin po che man 'dra/ yang na rdo rje 'chang*/ dpe med 'tsho/ dpal 'dzin/ 'od byed lha/ chos 'byung zhi ba/ nyi ma dpal ye shes/ rin chen 'tsho/ bi bhū ti/

ko grag pa bsod nams rgyal mtshan/ go lung pa gzhon nu dpal man 'dra/ yang nye brgyud ni/ rdo rje 'chang*/ sha ba ri/ bi bhū ti/ ko grag pa man 'dra/ yang shong lugs kyi brgyud pa ni/ se mo che pa nam mkha' rgyal mtshan nas/ bo dong rin chen rtse mo/ stag sde ba seng ge rgyal mtshan/ shong lo tsā ba rdo rje rgyal mtshan/ shong lo tsā ba blo gros brtan pa/ mang mkhar lo tsā ba mchog ldan legs pa'i blo gros/ bla ma dpal ldan seng ge bu ston thams cad mkhyen pa man 'dra/ yang na bo dong rin chen rtse mo nas/ 'dzim pa rin chen shes rab/ shar pa dus 'khor ba ye shes rin chen/ kun spangs thugs rje brtson 'grus/ 'phags 'od yon tan rgya mtsho/ chos rje bu ston rin po che man 'dra'o// yang na bu ston rin po che nas/ bla ma dharma shrī snar thang lo tsā ba saṅgha shrī/ gzad pa rin chen rgyal mtshan/ brag thog pa bsod nams bzang po/ rdo rje gdan pa chen po/ mkhas grub rin chen rnam rgyal/ yangs pa can pa shākya kun dga'/ dam chos gling pa ye shes dbang po/ mtshungs med nyi ma gling pa man 'dra/ yang na bu ston rin po che nas/ thugs sras rin chen rnam rgyal/ zhwa lu khang rnying slob dpon bsod nams chos 'phel/ stag tshang lo tsā ba sogs las brgyud pa'ang yod do// bka' babs gnyis pa rwa lugs kyi brgyud pa ni/ dang po'i sangs rgyas/ chos rgyal zla ba bzang po/ chos rgyal sum cu gnyis/ gsan yig rnams su 'di ltar 'byung yang tsi lu pa'i dus rigs ldan yan ma gtogs de min dpyad gzhir snang*/ 'jam dbyangs sprul pa tsi lu paṇ+ḍi ta/ pi to pa/ gong dkar ba dang thar rtse ba'i gsan yig na paṇ+ḍi ta ā tsār+ya zhes pa 'dug dus zhabs pa che chung*/ mañdzu kīrti/ sa man+ta shrī/ rwa lo tsā ba chen po chos rab/ ne'u me tog gdan du 'khrungs/ rwa ye shes seng ge khu lung se byi ru/ rwa 'bum seng*/ khu lung chos shing dgon pa/
