rje btsun rgwa lo rnam rgyal rdo rje/ rong dman dmar ba/ bla ma rong pa shes rab seng ge rong sham+bhar du/ skyi ston grags pa rgyal mtshan man gong bzhin no// bu lugs rwa brgyud ltar na/ dam pa dang po'i sangs rgyas/ dpal dus kyi 'khor lo/ rgyal ba shākya thub pa/ zla ba bzang po/ lha dbang gzi brjid can/ zla bas byin/ lha'i dbang phyug sna tshogs gzugs/ lha'i dbang ldan/ 'jam dbyangs grags pa/ pad+ma dkar po/ 'jam dbyangs sprul pa/ tsi lu paṇa chen/ rwa pa rnams 'di dang dus zhabs pa tha dad du bzhed/ pi to ā tsār+ya/ dus zhabs pa che ba/ dus zhabs pa gnyis pa/ mañdzu kīrti/ sa man+ta shrī/ rwa chos rab/ rwa ye shes seng ge rwa 'bum seng*/ rgwa lo rnam rgyal rdo rje/ de sras shes rab seng ge bla ma dpal ldan seng ge bu ston thams cad mkhyen pa man sngar bzhin no// yang na rong pa shes rab seng ge nas/ rong pa rdo rje rgyal mtshan/ bu ston rje man sngar dang 'dra'o// bka' babs gsum pa sa lugs kyi brgyud pa ni/ dpal dus kyi 'khor lo/ byang chub sems dpa' rdo rje snying po/ rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma/ tsi lu paṇ+ḍi ta/ dus zhabs pa che ba/ dus zhabs pa gnyis pa/ a nu pa ma rak+ṣi ta/ sā dhu pu tra/ chos kyi 'byung gnas/ chos kyi bshes gnyen/ bi k+ṣā ta de wa/ ma hā paṇ+ḍi ta shākya shrī/ 'jam dbyangs sa skya paṇ+ḍi ta/ 'gro ba'i mgon po chos rgyal 'phags pa/ rgyus pa gzhon nu seng ge dol po ye shes mgon po/ kun spangs kun tu bzang po/ kun mkhyen 'phags 'od yon tan rgya mtsho/ bu ston thams cad mkhyen pa man 'dra'o// bka' babs bzhi pa ma hā paṇ+ḍi ta nags kyi rin chen lugs kyi brgyud pa ni/ rigs ldan rnam rgyal yan gong ltar las/ de nas dus zhabs pa che chung*/ shākya seng ge rgyal mtshan/ nyi ma'i 'od/ gau tam dpal/ rin chen bkra shis/ rgyal ba'i rgyan/ blo ldan rje/ shākya bsrungs pa/ rje chen po legs skyes/

dpal sangs rgyas dbyangs/ ma hā paṇ+ḍi ta nags kyi rin chen/ kun mkhyen rdo rje gdan pa man sngar bzhin no// ༈ /dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i rgyas 'grel rtsa ba'i rgyud kyi rjes su 'jug pa 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs kyis mdzad pa/ stong phrag bcu gnyis pa dri ma med pa'i 'od le'u lnga pa 'bro lo tsā ba shes rab grags kyis bsgyur zhing*/ slar shong ston gyis dpal ldan sa skyar dag par bsgyur ba la bu ston thams cad mkhyen pas dka' ba'i gnas la gsung mchan zhib par mdzad pa bcas pa'i lung yongs su rdzogs pa thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ rong pa shes rab seng ge yan dbang brgyud bu lugs kyi rwa lugs dang 'dra zhing*/ de nas bla ma rdo rje rgyal mtshan/ thams cad mkhyen pa bu ston rin chen grub/ thugs sras sems dpa' chen po rin chen rnam rgyal/ mkhas pa rat+na shrī/ mkhas pa zla ba dpal rin/

tsan+d+ra shrī/ 'khrul zhig tshul khrims rgyal mtshan/ rdo rje 'chang mkhyen rab chos rje/ byang gling pa rin chen rgyal po/ 'brog khang pa don grub rgyal mtshan/ byang gling pa rin chen bkra shis rgyal mtshan/ dge 'khor ba rin chen dkon mchog lha 'o pa rin chen rgya mtsho/ mkhan chen rin chen bsod nams mchog grub/ mngon dga' ba rin chen rgya mtsho/ don grub chos gling pa mtshungs med bstan pa dar rgyas/ rmor chen ngag dbang kun dga' lhun grub/ gnas gsar ba kun dga' legs pa'i 'byung gnas man 'dra'o// dpal dus kyi 'khor lo la thun mong gi las sgrub pa'i lha gsum yod pa'i dang po rje sgo rum pas mdzad pa'i yi ge'i steng nas rdo rje'i tsher ma 'brum nad kyi gnyen po bcom ldan 'das ma sna tshogs yum gyi rjes su gnang ba thun mong ma yin pa phyag len ltar dang sgo rum pas mdzad pa'i yi ge'i lung bcas thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ dang po'i sangs rgyas/ rigs gsum mgon po/ dus zhabs pa che chung*/ rgyal sras nā len+da pa/ paṇa chen zla ba mgon po/ 'bro lo tsā ba shes rab grags/ sgom pa dkon mchog srung*/ sgro ston gnam la brtsegs/ 'phan yul sgro rings pa/ yu mo dad pa rgyal po/ sras dharme shwa ra/ rje nam mkha' 'od/ ma gcig sprul sku jo 'bum/ se mo che ba nam mkha' rgyal mtshan/ 'jam gsar shes rab 'od zer/ kun mkhyen chos sku 'od zer/ kun spangs thugs rje brtson 'grus/ byang sems rgyal ba ye shes/ mkhas btsun yon tan rgya mtsho/ dol po kun mkhyen shes rab rgyal mtshan/ sa bzang ma ti paṇa chen/ 'phags pa gzhon nu blo gros/ rdo rje 'chang kun dga' bzang po/ rje bsod nams sangs rgyas/ rje btsun rdo ring pa chen po/ rdo rje 'chang tshar pa chos rje/ 'jam mgon mkhyen brtse'i dbang phyug rdo rje 'chang dbang phyug rab brtan/ mkhan chen zhwa lu pa rin chen bsod nams mchog grub/ rdo rje 'chang mkhyen rab byams pa ngag dbang lhun grub/

ngag dbang kun dga' lhun grub man sngar bzhin no// yang na rdo ring rin po che nas/ rje btsun sgo rum pa/ 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i dbang phyug man 'dra/ yang na sgo rum pa nas/ de dbon ngag dbang brtan pa'i rdo rje/ mkhyen brtse'i zhabs man 'dra'o// yang na shrī kā la tsakra/ ma hā paṇ+ḍi ta nags kyi rin chen/ khrims khang lo tsā ba bsod nams rgya mtsho'i sde/ bla ma gnyis gong 'og nor 'dug kyang ras chung pas mid la la tshe dbang phul ba ltar yin nam zhes gsan yig tu snang*/ 'gos lo tsā ba gzhon nu dpal/ chag lo rin chen chos rgyal/ bdag chen ngag gi dbang phyug kun mkhyen mkhyen brtse'i zhabs man 'dra'o// ༈ /gnyis pa klu dang sa bdag gi gdon 'joms pa mkha' lding rdo rje khyung khra bo'i skor la/ rje sgo rum pas mdzad pa'i sgrub thabs rgyud 'grel dang mthun par sbyar ba'i yi ge'i steng nas rjes gnang thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ rdo rje 'chang*/ chos rgyal zla ba bzang po/ 'jam dpal grags pa/ pad+ma dkar po/ dus zhabs pa che chung gnyis/ tai lo pa/ nā ro pa/ pham mthing pa sku mched/ mkhyen brtse thar rtse sgrub khang gsum gyi gsan yig na mi gsal yang rdzong lugs kyi gsan yig na 'di'i rjes su glog skya shes rab brtsegs 'dug pa chad dam snyam/ mal lo tsā ba blo gros grags/ sa chen kun dga' snying po/ slob dpon bsod nams rtse mo/ rje btsun grags pa rgyal mtshan/ chos rje sa skya paṇ+ḍi ta/ 'phags pa rin po che/ zhang dkon mchog dpal/ dga' ldan pa kun dga' bsod nams/ rgyal ba brag phug pa/ ri khrod pa blo gros brtan pa/ chos rje dpal ldan tshul khrims/ shar chen ye shes rgyal mtshan/ rdo rje 'chang kun dga' bzang po/ gu ge paṇ+ḍi ta grags pa rgyal mtshan/ mkhan chen legs pa'i 'byung gnas/ sa skya lo tsā ba/ rje dkon mchog lhun grub/ rje nam mkha' dpal bzang*/ 'jam dbyangs kun dga' bsod nams lhun grub/

spyan snga kun dga' don grub/ ngag dbang bsod nams rgyal mtshan/ chos rje bkra shis dpal ldan/ chos rje sangs rgyas dpal bzang*/ mkhas grub chen po sangs rgyas phun tshogs/ bka' drin mnyam med rdo rje 'chang tshul khrims lhun grub/ des bdag ban+de tshul khrims rin chen la bka' drin du stsal to// sgrub thabs gong du smos pa dang*/ rjes gnang sgrub thabs rgya mtsho ltar mdzad do// ༈ /chos kyi rgyal po 'phags pas mdzad pa'i rjes gnang dang de'i zur 'debs le'u mkhan chen byams pa ngag dbang dpal bzang gis mdzad pa gnyis la brten nas dus kyi 'khor lo'i bsdus rgyud kyis zin cing paṇ+ḍi ta nā ro pa'i man ngag rje btsun sa skya pa chen po'i zab chos dpal rdo rje khyung khra'i sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las kyi byin rlabs byab bsrung dang 'brel ba nos nas/ rgyab brten lung la/ mnyam med bzang po rgyal mtshan gyis mdzad pa'i chos skor gyi dkar chag thub bstan mi mjed ma/ byis pa'i gdon chen bco lnga'i nang nas bya mig gi bcos thabs zhes pa brtag thabs/ gso thabs/ phyir 'phro gcad pa dang bcas pa sngags 'chang gzungs kyi dpal bas mdzad pa la snying po'i zhal shes rnams go bde phyir shrī bsam rtser pha la'i ming can gyis bris pa/ tshim par byed pa bya mdos kyi yi ge bya rgyud dang mthun par rdo rje khyung khra'i las mtha' gzungs kyi ming can gyis mdzad pa/ khyi smyon gyi brtag pa/ gso ba'i thabs/ rang srung rjes gcod dang bcas pa sngags 'chang gzungs pas mdzad pa zhal shes rnams go bde phyir bsnan te shrī bsam rtser pha la'i ming can gyis bris pa/ gza' nad la dang por brtag pa/ bar du gso dpyad/ phyir mi ldog pa rjes kyi bya ba dang gsum gyis bstan pa sngags 'chang gzungs dpal gyis mdzad par slar yang zhal shes kyis brgyan pa shrī bsam rtser pha la'i ming can gyis bris pa/ dkar phra men brtag thabs kyi zhal shes/

gza' bcos kyi lag len dang shog dril khyung rgya ma zhes par ming dang 'gyu dus/ phyi ru rten 'brel brtsi ba/ gza' brgyad kyi sngags/ rā hu la'i byad 'grol dang bcas pa gzungs pas rdzong chung bla brang du mdzad pa/ las mde gshed skor zab mo/ sbrul lpags la brten pa'i bsrung ba/ gza' mdos kyi cho ga 'bring po rdzogs byang gi mtha' can/ dug nad gso ba bai ḍūr+ya'i phreng ba zhes pa brtag pa/ 'chos thabs/ 'bring bsdus zab mo sngags 'chang gzungs pas mdzad pa/ dug bsrung brtag pa'i man ngag zab mo zur du bris pas blta bar bya'o'i mtha' can/ las sbyor drug pa zhes pa bong nga'i bcud len gnyan gyis so btab pa gso ba/ dug bsrung dug khong du song ba bzlog pa/ nad phyogs med 'joms pa/ de'i gegs sel dang dmigs pa'i khyad par rnams bla ma'i gsung bzhin 'phags pa rin po ches mdzad pa/ nā ro paṇa chen nas brgyud pa'i rdo rje khyung khra'i las sbyor brgyad pa/ zhes pa bong nga la brten nas grang ba snying rlung tshad pa sel zhing bcud len gyi mchog tu 'gyur ba/ g.yos dug dbyig dug sbyar dug bsrung ba/ rgyu ba'i dug rnams kyis so btab pa zhi ba/ gre nad sel ba/ gnyan tshad las grol ba/ nad brgya sman gcig nad spyi dang khyad par mdze dreg grum gza' nad sel ba/ bum chog gtor chog dang bcas pa sngags 'chang gzungs pas rdzong chung bla brang du mdzad pa/ dreg 'don pa'i man ngag bla ma dam pa'i zhabs la dreg byung ba'i dus dpal gyi ming can gyis sa skyar bkod pa/ dreg sel ba sdig pa chung pa bka' rgya ma/ mdze 'chos pa brtag thabs gso thabs rjes gsum gyis bstan pa lus la btags so'i mtha' can/ bsnyen pa 'khyol nas thog bsrung ba 'phags pas shing kun tu mdzad pa/ khyung gi las mtha' gegs sel gzer lnga'i snyan brgyud gzungs kyi ming can gyis rdo rje khyung khra'i las mder sbyar ba/ rgyal mo chu sbyang ba 'og rlung 'bebs so'i mtha' can/

rigs gsum 'dus pa'i drag sngags phyag cha rang la bskor ba skyin thang bsrung ba/ ser ba bsrung ba/ lo chog dang lo phud kyi lag len zhes pa sngon 'gro dang dngos gzhi la nam mkha'i mthongs su sprin nag gi gur bshig pa/ ri thang mtshams su ser ba'i rkang bcag pa/ bar snang khams su 'khyags pa chur bzhu ba/ sa gzhi'i steng du rlung gi gzhu bcag pa/ drag po 'brug gi ngar skad bcag pa rnams bstan pa/ kha ba bsrung ba/ 'phags pa rin po ches mdzad pa'i sbyin sreg gi cho ga des mdzad pa'i rjes gnang gi yi ge des mdzad pa'i bstod pa rigs lnga'i klu 'dul/ ā nan+da ma ti bha dras mdzad pa'i sgrub thabs/ sngags 'chang gzungs pas mdzad pa'i sgrub thabs nang bzhin las 'don mjug cung zad kha bskang ba/ mkhan chen byams pa ngag dbang dpal bzang gis mdzad pa'i byin rlabs zur 'debs kyi yi ge dang bcas pa rnams legs par thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ drug pa rdo rje 'chang*/ ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro ma/ paṇa chen nā ro pa/ bal po pham mthing pa sku mched/ gcen 'jigs med grags pa/ gcung ngag dbang grags pa/ klog skya shes rab brtsegs/ mal lo blo gros grags/ dpal sa skya pa chen po/ slob dpon rin po che/ rje btsun grags pa rgyal mtshan/ chos rje sa paṇ+ḍi ta/ 'gro ba'i mgon po 'phags pa/ zhang dkon mchog dpal/ brag phug pa bsod nams dpal/ bla ma dam pa bsod nams rgyal mtshan/ sngags 'chang gzungs kyi dpal ba/ chos rje dge legs dpal bzang*/ rdzong chung pa ā nan+da ma ti bha dra/ chos rje sangs rgyas bzang po/ rig 'dzin chos blo gros/ rig 'dzin chos dpal bzang po/ mkhan chen byams pa bzang po/ 'bum chen kun dga' dpal 'byor/ mkhan chen byams pa ngag dbang dpal bzang*/ rdo rje 'chang zhwa lu pa rin chen bsod nams mchog grub/ gnas gsar pa mkhan chen 'jam dbyangs bstan 'dzin/ dpal ldan bla ma dam pa wā gīn+d+ra shā sa na lak+ṣ+mī/ rmor chen ngag dbang kun dga' lhun grub/

mkhan chen thams cad mkhyen pa dpal ldan chos skyong*/ de las bdag tshul khrims rin chen gyis nos so// yang na las tshogs kyi lung rkyang gi brgyud pa ni yan chad sngar bzhin la/ thams cad mkhyen pa dpal ldan chos skyong*/ de las bdag gis legs par nos so// yang na sngags 'chang gzungs pa nas/ mnyam med bzang po rgyal mtshan/ sems dpa' chen po rgyal mtshan dkon mchog rus kyi ming yin/ rtsang byams pa rdo rje rgyal mtshan/ rgyud gsum smra ba shes rab rin chen/ rdo ring kun dga' rgyal mtshan/ sgye chu mkhan chen byams pa bzang po/ 'bum chen kun dga' dpal 'byor man 'dra/ yang na ā nan+da ma ti nas/ mkhas grub byams pa rdo rje rgyal mtshan man 'dra/ yang rjes gnang dang bya khyi rnam gsum bcos thabs kyi lung brgyud lugs gcig ni/ 'bum chen nas/ 'jam dbyangs sangs rgyas bkra shis/ byams pa ngag dbang dpal bzang man 'dra// ༈ /gsum pa lo pa spyan snga kun dga' don grub kyis mdzad pa'i sgrub thabs dang rjes gnang gi yi ge la brten nas char dbab gcod byed pa khro bo'i dbang po rdo rje shugs kyi rjes su gnang ba nos pa'i brgyud pa ni/ rdo rje 'chang*/ dus kyi 'khor lo/ shākya thub pa/ chos rgyal rigs ldan so lnga/ dus zhabs pa che chung*/ kha che zla ba mgon po/ 'bro lo tsā ba shes rab grags/ lha rje sgom pa pa/ sgro ston gnam la brtsegs/ yu mo mi dad pa rgyal po zer ba'ang byung*/ bskyod rdo rje/ sras chos kyi dbang phyug se chen nam mkha' 'od zer/ kun mkhyen 'jam gsar ba/ bla ma chos sku 'od zer/ zhang thugs rje brtson 'grus/ byang sems rgyal ye/ mkhas btsun yon tan rgya mtsho/ kun mkhyen dol po shes rab rgyal mtshan/ rje phyogs las rnam rgyal/ mkhas grub nya dbon/ grub chen kun blo/ mkhan chen dkon mchog dpal 'khor chos sde'i mkhan po/ bzang po/ zhwa lu lo chen chos skyong bzang po/ lo chen rat+na bha dra/

lo chen 'gyur med bde chen/ rje a wa dhū tī pa/ spyan snga rin po che kun dga' don grub/ mkhyen rab bstan 'dzin bzang po/ mkhyen rab byams pa ngag dbang lhun grub/ thams cad mkhyen pa ngag dbang kun dga' lhun grub/ de las bdag tshul khrims rin chen gyis mnos so// 'dir rmor chen pa'i gsan yig tu/ yang ngag dbang mchog legs rdo rjes mdzad pa'i sgrub thabs rjes gnang gi yi ge'i steng nas thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ zhwa lu lo chen nas/ she'u lo tsā ba kun dga' chos grags/ byams pa ngag dbang mchog legs rdo rje/ mkhyen rab bstan 'dzin bzang po man 'dra'o// gong gi yi ge gnyis kyi rjes gnang gi chings ni shin tu mi 'dra mod kyang brgyud pa gcig pa'i phyir na gcig go gcig gis chod dam snyam mo zhes gsungs/ bdag gis ni yig cha snga ma'i steng nas thob bo// smras pa/ gsang rgyud gzhan las bshad tshul khyad par ba// dus 'khor dbang bdun gong ma gong chen bcas// thun mong dngos grub sgrub pa'i lha gsum gyi// rjes gnang thos pa'i rna lung ma dog tsam// zhes dam pa'i chos thos pa'i yi ge don gnyer gdengs can rol pa'i chu gter las/ dus kyi 'khor lo'i chos skor thos pa'i brgyud rim gyi sarga ste nyi shu pa'o// //rnal 'byor mchog gi dbyar skyes 'dzam bu las/ shing rta che srol snye ma yongs lhung ba// mkhas dbang mkhyen pa'i ma dros rtsis bsgyur ba'i// zab chos bum pa brgya skyes mnos pa'i tshul// spyi don lnga pa gser chos skor la/ dus gsum gyi bde bar gshegs pa byon dang 'byon 'gyur 'byon bzhin pa mtha' dag gi lam po che/ mdo sde dang rgyud sde mtha' dag gi man ngag thams cad kyi bcud phyung ba/ 'phags yul paṇa grub kun gyi gtsug gi nor bu lta bur gyur pa 'jigs bral dpal ldan chos skyong ngam grub pa'i 'khor los sgyur ba'i rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug bir+wa pa chen po la rje btsun rdo rje bdag med mas dngos su gnang ba'i gdams pa lam 'bras bu dang bcas pa/

'bras bu lam dang bcas pa/ gcig shes pas mang po shes pa/ skyon yon tan du blang ba/ bar gcod dngos grub tu blang ba/ ltas ngan g.yang du 'gugs pa/ ting nge 'dzin ngo shes pas bsam gtan gyi gegs sel ba/ bar gcod ngo shes pas bdud kyi gegs sel ba/ sde snod gsum gyi de nyid shes pa gser 'gyur gyi rtsi lta bu/ mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub kun gyi 'dod pa 'jo ba'i yid bzhin gyi nor bu/ gsung ngag rin po che zhes mkhas shing grub pa'i dbang phyug mtha' dag zung 'jug tu gshegs pa'i them skas chen po 'di nyid ni/ lo tsā ba rnams kyi nang nas nyi zla ltar phyogs kun tu yongs su grags pa 'brog mi shākya ye shes kyis/ 'phags yul paṇa grub kun gyi gtsug rgyan du gyur pa'i ma hā paṇ+ḍi ta gha ya dha ra mnyes pa gsum gyi sgo nas mnyes par mdzad de legs par zhus shing gtan la phab/ lo tsā ba chen po de la slob ma bgrang gis mi ldang ba'i tshogs dpag tu med pa byung ba'i nang nas gtso bor gyur pa/ gzhung rdzogs pa/ gdams ngag rdzogs pa/ grub pa thob pa'i slob ma gsum sogs byung bar grags shing*/ gdams pa rdzogs pa'i slob ma'i nang nas rab tu thob pa se mkhar chu ba kun rig de'i slob ma zhang ston chos 'bar nas bstan pa'i mnga' bdag rje btsun sa skya pa yab sras la bka' babs pa/ de'i srol 'dzin ngor rdzong gong dkar ba tshar pa la sogs pa'i mkhas shing grub pa ston ka'i mkha' dbyings dag pa'i ngos su sgrib pa med par rgyu skar gyi tshogs bkrag tu che ba ltar grangs su mi chod pa byon pa'i nang nas/ rgyal ba nyi ma'i rtsa lag chen po rang gi lung rtogs kyi bstan pa rin po che'i snang byed chen por pad+mo'i gnyen nam bsil sbyin mkhan gyi dkyil 'khor ltar bsngags shing nges pa grub pa ngor chen rdo rje 'chang kun dga' bzang po zhes yongs su grags pa'i skyes bu chen po de nyid kyis rgyal tshab chen po'i spyod pa rmad du byung ba ci rigs pas mdo sngags kyi chos thams cad la mkhas pa'i bgyi ba gsum gyi bgyi ba yang dag par bgyis pa'i nang nas/

lhag par sam+pu ṭa las/ bstan bcos tshad ma slob dpon dang*// lung gi rjes 'brang de nyid rig /gsang ston de nyid dngos po yang*// gcig nas gcig brgyud shes par bya// bla ma rab kyi zhal las blangs// zhes dang*/ tshad ma snyan brgyud bzhi yis spros pa bcad// ces pa ltar lugs srol 'di la tshad ma bzhi dang*/ snyan brgyud bzhi zhes gsungs pa'i dang po rje btsun chen pos/ chos kun tshad ma bzhi yis gtan la dbab// ces gsungs pa ltar/ bla ma tshad ma/ nyams myong tshad ma/ bstan bcos tshad ma/ lung tshad ma bzhi'i sgo nas gtan la 'bebs par mdzad pa'i tshul gyis legs par phye zhing log par smra ba gzhan gyi klan ka'i gnas rnams yang dag pa'i lung dang rigs pa dang man ngag gi sgo nas dgag sgrub kyis legs par gtan la phab pa ni/ bdag cag gi ston pas kyang ji skad du/ bsreg bcad brdar ba'i gser bzhin du// legs par brtags la nga yi bka'// blang bar bya yi gus phyir min// zhes gsungs pa lta bu'i tshul gyis sprin bral nyin mor byed pa'i dkyil 'khor ltar ches cher gsal bar byed pa po ni rdo rje 'chang chen po de nyid de/ slar yang de nyid kyi zhal slob yang slob tu bcas pa rnams kyis deng sang gi bar du 'chad nyan gyis gtan la phab cing thugs nyams su bstar bar mdzad pa'i zab pa las kyang ches zab pa 'di nyid mkhas par rlom pa gzhan gyi spyod yul du ma gyur pa yin pas/ ji skad du/ ngor chen rdo rje 'chang chen pos/ gsung ngag gnad kyi snying po ni// gnyis las gsum byung gdams ngag yin// kun gyi spyod yul ma yin pa'i// man ngag shes pa bla ma'i drin// zhes pa ltar gyi lam srol chen po de nyid kyi nyams khrid zab mo lan gsum gyi bar du thob pa'i chos kyi rkang grangs la/ thams cad mkhyen pa dkon mchog lhun grub kyis mdzad pa'i gdams ngag gi gzhung shing rgyas pa gzhung ji lta ba bzhin bkri ba'i lam gyi sngon 'gro'i khrid yig snang gsum mdzes par byed pa'i rgyan gyi steng nas bkri ba'i 'gor/

khog phub bshad thabs la/ gsung ngag bstan pa rgyas pa'i nyi 'od/ kha skong kun mkhyen go rams pas mdzad pa dang*/ kun mkhyen gung rus mdzad pa gnyis/ rje dkon mchog lhun grub pas mdzad pa'i chos 'byung rnams kyi steng nas bshad pa'i rnam grangs ci rigs pa len par mdzad/ thog mar chos spyod po ti'i lung gi skor la/ 'phags pa dkon mchog gsum rjes su dran pa'i mdo'i lung thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas thub pa/ 'phags pa kun dga' bo/ ma hā paṇ+ḍi ta/ jo bo dpal ldan a ti sha 'brom ston rgyal ba'i 'byung gnas/ pu to ba rin chen gsal/ sha ra ba yon tan grags/ gro ston bdud rtsi grags/ sangs rgyas sgom pa seng ge skyabs/ mchims nam mkha' grags/ rgyang ro byang chub 'bum/ mchims blo bzang grags/ yol ston bsod nams lhun grub/ slob dpon grags pa rgya mtsho/ mkhan chen grub pa shes rab/ rgya ston tsan+d+ra de wa/ ri khrod pa bsod nams rgya mtsho/ 'jam dbyangs shes rab rgya mtsho/ mkhas grub dpal ldan rdo rje/ yongs 'dzin dkon mchog 'phel/ thams cad mkhyen pa dkon mchog lhun grub/ de las rje dkon mchog dpal ldan dang brang ti nam mkha' dpal bzang gnyis kyis gsan/ de gnyis ka las 'jam dbyangs bsod nams lhun grub dang shar chen byams pa kun dga' bkra shis gnyis kyis gsan/ de gnyis ka las rje dpal ldan don grub/ de las rje dpal mchog rgyal mtshan/ bstan pa'i snang byed sangs rgyas phun tshogs/ thams cad mkhyen pa tshul khrims lhun grub bkra shis grags pa'i rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po/ de las ban+de tshul khrims rin chen gyis lan gsum gyi bar du nos so// yang na khri chen 'jam dbyangs kun dga' bsod nams lhun grub las/ 'dren mchog nam mkha' sangs rgyas/ rje btsun nam mkha' dpal bzang*/ 'jam dbyangs sangs rgyas phun tshogs/ thams cad mkhyen pa tshul khrims lhun grub/

des bdag ban+de tshul khrims rin chen la'o// ༈ /'phags pa phung po gsum pa'i mdo'i brgyud pa ni/ thub dbang kun dga' bo dang rak+ṣi ta// kṛṣ+ṇa'i gos can sha na'i gos can dang*// nyi ma gung pa rgyal rigs thams cad mkhyen// 'phags pa klu sgrub ār+ya de wa dang*// 'jam dbyangs grags pa chos 'byung zhi ba dang*// rdo rje gdan pa che 'bring chung gsum rnams// paṇa chen shāka shrī lho pa thams cad mkhyen// kong nag ral gri jo gdan zas gtsang dang*// shangs pa grags seng zhal snga bsod rin dang*// mkhan po gzhon ye se ston 'byung ldan pa// mang mkhar byang sems kun dga' 'od zer ba// bag ston gzhon tshul kun spangs chos grags dpal// ma ti paṇa chen sa bzang 'phags pa dang*// ngor chen kun bzang rgyal tshab kun dbang pa// rat+na war+dha dkon mchog lhun grub zhabs// dkon mchog dpal ldan paṇa chen gnyis kyis gsan// gnyis kas 'jam dbyangs bsod nams lhun grub dang*// shar chen byams pa bkra shis gnyis las gsan// gnyis kas rjes bzung dpal ldan don grub pa// de las 'jam mgon dpal mchog rgyal mtshan nas// bstan pa'i snang byed sangs rgyas phun tshogs pa// bka' drin tshad med tshul khrims lhun grub zhabs// de las thos pa tshul khrims rin chen no// yang na 'jam dbyangs bsod nams lhun grub nas// nam mkha' sangs rgyas nam mkha' dpal bzang pa// de las mkhas grub sangs rgyas phun tshogs zhabs// gang des rjes bzung tshul khrims lhun grub las// legs par nos pa ban+de tshul rin no// yang na thub pa'i dbang po/ rje btsun 'jam dbyangs/ zhi ba lha/ e la dha ri/ dpa' bo'i sde/ gser gling pa/ jo bo rje/ 'brom ston pa/ pu to ba/ sha ra ba/ chu mig pa/ gro ston pa/ mchims nam mkha' grags/ ze'u grags brtson/ grags pa shes rab/ mchims blo bzang*/ mkhan chen kun dga' rgyal mtshan/ mkhan chen grub pa shes rab/ 'jam dbyangs shes rab rgya mtsho/

yongs 'dzin dkon mchog 'phel man 'dra'o// ༈ /thub pa'i dbang po'i bstod pa mdo sde rgyan las phyung ba sems can rnams la brtse ba can zhes sogs yod pa'i lung thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas/ 'phags pa byams pa/ 'phags pa thogs med/ mkhas pa dbyig gnyen/ slob dpon blo gros brtan pa/ paṇa chen gang ba spel/ kha che rin chen rdo rje/ bram ze sadz+dza na/ pa ra hi ta/ blo gros grags pa/ mar pa jo gdan/ mchims don grub/ mchims brtson 'grus seng ge mchims nam mkha' grags/ skyi ston shākya 'bum/ skyi ston grags pa rgyal mtshan/ dol pa shes rab rgyal mtshan/ ma ti paṇa chen/ sa bzang 'phags pa/ rdo rje 'chang kun dga' bzang po/ 'jam dbyangs shes rab rgya mtsho/ yongs 'dzin dkon mchog 'phel/ rgyal ba lha mchog seng ge rje dkon mchog lhun grub man gong gi dkon mchog rjes dran brgyud pa dang 'dra'o// ༈ /'phags pa shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i snying po'i mdo'i lung thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ thub pa'i dbang po/ rje btsun sgrol ma/ jo bo rje/ a ti sha de'i dbon po dā na shī la/ byang sems zla ba rgyal mtshan/ dbang bka' gdams pa/ skyer sgang pa ye shes seng ge

chos kyi seng ge'ang zer/ sangs rgyas sgom pa seng ge skyabs/ mchims nam mkha' grags/ tshad ma'i skyes bu bsod nams mgon/ kun mkhyen bu ston/ lo tsā ba rin chen rnam rgyal/ bla ma bkra shis rin chen/ thams cad mkhyen pa kun dga' bzang po/ rgyal tshab kun dga' dbang phyug yongs 'dzin dkon mchog 'phel/ rje dkon mchog lhun grub man gong ma rnams dang 'dra'o// mchims nam mkha' grags kyis mdzad pa'i mdo sgrub thos pa'i brgyud pa'ang de dang 'dra'o// ༈ /'phags pa bzang po spyod pa'i smon lam gyi mdo dang*/ byams pa'i smon lam gyi brgyud pa ni/ shes bya kun gzigs thub pa'i dbang po/ 'phags pa kun dga' bo/ rak+ṣi ta/ kṛṣ+ṇa'i gos can/ sha na'i gos can/ nyi ma gung pa/ rgyal rigs thams cad mkhyen pa/ thams cad mkhyen pa klu sgrub/ ār+ya de wa/ 'jam dpal grags pa/ chos 'byung zhi ba/ rdo rje gdan pa mya ngan med pa'i dpal/ paṇ+ḍi ta don yod rdo rje/ jo bo puṇ+ya shrī/ paṇa chen shākya shrī/ dpyal chos bzang*/ dpyal pad+mo can/ dpyal a mo gha/ dpyal gzhon nu ye shes/ rong pa shes rab seng ge bag ston gzhon nu tshul khrims/ kun spangs chos grags/ sa bzang ma ti paṇa chen/ sa bzang 'phags pa gzhon nu blo gros/ rgyal ba'i rgyal tshab kun dga' bzang po/ rgyal tshab kun dga' dbang phyug yongs 'dzin dkon mchog 'phel man gong ma rnams dang 'dra'o// ༈ /yang bzang po spyod pa'i smon lam rkyang pa'i brgyud pa ni/ rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas/ 'phags pa 'jam dpal/ 'phags pa klu sgrub/ slob dpon klu'i byang chub/ slob dpon ḍom+bi pa/ slob dpon 'jam dpal grags pa/ rdo rje gdan pa che ba mya ngan med pa'i dpal/ 'bring ba don yod rdo rje/ chung ba puṇ+ya shrī/ so ma shrī/ rwa hu la bha dra/ bi ma la shrī/ be na dha ri/ paṇa chen shākya shrī bha dra/ khro phu lo tsā ba byams pa dpal/ lho pa kun mkhyen rin chen dpal/ spang sgang grags pa rgyal mtshan/

shangs pa grags pa seng ge zhal snga bsod nams rin chen/ dpyal gzhon nu ye shes/ shes rab dpal/ dge slong kun nyi/ bag ston gzhon nu tshul khrims/ kun spangs chos grags/ ma ti paṇa chen/ sa bzang 'phags pa/ rgyal ba kun dga' bzang po man sngar dang 'dra'o// ༈ /pha rol tu phyin pa bcu'i smon lam gyi brgyud pa ni gong byams pa'i smon lam dang 'dra'am snyam pa dpyad do// ༈ /mtshan yang dag par brjod pa'i brgyud pa ni/ dang po'i sangs rgyas dus kyi 'khor lo/ chos rgyal rigs ldan/ dus zhabs pa che chung*/ kha che zla ba mgon po/ 'bro lo tsā ba/ grags mkhar ba dkon mchog srung*/ sgro ston gnam la brtsegs/ grub chen yu mo/ sras dharme shwa ra/ sprul sku jo 'bum/ khang gsar ba nam mkha' 'od zer/ se mo che pa nam mkha' rgyal mtshan/ 'jam dbyangs gsar ma/ de gnyis char las bo dong rin po che/ de las 'dzim pa rin chen shes rab/ glo chen sangs rgyas sras/ mkhan po rgyal bzang ba/ gangs pa grags pa dpal/ ma ti paṇa chen/ sa bzang 'phags pa/ ngor chen rdo rje 'chang kun dga' bzang po/ rgyal tshab kun dga' dbang phyug yongs 'dzin dkon mchog 'phel/ thams cad mkhyen pa dkon mchog lhun grub/ chos rje dkon mchog dpal ldan man 'dra'o// yang na mkhas grub dpal ldan rdo rje/ rwa ston yon tan dpal bzang*/ mkhan chen bsod nams lhun grub/ 'jam dbyangs sa skya lo tsā/ thams cad mkhyen pa dkon mchog lhun grub man 'dra'o// ༈ /sgrol ma'i phyag 'tshal nyer gcig yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rnam par snang mdzad chen pos mdzad pa sgrol gsol dang bcas pa'i brgyud pa ni/ yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas/ rje btsun sgrol ma/ slob dpon nag po pa/ wa gu paṇ+ḍi ta/ khu rnal 'byor pa/ zur khang pa gzhon nu dbang*/ dge slong bsod nams lo mchog glo chen sangs rgyas sras/ mkhan chen rgyal ba bzang po/ ma ti paṇa chen/ sa bzang 'phags pa/ ngor chen thams cad mkhyen pa kun dga' bzang po man sngar dang 'dra'am snyam ste dpyad do// yang na rje btsun sgrol ma nas/

'phags pa kun dga' bo/ nyi ma gung pa/ sha na'i gos can/ kṛṣ+ṇa'i gos can/ nyi ma sbas pa/ rā hu la shrī/ bo dhi da shrī/ paṇa chen shākya shrī/ khro phu lo tsā ba/ rin chen 'bum/ bla ma sangs rgyas 'bum/ lo tsā ba mchog ldan/ glo chen sangs rgyas sras man 'dra/ yang na mkhan chen rgyal ba bzang po nas/ byang seng ba/ shar chen ye shes rgyal mtshan/ ngor chen rdo rje 'chang man 'dra/ yang na ngor chen rdo rje 'chang*/ paṇ+ḍi ta grags pa rgyal mtshan/ mkhan chen bsod nams lhun grub/ sa lo 'jam dpal rdo rje/ thams cad mkhyen pa dkon mchog lhun grub man 'dra/ yang na sha na'i gos can/ kha che thams cad mkhyen pa/ nyer sbas/ rgya mtsho bskyangs/ slob dpon dze tā ri/ ngag dbang grags pa/ kha che ma ṇi ka mal lo tsā ba/ la stod dbang rin/ mchims chos seng*/ mchims blo brtan/ 'jam gsar/ chos 'od/ 'phags 'od/ bu ston/ don grub/ rgyal mgon/ bkra shis rin chen/ bla ma rdo rje 'chang man 'dra/ de dag ni brgyud pa dmigs bsal dgos pa cung zad bris pa yin la/ chos spyod pusti dngos kyi rkang grangs ni/ dkon mchog rjes dran/ byang chub ltung bshags/ bcom ldan 'das shākya'i rgyal po la mdzad pa bcu gnyis kyi sgo nas bstod pa klu sgrub kyis mdzad par grags pa/ thub bstod sems brtse ma mgon po byams pas mdzad pa mdo sde rgyan las phyung ba/ thub dbang rgyan drug mchog gnyis sogs la bstod pa zhi gdong ma 'phags pas mdzad pa 'dogs 'brel dang bcas pa/ mkhan po bo d+dhi sa twa/ chos rgyal mes dbon/ lo paṇa rnams la thun mong du bstod pa rnams chos rje bla ma dam pas mdzad pa'i rgyal rabs gsal ba'i me long gi mchod brjod du mdzad pa rnams dang*/ jo bo yab sras kyi bstod pa sh+lau ka re re/ jo bstod phun tshogs bhaṅga ma nas 'byung ba rnams so// de nas snyan brgyud tshad ma bzhi'i dang po bla ma tshad ma'i skor la/ rdo rje 'chang kun dga' bzang pos mdzad pa'i gsung ngag bla ma brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs 'gor rnam dag dkyil 'khor bzhi zhes yod pa/

sa skya pa chen po la rnal 'byor dbang phyug bir+wa pa gtso 'khor lngas mngon sum du zhal bstan pa'i dus su mdzad pa'i bstod pa 'gor a la la ste zhes yod pa/ sa paṇa gyis mdzad pa'i bir+wa pa'i bstod pa dad pa'i chu las ma/ sa chen gyi bstod pa tshangs dbang ma/ slob dpon rtse mos mdzad pa/ rje bsod nams rtse mo'i rnam thar bstod pa khyod nyid dam pa can dang*/ tshangs par spyod pa'i dge bsnyen ma gnyis rje btsun rin po che grags pas mdzad pa/ rje btsun grags pa'i bstod pa yon tan rgya mtsho ma sa paṇ+ḍi ta kun dga' rgyal mtshan gyis mdzad pa/ sa skya paṇ+ḍi ta'i rnam thar bstod pa chos rgyal ma chung ba yar lung pa byang chub rgyal mtshan gyis mdzad pa/ 'phags pa rin po che la bstod pa sangs rgyas kun gyi thugs rje ma gtsang nag phug pa 'jam dbyangs shes rab 'od zer gyis mdzad pa/ yang 'phags pa'i bstod pa grags ldan ma sh+lau ka gcig rgya nag rgyal pos mi nyag paṇa chen grags pa rdo rje'i bka' 'bum na'ang 'dug pa des mdzad dam brtag mdzad par grags pa/ bla ma dam pa'i bstod pa bsod nams ye shes ma sh+lau ka gcig rgyal sras thogs med pas mdzad pa'i bstod pa las phyung ba/ rje kun dga' bzang po la bstod pa mdo rgyud kun gyi rgya mtsho can sh+lau ka gcig mus chen gyis mdzad pa/ rong ston shes bya kun rig la bstod pa mang thos ma/ rje mus chen la bstod pa dkon mchog dges pa ma/ 'jam dbyangs shes rgyal la bstod pa shes bya kun la thogs med ma/ rgyal tshab dam pa la bstod pa rgyud sde kun gyi de nyid ma/ gung ru sher bzang la bstod pa shes bya'i mkha' la sogs mnga' ris tshul 'od pas mdzad pa/ kun mkhyen chen po la bstod pa rgya chen bsod nams ma sh+lau ka gcig rje de nyid kyis mdzad pa/ mkhas grub dpal rdor ba la bstod pa mtha' yas rgyud sde ma kun mkhyen gyis mdzad pa/ rje yongs 'dzin/ rje sangs rin/

rje lha mchog pa rnams la bstod pa sh+lau ka re re ba rnams dang*/ rdo rje 'chang kun dga' bzang po la bstod pa rab dkar ma rong ston gyis nā len+d+rar mdzad pa/ rdo rje 'chang la bstod pa sde snod ma mus chen gyis mdzad pa/ yang de la lam 'bras bu dang bcas pa'i sgo nas bstod cing gsol ba 'debs pa dad pa'i rba rlabs zhes bya ba 'jam dbyangs chos rje shes rab rgya mtshos glo bo smon thang gi thub bstan dar rgyas gling gi gtsug lag khang du sbyar ba/ rong ston chen po'i bstod pa gsung rab rgya mtsho ma rje nyid kyis mdzad pa/ mus chen dkon mchog rgyal mtshan gyi bstod pa thub bstan gser gyi khang pa ma bdag chen chu mig pas mdzad pa/ yang sems dpa' chen po'i bstod pa dkon mchog gsum gyi ngo bo ma gung rus mdzad pa/ 'jam dbyangs shes rab rgya mtsho'i bstod pa mtha' yas shes bya ma bdag chen chu mig pas mdzad pa/ rgyal tshab dam pa'i bstod pa dpal ldan kun dga' ma kun mkhyen go rams pas mdzad pa/ kun mkhyen gyi bstod pa bsod nams ye shes ma mi nyag grags rdor pas mdzad pa/ yongs 'dzin la bstod pa rgyal ba rigs bdag ma glo bo mkhan chen gyis mdzad pa/ yang yongs 'dzin la bstod pa phun tshogs dngos grub ma rje dkon mchog lhun pas mdzad pa/ rje sangs rin gyi bstod pa sangs rgyas kun gyi ngo bo ma sa los mdzad pa/ yang rje sangs rgyas rin chen gyi bstod pa sangs rgyas kun gyi ngo bo nyid sogs sh+lau ka gcig glo bo mkhan chen bsod nams lhun grub legs pa'i 'byung gnas rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po la bstod pa bsod nams rab rgyas ma sh+lau ka gcig sa skya lo tsā ba'i bstod pa rab mdzes ma rje rang gis mdzad pa/ rje lha mchog seng ge'i bstod pa bla ma rnams dang lhag pa'i lha sogs sh+lau ka gcig yang de la bstod pa lhag pa'i lha mchog ma mkhan chen legs 'byung gis mdzad pa/ yang de la bstod pa mtshan spel phan bde ma rje dkon mchog lhun grub kyis mdzad pa/

rje dkon mchog lhun grub kyis bstod pa dkon mchog gsum dngos ma dang 'dod dgu'i dpal 'byung ma/ dkyil 'khor rgya mtsho ma gsum rje de nyid kyis mdzad pa dang*/ yang de la bstod pa dkon mchog gsum gyi gdung 'dzin ma dpal sa skya pa ngag dbang kun dga' rin chen gyis mdzad pa/ 'jam dbyangs sangs rgyas seng ge la bstod pa phun tshogs sa gsum ma rje rang gis mdzad pa/ rje dkon mchog dpal ldan la bstod pa dngos grub kun 'byung ma rje rang gis mdzad pa/ shar khang pa shes rab rgyal mtshan gyi bstod pa rnam dag thos bsam ma rje rang gis mdzad pa/ paṇa chen nam mkha' dpal bzang la bstod pa thugs rjes nam yang ma rje rang gis mdzad pa/ yang de la bstod pa rab 'byams shes bya ma ngor chen dkon mchog dpal ldan gyis mdzad pa/ shar chen byams pa kun dga' bkra shis la bstod pa byams pa'i thugs rje ma rje rang gis mdzad pa/ yang de'i brtan bzhugs bla chen dkon mchog rgya mtshos mdzad pa/ rtse gdong khri chen 'jam dbyangs kun dga' bsod nams lhun grub la bstod pa kun dga'i legs bshad ma rje dkon mchog dpal ldan pas mdzad pa/ mkhas grub dpal ldan don grub la bstod pa/ dpal ldan rtsa brgyud ma sh+lau ka gcig dang*/ rnam dag smon lam ma rje rang gis mdzad pa/ brang ti nam mkha' sangs rgyas la bstod pa nam mkha' lta bu ma sh+lau ka gcig mkhas pa'i dbang po dpal ldan don grub kyis mdzad pa dang*/ nam yang bla ma lha yi rjes bzung ma rje rang gis mdzad pa/ shar chen shes rab 'byung gnas la bstod pa rgya chen shes bya'i ma sh+lau ka dang po rje dpal grub kyis mdzad pa dang grangs med rgyal ba'i ma rje rang gis mdzad pa/ nam rin la bstod pa khang gsar bas mdzad pa/ bsod nams rgya mtshor bstod pa rje rang gis mdzad pa/ rje dpal mchog rang la bstod pa rab 'byams bde gshegs ma rje rang gis mdzad pa/ nam mkha' dpal bzang la bstod pa legs byas dge ba ma shar pa ye shes bzang pos mdzad pa/

lhun grub dpal ldan la bstod pa lhag bsam lhun grub ma rje rang gis mdzad pa/ mkhan chen sangs rgyas phun tshogs la bstod pa mkhyen rab ma rje rang gis mdzad pa/ shar chen sangs rgyas bstan 'dzin la bstod pa sangs rgyas bstan pa'i snying po ma sangs rgyas phun tshogs kyis mdzad pa/ shes bya bzang po la bstod pa sangs rgyas phun tshogs kyis mdzad pa/ byams pa tshul khrims dpal bzang la bstod pa rje rang gis mdzad pa/ mkhan chen bsod nams dpal ldan la bstod pa rnam dkar tshogs gnyis ma rje rang gis mdzad pa/ byams pa bsod nams bzang por bstod pa rje rang gis mdzad pa/ 'jam mgon bkra shis lhun grub la bstod pa sangs rgyas kun gyi mkhyen brtse ma dang dus gsum rgyal ba'i mkhyen brtse ma gnyis rje rang gis mdzad pa/ 'jam pa'i dbyangs tshul khrims lhun grub la bstod pa/ rnam dag tshul khrims nam mkha'i khyod yangs ma rje nyid kyis mdzad pa/ yang de nyid la bstod pa sngon bsags bsod nams chu gter ma mkhan chen bkra shis lhun grub kyis mdzad pa/ mkhan chen nam mkha' bsam 'grub la bstod pa sa skya pa ngag dbang kun dga' blo gros kyis mdzad pa/ thams cad mkhyen pa dpal ldan chos skyong la bstod pa/ rgyal ba kun gyi ye shes gcig bsdus ma sogs rje rang gis mdzad pa tshan pa gsum rnams kyi lung rnams legs par thos so// gzhan yang rgyud gsum man ngag dang bcas pa'i bla ma brgyud pa la gsol ba 'debs pa kun khyab 'khor lo ma rje dkon mchog lhun grub kyis mdzad pa kha skong dang bcas pa/ zhen pa bzhi bral gyi brgyud 'debs rje rdo rje 'chang gis mdzad pa kha skong dang bcas pa/ bsnyen rdzogs sdom brgyud kyi gsol 'debs brang ti pas mdzad pa/ yon sbyong ba'i gzungs/ rje ngor chen pas mdzad pa'i 'gro la bde nor rgyun ma'i bstod pa nas phyung ba yin/ skyid ma'i bar paṇa chen gyis thar rtser bsgrigs pa bla ma phyi ma rnams kyis mdzad pa'i kha skong dang bcas pa'i phyag dpe'i steng nas mnos so// rnam dag dkyil 'khor ma ni snang gsum gyi dad pa'i skabs kyi brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs gang rung ba zhig gi lung byin la kha ton byar gzhug ces pa'i skabs su lung gnang ba dang*/

de ma gtogs pa'i chos spyod pusti dang rnam thar pusti rnams snga chos la gang 'gro mdzad pa las/ brgyud pa'i bla ma rnams kyi rnam thar skor la/ bla ma brgyud pa rgya bod kyi lo rgyus rje btsun rin po ches mdzad pa/ rje sa chen gyi rnam par thar pa dang*/ rtse mo'i rnam par thar pa khyod nyid ma mchan bu dang bcas pa rje btsun gyis mdzad pa/ rje btsun grags pa rgyal mtshan gyi rnam thar sa paṇa gyis mdzad pa/ yang mnal lam sbal ston gyis bris pa/ rje sa paṇa gyi rnam thar lho pa kun mkhyen rin chen dpal gyis mdzad pa/ rnam thar gsung sgros ma rje rdo rje 'chang gis mdzad pa/ 'phags pa rin po che'i rnam par thar pa rin po che'i phreng ba shar pa ye shes rgyal mtshan pas mdzad pa/ nyan chen pa'i rnam par thar pa rat+na singhas mdzad pa/ zhang dkon mchog dpal ba'i rnam thar bla ma dpal ldan tshul khrims pas mdzad pa/ brag phug pa'i rnam thar rin po che'i phreng ba ri khrod pa blo gros brtan pas mdzad pa/ ri khrod pa'i rnam par thar pa dpal ldan tshul khrims kyis mdzad pa/ dkar po brag pa rin chen seng ge'i rnam par thar pa rje rang gis mdzad pa/ bla ma dam pa bsod nams rgyal mtshan pa'i rnam thar dpal ldan tshul khrims kyis mdzad pa/ dpal ldan tshul khrims pa'i rnam thar mus chen dkon mchog rgyal mtshan gyis mdzad pa/ grub chen bud+dha shrī'i rnam thar rdo rje 'chang kun dga' bzang pos mdzad pa/ ngor chen rdo rje 'chang gi rnam par thar pa dkon mchog rgyal mtshan gyis mdzad pa/ yang de nyid kyi rnam par thar pa gu ge paṇa chen grags pa rgyal mtshan gyis mdzad pa/ yang rje de nyid kyi rnam par thar pa legs bshad chu bo 'dus pa'i rgya mtsho yon tan yid bzhin nor bu'i 'byung gnas zhes pa mkhan chen sangs rgyas phun tshogs kyis mdzad pa/ sgrub khang dpal ldan don grub kyis mdzad pa'i lam 'bras bka' rgya thim pa'i gzigs snang*/ sems dpa' chen po dkon mchog rgyal mtshan gyi rnam par thar pa ngo mtshar rgya mtsho zhes bya ba kun mkhyen bsod nams seng ges mdzad pa kha skong dang bcas pa/

yang de'i rnam par thar pa gsung sgros ma gung rus mdzad pa/ rje btsun kun dga' dbang phyug pa'i rnam par thar pa rin po che'i phreng ba zhes bya ba mkhan chen bsod nams lhun grub kyis mdzad pa/ kun mkhyen bsod nams seng ge'i rnam par thar pa sangs rgyas rin chen gyis mdzad pa/ yongs 'dzin dkon mchog 'phel ba'i rnam par thar pa yon tan mtha' yas zhes bya ba rje sangs rgyas rin chen gyis mdzad pa/ rje sangs rgyas rin chen pa'i rnam par thar pa dge legs rin po che'i gter zhes bya ba dgung lo re lnga yan dang*/ de'i kha skong ut+pa la'i chun po dang bcas pa sa los mdzad pa/ lha mchog seng ge'i rnam par thar pa dad pa'i char 'bebs zhes bya ba paṇa chen nam mkha' dpal bzang gis mdzad pa/ rje dkon mchog lhun grub pa'i rnam par thar pa 'dod dgu'i dpal 'byung gi rnam bshad 'dod dgu'i chu gter zhes bya ba dkon mchog dpal ldan gyis mdzad pa/ ngor dbon sangs rgyas seng ge'i rnam par thar pa dad pa'i me tog gi phreng ba zhes bya ba nam mkha' dpal bzang gis mdzad pa/ shar chen byams pa kun dga' bkra shis kyi rnam par thar pa ye shes glu dbyangs zhes bya ba ngag dbang brtan pa'i rdo rjes mdzad pa/ shar pa shes rab 'byung gnas kyi rnam par thar pa dge legs ngo mtshar lhun po rgyal rtse pa ngag dbang bsod nams rgyal mtshan gyis mdzad pa/ mkhan chen sangs rgyas phun tshogs pa'i rnam par thar pa nges 'byung gtam gyi rol mtsho mnal lam rnam thar dang bcas pa rje rang gis mdzad pa/ e waṃ pa'i gdan rabs rin po che nor bu'i phreng ba zhes bya ba rnam thar bsdus pa mkhas grub sangs rgyas phun tshogs kyis mdzad pa rnams kyi lung ni/ mkhan chen thams cad mkhyen pa tshul khrims lhun grub pa'i zhal snga nas gsung ngag lam 'bras khrid kyi bla ma tshad ma'i skabs su legs par thos so// der ma 'thus pa'i brgyud pa thos pa'i chos kyi rnam grangs ni/

'dren mchog chos kyi rgyal po'i rnam par thar pa dang*/ sa lo 'jam dbyangs chen po'i rnam par thar pa gnyis rje dkon mchog lhun grub pas mdzad pa/ chos rje shes rab rgyal mtshan pa'i rnam par thar pa yon tan rgya mtsho zhes bya ba brang ti pa nam mkha' dpal bzang gis mdzad pa/ mkhas grub dpal ldan don grub pa'i rnam par thar pa dad pa'i gsal 'debs ngag dbang brtan pa'i rdo rjes mdzad pa/ brang ti nam mkha' sangs rgyas kyi rnam par thar pa 'phros dang bcas pa byin rlabs chu rgyun zhes bya ba sangs rgyas phun tshogs kyis mdzad pa/ rgyal rtse pa ngag dbang bsod nams rgyal mtshan pa'i rnam par thar pa byin rlabs char 'bebs zhes bya ba rje rang gis mdzad pa'i kha skong sangs rgyas phun tshogs kyis mdzad pa/ 'dren mchog bsod nams rgya mtsho'i rnam par thar pa yon tan rgya mtsho zhes bya ba rje lhun grub dpal ldan gyis mdzad pa/ 'jam dbyangs dpal mchog rgyal mtshan pa'i rnam par thar pa dad pa'i gsal 'debs zhes bya ba rje sangs rgyas phun tshogs kyis mdzad pa/ rdo rje 'chang lhun grub dpal ldan pa'i rnam par thar pa logs byas dpal gyi dga' ston zhes bya ba kha skong dang bcas pa 'jam dbyangs sangs rgyas phun tshogs kyis mdzad pa/ yang mkhan chen sangs rgyas phun tshogs pa'i rnam par thar pa thub bstan snang ba'i nyin byed ces bya ba byams pa tshul khrims dpal bzang pas mdzad pa/ 'jam pa'i dbyangs tshul khrims dpal bzang pa'i rnam par thar pa dad pa'i pad dkar bzhad pa'i zla zer zhes bya ba mkhas dbang bkra shis dbang phyug gis mdzad pa/ thams cad mkhyen pa bkra shis lhun grub pa'i rnam par thar pa cha ba'i yon tan gyi me tog rab tu bkra ba dpag bsam gyi ljon pa/ de dbon sangs rgyas ye shes dang nga rang gis byas pa rnams dang*/ mkhas grub sangs rgyas phun tshogs kyis mdzad pa'i e waṃ pa'i gdan rabs nor bu'i phreng ba'i kha skong du/ mkhan chen tshul khrims dpal bzang*/

mtshungs med bsod nams dpal ldan/ byams pa bsod nams bzang po/ 'jam mgon bkra shis lhun grub/ thams cad mkhyen pa tshul khrims lhun grub/ rdo rje 'chang nam mkha' bsam 'grub pa rnams kyi rnam par thar pa bsdus pa re mkhas grub dpal ldan chos skyong gis mdzad pa rnams kyi lung gi brgyud pa ni/ bla ma gong mas mdzad pa po so so'i bka' 'bum gyi lung gi brgyud pa dang 'dra'o// ༈ /gnyis pa nyams myong tshad ma rgyud la skyed par byed pa'i thabs glegs bam rin po cher bzhugs pa'i khrid kyi gzhung shing chen mo bzhi las/ gzhung ji lta ba bzhin bkri ba'i gzhung shing rgyas pa lam gyi sngon 'gro'i khrid yig snang gsum mdzes par byed pa'i rgyan nyid gzhir byas 'khrid tshul gyi rnam gzhag gi rgyas 'gebs dang brgyud pa'i phyag bzhed kyis legs par brgyan te nyams khrid smin rgyas su stsal nas/ snyan brgyud bzhi'i spros pa'i sgro 'dogs gcod pa'i skabs dbang gi chu bo ma nub pa/ byin rlabs kyi brgyud pa ma nyams pa/ gdams ngag gi sarga ma log pa/ mos gus kyi bsam pa tshim pa ste bzhi dang ldan pa'i 'chad tshul gyi sgo nas bshad pa'i dang po ni rgyu lam 'bras gsum gyi dbang gi chu bo ma nub pa/ gnyis pa ni rdo rje 'chang nas rtsa ba'i bla ma'i bar du nyams su blangs pa myong ba byin gyis brlabs pa grub pa'i mtha' ste brgyud pa ma nyams pa/ gsum pa ni gdams ngag gi sarga zhes pa rgyud dang man ngag gi go rim ma 'chol ba/ bzhi pa mos gus kyi bsam pa tshim pa rtogs pa rgyud la skyes pas bla ma lha dang gdams ngag tu bcas pa la gzhan rkyen gyis mi 'phrogs pa'i mos gus skyes pa ste bzhi yin la/ de yang snyan brgyud gsum pa'i go rim ma 'chol ba dpon slob kyi 'brel pa ma brtags par dbang mi bskur/ dbang ma bskur bar gdams ngag mi 'chad/ de ma bshad par gzhung mi sbyin/ de ma sbyin par sgrub pa'i lung dang gsang bcu'i rgyas mi gdab pa sogs 'khrul pa'i dri ma phra mo tsam yang med pa'i phyag len rnam par dag pa yin la/

spyir 'khrid tshul ni/ brtag gnyis las/ dang por gso sbyong sbyin par bya// de nas bslab pa'i gnas bcu sbyin// de la bye brag smra ba bstan// mdo sde pa yang de bzhin no// de nas rnal 'byor spyod pa nyid// de yi rjes su dbu ma bstan// sngags kyi rim pa kun shes nas// de rjes kye yi rdo rje brtsams// zhes rgyud kyi dgongs pa dang*/ de dang cha 'dra bar/ ljon shing las/ thun mong gi gdams pas bkral ba/ thun mong ma yin pa gzhung chung rdo rje'i tshig rkang nas gsungs pa sogs mtha' dag gi dgongs don lam thun mong bas rgyud sbyangs pa sngon du song nas/ sngags lam la 'jug dgos pa yin zhing*/ de yang gang zag rab 'bring tha gsum gyi rab rnams dbang bzhi tshad ldan thob nas de bskur ba'i bla ma sku bzhi ye shes lnga ldan du thag chod nas gsol ba 'debs pa ni lam zab kho nas grol ba/ 'bring po som nyi cung zad yod pa dam tshig bsrungs pas grol ba/ tha ma bskyed rdzogs kyi rnal 'byor tshul bzhin nyams su blangs pas grol ba las/ deng sang phyi ma nyid gtso che ba'i phyag len du mdzad pa ni/ bstan pa rin po che yongs rdzogs kyi nyams len du 'gyur ba la/ lam thun mong bas rgyud sbyangs nas dbang bzhi pa'i bar gyi gang zag gcig 'tshang rgya ba'i nyams len cha tshang ba dgos pas thog mar/ theg pa thun mong ba'i lam sems can la nyon mongs pa la ma dag pa'i snang ba/ rnal 'byor pa la ting nge 'dzin la nyams kyi snang ba/ bde bar gshegs pa'i sku gsung thugs mi zad pa rgyan gyi 'khor lo la dag pa'i snang ba ste lam snang ba gsum gyi 'khrid/ de rjes maṇ+ḍal tshom bu lnga pa la brten nas byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed pa brgyud pa khyad par gnyis ldan gyi cho ga rje btsun gong ma rnams kyi gsung rab kyi don snying por bsdus pa ngor chen dkon mchog lhun grub kyis mdzad pa'i yi ge'i steng nas legs par mnos nas/

slob dpon tsan+d+ra go mis mdzad pa'i sdom pa nyi shu rtsa 'grel dang*/ bla ma lnga bcu pa rtsa 'grel gyi bshad lung dpon slob kyi 'brel brtag pa'i don du stsal/ de nas rje ngor chen dkon mchog lhun grub kyis mdzad pa'i yi ge ltar slob ma rjes su gzung ba mdzad de/ bsags sbyong gi khrid dmigs rnams phog nas slob dpon rang nyid bsnyen pa kha gso ba'i ting nge 'dzin la zhag bdun du snyoms par bzhugs nas/ ting nge 'dzin de las grol ba na/ bla med rdo rje theg pa'i thun mong ma yin pa'i thabs rgyud kyi gtso bo smin grol gnyis las/ dang po ni kye rdo rje lha dgu'i rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor chen por ngor chen thams cad mkhyen pa dkon mchog lhun grub kyis mdzad pa'i kye rdo rje'i mngon par rtogs pa yan lag drug pa dang*/ gtor chog mdzes par byed pa'i rgyan dang*/ dbang gi chu bo chen po mdzes par byed pa'i rgyan/ dbang gi mtshams sbyor lung dang rigs pa man ngag gi gter mdzod dang rgya gzhung gi bstod pa dang bkra shis rnams la brten nas/ dbang gi mngon par rtogs pa brgyad dang ldan pa'i sgo nas rgyu dus kyi dbang gi chu bo ma nub pa bshad pas mtha' dpyad de sbyang gzhi sbyong byed legs par ngo sprad pa dang bcas te smin rgyas su nos pa'i thun mong gi dbang drug gi skabs nas bcom ldan 'das kyi rtsa ba'i sngags aṣ+ṭa'i bzlas lung bcas te rgyu dus kyi dbang phyin ci ma log pa thob bo// de ltar nos pa'i dam tshig dang sdom pa rnams mi nyams par bsrung ba gsal bar ston pa'i rdo rje theg pa'i rtsa ba'i ltung ba rgya cher bshad pa'i 'grel pa 'khrul pa spong

'di nas brtsams te las dang po pa dang thun mong gi chos bdun ni glegs bam gyi dkar chag gis zin pa logs su bzhugs kyang rung ba ni/ ba zhes bya ba rje btsun chen po grags pas mdzad pa/ mngon rtogs rgyas pa 1 yan lag bzhi pa slob dpon rin po che rtse mos mdzad pa/ rje btsun chen pos mdzad pa'i mngon rtogs 'bring po 2 yan lag drug pa tshig sna ring thung gnyis yod pa'i thung ba/ des mdzad pa'i rje btsun rdo rje bdag med ma'i rim pa gnyis 'khor dang bcas pa'i mngon rtogs 3 / rje btsun rtse mos mdzad pa'i dbang gi chu bo chen po 4 ma nub pa'i phyag len/ des mdzad pa'i zhi ba 'ba' zhig gi sbyin sreg gi cho ga 5 zhib tu bstan cing rnam gzhag mdor bsdus pa/ de'i 'phros las las bzhi ga'i sbyin sreg gi cho ga mdor bstan zhing rnam gzhag rgyas par bstan pa 6 rje btsun chen po grags pas mdzad pa/ khyad par gyi bza' ba'i dam tshig gi tshogs 'khor 'bring po 7 rje btsun chen pos mdzad pa ste las dang po pa'i chos tshan bdun gyi lung rnams stsal nas/ khrid kyi dngos gzhi rje ngor chen thams cad mkhyen pas mdzad pa'i khrid gzhung rgyud gsum mdzes par byed pa'i rgyan bla ma phyi mas mdzad pa'i 'chad thabs kyi man ngag dang bcas pa'i steng nas sngon 'gro dngos gzhi rjes gsum tshang ba'i sgo nas dbang gi ye shes la log par rtog pa dgag cing 'og nas 'byung ba'i lam thams cad skyon med par sgrub pa'i slad du kun gzhi rgyu rgyud la 'khor 'das dbyer med kyi lta ba'i khrid 'khor 'das dbyer med rtsa 'grel la brten nas rig thog tu brdar sha dpyad/ lus thabs rgyud la dbang bzhi dang 'brel ba'i lam gyi thog mar bum dbang dang 'brel ba phyi bskyed pa'i rim pa sems 'dzin dang bcas pa gsal snang ma mthong bar bsgom blor byas/ de dag gi skabs su rdo rje 'chang kun dga' bzang pos mdzad pa'i kye rdor sgrub thabs kyi rgya cher bshad pa bskyed rim gnad kyi zla zer/

kun mkhyen bsod nams seng ges mdzad pa'i kye rdo rje man ngag lugs kyi rnam par bshad pa dang bsnyen pa bya tshul dang*/ bsnyen pa'i kha skong gi sbyin sreg rnams kyis rang gzhan gyi don gang sgrub kyang phyin ci ma log par shes pa'i rdo rje slob dpon du bsgrubs nas/ phyi rol du zhen pa'i gdon gyi gnyen por nang rdo rje slob dpon chen po'i don dam zab mo lus kyi dkyil 'khor du shar chen byams pa kun dga' bkra shis kyis mdzad pa'i yi ge'i steng nas lam dus kyi dbang gi chu bo ma nub pa bskur ba yi ge brgya pa'i bzlas lung bcas pa stsal nas/ kun mkhyen bsod nams seng ges mdzad pa'i lus dkyil gyi rnam par bshad pa bde chen bcud kyi snying po dang*/ kye rdo rje'i mngon par rtogs pa lam dus kyi dbang dang bcas pa'i rnam par bshad pa bklags pas kun shes kyi lung yang stsal zhing*/ de nas khrid gzhung ltar nang bskyed pa'i rim pa bsgom bya'i don la thos bsam gyis sgro 'dogs dpyad de dpyad don nyams su len pa bskyed rim sems 'dzin gyi nyams khrid la lam dang*/ lta ba dang*/ grub mtha' dang*/ 'da' ka ma dang*/ zhar byung bar do dang*/ 'bras bu ste don tshan drug ldan du stsal/ gsang dbang gi lam bdag byin gyis brlabs pa khams 'dus pa dang po rlung gtum mo drod rtags kyi khrid ces pa gtum mo'i dmigs rkang bco brgyad kyi rim pa/ pho nya'i lam mam shes rab ye shes kyi lam zhes bya ba khams 'dus pa bar ma dkyil 'khor 'khor lo 'dod pa'i lcags kyu dga' bzhi lugs 'byung lugs ldog tu nyams su blang ba'i khrid/ khams 'dus pa tha ma skyon med gnyug ma ye shes kyi lam khrid dam dbang bzhi pa'i lam rba rlabs gsum gyi khrid dang bcas pa'i dbang bzhi re re la'ang*/ lam/ lta ba/ grub mtha'/ 'da' kha ma/ zhar byung bar do/ 'bras bu ste don tshan drug drug gi sgo nas gtan la bab pa dang bcas pa'i dbang po rab 'bring tha ma'i lam cha tshang ba re re khrid rim du tshang bar stsal/

rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug bir+wa pas rje btsun brtse ba chen po pa la dngos su gnang ba'i man ngag sa skya'i lcags ri'i khongs las mi 'da' ba bzhi'i nang tshan lam zab phyi nang gsang gsum las/ ngor chen dkon mchog lhun grub pa dang*/ paṇa chen nam mkha' dpal bzang gis mdzad pa'i steng nas lam zab mo bla ma'i rnal 'byor gyi phyi ma'i khrid kyi byin rlabs/ paṇa chen nam mkha' dpal bzang dang ngag dbang chos grags kyis mdzad pa'i yi ge'i steng nas lam zab nang ma'i khrid kyi byin rlabs/ brang ti paṇa chen dang ngag dbang chos grags kyis mdzad pa'i yi ge ltar bla ma rin chen 'byung ldan gyi byin rlabs/ paṇa chen gyi yi ge'i steng nas rnal 'byor dbang phyug gis brtse chen snying po'i zhabs la dngos su gnang ba'i phyi'i bar gcod srung ba rnal 'byor dbang phyug gi srung ba thun mong ba'i byin rlabs/ ngor chen rdo rje 'chang dang ngag dbang chos grags pa'i yi ge'i steng nas rnal 'byor dbang phyug gi srung ba nang ma'i byin rlabs/ de dang 'brel ba'i bir srung gi bsrung ba'i dmigs rim dang yig rnying*/ sngon chad zhal shes kho nar bzhugs pa'i bir srung gi cha lag zab mo'i dmigs khrid/ rje ngor chen gyi yi ge'i steng nas bla ma don grub kyi bla ma'i rnal 'byor bye brag pa tshar gsum khug pa'i byin rlabs/ rje btsun rdo rje bdag med ma lha mo bco lnga'i sin+dhū ra'i dkyil 'khor du byin gyis brlabs pa/ paṇa chen ngag dbang chos grags kyi yi ge ltar brda don gsal ba'i byin rlabs/ kun mkhyen bsod nams seng ges mdzad pa'i yi ge ltar rnam 'joms bir lugs kyi byin rlabs/ man ngag rnams yongs su rdzogs pa'i mthar brda chig brgyud kyi byin rlabs/ gsung ngag stan thog gcig tu nyams su blang ba'i tshul ston pa lam bsdus te sgrub pa'i lung sbyin pa/ lam yongs su rdzogs pa'i mthar gsang ba bcus rgyas gdab pa'i byin rlabs/

kun mkhyen go rams pa dang ngag dbang chos grags pa'i yi ge ltar bstan pa gtad cing bka' bsgo ba'i tshul du lam 'bras pa'i mgon rkyang gi rjes gnang dang bzhi/ chos grags kyis mdzad pa'i yi ge la brten pa dang bcas pa rnams legs par thos so// gnyis pa de rnams kyi rgyab brten du bstan bcos tshad ma dang 'brel ba'i lung thob pa'i rnam grangs la/ thog mar gsung ngag glegs bam pod ser ma zhes pa ste/ de'i rgyu mtshan na bza' ser pos dril bas de ltar du grags so zhes gsungs te/ der bzhugs pa'i chos tshan gyi rnam grangs la/ 'phrang brag dmar ba dang*/ dkar shākya grags sogs kyis bsgrigs pa cung zad mi 'dra tsam du ma 'dug kyang 'dir rje btsun mchog gis bsgrigs pa 'phyugs med kyi rkang grangs tshigs bcad du brjod na/ rdo rje'i tshig rkang rnam 'grel sa dpyad gcig yod/ gnyags ma dang*// gsal byed kun gzhi rgyu rgyud gdan sogs dang*// lus dkyil 'chi bslu bum dbang 'da' ka ma// thig le'i rnal 'byor phyag rgya'i mtshan nyid dang*// bzhi pa'i 'da' kha bar do'i gdams ngag dang*// lam dbang tshad ma bzhi dang gdams ngag drug /rten 'brel lnga dang grib sel yi ge gnyis// thig le bsrung dang yig brgya'i 'don thabs dang*// rlung sbyor bha ga'i yi ge 'khor bzhi'i rgya// dbang phyug don brgyad sa phyed mngon rtogs dang*// don bsdus ma ste nyi shu rtsa bzhi ni// rtsa ba nyid kyi steng du bshad bya'o// de dag las 'phros gud du gsungs pa'i chos// 'khor 'das dbyer med dbang bzhi'i man ngag gnad// mchog dbang bskur tshul bskyed rim bsdus pa dang*// ril bu'i sgrub thabs yum gyi byin rlabs dang*// gegs sel bzhi dang dbang chu sgrub thabs gsum// rtsa ltung 'khrul spong tshogs 'khor sbyin sreg ste// 'phros te gsungs pa'i chos sna bcu bdun las// phyi ma bdun po logs su bzhugs kyang rung*// 'bring gsum lam gnyis gzhung shing chen po bzhi// rtogs bskyed chos lnga lam zab bla ma dang*// lung sbyor bzhi dang brgyud pa'i lo rgyus gnyis// man ngag phra mor bcas pa drug cu'o// zhes te drug cu pa 'dir man ngag phra mo la ngos bzung ba ltar snang yang don la gzhung rtsa ba 'dren pa 'thad par bzhed/

de yang tshad ma bzhi dang sbyor tshul ni// bla ma tshad ma rgya bod rnam thar gnyis// nyams myong tshad ma khrid kyi gzhung shing bzhi// rtogs bskyed chos lnga gegs sel yi ge bzhi// dbang dang dam tshig gsum gsum lta ba'i gcig /bskyed rim lnga dang yum gyi byin rlabs dang*// gzhung shing dang po sbyar ba'i chos bcu gsum// 'bring bsdus lam gnyis lam zab bla ma dang*// nyi shu rtsa dgu nyams myong tshad ma'i skor// gnyags ma gsal byed nyer gnyis don bsdus ma// nyi shu rtsa bzhi bstan bcos tshad ma'i skor// lung gi tshad ma lung sbyor rnam bzhi ste// man ngag phra mos kun la phan 'dogs byed// gzhung shing rgyas par sbyar bya'i chos bcu gsum// 'phros te gsungs pa'i chos sna bcu bdun las// gegs sel gdams ngag bzhi spang bcu gsum mo// zhes pa ltar tshigs su bcad pas mdor bstan nas/ de dag so sor phral te bstan pa ni/ gsung ngag rin po che lam 'bras bu dang bcas pa'i glegs bam gyi dkar chag rje btsun 'di glegs bam gyi dbur bzhugs kyang chos sna drug cur mi gtogs so// chen pos dpal sa skya'i gtsug lag khang du mdzad pa/ gsung ngag rin po che'i rtsa ba rdo rje'i tshig rkang*/ 'di rje btsun chen po'i glegs bam dkar chag na mi gsal bar brten rjes 'brang mang po zhig glegs bam gyi grangs su mi 'dren pa ni 'khrul par bzhed do// gzhung chung yid bzhin gyi nor bu rin po che/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen gnyags bzhi rab pa dbang phyug rgyal mtshan gyis zhus pa'i ngor dpal ldan sa skya pa chen pos mdzad pa'i rnam 'grel gnyags ma/ rnam 'grel bcu gcig tsam yod pa'i nang nas 'di gzhung nyung la don rgyas pa'i khyad du 'phags zhes dkar chag tu snang ngo*// dkar chag las mi gsal ba gsal bar byed pa la zhal las shes so zhes smos pa dgu las med kyang gsal bar byed pa'i yi ge nyi shu rtsa gnyis yod de zhes gsal byed kyi yi ge nyi shu rtsa gnyis don bsdus ma dang bcas pa las kun gzhi'i yi ge don bsdus pa/

gdan sogs kyi yi ge lus kyi dkyil 'khor gyi yig chung*/ bum dbang gi 'da' kha ma'i skabs su 'chi ltas 'khrul 'khor 'chi bslu dang bcas pa snang ba bsgyur ba'i 'da' kha ma ste bum dbang gi yig chung chos sde gcig tu 'dren pa/ gsang dbang gi thig le'i rnal 'byor/ shes rab ye shes kyi phyag rgya'i mtshan nyid/ bzhi pa'i 'da' kha ma bum dbang dang thun mong du yi ges sgo dgag pa dang bcas pa'i yig chung 'di ni bum dbang dang thun mong ba yin no'i mtha' can/ bar do bzhi'i yig chung*/ lam dus kyi dbang rgyas 'bring bsdus gsum gyi yig chung*/ tshad ma bzhi'i yig chung*/ gdams ngag drug gi yig chung*/ rten 'brel lngar bstan pa'i lam gyi yig chung*/ grib sel dang gnas sbyong 'byams gcod kyi za byed mkha' 'gro'i sbyin sreg klu sgrub pa'i khog 'bubs su 'di sāts+tsha'i mjug tu 'dug gi yig chung*/ gdon gyi grib ma khrus kyis sel ba'i yig chung*/ grib ma sāts+tshas sel ba'i yig chung*/ thig le 'dzag pa bsrung ba'i yig chung*/ yi ge brgya pa gdon thabs kyi yig chung ste 'khor 'das thun mong gi skabs dgos pa bcu bdun/ rlung gi sbyor ba bdun/ bha ga'i yi ge bcu bzhi ste 'khor lo 'cham pa la gnyis/ gsang dbang gi skabs su 'khor bzhi'i rgya/ bzhi pa'i dbang phyug gi don brgyad/ mthar phyin pa'i sa bcu gsum phyed 'og ma'i mngon rtogs te 'das lam gyi skabs su gsum gyi gsal byed nyi shu rtsa gnyis so// byang chub sems dpa' a seng gis zhus pa'i ngor sa skya pa chen pos gnang ba'i 'grel pa thams cad kyi don bsdus kyi tshigs bcad rnam 'grel a seng mar grags pa nyi shu rtsa bzhi glegs bam 'di nyid tshad ma bzhi dang sbyar na 'di yan gyi chos tshan nyi shu rtsa lnga po bstan bcos tshad ma/ ni bstan bcos 'di nyid kyi steng du bshad par bya ba yin no// de dag las 'phros pa'i gud du gsungs pa'i chos skor la/

kun gzhi rgyu rgyud las 'phros nas snying po'i don lta ba 'khor 'das dbyer med kyi rtsa ba tshig le'ur byas pa rin po che'i snang ba sh+lau ka nyi shu pa 'grel pa dang bcas pa/ thabs rgyud gdan sogs las 'phros pa dbang bzhi'i cho ga mtha' dag mdor bsdus pa'i man ngag gi yi ge'am rgyu dus su dbang gi chu bo ma nub pa'i man ngag gi gnad/ gdan sogs las 'phros pa mchog dbang gsum grol lam la brten nas bskur ba'i man ngag lam sogs nyi shu las 'phros nas phyi bskyed pa'i rim pa mdor bsdus pa'i gnad ces pa rgyas 'bring mi 'dra ba'i khyad par bstan pa'i mjug tu bsdus pa la bsod nams tshogs gsog sogs gsal bar bstan pa/ dam tshig las 'phros pa bdud rtsi ril bu sgrub tshul/ gsang sngags snyan brgyud sogs ma chad pa las 'phros nas rdo rje bdag med ma'i byin rlabs kyi brgyud pa ma nyams pa'i tho yig brtse chen snying po'i zhabs kyis mdzad pa/ dkar chag tu byin rlabs kyi brgyud pa ma nyams pa ni logs su rtogs par bya'o gsung ba 'di yin la phra mo'i chos sder yang gtogs so// bsrung ba sum cu dang man ngag gi gnad bdun cu las 'phros nas gegs sel gyi yi ge bzhi byung ba las thog mar bsam gtan 'dor ba'i 'phrang bdun gyi gegs sel thabs/ byung rgyal du mi gtong ba'i gnad bzhi/ lus 'khrugs rlung dang spyod lam gyis sel ba/ rnal 'byor gyi phrin las sum cu rtsa gnyis te dgu po 'di glegs bam du dngos su bzhugs shing*/ las dang po pa dang thun mong du dgos pa'i chos bdun po deng sang glegs bam 'dir mi bzhugs pas gong du smos zin na'ang don du de dag thams cad rtsa ba rdo rje'i tshig rkang las 'phros pa'i skor yin/ dkar chag tu glegs bam 'di na gnas kyang 'gal ba med la las dang po pa dang thun mong du dgos pa'i phyir logs su 'dug kyang nyes pa med do zhes so/

/lam rgyas 'bring bsdus gsum gyi rgyas pa gong du bshad ma thag pa ltar dang*/ 'bring po rtsa ba med pa'i lam 'bras 'bring du bsdus nas gang zag gcig gis lam 'bras bu dang bcas ma tshang ba med par ston pa/ rang gi gzhung cung zad yod pa sgrub pa'i lung sbyin pa'am 'bogs pa lam bsdus pa/ de ltar lam rgyas 'bring bsdus gsum mtha' dag rnal 'byor pas nyams su blang ba'i phyir gzhung shing chen po bzhi las thog mar gzhung ji lta bar bkri ba'i khrid yig jo lcags mar grags pa lho brag pa dkar ston jo sras lcags kyi rdo rjes lan mang du gsol ba btab pa la brten nas mdzad pa/ dkar chag dang rin po che klu sgrub pa'i khog 'bubs su 'di ltar 'dug cing*/ rje mkhyen brtse'i khog 'bubs na gzhung shing dang rtogs pa bskyed pa bsdoms pa'i chos tshan dgu po gegs sel gyi 'gor 'dug pa tshad ma bzhi dang sbyor ba'i dbang du byas so/

/man ngag gi gnad drug gis bkri ba'i khrid yig khyad par can/ brtson 'grus can man ngag gi gnad bcu gcig gis bkri ba'i khrid yig gang zag dbang po rab 'bring gsum bkri ba'i khrid yig dang bzhi/ de ltar nyams su blangs pa las byung ba'i rtogs pa bogs dbyung ba'i phyir rtogs pa bskyed pa'i chos lnga la/ thog mar lam 'jug ldog mgyogs byed pho nya'i lam phyag rgya 'jug ldog shes pas phan 'dogs pa'i man ngag bdun/ 'khor 'das kyi lam thun mong du bsre ba dang*/ 'gros bzhi dang bcas pa'i yi ge phyi nang gi mdzad pa bcu gnyis/ rtogs pa bsal ba'i phyir dkar chag dang klu sgrub pa'i khog 'bubs kyi dngos bstan las bdag chen rdo rje 'chang gi phyag dpe'i dpe ris rnams cung zad mang bar snang ngo*// 'chi ltas brtag pa rgyas pa'i dpe chung*/ ma nges pa'i 'chi ltas kyi dpe chung*/ de gnyis dang 'dra min re/ rtsa ba'i dpe ris rgyas 'bring bsdus gsum/ gsung ngag dkyus dang sras don ma'i lugs kyi bha ga'i yi ge bcu bzhi'i dpe chung so so/ yang bha ga'i dpe chung lugs gcig nyams skye tshul dang bcas pa/ rnal 'byor gyi phrin las sum cu rtsa gnyis dpe ris/ gegs sel gzhan gyi dpe chung gnyis/ lam sbas bshad kyi rigs drug skye ba brtag pa'i dpe chung rnams rnam grangs gcig tu 'dren no// gang zag dbang po rab bla mas grol bas lam gzhan la ltos mi dgos pas de'i cha rkyen lam zab 'bring gsum las lam zab mo bla ma'i rnal 'byor bla ma chen po'i dbu snyung ma 'di yan la rtogs pa bsal ba'i skor ma gtogs dngos bstan gyi yi ge rnams kyi steng du dbang chu/ sgrub thabs yan lag bzhi drug bdag med ma'i sgrub thabs/ sbyin sreg rnams bsnan pa'i chos sna sum cu po rnams nyams myong tshad ma yin no// tshad ma bzhi pa bka' yang dag pa'i lung tshad ma dang sbyor bar lung tshad ma gsung ngag rin po che 'di nyid dang mdor bsdus te sbyar ba lam phyi ma gnyis kyang de bzhin du shes par bya'o'i mtha' can/

gsung ngag rin po che lung mtha' dag dang mdor bsdus te sbyar ba gsung ngag tshad ma lung dang sbyar ba'i gdams ngag go'i mtha' can/ rje btsun brtse ba chen pos mdzad pa'i gsung ngag rin po che lung 'di nyid dang zhib tu sbyar ba/ dkar chag tu lung 'di nyid dang zhib tu sbyar ba ni logs su shes par bya'o gsung ba 'di yin pas/ dpe la lar dmar gyis mdzad tshul 'dug pa ni mchan bu lta bu dmar gyis mdzad pa yod srid pa la 'khrul lam snyam mo// phra mo'i chos sder yang snang ngo*/ /gleng gzhi dang gleng bslang ba dang rgyud kyi yan lag rgyas par dbye ba dang sbyar ba gsum gyi sgo nas bstan pa lung sbyor gsum po 'di lung tshad ma/ mtshon gyis bsrungs la mkha' 'gros bzod par gsol gyi mtha' can/ bla ma tshad mar sbyar ba'i skabs kyi bla ma brgyud pa rgya gar ba'i lo rgyus zhes pa rnal 'byor dbang phyug gi rnam thar/ 'di gnyis bla ma tshad ma'o/ /bla ma brgyud pa bod kyi lo rgyus zhes pa 'brog mi lo chen nas sa skya pa chen po'i bar gyi rtogs brjod mdor bsdus/ 'di yan gyis lam 'bras glegs bam chos sna drug cu zhes pa tshang ba yin la/ rjes 'brang la la dag rdo rje'i tshig rkang dang rtog bsal dor nas yi ge med pa'i lung sbyor rgyas pa dang phra mo'i dkar chag gnyis 'dren pa dang*/ 'ga' zhig rdo rje'i tshig rkang gi tshab tu man ngag phra mo gzhan rnams gcig tu 'dren pa dang*/ rdzong pa'i bzhed par rdo rje'i tshig rkang gi tshab tu dkar chag 'dren pa 'dug go /deng sang yongs grags la glegs bam du nges par bzhugs dgos pa bzhi bcu zhe dgu dgar chag la snga rtsom phyi rtsom gyi khyad nas la lar 'khor 'das dbyer med rtsa 'gral med 'dug pa de'i dbang gis zhe dgur ngos bzung ngam snyam mo/ /zhes grags na'ang dkar chag gi tshig gis zin pa lnga bcu nga gcig logs su bzhugs pa byin rlabs kyi brgyud pa ma nyams pa dang lung 'di nyid dang zhib tu sbyar ba gnyis/

glegs bam 'dir bzhugs kyang rung zhing ma bzhugs kyang rung ba'i yig sna bdun dang bcas pas chos sde drug cu tham pa/ yang chos sde drug cur dngos su mi gtogs par glegs bam du bzhugs pa/ bde bar gshegs pa'i bka' yang dag pa lung gi tshad ma lung 'di nyid dang sbyar na mthar thug rdo rje 'chang chen po nyid kyi bka'i dbang du byas te/ gleng gzhi'i mdo dang gleng bslang gi mdo rgyud don rgyas pa dang sbyar ba slob dpon rin po ches mdzad pa/ phra mo'i chos sder yang the/ mjug na 'di ni bdag cag spun gnyis dang bka' lung pa dang rmog ston dang bzhis zhus pa lags zhes sogs yod pa/ rje sa skya pa chen pos gsung ngag 'di la zhu ba po so so'i don du mdzad pa'i rnam 'grel bcu gcig tsam yod pa'i nang nas shin tu zab cing rgyas pa rigs kyi sras slob dpon rin po che sku mched gnyis kyi don du mdzad pa'i rnam 'grel sras don ai we 'di dang pod nag ma gnyis de sngon ma thob kyang thob 'gyur gyi dbang gis bris so/ /mar grags pa rdo rje'i tshig rkang yid bzhin gyi nor bu rin po che'i bshad pa zhal nas zhal du brgyud pa'i gdams ngag rdzogs byang gi mtha' can/ dpal ldan bla ma dam pa bsod nams rgyal mtshan gyis mdzad pa'i glegs bam pod e we nag tu grags pa'i skor la/ bla ma brgyud pa'i rnam thar ngo mtshar snang ba/ phyi dkyil gyi mngon rtogs yan lag drug pa/ lam dus kyi smin byed mchog gi dbang bskur ba'i tshul zab pa las kyang ches zab pa/ kye rdo rje'i sgrub thabs lam dus dbang gi nyams len dge bshes kun dga' rgyal mtshan gyi ngor mdzad pa/ bla ma la brten nas dngos grub rnam gnyis sgrub pa'i rnal 'byor yar klungs pa seng ge rgyal mtshan dang bla ma sras pa'i don du mdzad pa/ lam zab mo bla ma'i rnal 'byor gyi yan lag mdo stod pa chos rgyal 'od zer gyi ngor mdzad pa/

lam 'bras bu dang bcas pa'i gzhung ji lta ba bzhin bkri ba'i khrid yig sbas don gsal ba/ gnad drug gis bkri ba'i khrid kyi gsal byed gnad kyi lde mig gnad bcu gcig gis bkri ba'i khrid kyi gsal byed gnad kyi sgo 'byed/ dbang po rab 'bring tha gsum bkri ba'i khrid kyi gsal byed nyung ngu rnam gsal/ lam 'bras 'bring du bsdus nas snang ba gsum du gang zag gcig la dgos pa phyogs gcig tu bsgrigs nas rjod byed kyi sgra la ma ltos par brjod bya'i don gtso bo'i dbang du byas nas ma tshang ba med par bstan pa'i snyan brgyud/ lam 'bras bu dang bcas pa'i gdams ngag rnam par bshad pa man ngag gi mdzod rnams so// gsung ngag rin po che'i po ti smar chung ngam pod dmar du grags pa'i lam 'bras kyi yi ge'i skor la/ ring brgyud kyi skor tshad ma bzhi dang sbyar te bshad pa dang*/ nye brgyud kyi skor tshad ma bzhi dang sbyar te shes par bya ba la/ dang po ni/ bla ma tshad ma brgyud 'debs kha skong dang*// sa bir mjal tshul nyams myong tshad ma ni// zhu lan spyan dang aṣ+ṭa'i bzlas lung bshad// bdud rtsi dbang dbye rga gdams maṇ+ḍal gsum// lus sbyong lus gnad bdag med gtum mo gnyis// gegs sel dgu dang phrin las sdom bcas dang*// dbang bzhi ngo sprod rtsa 'grel lung sbyin dang*// gsang ba bcu yi rgyas gdab rnams yin no// gnad chen rten 'brel lnga dang lcags kyu dang*// phyag chen 'khor bzhi'i rgya dang tshogs sbyor lam// lam bsdus bshad pa bstan bcos tshad ma'i skor// lung gi tshad ma lung sbyor gsal byed de// dgon pa ba las brgyud pa'i rnam grangs so// gnyis pa ni/ lam zab rin 'byung bir srung byin rlabs skor// bir+was sa chen dngos la brgyud pa'o// brda don gsal ba rtsa 'grel dang bcas pa// tshad ma sbyar tshul bsgres te shes par bya// zhes gsungs pa ltar/ de rnams kyi kha skong rje yab sras kyis mdzad pa la/

rje btsun 'gro kun dga' mdzad bcu phrag gcig /dkon mchog mkhyen pa'i gter chen rnam grangs brgyad// ces sdom gyis bsdus pa'i chos kyi rnam grangs so sor gsal bar 'god pa 'di lta ste/ rgyal tshab kun dga' dbang phyug gis mdzad pa'i dkar chag rin po che'i phreng ba/ bla ma tshad ma'i skabs su/ rje btsun rin po che grags pas mdzad pa'i bla ma brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs bla ma rdor 'dzin ma phra mo na'ang yod/ de'i kha skong shar chen ye shes rgyal mtshan gyis mdzad pa'i gangs khrod ma/ de'i zhar byung kha skong du ngor chen gyis mdzad pa'i shar chen dang bud+dha shrī'i gsol 'debs/ sa chen yab sras dang bir+wa pa mjal ba'i lo rgyus sga theng la bskur ba/ nyams myong tshad ma'i skabs su/ bra ston blo gros kyis zhus pa'i gzhung ji lta ba bzhin du bkri ba'i khrid yig tshigs bcad ma rje btsun grags pas mdzad pa/ phra mor 'jug pa sh+lau ka gcig med pa zhig 'dug brtse ba chen pos mdzad pa'i sangs rgyas spyan ma'i rnal 'byor dbang dus su rmi lam ngan pa bzlog pa dang thun mong 'chi ba thub pa yang ngo'i mtha' can/ des mdzad pa'i aṣ+ṭa'i bzlas lung bla ma'i phyag len mdzad pa bzhin bris pa'o'i mtha' can/ phra mo'i de 'di dang mi gcig pa 'dug sa paṇa gyis mdzad pa'i rtsa ba'i sngags kyi rnam par bshad phra mo na'ang yod/ pa snying po don gsal/ bdud rtsi ril bu sgrub pa'i phyag len bdud rtsi 'byung ba zhes pa 'phags pas mdzad pa/ phra mo na'ang yod/ dbang gi rab dbye rje btsun grags pa'i gsung bzhin zhang btsun gyis bris pa/ rje btsun grags pa rgyal mtshan gyis byi lo nag zla'i tshes bcu la sga ston rdo rje grags la spring yig phra mor yang yod/ skyu ra'i dbon po dpon g.yog gis gsol ba btab pa la brten nas sa paṇa gyis bsam yas su mdzad pa'i phyi nang gsang gsum gyi maṇ+ḍal/

de'i kha skong shar chen ye shes rgyal mtshan gyis mdzad pa'i pags pa gser gyi sa gzhi ma/ 'gor dang po lag bkru lta bu ste/ zhes yod pa'i lus sbyong nyi shu'i gsal byed mdud 'grol zin bris nor bzang pas mdzad pa/ lus gnad la dbab pa'i gdams pa tshigs bcad ma sa paṇa gyi zhabs la spyi bos rab tu btud pa'i dpal ldan phug pa dmar gyis zin bris kun dang thun mong ma yin pa/ bdag med ma'i byin rlabs brgyud pa ma nyams pa'i lag len gyi tho yig rje btsun grags pas mdzad pa/ phra mor 'dug pa sa chen gyis mdzad par bzhed/ 'gor bshang sgor yaṃ las rlung gi dkyil 'khor zhes yod pa'i 'khor lo bzhi'i rgya sa chen gyis mdzad pa thugs kyi nying khu lags so'i mtha' can/ dpal yang dag par sbyor ba'i rgyud las byung ba'i rang byin gyis brlabs pa'i dmigs pa nyi shu rtsa dgu ba zhar byung rlung gi rnal 'byor gtso bor bzhed pa bla ma'i zhal shes zhes pa'i gegs sel dang bcas pa/ rje sa skya pa chen pos lho brag dkar ston la gnang ba'i phyi nang gsang ba'i bar gcod gsum sel/ phra mo na'ang yod/ 'gor rtsa dag par bya ba ni zhes yod pa'i bla ma sa chen gyi nyams chung pa bar pa dang mtha' ma la sogs pa'o'i mtha' can/ phra mor yang yod/ 'gor spyir srog 'dzin pa snying gar rengs pa'i tshul bzhi zhes yod pa'i bla ma sa chen gyi nyams chen mo/ phra mor kun gzhi byin rlabs dang me mnyam gyi rlung rengs tshul sogs kyang chos tshan gcig tu bzhed/ mthar dri chen rdo lta bu skam po 'byung ngo'i mtha' can/ khyad par gyi rlung rengs pa lnga 'chos pa sogs kyi thabs bla ma'i zhal la ltos pa khrag de nyid bskol te spod kyis sbran nas gtang ngo'i mtha' can/ phra mor thig le bsrung ba yan las mi 'dug lho pa dkar ston gyis zhus pa'i gzhan la med pa'i gegs sel gsang bdun ma/ phra mor yang yod/

'gor 'khor 'das kyi chos thams cad bskyed pa'i sa bon zhes yod pa'i gegs sel gling bzhi ma ri bong gi ril ma 'dra ba chu dang bcas nas stan thog tu byung bas sel lo'i mtha' can/ phra mo na nyams chen po dang sbrel nas 'dug cig sgom chen rdo rje 'bar lus ma bde ba man mi 'dug 'byung ba lus 'khrugs sogs sel ba'i thabs gegs sel ces gnad du grags pa 'di dag thams cad nyams myong rjes su dran pa'i tshad ma las shes par bya'o'i mtha' can/ dmar chos kyi rgyal pos zhus pa'i gegs sel bka' rgya ma/ phra mor yang yod/ 'di khams pa lnga dang rje btsun sku mched gnyis la gnang zhing dzang gis rje btsun sku mched sbran pas dzang 'di nged la shin tu drin che gsung ba mjug na snang*/ 'gor gzhan dbang rten 'brel zhes byas ting nge 'dzin gyi gegs sel ston zhes yod pas gegs sel bzhi'i zhal shes 'di la goms nas mtshan sum cu so gnyis thob gsung ngo'i mtha' can/ 'gor dza lan+dha ra zhes yod pa'i phrin las so gnyis kyi sdom tshig zhal shes bud+dha shrīs mdzad pa/ de'i zhal shes 'gor lag gnyis bsnol ba zhes yod pa re mos rdog gi mtha' can/ sa skya pa chen pos mdzad pa'i dbang bzhi ngo sprod/ phra mo na'ang yod/ de'i 'grel pa/ 'gor rje btsun thugs rje chen po dang ldan pa zhes yod pa'i brda don gsal ba'i rtsa ba sa paṇa gyis mdzad pa/ phra mor yang yod/ de'i rang 'grel rtsom pa dam bcar/ rdo rje'i tshig 'byed brda don gsal ba 'di// dbus gtsang mtshams su bla ma rje la gnang*// zhes yod pa/ de'i gsal byed lho pas gsung bzhin zin bris su mdzad pa/ phra mo na'ang yod/ bstan bcos tshad ma'i skabs su bskyed rim/ rlung*/ byin rlabs/ phyag rgya ma/ phyag rgya chen po/ rten 'brel te gnad du che ba drug gi gdams pa sa chen gyis mdzad pa/ 'di phra mor lam skor khrod du bgrangs 'dug

sa paṇa gyis mdzad pa'i rten 'brel lngas lam yongs su rdzogs pa/ 'di phra mo na'ang bzhugs/ 'gor g.yas pa'i khu tshur brkyangs byas te zhes yod pa'i dmar gyis mdzad pa'i lam bsdus pa 'dod pa'i lcags kyu lam 'bring po bya ba yin gsung ba'i mtha' can/ phyag rgya chen po'i dbye ba dpal ldan sa skya paṇ+ḍi ta'i mnal lam bsam yas su byung ba/ mjug gi sh+lau ka gcig ma tshang ba zhig phra mo na'ang yod/ des mdzad pa'i 'khor lo bzhi'i rgya/ 'di gnyis phra mor yang yod/ bla ma chos kyi rgyal po 'phags pas mdzad pa'i tshogs sbyor gnyis kyi mngon rtogs/ lam bsdus pa'i bshad pa mdo tsam du bstan pa bla ma rin po che'i gsung la brten nas sa chen gyis mdzad pa/ lam bsdus te sgrub pa'i lung sbyin pa sa paṇa gyis mdzad pa/ phra mor yang yod/ rje sa chen gyis mdzad pa'i gsang bcu'i rgyas gdab/ nyam pa'i 'phrang la yid bzhin nor bu ltar// gsang bcud ldan pa'i spyod pa mtha' ru bskyal gyi mtha' can/ lam zab bla ma'i khrid yig sa paṇa gyis dpal ling chu rtse'i khab kyi gtsug lag khang du sbyar ba/ phra mo na'ang yod/ bla ma rin chen 'byung gnas kyi rnal 'byor sa skya paṇa chen gyi gsung bzhin chos rgyal dmar gyis yi ger bkod pa/ lam sbas bshad kyi yi ge sa skya paṇ+ḍi tas mdo smad du sbyar ba/

phra mo na'ang yod/ 'gor lam sbas te khrid na zhes yod pa'i pho brang lnga la brten pa'i sbas bshad 'bras bu rim par rgyas pa gzhung du gsal lo'i mtha' can/ 'gor mkhal 'degs rigs gsum spyi'u tshugs dang*/ zhes yod pa'i lam sbas bshad kyi 'khrul 'khor rtsa ba rje dpal ldan tshul khrims kyis mdzad pa/ de'i rang 'grel chos rdzong du yi ger bkod pa/ 'gor rdo rje lce yi sbyor ba dang*/ zhes yod pa'i grub chen bcu dang phra mo brgyad kyi rtsa ba/ 'di gnyis phra mo na'ang yod/ de'i 'grel pa 'gor dpal ldan rnal 'byor dbang phyug bir+wa pa'i zhal gyi gdams pa zhes yod pa sa skya paṇ+ḍi ta'i thun mong ma yin pa'i gdams pa/ de'i gsal byed snyom las pa bud+dha shrīs brjed byang du bris pa/ phra mor la lar bud+dha shrīs mdzad zer ba mi 'thad tshul dang bcas pa snang ngo*// 'gor rdo rje'i tshig rkang las srung ba'i 'khor lo zhes yod pa'i bir srung swa dheṃ swā hā'i mtha' can/ phra mor 'phags pa'i yi ge'i gsal byed du bgrangs 'dug go /'gor dpal ldan mthu stobs dbang phyug ces yod pa'i bir srung spyan sngar dpe 'di gtugs so'i mtha' can/ 'gor ra ga ta dza phaṭa/ ces yod pa'i bir srung mi tshugs so'i mtha' can/ 'phags pas shin tu zhib par bkod pa'i bir srung dang*/ 'di phra mor yang yod/ byin rlabs bya tshul/ phra mor byin rlabs 'di sa chen gyis mdzad par bzhed/ 'gor rnal 'byor dbang phyug bir+wa pa nas byin rlabs kyi brgyud pa ma chad pa/ zhes yod pa'i rnam 'joms bir lugs kyi byin rlabs bya tshul bar ma chad pa'o'i mtha' can/ rdo rje rnam par 'joms pa'i gzungs la sa paṇa gyis mchan mdzad pa/ de'i gsal byed sa paṇa gyis mdzad pa'i rnam par bshad pa bdud rtsi spel ba/ rdo rje rnam par 'joms pa'i rgyud don nyams su blang ba'i cho ga nub pa rig 'dzin grags kyis mdzad pa/

rje btsun chen pos dbang phyug 'od zer gyi ngor btsong kha dgon par mdzad pa'i tshar gsum khug pa'i man ngag phra mor dkar chag gis ma zin pa'i khrod du yod/ 'gor spyir yi ge brgya pa phyir bzlog tu 'gro ba dang*/ zhes yod pa'i yig brgya'i man ngag sa chen gyis mdzad pa/ 'gro ba'i gtso la bdag skyabs mchi// zhes brjod do'i mtha' can/ 'brog mis paṇ+ḍi ta drug las chos gsan pa'i sgo drug chos 'brel du grags pa la shes rab 'byung gnas sbas pas gdon/ dzñā na shrī lus 'khrugs/ rin chen rdo rjes sems kyi bar chad bsrung ba gsum chos tshan gcig tu byas pa/ phra mor yang yod/ nā ro pa'i phyag rgya chen po sdug bsngal gsum sel gyi gsal byed rje btsun gyis mdzad pa zhar byung bzhi pa man chad rlung dang bstun tshul/ phra mor yang yod/ ngag dbang grags pa'i gnyug ma dran gsal/ phra mor yang yod/ de'i dbang bzhi stan thog gcig tu blang ba zhang 'phags pa lhas yang yang bskul nas rje btsun chen pos mdzad pa/ phra mor bla ma brgyud pa yan las de man gyi zhang 'phags pa lhas bskur tshul sogs mi 'dug gzhung rnams legs par tshar nas shān+ta pas gnang ba'i mdo rgyud bsre ba snying po'i don rang grol du grags pa/ phra mor yang yod/ rdo rje 'chang kun dga' bzang pos mdzad pa'i lam 'bras bu dang bcas pa bshad thabs kyi gdams ngag gsang ba'i sgo 'byed/ des mdzad pa'i rgyud gsum lam gyi rim pa'i bsdus don/ des mdzad pa'i lam zab nang ma'i bla ma'i rnal 'byor/ des mdzad pa'i rgyu dus kyi dbang gi rtogs pa bskyed pa'i rim pa/ bir srung gi man ngag bar chad kun sel/ des mdzad pa'i bir+wa pa'i sku'i rnam 'gyur drug gi dbye ba/ des mdzad pa'i bir srung gi thun mong ma yin pa'i byin rlabs bya tshul tshigs bcad ma/ des mdzad pa'i thun mong ma yin pa'i bir srung nyams su blang tshul/

dkar chag tu mi gsal ba des mdzad pa'i bir srung gsar ma srung bzlog gi gdams pa khyad par can rnams so// de dag tu ma gtogs pa lam skor lhag ma brgyad kyi chos tshan kha shas bgrangs 'dug pa ni phal cher glegs bam du bzhugs pa shas che/ de thams cad la nye bar mkho ba'i gnad drug ces pa bskyed rim rlung*/ pod dmar na lam 'bras kyi chos sder bgrangs 'dug mkha' 'gro'i byin rlabs/ phyag rgya ma/ phyag rgya chen po/ rten 'brel te drug ston pa/ lam skor byung tshul zhes pa'i yig chung lam dgu po bla ma bzhi las gsan gsung ngo'i mtha' can/ bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i lo rgyus bla ma sa skya pa chen po'i gsung sgros ji lta ba bzhin rang gi slob ma'i ngor dkar ston chos 'od kyis dbri bsnan med par bris pa/ bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i byin rlabs bla chen 'brog mi las rang gis thob pa ltar brjed byang du bris pa 'di ni yab yum dbang rdzogs thob par gdams te byin pa/ 'di 'brog mi'i dngos slob gcig gis yin tshul dkar chag na 'dug bar ston gyi lam skor zin bris la/ mchod rten drung thob/ bsam mi khyab/ pad+ma badz+ra gyi lam/ lhan cig skyes grub/ gtum mo lam rdzogs rnams kyi zin bris chos tshan gcig tu bsdebs pa/ thog mar rtsom pa'i dus 'di rnams 'khor 'das dbyer med kyi 'gor bris yod 'dug gnyags snying po rgyal mtshan gyis mdzad pa'i phyag rgya chen po yi ge med pa nyams su len pa'i khrid/ mdzad byang na hri da dh+wa dza zhes rgya skad du bris 'dug 'gor bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i gdams ngag 'di la zhes yod pa'i zin bris chen mo lta ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa lngas rgyu dus su gtan la phab ste lam dus su lus ngag yid gsum sbyangs nas 'bras bu lung bstan pa'i phyag rgyas mtshams sbyar bas gnas 'gyur gyi sku gsum yan lag bdun ldan 'grub par byed pa'o'i mtha' can/

gsung ngag rin po che'i bstan pa 'dzin pa rnams kyis mdzad pa'i yig sna thor bu'i skor la/ rnam 'joms bir lugs lha bdun cu rtsa lnga'i sgrub thabs nub pa rig 'dzin grags kyis mdzad pa'i dbu'i phyogs nas phyung ba rnams/ rnam 'joms bir lugs kyi byin rlabs kun mkhyen bsod nams seng ges mdzad pa/ des mdzad pa'i ga ya dha ra nas brgyud pa'i gur mgon gyi rjes gnang bya tshul/ rje mus chen sangs rgyas rin chen gyis mdzad pa'i gsung ngag rin po che'i khrid yig dngos grub 'byung gter kha skong dang bcas pa/ ngor chen dkon mchog lhun grub kyis mdzad pa'i gsung ngag rin po che rgyud gsum man ngag dang bcas pa'i bla ma brgyud pa la gsol ba 'debs pa byin rlabs myur 'jug gi pho nya bcas pa/ lam zab mo bla ma'i rnal 'byor gyi nyams len/ gsung ngag rin po che'i dmigs rim dang mthun pa'i gsol 'debs zab don snying po/ de'i lam khyer gyi smon lam bdud rtsi'i thigs pa/ man ngag gi brda 'phros zab don snang ba/ dbang gi sngon 'gro'i sems bskyed/ man ngag lugs kyi slob ma rjes 'dzin gyi yi ge sa chog mdor bsdus/ kye rdo rje'i sgrub thabs bsnyen sgrub yan lag bzhi ldan/ mngon rtogs yan lag drug pa'i mdzes rgyan/ lus dkyil mdzes rgyan/ bdag med ma'i sgrub dkyil gyi tho/ lam 'bras rdo rje'i tshig rkang gi bsdus don tshang bde nyung gsal/ gzhung ji lta ba bzhin du bkri ba'i lam gyi sngon 'gro'i khrid yig snang gsum mdzes par byed pa'i rgyan/ des mdzad pa'i lam gyi dngos gzhi'i khrid yig rgyud gsum mdzes par byed pa'i rgyan/ des mdzad pa'i dpal kye rdo rje'i dbang gi tshig don rnams legs par bshad pa lung dang man ngag gi gter mdzod/ des mdzad pa'i dbang gi mtshams sbyor snying po bsdus pa/ des mdzad pa'i kye rdo rje'i zhi ba'i sbyin sreg gi cho ga lag len gsal ba'i me long*/
