de la ltos pa rgyas pa'i sbyin sreg gi tho/ kye rdo rje'i 'grel pa lugs dang mtsho skyes lugs dang nag po lugs rnams kyi sgrub thabs dang dkyil chog tshul dang po gsum gyi don nyung ngus ngag gi sgo nas ston pa tshul gsum gsal bar byed pa'i rgyan/ rgyud kyi mngon par rtogs pa'i don gsal bar byed pa ljon shing mdzes par byed pa'i rgyan/ legs par bshad pa gong ma'i dgongs rgyan la sogs pa dang*/ thar rtse paṇa chen nam mkha' dpal bzang gis mdzad pa'i lam zab mo bla ma'i rnal 'byor gyi cho ga lam zab mo bla ma'i rnal 'byor gyi nyams len/ bla ma rin 'byung gi byin rlabs bya tshul/ bir srung thun mong ba'i byin rlabs bya tshul/ sgrub pa lung byin/ brda chig brgyud/ rnam 'joms bir lugs/ brda don gsal ba rnams kyi byin rlabs bya tshul gyi cho ga bla ma mchod pa'i cho ga thun mong dang thun mong ma yin pa bya ba'i lag len/ rje dpal ldan don grub kyis mdzad pa'i kye rdo rje'i las bzhi'i sbyin sreg gi rnam bshad ye shes me dpung rnams so// paṇa chen ngag dbang chos grags kyis mdzad pa'i gsung ngag gi yi ge'i skor la/ slob ma rjes 'dzin gyi phyag len nyams su blang bde ba/ aṣ+ṭa'i bzlas lung byed tshul lugs gnyis/ brgyud pa khyad par gnyis ldan gyi sems bskyed kyi cho ga dam pa'i bzhed srol sems nyid ngal gso'i bdud rtsi/ tshar gsum khug pa'i byin rlabs bya tshul gsang chen chos kyi rnga chen/ lam dbang gi mtha' dpyod zur 'debs kyi gnad/ rdo rje bdag med ma'i byin rlabs bya tshul legs byas gtam gyi bdud rtsi/ lam zab bla ma'i rnal 'byor gyi byin rlabs bya tshul mkhas la nye bar mkho ba/ bla ma rin 'byung gi nyams len byin rlabs dang bcas pa'i yi ge 'dod dgu'i dpal 'byor ma lus pa 'byung ba'i gnas legs byas kyi rnga bo che/ lam zab nang gi rnal 'byor gyi byin rlabs bya tshul mkhas la nyer mkho/

bir srung thun mong gi byin rlabs rje rdo rje 'chang gis mdzad pa la zur 'debs cung zad dang bcas pa/ bir srung thun mong ma yin pa'i byin rlabs bya tshul zur 'debs dang bcas pa/ brda don gsal ba'i byin rlabs bya tshul la gnyis las gsum byung gi go don dang bcas pa/ lam sbas bshad kyi byin rlabs bya tshul bklag chog tu bkod pa/ brda chig brgyud kyi byin rlabs bya tshul lag len go bde bklag chog tu bkod pa/ sgrub pa lung sbyin dang gsang bcu rgyas gdab kyi phyag len go bde bklag chog tu bkod pa mtha' dpyod dang bcas pa rnams kyi lung dang*/ gzhan yang 'di dag gi skor rgyas pa ni sa skya pa'i rje btsun gong ma lnga dang*/ ngor chen rdo rje 'chang yab sras la sogs pa'i gsung rab la bzhugs pa thos pa'i brgyud pa rnams ni so so'i lung gi skabs su 'chad par 'gyur la/ 'dir rgyu dus kyi dbang bskur ba dang byin rlabs dang khrid dang glegs bam rin po che phal cher gyi lung dang bcas pa thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ samyak+saṃ bud+dha badz+ra dha raḥ/ bhaṭ+ṭā rā ka badz+ra nai rat+na/ ā tsār+ya yo ge shwa ra shrī mad+bir+wa/ ṣaṣabhū mi shwa ra ma hā sid+dha pūrba dika h+ṇaḥ/ rā dzñāḥkū la ḍā ma ru pa/ bhaṭ+ṭā rā ka a wa dhū tiḥ/ ma hā paṇ+ḍi ta ga ya dha raḥ/ yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rdo rje 'chang*/ rje btsun rdo rje bdag med ma/ slob dpon rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug dpal ldan bir+wa pa/ sa drug gi dbang phyug grub chen shar phyogs nag po pa/ rgyal rigs ḍā ma ru pa/ rje btsun gnyis spangs pa/ mkhas pa chen po sprin 'dzin/ ma hā lo ka tsak+ṣu 'brog mi shākya dzñā naḥ/ gu ru se ku ḍ+yalpa sar+b+ba bi traḥ/ gu ru ka kā ra ṇ+ya ka dhar+m+ma dz+wa laḥ/ bhaṭ+ṭā rā ka ma hā bhū mi paṇ+ḍu ra nan+da gar+bhaḥ/ ā tsār+ya rat+na puṇ+yā graḥ/ bhaṭ+ṭā rā ka rat+na kīrti dh+wa dzaḥ/ ma hā paṇ+ḍi ta bhū mi paṇ+ḍa rā nan+da dh+wa dza shrī bha draḥ/

'jig rten gyi mig chen po 'brog mi shākya ye shes/ bla ma se mkhar chung pa kun rig bla ma zhang dgon pa ba chos 'bar/ rje btsun sa skya pa chen po kun dga' snying po/ slob dpon rin po che bsod nams rtse mo/ rje btsun rin po che grags pa rgyal mtshan/ sa skya paṇ+ḍi ta chen po kun dga' rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po/ dza ga nā tha dhar+m+ma rā dza/ rat+nār+ya ma ti dh+wa dzaḥ/ gu ru ka ka rat+na shrīḥ/ ma hā sid+dha she la kau ṭ+ya ka puṇ+ya shrī/ sarba dzñā puṇ+ya dh+wa dza shrī bha draḥ/ dhar+m+ma swā mi shrī mats+tshī laḥ/ ma hā sid+dha bud+dha shrī/ ma hā ngor badz+ra dha rā nan+da bha draḥ/ 'gro ba'i mgon po chos kyi rgyal po/ 'phags pa rin po che blo gros rgyal mtshan/ bla ma zhang dkon mchog dpal/ grub chen brag phug pa bsod nams dpal/ thams cad mkhyen pa bsod nams rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po/ chos rje dpal ldan tshul khrims/ grub chen sangs rgyas dpal/ ngor chen rdo rje 'chang kun dga' bzang po/ ma hā satwa rat+na dh+wa dzaḥ/ tau yu bha yā bh+yaṃ sang+yu wa rā dzā nan+de sho rash+tsa sarba dzñā puṇ+ya si dhau yu bha yā bh+yaṃ shru taṃ/ pish+tsu ma tri bh+yaḥpa ri dha ra rat+na war+dhaḥ/ tasmāt+pū mi paṇ+ḍa ral+lo tsā mañdzu swa rā nan+da puṇ+ya na shru taṃ/ sems dpa' chen po dkon mchog rgyal mtshan/ de gnyis ka las rgyal tshab dam pa kun dga' dbang phyug dang kun mkhyen bsod nams seng ge gnyis kas gsan/ phyi ma gsum char las yongs 'dzin dkon mchog 'phel/ de las sa skya lo tsā ba 'jam dbyangs kun dga' bsod nams kyis gsan/ tau yu bha yā bh+yaṃ sar+b+ba dzñā rat+na ni rā bho ge na shru tam/ tasmātabha ṭ+ṭā ra ke wa mi rat+na shrī wāñtsa/ bhaṭ+ṭā rā ka ga ga na shrī bha dra dī bh+yaṃ shru taṃ/ tau yu bha yā bh+yam+mañdzu swa rā nan+da ni rā bho ge na shru taṃ/ tasmat+sar+b+ba dzñā sh+ya gra dh+wā dze na shru taṃ/ de gnyis ka las thams cad mkhyen pa dkon mchog lhun grub kyis gsan/

de las rje btsun e waṃ pa dkon mchog dpal ldan dang*/ rje btsun nam mkha' dpal bzang gnyis kyis gsan/ de gnyis ka las 'jam dbyangs kun dga' bsod nams lhun grub kyis gsan/ de las thams cad mkhyen pa dpal mchog rgyal mtshan gyis gsan/ tasmad+mañdzu gho ṣa bud+dha luk+ṣ+m+yā shru taṃ/ tasmāt+p+ra sa dātabhū ta ma hā badz+ra dha rash+shī la ni rā bho ga maṅga la kīrti dh+wa dza shrī bha dre na shru taṃ/ ta twa s+ya dzñā na kṛ sā nu bha wai ra nu dha ra ka s+yāt+ma ban+de shī la rat+naṃ wa tsa na wā grat+na s+yā bhi ṣe ka nā ya nau pa ri pūr+ṇaṇa s+t+ri ṇāñtsa/ de las 'jam dbyangs sangs rgyas phun tshogs kyis gsan/ de las bka' drin rmad byung rdo rje 'chang ba chen po tshul khrims lhun grub bkra shis grags pa'i rgyal mtshan dpal bzang pos gsan/ de nyid kyi mkhyen brtse nus pas rjes su bzung ba'i bdag btsun pa tshul khrims rin chen la gsung ngag rin po che'i dbang khrid yongs su rdzogs pa lan gsum dang*/ he tu wā pañtsa ma pra da ti/ wā ma hā pa ṭu sid+dha bud+dha lak+ṣ+m+yā tra/ a pa mā ṇa puṇ+ya shrī wāṃ/ ma hā badz+ra dha rash+shī la ni rā bho ga ma tho kīrti dh+wa dza shrī bha draḥ/ tasmā dāt+ma ban+de shī la rat+ne na su prap+taḥ/ rgyu dbang lan lnga'i bar du stsal to// yang na mkhas grub chen po sangs rgyas phun tshogs nas/ mtshungs med bsod nams dpal ldan/ rdo rje 'chang ba chen po tshul khrims lhun grub bkra shis grags pa'i rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po/ de las bdag btsun pa tshul khrims rin chen gyis legs par thob bo// yang na shar chen shes rab 'byung gnas nas/ mkhan chen lhun grub dpal ldan/ 'jam dbyangs sangs rgyas phun tshogs man sngar bzhin no// yang na 'jam dbyangs kun dga' bsod nams lhun grub nas/ rje nam mkha' sangs rgyas/ nam mkha' dpal bzang*/ 'jam dbyangs sangs rgyas phun tshogs man sngar bzhin no// yang na paṇa chen nam mkha' dpal bzang dang byams pa kun dga' bkra shis/

mkhas grub dpal ldan don grub gsum ga las/ rje nam mkha' sangs rgyas kyis gsan/ de las hor nam mkha' dpal bzang man 'dra/ yang na thar rtse paṇa chen nam mkha' dpal bzang nas/ mkhas pa'i dbang po dpal ldan don grub/ de las 'jam mgon dpal mchog rgyal mtshan gyis gsan pa man sngar bzhin no// yang na paṇa chen nam mkha' dpal bzang nas/ rje nam mkha' sangs rgyas/ 'jam mgon dpal mchog rgyal mtshan man sngar dang 'dra/ yang na paṇa chen brang ti pa nas/ rje dpal ldan don grub/ shar chen shes rab 'byung gnas/ rje dpal mchog rgyal mtshan man 'dra/ yang na rtse gdong khri chen/ byams pa kun dga' bkra shis/ mkhas grub dpal ldan don grub gsum char las/ shar pa shes rab 'byung gnas kyis so// yang na yongs 'dzin dkon mchog 'phel dang rje sangs rgyas rin chen gnyis ka las rje lha mchog seng ge de las rje dkon mchog lhun grub dang*/ rje sangs rgyas seng ge gnyis char gyis gsan/ de gnyis char las rje dkon mchog dpal ldan dang*/ paṇa chen nam mkha' dpal bzang gnyis char gyis gsan/ de gnyis char las 'jam dbyangs kun dga' bsod nams lhun grub dang*/ shar chen byams pa kun dga' bkra shis gnyis kyis gsan/ de gnyis char las rje dpal mchog rgyal mtshan gyis gsan no// yang na rje dkon mchog dpal ldan las/ rje nam mkha' dpal bzang*/ byams pa kun dga' bkra shis/ mkhas grub dpal ldan don grub gsum char gyis/ de gsum las rje nam mkha' sangs rgyas kyis gsan pa man 'dra/ yang na 'jam dbyangs sangs rgyas seng ge mus chen nam mkha' dpal bzang*/ mkhas grub dpal ldan don grub man sngar bzhin no// yang na ngor chen rdo rje 'chang las/ 'jam dbyangs shes rab rgya mtsho dang mkhas grub dpal ldan rdo rje gnyis kyis gsan/ de gnyis ka las yongs 'dzin dkon mchog 'phel man 'dra/ yang na sems dpa' chen po dkon mchog rgyal mtshan dang 'jam dbyangs shes rab rgya mtsho gnyis char las/

mkhas grub dpal rdor man 'dra/ yang na rje sangs rgyas rin chen/ lha mchog seng ge dkon mchog lhun grub gsum char las/ 'jam dbyangs sangs rgyas seng ges gsan/ de las rje btsun dkon mchog dpal ldan dang rje nam mkha' dpal bzang gnyis kyis gsan/ yang na rje sangs rgyas rin chen/ lha mchog seng ge dkon mchog lhun grub gsum char las shar khang pa shes rab rgyal mtshan gyis gsan/ de las rje nam mkha' dpal bzang pas gsan no// yang na sangs rgyas rin chen dang lha mchog pa dang dkon mchog lhun grub gsum char las/ mus chen dkon mchog rgya mtshos gsan/ de las rje dkon mchog dpal ldan gyis so// yang na sems dpa' chen po dang kun mkhyen gnyis ka las/ rje btsun sangs rgyas rin chen/ de las sa lo dang rje dkon mchog lhun grub kyis gsan pa man 'dra/ yang na sems dpa' chen po nas/ mkhas grub dpal ldan rdo rje man 'dra/ yang na sems dpa' chen po nas/ grub chen dkon mchog blo gros/ rje sangs rgyas rin chen man 'dra/ yang na rgyal tshab kun dbang nas/ mkhan chen bsod nams lhun grub/ de las rje sa lo dang dkon mchog lhun grub kyis gsan pa man 'dra/ yang na sa skya paṇ+ḍi ta nas/ tshogs sgom pa kun dga' dpal/ nyan chen bsod nams brtan pa/ brag phug pa bsod nams dpal man 'dra/ yang na nyan chen bsod nams brtan pa nas/ dkar po brag pa rin chen seng ge bla ma dpal ldan tshul khrims man 'dra/ yang na brag phug pa bsod nams dpal nas/ ri khrod pa blo gros brtan pa/ dpal ldan tshul khrims man 'dra/ yang na kun mkhyen rin po che nas/ paṇa chen dbang phyug grub pa/ bdag chen ngag gi dbang phyug 'jam dbyangs dkon mchog rgya mtsho man 'dra/ yang na rje dkon mchog 'phel nas/ bdag chen ngag gi dbang phyug man 'dra/ yang na sa lo tsā ba nas ngag gi dbang phyug man 'dra/ yang na rje sangs rgyas rin chen nas/ 'jam dbyangs nam mkha' dbang phyug dkon mchog rgya mtsho man 'dra/

yang na rje dkon mchog rgya mtsho nas/ rje btsun byams pa rab brtan/ 'jam dbyangs kun dga' bsod nams lhun grub man 'dra/ yang na kun mkhyen rin po che bsod nams seng ge dang*/ kong ston dbang phyug grub pa gnyis char las/ 'jam dbyangs chos grags rgya mtshos gsan/ phyi ma gsum char las mkhas grub blo gros rab yangs dang*/ mkhas mchog bkra shis brtan pa gnyis kyis gsan/ de gnyis ka las rje blo gros 'byung gnas kyis gsan/ de las rje byams pa rab brtan pas so// yang na kun mkhyen rin po che/ lum pa grags 'byor shes rab/ rje blo gros 'byung gnas man 'dra'o// yang na sa lo tsā ba dang rje dkon mchog lhun grub gnyis las sngags 'chang kun dga' rin chen pas gsan/ sngags 'chang rin po che dang 'jam dbyangs dkon mchog rgya mtsho rje dkon mchog dpal ldan gsum las 'jam dbyangs bsod nams dbang pos gsan/ de las 'jam dbyangs kun dga' bsod nams lhun grub kyis gsan pa man sngar bzhin no// yang na mus chen dkon mchog rgya mtsho/ mus chen sangs rgyas rgyal mtshan/ sngags 'chang kun dga' bsod nams/ mkhan chen bsod nams rgya mtsho/ rje nam mkha' dpal bzang man sngar bzhin no// yang nye brgyud ni/ brtse ba chen po mnga' ris gung thang du bzhugs skabs dug byung ba'i ro ma g.yas ru'i grong chu dgon par bzhugs dus longs pa'i skyon gyis chos rnams mnyel bas 'jam dbyangs phug tu sku mtshams bsdams te gsol ba btab pas/ zhang dgon pa ba mnal lam dang dngos su byon nas gdams pa rnams gsungs/ de rjes rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug chos 'khor gyi phyag rgya can sa skya'i 'bal grog mon grog gi bar skyil krung gcig gis khebs pa gtso 'khor lnga pa zhig zhal gzigs/ de nas dbu rtse rnying mar zla ba gcig gi bar du mngon sum du bzhugs nas gsung ngag rin po che dang lcags ri mi 'da' ba'i gser chos bzhi dang rgyud sde bdun bcu rtsa gnyis la sogs pa gsungs te/

de'i brgyud pa ni/ yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rdo rje 'chang*/ rje btsun rdo rje bdag med ma/ rnal 'byor dbang phyug bir+wa pa/ bla ma sa skya pa chen po kun dga' snying po man gong bzhin no// de rnams ni gsung ngag gi brgyud pa gtso che ba'i rnam grangs yin la/ rgyu dbang rkyang pa thob pa'i brgyud pa'i rnam grangs la/ chos kyi rgyal po 'phags pa yan gong bzhin lam 'bras rgyu dbang lhan cig pa ltar las/ de nas zhang dkon mchog dpal/ na bza' brag phug pa/ bla ma dam pa bsod nams rgyal mtshan/ ri khrod pa blo gros brtan pa/ bla ma dpal ldan tshul khrims/ grub chen bud+dha shrī/ rdo rje 'chang kun dga' bzang po/ sems dpa' chen po dkon mchog rgyal mtshan/ de gnyis ka las rgyal tshab kun dbang dang*/ kun mkhyen bsod nams seng ge yongs 'dzin dkon mchog 'phel/ de las sa lo tsā ba 'jam dbyangs kun dga' bsod nams/ de gnyis ka las thams cad mkhyen pa dkon mchog lhun grub/ rje btsun nam mkha' dpal bzang*/ 'jam dbyangs kun dga' bsod nams lhun grub/ shar pa shes rab 'byung gnas/ mkhan chen lhun grub dpal ldan/ mkhas grub sangs rgyas phun tshogs/ mkhan chen shes bya bzang po/ de gnyis ka las shug ra he ru ka dpal kun dga' dpal 'byor gyis gsan nam gsan yul gang yin cung zad brtag de las bdag tshul khrims rin chen gyis so// yang na mkhan chen lhun grub dpal ldan nas/ mkhas grub sangs rgyas phun tshogs thams cad mkhyen pa bkra shis lhun grub/ chos rje rdo rje 'chang kun dga' chos 'phel/ de bzhi char las drin chen rdo rje 'chang bkra shis bzang pos gsan/ de las bdag ban+de tshul khrims rin chen gyis thob bo// yang na brag phug pa nas/ lam 'bras pa ye shes dpal/ sa skya pa rin chen dpal/ chos kyi rje paṇ+ḍi ta man 'dra/ yang na chos rje dpal ldan tshul khrims las/ shar chen ye shes rgyal mtshan dang*/ grub chen bud+dha shrīs gsan/

de gnyis las rdo rje 'chang kun dga' bzang pos gsan pa man 'dra/ yang na rje btsun grags pa nas/ gcung dpal chen 'od po/ sa paṇa/ zangs tsha bsod nams rgyal mtshan/ 'phags pa/ 'di gnyis kyi bar na bla ma zhig dgos nges su 'dug pa dam pa kun dga' grags yin min dpyad/ bdag nyid chen po bzang po dpal/ bla ma dam pa man 'dra/ yang na bla ma dam pa nas/ bla chen kun dga' rgyal mtshan/ ngor chen man 'dra/ yang na 'phags pa rin po che nas/ tshogs sgom pa kun dga' dpal/ nyan chen bsod nams brtan pa/ dkar po brag pa rin chen seng ge chos rje dpal ldan tshul khrims/ grub chen bud+dha shrī/ rje rdo rje 'chang*/ mkhas grub dpal ldan rdo rje man 'dra/ yang na 'phags pa nas/ paṇ+ḍi ta rdo rje shes rab/ bla ma 'phags rgyal ba/ bla ma rin chen dpal bzang*/ 'gro mgon bsod nams rgyal mtshan man 'dra/ yang na zhang dkon mchog dpal nas/ dga' ldan pa kun dga' bsod nams/ rgyal ba brag phug pa man 'dra/ yang na nyan chen pa nas/ bang mo zhu pa gzhon nu dpal/ bla ma dam pa man 'dra/ yang na rje sa paṇa nas/ tshogs sgom rin po che/ gnyags snying po rgyal mtshan/ bar ston rdo rje rgyal mtshan/ mkhan chen rdo rje tshul khrims/ bla ma dkon mchog rgyal mtshan/ sa skya bu ston dbang phyug dar/ theg chen chos kyi rgyal po/ kun mkhyen rong ston chen po/ mkhas grub gung ru sher bzang man 'dra/ yang na sa skya'i zhal ngo nang brgyud ni/ 'phags pa nas/ bdag nyid chen po bzang po dpal/ bla chen kun dga' rgyal mtshan/ theg chen chos rje kun dga' bkra shis/ 'jam dbyangs nam mkha' rgyal mtshan/ rgya gar shes rab rgyal mtshan/ sa lo sngags 'chang chen po/ khri chen bsod nams dbang po/ 'jam dbyangs kun dga' bsod nams/ yab sras gnyis char las mkhan chen lhun grub dpal ldan pas gsan no// yang na brag phug pa bsod nams dpal nas/ brag phug pa dkon mchog rgyal mtshan/ sa skya bu ston dbang phyug dar man 'dra/

yang na dpal ldan bla ma dam pa nas/ sngags 'chang gzungs kyi dpal ba/ chos rje bzang po rgyal mtshan/ mtshungs med rgyal mtshan dkon mchog rdzong chung pa byams pa rdo rje rgyal mtshan/ bdag chen rgya gar shes rab rgyal mtshan man 'dra/ yang na ngor chen nas/ gu ge paṇ+ḍi ta/ rje ri ti skyog pa/ rje dpal ldan pa/ rje nam dpal ba/ rje yon tan chos rgyal/ rje legs pa'i shes rab drug gis gsan/ drug ga las glo bo mkhan chen pas gsan pa man 'dra/ yang na ngor chen nas/ dpal ldan rdo rje/ kun dga' mchog grub man 'dra/ yang na ngor chen dang sems dpa' chen po gnyis las/ shes rab rgya mtsho/ kun dga' dbang phyug dpal ldan rdo rje/ kun mkhyen bsod nams seng ge bzhis gsan/ mus chen man gyi bla ma lnga ga las rat+na war+dhas gsan pa man 'dra/ yang na sems dpa' chen po las/ kun mkhyen go bo/ grub chen dkon mchog blo gros/ rje dkon mchog 'phel gsum gas gsan/ gsum ga las rje sangs rgyas rin chen gyis gsan/ dkon mchog lhun grub man gong ltar ro// yang na ngor chen yab sras/ mkhas grub dpal ldan rdo rje nas/ mi nyag paṇa chen grags pa rdo rje/ sa lo tsā ba/ rje dkon mchog lhun grub man 'dra/ yang na ngor chen nas/ mkhas pa gzhon nu seng ge de gnyis kas rjes su bzung ba lha 'bri ston pa shes rab rdo rje/ mi nyag paṇa chen man gong bzhin no// yang na ngor chen dang mus chen gnyis las/ spyan snga rdo rje kun dga' dang*/ mkhas grub gung ru sher bzang gis gsan/ gnyis ka las mi nyag paṇa chen gyis gsan no// yang na sa paṇa nas/ grub thob yon tan dpal/ la ru ba bsod nams seng ge kun mkhyen gangs pa grags pa dpal/

spang khang pa yang zer/ ma ti paṇa chen/ theg chen chos rje/ nyi lde pa gu shrī nam mkha' bzang po/ dpal ldan rdo rje/ mi nyag paṇa chen grags pa rdo rje man gong ltar ro// yang na bla ma dpal ldan tshul khrims nas/ de dbon nam mkha' dpal bzang*/ gu shrī nam mkha' bzang po/ mkhas grub dpal ldan rdo rje man 'dra/ yang na gu shrī nam mkha' bzang po nas/ rje ngag dbang grags pa/ bdag chen rgya gar ba shes rab rgyal mtshan/ sa lo man 'dra/ yang na 'gro mgon bsod nams rgyal mtshan/ nya dbon kun dpal/ grub chen kun dga' blo gros/ 'jam dbyangs dkon mchog bzang po/ rgya gar shes rab rgyal mtshan man gong dang 'dra/ yang na 'gro mgon chos rje/ mkhan chen byang chub seng ge theg chen chos rje/ grub chen kun dga' blo gros sogs sngar dang 'dra'o// yang na 'jam dbyangs dkon mchog bzang po nas/ bdag chen rgya gar ba man sngar bzhin no// yang na sangs rgyas seng ge dang*/ brang ti pa nam mkha' dpal bzang gnyis las/ shar chen byams pa kun dga' bkra shis grags pa rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po/ de dbon rje btsun shes rab 'byung gnas man sngar dang 'dra/ yang na sangs rgyas seng ge nas/ dkon mchog dpal ldan/ shar chen pa man gong ltar/ yang na dkon mchog lhun grub nas/ shar khang pa shes rab rgyal mtshan/ shar pa kun bkras pa man 'dra/ yang na thar rtse pa nas/ rtse gdong khri chen kun dga' bsod nams lhun grub/ shar pa shes rab 'byung gnas man 'dra/ yang na dkon mchog lhun grub nas/ dkon mchog dpal ldan/ rtse gdong khri chen man 'dra/ yang na bdag chen ngag gi dbang phyug nas/ mkhan chen byams pa rab brtan/ rtse gdong khri chen man 'dra'o// zhes gsan yig 'ga' zhig tu 'di ltar byung yang rgyu dbang gi brgyud pa la'ang lam 'bras kyi brgyud pa 'dres pa'ang 'byung ba sogs zhib par gong ma so so'i rnam par thar pa la legs par dpyad pas rtogs par 'gyur ro// aṣ+ṭa'i bzlas lung gi brgyud pa ngor lugs ni/

chos rje rdo rje 'chang yan lam 'bras ltar la/ de nas mus chen sems dpa' chen po/ mus chen sangs rgyas rin chen/ yongs 'dzin dkon mchog 'phel/ ngor chen dkon mchog lhun grub/ de dbon dkon mchog dpal ldan/ shar chen byams pa kun dga' bkra shis/ shar chen shes rab 'byung gnas/ de gnyis ka las dpal ldan don grub/ 'jam mgon dpal mchog rgyal mtshan/ mkhas grub sangs rgyas phun tshogs/ mkhan chen rdo rje 'chang tshul khrims lhun grub/ des bdag ban+de tshul khrims rin chen la'o// yang na sangs rgyas phun tshogs nas/ mtshungs med bsod nams dpal ldan/ de las mkhan chen byams pa bsod nams bzang po dang*/ tshul khrims lhun grub gnyis char gyis gsan/ snga ma las 'jam dbyangs sangs rgyas dpal bzang bas gsan/ de las bdag gis so// yang na mtshungs med bsod nams dpal ldan pa nas/ mkhan chen thams cad mkhyen pa dpal ldan chos skyong*/ des bdag tshul rin la'o// yang na dkon mchog dpal ldan nas/ rje nam mkha' dpal bzang*/ sgrub khang pa dpal ldan don grub/ 'jam mgon dpal mchog pa man sngar bzhin no// rje btsun rdo rje bdag med ma lha mo bco lnga'i ras bris kyi dkyil 'khor du dbang bzhi rdzogs par thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ sa chen yan chad yab dang 'dra/ sa skya pa chen po nas ne tso sbal ston/ slob dpon slob dpon bye ma lung pa zhes pa 'dir sangs rgyas phun tshogs pa'i gsan yig na byung yang thar rtse paṇa chen dang rmor chen sogs kyi gsan yig na med pas dgos sam ma yin brtag bye ma lung pa/ bla ma shes rab grags/ gnam pa rwa chos kyi shes rab/ mngon pa ba dbang phyug brtson 'grus/ de las 'phags pa rin po che dang paṇ+ḍi ta rdo rje shes rab gnyis kyis gsan/ de gnyis las zhang dkon mchog dpal/ de nas na bza' brag phug pa bsod nams dpal ba/ de las bla ma dam pa bsod nams rgyal mtshan dang ri khrod pa blo brtan gnyis kyis gsan/

gnyis ka las bla ma dpal ldan tshul khrims/ de las chos rje shar pa ye shes rgyal mtshan dang grub chen bud+dha shrī gnyis kyis gsan/ de gnyis ka las ngor chen rdo rje 'chang gis gsan/ de nas sems dpa' chen pos gsan/ gnyis ka las rgyal tshab kun dga' dbang phyug dang kun mkhyen bsod nams seng ge gnyis kyis gsan/ gnyis ka las 'dren mchog rat+na war+dha/ sa lo thams cad mkhyen pa/ sngags 'chang ngag dbang kun dga' rin chen/ grub mchog bsod nams dbang po/ sngags 'chang ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams/ dpal sa skya pa ngag dbang kun dga' bkra shis/ mkhas grub chen po sangs rgyas phun tshogs/ drin chen rdo rje 'chang bkra shis lhun grub grags pa'i rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po/ de las bdag ban+de tshul khrims rin chen zhes bgyi bas legs par mnos so// yang na mngon pa ba/ 'phags pa rin po che/ sgang ston shes rab 'bum/ dkar po brag pa/ dpal ldan tshul khrims pa man 'dra/ yang na 'dren mchog dkon mchog 'phel nas/ rje lha mchog seng ge de gnyis ka las rje dkon mchog lhun grub/ mus chen dkon mchog rgya mtsho/ mus chen sangs rgyas rgyal mtshan/ a mi lags sngags 'chang kun dga' bsod nams man 'dra/ yang na 'dren mchog dkon mchog 'phel nas/ rje dkon mchog lhun grub/ mus chen dkon mchog rgya mtsho man 'dra/ yang na tshar chen nas brgyud pa ngag dbang chos grags las/ a mi lags kyis gsan no// yig cha rnams ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams kyis mdzad pa'i sgrub thabs/ dkyil chog mtshams sbyor rnams kyi steng nas thob bo// ༈ /rdo rje slob dpon chen po'i zab mo lus kyi dkyil 'khor du lam dus kyi dbang bskur ba lan du ma'i bar du thob pa'i brgyud pa rgyas pa ni gong gi gsung ngag yongs rdzogs kyi dbang khrid kyi brgyud pa ji lta ba bzhin yin zhing*/ 'dir yang rgyu dbang dang lam dbang gnyis ka'i brgyud pa so sor ma phye bar tshigs su bcad pa'i sgo nas rtogs bde bar brjod na/

thog mtha' med pa'i sangs rgyas rdo rje 'chang*// ma skyes mi 'gag shes rab bdag med ma// stobs bcu'i dbang phyug dpal mgon dmar ser zhes pa me sbrul lo la sau ma pū rir bltams nas rnam 'byung sa 'brug la grub pa brnyes/ bi rū pa// rnal 'byor dbang phyug shar phyogs nag po rgya gar shar phyogs su sku 'khrungs/ pa// rten 'brel zab mo'i don gzigs ḍā ma rgyal rigs yul dbus su sku 'khrungs/ ru// gzung 'dzin kun spangs a wā ra ṇā sīr sku 'khrungs/ wa dhū tī pa// mkhas shing grub pa brnyes pa rat+na gha ya dha ra'i mtshan gyi rnam grangs te bhaṃ ga lar sku 'khrungs/ shrī// sgra bsgyur rgyal po shākya mang mkhar du sku 'khrungs/ ye shes dang*// snyan brgyud gdams pa kun mdog sma che 'gram du sku 'khrungs/ rig rje btsun se// zab don chos kyi snang ba sag thang sdings su sku 'khrungs/ zhang chos 'bar// aṃ bag yod ces pa chu mo glang gi lo dpal sa skya btab nas lo bcu dgu 'das par brom stod kha 'ur/ gir chu sprel lor 'khrungs sa skya pa// rnga chen chu khyi lor 'khrungs yab lnga bcu pa'i dus gzims spyil dkar por/ rje btsun rtse// rab byung me yos de las lngas gzhon pa sgo rum mgon khang mdor/ 'khrungs pa grags pa'i zhabs// dge byed chu stag lor 'khrungs de las sum cu rtsa lngas gzhon pa sgo rum tshogs khang phur/ paṇ+ḍi ta// myos byed shing lug lor 'khrungs de las lnga bcu nga gsum gyis gzhon pa klung khud du/ 'phags pa'i zhabs// kun ldan lcags de las lngas gzhon par ra sa mtshal khud du/ byi lor 'khrungs dkon mchog dpal// dbang phyug me glang lor 'khrungs de las lo so bdun gyis gzhon pa ra sa mtshal khud du/ brag phug pa// yongs 'dzin chu byi lor 'khrungs 'gro mgon rje/

de las so lngas gzhon pa zhwa lu khang gsar du/ ag+ni de las bzhis gzhon pa/ me 'brug lor 'khrungs ri khrod pa// dpal gdong chu bya lor 'khrungs de las bcu bdun gyis gzhon pa 'bras khud sgang skya ru/ dpal ldan pa// myos ldan sa yos de las drug gis gzhon pa mdog gi phur/ lor 'khrungs bud+dha shrī// rnga chen chu khyi lor de las zhe gsum gyis gzhon pa sa skya'i byi khung sgor/ 'khrungs rdo rje 'chang*// rnam byung sa 'brug lor de las drug gis gzhon pa mus stod gling skyar/ 'khrungs mus pa rje// khro bo shing glang lor de las bdun gyis gzhon pa sa skya'i gu rar/ 'khrungs dkon mchog 'phel// dmar ser me sbrul lor de las nga gnyis kyis gzhon pa dpal sa skya'i gnyan bla brang du/ 'khrungs dkon lhun rje// myos byed shing lug lor 'khrungs de las so brgyad kyis gzhon pa sa skya'i mdo brjod bkra shis gling du/ brang ti pa// skyes bdag lcags lug lor 'khrungs de las so drug gis gzhon pa/ sa 'jam dbyangs kun gda' bsod nams lhun grub/ skya pa// gdong ngan me sprel lor 'khrungs de las nyer lngas gzhon pa bzhad kyi khyel du/ sher 'byung gnas// mig dmar shing byi lor 'khrungs de las nyer brgyad kyis gzhon pa shar mi nyag gi yul 'dun par/ lhun grub dpal/ 'gal ba sa glang lor de las nyer lngas gzhon pa mnga' ris smad kyi tre'i 'brog gseb tu/ 'khrungs bud+dha'i mtshan// ag+ni me 'brug lor 'khrungs de las lo nyer bdun gyis gzhon pa yul dar rtse mdor/ tshul lhun zhabs// rnam gnon lcags 'brug lor skyes de las nyer bzhis gzhon pa ldan yul sa dkar du/ bdag la'o// yang na mkhas grub sangs rgyas phun tshogs nas// phur bu sa sprel la de las bcu dgus gzhon pa mdo mkhar chos sder/

'khrungs bkra shis lhun// de yis rjes bzung tshul khrims rin chen de las so gnyis kyis gzhon pa ldan phrug go /no// yang na mkhas grub sangs rgyas phun tshogs nas// shing yos lor de las nyer drug gis gzhon pa mi nyag rab sgang du/ 'khrungs tshul khrims dpal bzang dang*// zhi ba sa bya'i bsod dpal de las drug gis bgres par phyug gzhung spes rgyar/ gnyis kyis gsan// gnyi gas rjes su bzung nas legs stsal ba// sna tshogs chu rta'i dpal ldan chos skyong phyi ma las so gsum gyis gzhon pa gtsang ngor gyi spe'i rong du/ ste// de yis rjes bzung ban+de tshul rin de las gsum gyis bgres pa 'bri klung gser dang ldan ma'i 'gram ngogs sa dkar du/ no// yang na mkhan chen bsod nams dpal ldan nas// dkar po sa sbrul la de las nyi shus gzhon pa gtsang rong gling ma mkhar du/ 'khrungs bsod nams bzang*// de las myos ldan sa yos dpal de las bcus gzhon pa 'bri klung gser ldan ma'i 'gram gyi bya rar/ bzang pa// de las rgyu lam dbang thob tshul rin no// yang na ngor chen yab rdo rje 'chang dang sems dpa' chen po dkon mchog rgyal mtshan/ sras gnyis char las// khro mo shing phyi ma las so drug gis gzhon pa sa skya ru/ 'brug rgyal tshab kun dbang dang*// zhi ba sa bya'i go rams de las lngas gzhon par mdo khams 'bam gyi yul du/ gnyi gas gsan// gnyi ga las thob dkon mchog 'phel de las bcu drug gis gzhon pa/ 'phel ba'o// de las dpal de las brgyad kyis gzhon pa mus stag mo gling skyar/ gdong chu bya sangs rin pa// gnyi gas rjes su bzung ba'i sras kyi mchog /kun 'dzin sa byi lor sangs rgyas rin chen las bco lngas gzhon pa sa skya ru/ 'khrungs lha mchog seng*// gnyi de las nyer dgus gzhon pa/ gas rjes bzung dkon mchog lhun grub dang*// mig dmar shing bya'i sangs rgyas seng ge gnyis/

*/de las bdun gyis gzhon pa/ /gnyi gas rjes bzung mi zad me khyi phyi ma las nyer gnyis kyis gzhon pa sa skya'i gnyan khang gsar du/ ba// dkon mchog dpal ldan pa dang brang ti pa/ */de las dgus gzhon pa/ gnyi gas sa rtar 'khrungs phyi ma las nyer gsum gyis gzhon pa sa skya'i gu ra ru/ pa kun bkras par// de las sgyur byed sa de las zhe gnyis kyis gzhon pa gcan lung mkhas sngar/ phag dpal mchog las// sangs rgyas phun tshogs man chad gong de las lnga bcus gzhon pa/ bzhin no// yang na ngor chen yab sras gnyis ka las// sa byi lor phyi ma las nyi shus gzhon par gtsang chu mig gi bya 'dab grong du/ 'khrungs 'jam dbyangs sher rgyam las// bong bu lcags yos dpal rdor de las gsum gyis gzhon pa dpal sa skyar sku 'khrungs/ man chad 'dra// yang sa skya'i zhal ngo nang brgyud ni/ 'phags pa nas bdag nyid chen po bzang po dpal/ de las bla chen kun dga' rgyal mtshan gyis gsan pa nas/ theg chen chos rje kun dga' bkra shis/ 'jam dbyangs nam mkha' rgyal mtshan/ rgya gar shes rab rgyal mtshan/ sa lo sngags 'chang chen po/ khri chen bsod nams dbang po/ 'jam dbyangs kun dga' bsod nams yab sras gnyis char las/ mkhan chen lhun grub dpal ldan pas gsan no// yang rmor chen rdo rje 'chang chen po'i drung nas lam dus lus dkyil gyi dbang thob pa'i brgyud pa slob bshad ltar na/ ngor chen rdo rje 'chang yan chad sngar bzhin la/ de nas sems dpa' chen po dkon mchog rgyal mtshan/ bdag chen rdo rje 'chang blo gros rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po/ rdo ring pa chen po kun bzang chos kyi nyi ma blo ldan shes rab kun dga' rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po/ tshar chen chos kyi rgyal po blo gsal rgya mtsho grags pa rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po/ 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i dbang phyug bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po/

mkhan chen bslab gsum rgyal mtshan/ rdo rje 'chang dbang phyug rab brtan bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po/ khyab bdag mgon po bsod nams mchog ldan bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po/ mkhan chen rin chen bsod nams mchog grub/ rdo rje 'chang mkhyen rab byams pa ngag dbang lhun grub bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po/ rigs dang dkyil 'khor kun gyi khyab bdag rdo rje sems dpa' ngag dbang kun dga' lhun grub bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po/ des bdag ban+de tshul khrims rin chen can la bka' drin du stsal to// brgyud pa thun mong tsam ni zhang dkon mchog dpal nas/ dga' ldan pa kun bsod/ bla chen kun dga' blo gros/ chos rje bla ma dam pa/ rje dpal ldan tshul khrims/ bud+dha shrī/ ngor chen rdo rje 'chang*/ mus chen sems dpa' chen po/ bdag chen rdo rje 'chang*/ rje btsun sgo rum pa/ 'jam mgon mkhyen brtse man sngar ltar ro// yang na mus chen nas/ kun mkhyen bsod nams seng ge paṇa chen dbang phyug grub pa/ bdag chen ngag gi dbang phyug bdag chen kun dga' bsam 'grub/ 'jam mgon mkhyen brtse man 'dra/ yang na ngor chen las/ mus chen/ rgyal tshab rje/ 'jam dbyangs shes rab rgya mtsho/ paṇa chen grags pa rgyal mtshan/ mkhas grub dpal ldan rdo rje las gsan/ de lnga char las mkhan chen legs pa'i 'byung gnas/ sa lo 'jam dpal rdo rje/ thams cad mkhyen pa dkon mchog lhun grub/ de dbon dkon mchog dpal ldan/ de las shar chen byams pa kun dga' bkra shis dang*/ khri chen kun dga' bsod nams lhun grub gnyis kyis gsan/ de gnyis ka las mkhan chen ngag dbang bstan pa'i rdo rje/ rdo rje 'chang mkhyen rab byams pa ngag dbang lhun grub/ ngag dbang kun dga' lhun grub/ des bdag la'o// ༈ /lam dbang gi skabs su mdzad pa'i he ru ka'i yi ge brgya pa'i bzlas lung thob pa'i brgyud pa ni gong gi lam dbang gi skabs brgyud pa'i 'gros gcig pas des shes shing*/

'dir mkhas grub sangs rgyas phun tshogs pa'i gsan yig tu/ rje nam mkha' sangs rgyas yan gong ltar las/ de nas rje dam chos bsam 'grub/ 'jam dbyangs sangs rgyas phun tshogs/ mkhan chen rdo rje 'chang tshul khrims lhun grub/ des bdag la'o// rje btsun rdo rje bdag med ma'i byin rlabs kyi brgyud pa ni/ shar chen shes rab 'byung gnas yan sngar bzhin las/ de nas mkhan chen lhun grub dpal ldan/ mkhas grub chen po sangs rgyas phun tshogs/ mtshungs med bsod nams dpal ldan/ thams cad mkhyen pa dpal ldan chos skyong*/ des bdag tshul khrims rin chen la'o// lam zab mo bla ma'i rnal 'byor zhal brgyad bcu drug phyag can du bsgom pa'i khrid dang byin rlabs bcas thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rdo rje 'chang*/ rnal 'byor dbang phyug bir+wa pa/ sa skya pa chen po/ slob dpon rin po che bsod nams rtse mo/ rje btsun rin po che grags pa rgyal mtshan/ chos rje sa skya paṇ+ḍi ta/ tshogs sgom kun dga' dpal/ nyan chen bsod nams brtan pa/ brag phug pa bsod nams dpal/ de las ri khrod pa blo gros brtan pa dang bla ma dam pa gnyis kyis gsan/ de gnyis ka las bla ma dpal ldan tshul khrims/ de las shar pa ye shes rgyal mtshan dang grub chen bud+dha shrī gnyis kyis gsan/ de gnyis ka las ngor chen rdo rje 'chang kun dga' bzang pos gsan/ de las sems dpa' chen po/ de gnyis ka las rgyal tshab dam pa kun dbang dang kun mkhyen bsod nams seng ge gnyis kyis gsan/ phyi ma gsum char las rje dkon mchog 'phel gyis gsan/ sems dpa' chen po las grub chen dkon mchog blo gros kyis gsan/ sems dpa' chen po dang*/ kun mkhyen dang*/ grub chen gsum char las sangs rgyas rin chen pas gsan/ phyi ma las rje dkon mchog 'phel dang sangs rgyas rin chen gnyis kyis gsan/ de gnyis ka las sa lo tsā ba dang*/ lha mchog pa dang dkon mchog lhun grub gsum gyis gsan/

sa lo tsā ba las rje dkon mchog lhun grub kyis gsan/ rje lha mchog pa dang dkon mchog lhun grub gnyis char las/ rje sangs rgyas seng ge dang shar khang pa gnyis kas gsan/ dkon mchog lhun grub dang*/ sangs rgyas seng ge dang shar khang pa gsum ga las rje brang ti nam mkha' dpal bzang pas gsan/ de nas rtse gdong khri chen kun dga' bsod nams lhun grub dang mkhas grub dpal ldan don grub gnyis kyis gsan/ de gnyis ka las rje dpal mchog rgyal mtshan gyis gsan/ de las mkhas grub sangs rgyas phun tshogs kyis gsan/ de las thams cad mkhyen pa tshul khrims lhun grub kyis gsan/ de las bdag ban+de tshul khrims rin chen gyis so// yang na 'jam dbyangs kun dga' bsod nams lhun grub las/ rje dkon mchog dpal ldan/ rje nam mkha' dpal bzang*/ rje byams pa rab brtan/ 'jam dbyangs bsod nams dbang po dang bzhis gsan/ rje nam mkha' dpal bzang las/ shar chen byams pa kun dga' bkra shis kyis gsan/ rtse gdong khri chen dang byams pa kun dga' bkra shis gnyis las/ shar chen shes rab 'byung gnas kyis gsan/ de las rje dam chos bsam 'grub pas gsan/ de las mkhan grub chen po sangs rgyas phun tshogs kyis gsan/ de las mkhan chen rdo rje 'chang tshul khrims lhun grub kyis gsan/ de las bdag ban+de tshul khrims rin chen gyis lan gsum bar du legs par nos so// yang na mkhas grub sangs rgyas phun tshogs nas/ 'jam mgon bkra shis lhun grub/ de las bdag tshul khrims rin chen gyis so// yang na sangs rgyas phun tshogs nas/ shes bya bzang po dang rje bsod nams dpal ldan gnyis kyis gsan/ de gnyi ga las 'jam mgon bkra shis lhun grub/ des bdag la'o// yang na sangs rgyas phun tshogs nas/ byams pa tshul khrims dpal bzang dang*/ mtshungs med bsod nams dpal ldan gnyis kyis gsan/ de gnyis ka las byams pa bsod nams bzang po dang*/ thams cad mkhyen pa dpal ldan chos skyong gnyis kyis gsan/

phyi ma de las bdag gis thob bo// yang na rje bsod nams bzang po dang bkra shis lhun grub gnyis ka las/ mkhan chen 'jam pa'i dbyangs sangs rgyas dpal bzang*/ de las bdag tshul khrims rin chen gyis legs par thob bo// lam zab mo bla ma'i rnal 'byor nang ma'i byin rlabs thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ sangs rgyas rdo rje 'chang*/ rnal 'byor dbang phyug bir+wa pa/ rje sa skya pa chen po/ slob dpon bsod nams rtse mo/ rje btsun grags pa rgyal mtshan/ chos rje sa skya paṇ+ḍi ta/ tshogs sgom pa/ nyan chen pa/ na bza' brag phug pa/ chos rje bla ma dam pa/ bla ma dpal ldan tshul khrims/ grub chen bud+dha shrī/ rdo rje 'chang kun dga' bzang po/ mus chen dkon mchog rgyal mtshan/ 'jam dbyangs shes rab rgya mtsho/ rgyal tshab kun dga' dbang phyug mkhas grub dpal ldan rdo rje/ kun mkhyen bsod nams seng ge lnga kas rjes su bzung ba 'dren mchog dkon mchog 'phel/ sa lo tsā ba/ rje dkon mchog lhun grub/ mus chen dkon mchog rgya mtsho/ mus chen sangs rgyas rgyal mtshan/ sa skya pa zhabs drung a mi lags/ bdag chen bsod nams dbang phyug mkhan chen lhun grub dpal ldan pa/ mkhas grub sangs rgyas phun tshogs/ mtshungs med bstan 'dzin lhun grub/ 'jam dbyangs bkra shis lhun grub grags pa'i rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po/ des bdag tshul khrims rin chen la stsal to// yang na 'jam mgon bkra shis lhun grub nas/ rdo rje 'chang dpal ldan chos skyong dang 'jam dbyangs sangs rgyas dpal bzang gnyis kyis gsan/ de gnyis ka las bdag tshul khrims rin chen gyis legs par thob bo// bla ma don yod grub pa la brten pa'i bla ma'i rnal 'byor tshar gsum khug pa'i byin rlabs zab mo thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ rdo rje 'chang*/ bdag med ma/ dpal bir+wa pa/ grub chen kah+ṇa pa/ rje btsun ḍā ma ru pa/ gnyis spangs zhabs/ paṇa chen ga ya dha ra/ lo chen/ 'brog mi/ mnga' ris pa gsal ba'i snying po/

'khon sgyi chu ba dgra lha 'bar/ rje btsun brtse ba chen po/ slob dpon rin po che/ rje btsun rin po che/ sa skya paṇ+ḍi ta/ lung phu ba nam mkha' bsod nams/ bkras lung pa/ mkhas grub gzhon nu don grub/ zhang ston byang chub shes rab/ chos rje bla ma dam pa/ bla ma dpal ldan tshul khrims/ grub chen bud+dha shrī/ chos kyi rje ngor chen rdo rje 'chang*/ mus chen sems dpa' chen po/ rgyal tshab kun dbang pa/ kun mkhyen bsod nams seng ge 'dren mchog rat+na war+dha/ thams cad mkhyen pa dkon mchog lhun grub/ shar khang pa pradzñā'i mtshan can/ thar rtse paṇa chen nam mkha' dpal bzang*/ rtse gdong khri chen kun dga' bsod nams lhun grub/ bco brgyad pa mkhyen rab bstan 'dzin/ de dbon byams pa ngag dbang lhun grub/ sprul sku rin po che pad+ma phrin las/ mkhas grub chen po sangs rgyas phun tshogs/ de nas bla ma gzhan yod dam mus pa'i dge bshes tshul khrims kyis gsan pa yin nam brtag drin chen rdo rje 'chang chen po tshul khrims lhun grub/ de las bdag ban+de tshul khrims rin chen gyis mnos so// yang na rje btsun grags pa rgyal mtshan nas/ dbang phyug 'od zer/ mkhan po rong pa/ lung phu ba man 'dra/ yang na sa skya paṇ+ḍi ta nas/ tshogs sgom pa/ nyan chen pa/ zhang dkon mchog dpal/ rgyal ba brag phug pa/ bla ma dam pa bsod nams rgyal mtshan/ ri khrod pa blo gros brtan pa/ bla ma dpal ldan tshul khrims man 'dra'o// bla ma rin chen 'byung ldan gyi byin rlabs zab mo thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ lo chen 'brog mi yan snga ma rnams dang 'dra ba las/ de nas mnga' ris pa gsal ba'i snying po/ 'khon sgyi chu ba/ sa skya'i rje btsun gong ma gsum/ sa skya paṇ+ḍi ta/ lung phu ba/ bkras lung pa/ mkhas grub gzhon nu don grub/ zhang ston byang she bla ma dam pa bsod nams rgyal mtshan/ dpal ldan tshul khrims/ ngor chen rdo rje 'chang*/ gung ru shes rab bzang po/ mkhyen rab rje/

lo pa ngag dbang chos grags/ bco brgyad pa mchog legs rdo rje/ mkhyen rab bstan 'dzin bzang po/ de dbon byams pa ngag dbang lhun grub/ sprul sku rin po che pad+ma phrin las/ 'jam pa'i dbyangs sangs rgyas phun tshogs/ mtshungs med bstan 'dzin lhun grub/ mkhan chen rdo rje 'chang bkra shis lhun grub/ des bdag tshul rin la'o// yang slob bshad pa las brgyud pa'i lugs ltar na/ ngor chen rdo rje 'chang yan chad sngar bzhin las/ de nas sems dpa' chen po/ bdag chen rdo rje 'chang*/ rje rdo ring pa/ tshar chen chos kyi rgyal po/ 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i dbang phyug mkhan chen bslab gsum pa/ rdo rje 'chang dbang rab pa/ mgon po bsod nams mchog ldan/ rin chen bsod nams mchog grub/ byams pa ngag dbang lhun grub/ sprul sku pad+ma phrin las/ 'jam dbyangs sangs rgyas phun tshogs man 'dra'o// bir srung thun mong ba'i byin rlabs thob pa'i brgyud pa rtse gdong khri chen dang byams pa kun dga' bkra shis gnyis yan chad ni lam zab zhal brgyad bcu drug phyag can pa'i byin rlabs kyi brgyud pa dang 'dra ba las/ de gnyis ka las shar chen shes rab 'byung gnas kyis gsan/ de las rim par rje dam chos bsam 'grub/ mkhas grub sangs rgyas phun tshogs/ thams cad mkhyen pa rdo rje 'chang tshul khrims lhun grub bkra shis grags pa'i rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po/ de las bdag ban+de tshul khrims rin chen gyis lan gsum gyi bar du mnos so// yang na rje sangs rgyas phun tshogs nas/ 'jam mgon bkra shis lhun grub/ des bdag la'o// yang na rje sangs rgyas phun tshogs nas/ shar chen sangs rgyas bstan 'dzin/ rje bkra shis lhun grub/ des bdag la'o// yang na sangs rgyas phun tshogs nas/ mtshungs med bsod nams dpal ldan/ mkhan chen byams pa bsod nams bzang po/ mkhan chen 'jam dbyangs sangs rgyas dpal bzang*/ des bdag la'o// yang na rje nam mkha' dpal bzang pa yan lam zab bla ma'i rnal 'byor gyi byin rlabs dang 'dra/

de nas 'jam dbyangs kun dga' bsod nams lhun grub dang mkhas grub dpal ldan don grub gnyis kyis gsan/ de gnyis ka las rje dpal mchog rgyal mtshan/ de las 'jam dbyangs sangs rgyas phun tshogs man gong bzhin no// bir srung thun mong ma yin pa'i byin rlabs man ngag dang bcas pa'i brgyud pa ni/ rdo rje 'chang kun dga' bzang po/ mus chen/ kun dbang pa/ 'dren mchog sa skya lo tsā ba/ rje dkon mchog lhun grub/ rdo rje 'chang sangs rgyas seng ge paṇa chen nam mkha' dpal bzang*/ 'di nas brgyud rim gyis tshul gang yin gyi bla ma 'ga' zhig btsal dgos pa yod/ de nas mus pa'i dge bshes tshul khrims/ mkhan chen rdo rje 'chang tshul khrims lhun grub/ des bdag ban+de tshul khrims rin chen la stsal to// yang na mkhan chen dpal ldan chos skyong pa'i gsan yig ltar yan chad btsal/ de nas mkhan chen rdo rje 'chang ba chen po dpal ldan chos skyong*/ des bdag tshul khrims rin chen la'o// yang na 'dren mchog rje lha mchog seng ge rdo rje 'chang bud+dha singha man 'dra'o// yang na mus chen/ grub chen dkon blo/ rje sangs rgyas rin chen/ sa skya lo tsā ba man 'dra/ yang na rgyal tshab kun dbang*/ mkhan chen legs 'byung*/ sa skya lo tsā ba/ rje dkon mchog lhun grub/ rdo rje 'chang bud+dha singha man 'dra'o// ༈ /gsung ngag rin po che lam 'bras bu dang bcas pa'i don thams cad bsdus pa brda don gsal ba byin rlabs khrid tho gnad zab mo du ma dang bcas pa thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ sangs rgyas rdo rje 'chang*/ dpal bi rū pa/ rje sa skya pa chen po/ rje btsun rin po che grags pa/ chos kyi rje sa paṇ+ḍi ta/ bla ma lung phu ba nam mkha' bsod nams/ bkras lung pa/ mkhas btsun gzhon nu grub/ dga' ldan pa kun dga' bsod nams/ rgyal ba brag phug pa/ de las bla ma dam pa dang blo gros brtan pa gnyis kyis gsan pas de gnyis gang rung*/ gnyis kas rjes su bzung ba bla ma dpal ldan tshul khrims/

grub chen bud+dha shrī/ ngor chen rdo rje 'chang kun dga' bzang po/ mus chen dkon mchog rgyal mtshan/ gnyis kas rjes su bzung ba rgyal tshab kun dbang*/ de nas yongs 'dzin dkon mchog 'phel/ sa lo thams cad mkhyen pa/ thams cad mkhyen pa dkon mchog lhun grub/ sngags 'chang ngag dbang kun rin/ khri chen bsod nams dbang po/ sngags 'chang thams cad mkhyen pa kun dga' bsod nams/ de sras 'jam dbyangs bsod nams dbang phyug mkhan chen lhun grub dpal ldan/ bstan pa'i sgron me sangs rgyas phun tshogs/ rigs kun khyab bdag mkhan chen bkra shis lhun grub/ des bdag tshul khrims rin chen la'o// yang na dkon mchog lhun grub nas/ mus chen dkon mchog rgya mtsho/ mus chen sangs rgyas rgyal mtshan/ khri chen kun dga' bsod nams/ 'jam dbyangs bsod nams dbang phyug man sngar bzhin no// yang na rgyal tshab kun dbang nas/ kun mkhyen go rams pa/ rje sangs rgyas rin chen/ sa lo tsā ba man 'dra/ yang na sa paṇa nas/ 'phags pa rin po che/ zhang dkon mchog dpal/ rgyal ba brag phug pa man 'dra'o// brda chig brgyud kyi man ngag byin rlabs kyi brgyud pa ni/ chos rje bla ma dam pa yan gong dang 'dra/ de nas ri khrod pa blo gros brtan pa/ bla ma dpal ldan tshul khrims/ grub chen bud+dha shrī/ ngor chen rdo rje 'chang kun dga' bzang po/ rje sems dpa' chen po dkon mchog rgyal mtshan/ kun mkhyen bsod nams seng ge rje sangs rgyas rin chen/ 'jam dbyangs dkon mchog lhun grub/ rdo rje 'chang sangs rgyas seng ge paṇa chen nam mkha' dpal bzang la sogs pa nas rim par btsal/ de nas mtshungs med bstan 'dzin lhun grub yin nam/ de nas mkhan chen rdo rje 'chang dpal ldan chos skyong bkra shis grags pa'i rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po/ des bdag tshul khrims rin chen du bod pa la'o// yang na ngor chen/ rgyal tshab kun dbang*/ 'dren mchog dkon mchog 'phel/ 'jam dbyangs sa skya lo tsā ba/

rje dkon mchog lhun grub/ rje sangs rgyas seng ge des bdag la'o// yang na ngor chen/ kun dbang*/ 'dren mchog rgyal ba lha mchog seng ge rdo rje 'chang bud+dha singha*/ des bdag la'o// lam sbas bshad kyi byin rlabs kyi brgyud pa ni/ sa paṇa yan nye brgyud ltar la/ de nas tshogs sgom pa/ nyan chen pa/ brag phug pa/ bla ma dam pa/ ri khrod pa blo brtan/ gnyis ka las dpal tshul ba/ bud+dha shrī/ ngor chen/ rgyal tshab pa/ dkon mchog 'phel/ sa lo/ dkon mchog lhun grub/ dkon mchog rgya mtsho/ mus chen sangs rgyas rgyal mtshan man brda don gsal ba'i ngor lugs bzhin no// rdo rje rnam par 'joms

'di de sngon ma thob kyang thob 'gyur gyis bris/ pa bir+wa pa'i lugs kyi dbang bzhi byin rlabs kyi tshul du legs par nos pa'i brgyud pa ni/ rdo rje rnam par 'joms pa/ rnal 'byor dbang phyug dpal ldan chos skyong*/ dpal sa skya pa chen po/ rje bsod nams rtse mo/ rje btsun grags pa/ 'jam dbyangs sa paṇ+ḍi ta/ skyo ston dri med/ zhang dkon mchog 'phel/ dga' ldan pa kun bsod/ gan pa rin rgyal/ chos rje bsod nams rgyal mtshan/ dpal tshul ba/ shar chen ye shes rgyal mtshan/ ngor chen rdo rje 'chang*/ mus chen sems dpa' chen po/ kun mkhyen bsod nams seng ge rje sangs rgyas rin chen/ 'jam dbyangs dkon mchog lhun grub/ rje dkon mchog rgya mtsho/ mus chen sangs rgyas rgyal mtshan/ sa skya pa khri chen kun dga' bsod nams/ rje dkon mchog dpal 'byor/ sprul sku rin po che pad+ma phrin las/ mkhas grub chen po sangs rgyas phun tshogs/ mtshungs med bstan 'dzin lhun grub yin nam brtag thams cad mkhyen pa dpal ldan chos skyong*/ des bdag ban+de tshul khrims rin chen la stsal to// sgrub pa lung sbyin gyi byin rlabs zab mo thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ ngor chen nas rgyal tshab kun dbang*/ 'dren mchog dkon mchog 'phel/ sa skya lo tsā ba/ dkon mchog lhun grub/ spyan snga dkon mchog rgya mtsho/ mus chen sangs rgyas rgyal mtshan/ sa skya pa ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams/ gling stod zhabs drung dkon mchog dpal 'byor/ sprul sku rin po che man 'dra/ yang na 'dren mchog rgyal ba lha mchog pa/ rdo rje 'chang bud+dha singha man 'dra/ yang na rgyal tshab kun dbang*/ kun mkhyen go rams pa/ rje sangs rgyas rin chen/ sa lo tsā ba/ rje dkon mchog lhun grub man 'dra'o// rje btsun chen pos gzhung ji lta ba bzhin bkri ba'i khrid yig tu/ lus sbyong rgyas bsdus ji rigs pas lus 'byong 'byong bya'o// zhes gsungs pa'i lus sbyong bsdus pa ni yan lag lnga'i sbyong ba dang*/

rgyas pa ni lung sbyong nyi shu pa ste de'i gsal byed mdud 'grol lam 'bras pa nor bzang gis zin bris mdzad pa dang*/ 'khrul 'khor gyi dngos gzhi rje btsun rin po che grags pa rgyal mtshan gyis mdzad pa'i rnal 'byor gyi phrin las sum cu rtsa gnyis kyi yi ge dang*/ de dag gi gsal byed bla ma phyi rabs pa'i zin bris las 'byung tshul bshad pa/ snyigs dus bstan pa'i nyi ma sngags 'chang chos kyi rgyal po'i gsung rgyun zin bris las 'byung tshul bshad pa/ gzhan yang mkhas pa gzhan gyi gsung rab las 'byung tshul bshad pa gsum gyi sgo nas gsal bar bshad pa'i lam 'bras 'khrul 'khor rnams kyi lag len rnal 'byor kun dga' zhes bya ba sa skya pa ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams kyis mdzad pa'i yi ge'i steng nas/ lus sbyong rgyas bsdus dang phrin las sum cu rtsa gnyis kyi 'khrul 'khor rnams kyi lag len gyi khrid rgyug 'bul dang bcas pa ste legs par thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ ngor chen rdo rje 'chang yan lam 'bras khrid kyi brgyud pa dang 'dra zhing*/ de nas mus chen dkon mchog rgyal mtshan/ rgyal tshab kun dga' dbang phyug mkhas grub dpal ldan rdo rje/ kun mkhyen bsod nams seng ge yongs 'dzin dkon mchog 'phel ba/ de las rje btsun sangs rgyas rin chen dang*/ sa lo 'jam dpal rdo rje/ thams cad mkhyen pa dkon mchog lhun grub gsum gas gsan/ phyi ma gnyis las sngags 'chang ngag dbang kun dga' rin chen gyis gsan pa nas/ rim par 'jam dbyangs bsod nams dbang po/ sngags 'chang grags pa blo gros/ mus chen sangs rgyas rgyal mtshan/ de gsum ga las 'jam dbyangs kun dga' bsod nams kyis gsan/ de nas 'jam dbyangs bsod nams dbang phyug sngags 'chang ngag dbang kun dga' bkra shis/ e waṃ pa mkhan chen tshul khrims dpal bzang*/ mtshungs med bstan 'dzin lhun grub/ mi nyag mkhas btsun sangs rgyas tshul khrims/ des bdag ban+de tshul khrims rin chen la'o// yang na sems dpa' chen po dkon mchog rgyal mtshan yan gong bzhin las/

de nas bdag chen rdo rje 'chang blo gros rgyal mtshan/ rje btsun rdo ring pa chen po/ tshar chen chos kyi rgyal po/ 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i dbang phyug mkhan chen bslab gsum rgyal mtshan/ rdo rje 'chang dbang phyug rab brtan/ sa skya pa ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams man 'dra/ yang na mkhyen brtse'i dbang phyug nas/ sngags 'chang bsod nams chos 'phel/ mkhan chen ngag dbang chos grags/ rje dbang phyug rab brtan/ ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams man 'dra'o// zhabs drung kun dga' bsod nams kyis mdzad pa'i yi ge'i lung gi brgyud pa ni rje tshul khrims dpal bzang pa yan 'dra/ de nas mtshungs med bstan 'dzin lhun grub/ thams cad mkhyen pa dpal ldan chos skyong*/ des bdag la'o// lam 'bras kyi bstan pa gtad pa'i tshul du mgon rkyang gi rjes gnang thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ ngor chen rdo rje 'chang yan chad lam 'bras dang 'dra zhing*/ de nas rgyal tshab kun dga' dbang phyug kun mkhyen bsod nams seng ge mus chen sangs rgyas rin chen/ rgyal ba lha mchog seng ge de gnyis ka las thams cad mkhyen pa dkon mchog lhun grub/ mus chen dkon mchog rgya mtsho/ mus chen sangs rgyas rgyal mtshan/ zhabs drung sngags 'chang kun dga' bsod nams/ bdag chen bsod nams dbang phyug mkhan chen lhun grub dpal ldan/ mkhas grub sangs rgyas phun tshogs/ rdo rje 'chang kun dga' bstan 'dzin/ mkhan chen 'jam pa'i dbyangs sangs rgyas dpal bzang*/ des bdag tshul rin la'o// yang na mkhan chen sangs rgyas phun tshogs nas/ mtshungs med bstan 'dzin lhun grub yin nam/ mkhan chen dpal ldan chos skyong*/ des bdag la'o// yang na rgyal tshab pa dang kun mkhyen gnyis ka las rje sangs rin dang rat+na war+dha gnyis kyis gsan/ de gnyis las sa lo thams cad mkhyen pa/ de gsum char las dkon mchog lhun grub man 'dra'o// yang na ngor chen rdo rje 'chang*/ mus chen sems dpa' chen po/ chos rje blo gros rin chen/

bdag chen rdo rje 'chang*/ rje btsun rdo ring pa/ tshar chen rdo rje 'chang*/ mang thos klu sgrub rgya mtsho/ rje ngag dbang chos grags/ zhabs drung a mi lags man 'dra'o// 'di'i rjes gnang gi yi ge kun mkhyen gyis mdzad pa ltar dang*/ rjes gnang gi tshe thun mong ma yin pa'i gsol gdab mdzad cing*/ zhabs g.yas brkyang can du mdzad/ thugs la rigs 'dra bstim nas lta ba ngo sprod mnyam par gzhag gzhan dkyus bzhin no// 'dir gsang bcu'i rgyas gdab ni ma thos so// ༈ /bla ma 'brog mis chos rnams rdzogs pa'i mthar bi kra ma shī la'i mkhas pa sgo drug las chos 'brel du gsan pa'i sgo drug chos 'brel du grags pa/ shān+ti pa'i mdo rgyud bsre ba shes rab 'byung gnas sbas pa'i gdon gyi bar chad sel ba/ dzñā na shrī'i 'byung ba lus 'khrugs/ rin chen rdo rjes sems kyi bar chad sel ba/ nā ro pa'i phyag rgya chen po sdug bsngal gsum sel/ ngag dbang grags pa'i gnyug ma dran gsal te drug las/ de dag gi brgyud pa ni shān+ti pa/ dzñā na shrī/ shes rab 'byung gnas sbas pa/ rin chen rdo rje/ ngag dbang grags pa/ jo bo nā ro pa drug las 'brog mis gsan/ de nas bar chad gsum sel gdon sel ba 'byung ba lus 'khrugs sems kyi bar chad sel ba gsum/ gyi brgyud pa sgom chen se reg gnyis/ des gnyos yer pa sgom seng*/ grub thob lha 'bar/ kha reg bsgom pa/ lung phu ba/ bkras lung pa/ mkhas grub gzhon nu grub/ byang chub shes rab/ chos rje bla ma dam pa bsod nams rgyal mtshan/ dpal ldan tshul khrims/ de las shar chen ye shes rgyal mtshan dang bud+dha shrī gnyis kyis gsan/ de gnyis ka las ngor chen rdo rje 'chang kun dga' bzang po/ gnyug ma dran gsal gyi brgyud pa ni/ rje btsun sgrol ma/ ngag dbang grags pa/ 'brog mi lo tsā ba/ 'khon dkon mchog rgyal po/ bla ma shangs pa/ sa chen/ rje btsun rin po che grags pa/

lung phu ba/ bkras lung pa/ zhar byang chub shes rab/ bla ma dam pa/ dpal ldan tshul khrims/ de las shar chen dang bud+dha shrī/ gnyis ka las ngor chen rdo rje 'chang*/ nā ro pa'i sdug bsngal gsum sel gyi brgyud pa ni/ nā ro pa/ 'brog mi/ mnga' ris pa gsal ba'i snying po/ 'khon sgyi chu ba/ sa skya pa chen po/ rje btsun rin po che/ lung phu ba/ bkras lung pa/ mkhas grub pa/ zhang byang she/ bla ma dam pa/ bla ma dpal ldan tshul khrims/ shar chen bud+dha shrī/ ngor chen rdo rje 'chang*/ mdo rgyud bsre ba'i brgyud pa ni/ shān+ti pa/ 'brog mi/ se ston/ zhang dgon pa ba/ bla ma sa skya pa chen po/ rje btsun rin po che grags pa/ lung phu pa/ bkras lung pa/ gzhon nu grub/ byang she/ chos rje bla ma dam pa/ bla ma dpal ldan tshul khrims/ bud+dha shrī/ ngor chen rdo rje 'chang*/ de man cha da gong gi brda don gsal ba ltar so sor phyin pas chog go/ ༈ /rje ngor chen gyis lam 'bras la sogs lam skor dgu zhes pa'i gdams pa paṇa grub brgyad kyis mdzad pa lam skor brgyad dang chos kyi rnam grangs dgu yod pas lam skor dgur yang grags pa bla chen 'brog mi la bka' babs pa'i chos skor la/ dpal ldan tog tse pas sam+pu ṭa la brten nas bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i gdams pa mdzad/ de nyams su len pa la bsam mi khyab lnga'am byin rlabs kyi brgyud pa ni/ rdo rje 'chang*/ rta mchog zhabs/ mda' chen zer/ pi na pā da/ 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i gsan yig na 'di ltar 'dug kyang rdo rje gdan pa'i gsan yig na bi na pa ti dang thar rtse ba'i der pī na pa zhes pi waṃ 'dzin pa yin zhes snang ngo*/ /rgyal po in+d+ra bhū ti/ leg+mi pā da/ thar rtse ba'i der phun tshogs zhes bsgyur 'dug cing lcam lak+ṣ+mī ka ra zhes sangs rgyas phun tshogs pa'i der byung gzhan du zur chag 'di bzhin 'dug lī la badz+ra gun+dha ri pa/ rdo rje gdan pa dang thar rtse ba'i der sgeg pa'i rdo rjer bsgyur/

pad+ma badz+ra/ dhar+m+mā pa/ gong dkar ba dang thar rtse ba'i der chos kyi pha zer ba 'dug bha dra pā da/ gong dkar ba dang thar rtse ba'i der bzang po'i zhabs su bsgyur 'dug grub chen tog tse pa/ sta mo'am 'jor 'dzin pa'i don/ bhu ṣa ṇa pa/ gong dkar ba'i der ghu sha na 'dug dha ma pa/ gong dkar ba'i der pad+ma pa zer/ kah+na pa/ gong dkar ba'i der kar+ṇa zer/ bī ra badz+ra/ 'brog mi lo chen/ rdo rje gdan pa'i der ga ya dha ra la yang bod du gsan zer/ se ston kun rig zhang dgon pa ba/ brtse ba chen po/ slob dpon rin po che/ rje btsun rin po che/ sa skya paṇ+ḍi ta/ chos rgyal 'phags pa/ zhang dkon mchog dpal/ na bza' brag phug pa/ chos rje bla ma dam pa dang ri khrod pa gang rung*/ bla ma dpal ldan tshul khrims/ grub chen bud+dha shrī/ ngor chen kun dga' bzang po/ mus chen dkon mchog rgyal mtshan/ zhwa lu pa chos rje sangs rgyas dpal bzang*/ mus chen nam mkha' dpal bzang*/ ngor chen dkon mchog lhun grub/ mtshungs med dkon mchog dpal ldan/ byams pa kun dga' bkra shis/ mkhas grub dpal ldan don grub/ rje dpal mchog rgyal mtshan/ mkhas grub sangs rgyas phun tshogs/ rdo rje 'chang tshul khrims lhun grub/ des bdag tshul khrims rin chen la'o// yang na rje dkon mchog lhun grub/ 'jam dbyangs sangs rgyas seng ge paṇa chen nam mkha' dpal bzang*/ rtse gdong bdag chen kun dga' bsod nams lhun grub/ rje nam mkha' sangs rgyas/ de gnyis ka las rje dpal mchog man 'dra/ yang na rje rdo rje 'chang*/ mkhas mchog kun dga' blo gros/ mkhas btsun dpal ldan rgyal po/ mus chen nam mkha' dpal bzang*/ rje dkon mchog lhun grub man 'dra'o// ༈ /paṇ+ḍi ta ngag gi dbang phyug grags pas dpal gsang ba 'dus pa'i rgyud dang brtag pa gnyis pa'i dgongs pa dang rje btsun ma sgrol ma'i gsung la brten nas yan lag bdun pa dang bzhi pa snang bar byed pa la sogs pa'i bstan bcos mdzad pa'i lam nyams

ḍom+bi he ru ka'i bdag med ma'i sgrub thabs bdud rtsi 'od kyi snying po nyams su len pa'i ched du'ang yin/ su len pa la phyag rgya chen po yi ge med pa'i gdams pa las byung ba'i byin rlabs dang de'i gsal byed rje btsun chen po grags pas dge slong blo gros brtan pa'i don du mdzad pa nos pa'i brgyud pa ni/ rdo rje 'chang*/ rje btsun sgrol ma/ paṇa grub ngag gi dbang phyug grags pa/ de wā ka ra tsan+d+ra/ de gnyis ka las jo bo a mo gha badz+ras gsan/ de las bla chen 'brog mis gsan pa man gong ltar ro// dpal mgon 'phags pa klu sgrub kyis gsang ba 'dus pa la brten nas byang chub sems 'grel mdzad/ de nyams su len pa la mchod rten gyi drung du sems thag bcad pa'i gdams pa'i gsal byed rje btsun chen po grags pas mdzad pa'i brgyud pa ni/ rdo rje 'chang*/ phyag na rdo rje/ bram ze sa ra ha/ 'phags pa klu sgrub/ slob dpon ār+ya de wa/ dge slong nag po'i zhabs/ slob dpon tsan+d+ra kīrti/ rdo rje gdan pa dang thar rtse pa'i gsan yig na zla ba grags pa zhes bsgyur/ bram ze dpal 'dzin/ dpa' bo rdo rje/ gong dkar ba'i gsan yig na ga ya dha ra zer ba 'dug pa bla chen gyis rgya gar du dpa' bo rdo rje dang bod du ga ya dha ra las gsan pa'i khungs mdzad 'dug 'brog mi man gong bzhin no// slob dpon nag po spyod pas sam+pu ṭa dang sdom 'byung la sogs pa bde mchog gi rgyud la brten nas nag po pa'i chos drug mdzad/ de dag gi nang nas o la pa ti mngon par rtogs pa'i sdom gyi nyams len gsal byed rje btsun chen po grags pas mdzad pa'i gtum mo lam rdzogs kyi brgyud pa ni/ yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rdo rje 'chang*/ rdo rje rnal 'byor ma/ rdo rje dril bu pa/ kur+m+mā pā da/ thar rtse pa'i der rus sbal zhabs su bsgyur/ dza lan+dha ra/ rdo rje gdan pa'i der 'dis rdo rje rnal 'byor mar gsan zhes snang*/

kah+na pa/ thar rtse ba'i der nag po spyod pa ro la zhon pa zhes byung*/ bram ze dpal 'dzin/ paṇ+ḍi ta ga ya dha ra/ 'brog mi lo tsā ba man gong dang 'dra'o// slob dpon u tsi ta 'chi ba med pas dpyid kyi thig le'i rtsa ba'i sdom nyams su len pa la yon po bsrang ba 'khor ba lu gu rgyud du gcod pa'i gdams pa nag po pa'i gsung bzhin rje btsun chen pos mdzad pa'i brgyud pa ni/ rgyal ba rdo rje 'chang chen po/ lha dbang phyug chen po/ nag po 'chi ba med pa/ u tsi ta/ grub chen nag po spyod pa/ slob dpon dpal 'dzin/ sangs rgyas phun tshogs pa'i der bram ze rin chen zhes byung*/ paṇ+ḍi ta ga ya dha ra/ 'brog mi lo tsā ba man sngar dang 'dra'o// mi dbang in+d+ra bhū tis rnal 'byor bla na med pa'i rgyud sde mtha' dag la brten nas dbang yon tan gyi rim pa mdzad/ de nyams su len pa la phyag rgya bzhi rdzogs kyi lam ma gor/ lhas byin gyis ni rta byas la/ zhes pa dang*/ lo rgyus dang bcas pa bstan zin to'i mtha' can rgya gzhung ma'i brgyud pa ni/ dang po dpal sde'i zhal snga nas// de bzhin du yang tshangs pa dang*// bram ze mo ni rdo rje grub// shrī badz+ra rdo rje rgyal// de yi slob dpon de'i phyi ma// gos bral zhal snga de bzhin no// dpal ldan dzñā na bo dhi rgyal// de bzhin shrī yo bo dhi dang*// slob dpon pad+ma badz+ra dang*// ḍom+bi zhal snga de bzhin no// yan lag bar pa dpal lha mo// bung ba'i pad+ma de bzhin no// dur khrod du na kī lar bzhugs// lha lcam legs smin de bzhin no// bdag kyang dang po grub pa yin// zhes pa ltar/ kun mkhyen rdo rje 'chang chen po/ in+d+ra bhū ti che ba/

rje mkhyen brtse'i gsan yig na dpal bde ba zhes byung ba tshigs bcad ltar na dpal bde ba dang in+d+ra bhū ti che ba gnyis gcig pa 'dra/ brah+ma pā da/ tshangs pa'i zhabs zhes bsgyur/ bram ze mo grub pa'i rdo rje/ rgyal po in+d+ra bhū ti bar pa/ slob dpon u pa ma'i zhabs/ ni ut+ta pā da/ rdo rje gdan pa'i gsan yig na slob dpon gong bral zhabs zhes 'dug pa 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i gsan yig rgya skad ma dang mthun yang thar rtse pa'i der gcer bu'i mchan dang bcas gos bral du bshad 'dug pa dpyad/ rgyal po dzñā na bhū ti/ shrī yo bhū ti/ slob dpon pad+ma badz+ra/ ḍom+bi he ru ka a naṅga an+tar+bha/ rdo rje gdan pa dang thar rtse pa'i der yan lag bar ma'i zhabs zhes bsgyur/ lha mo bung ba'i pad+ma/ lcam lak+ṣ+mī/ thar rtse pa'i gsan yig tu legs smin zhes zur chag 'dug rgyal po in+d+ra bhū ti chung ba/ bram ze rat+na badz+ra/ kha che shes rab gsang ba'am/ a tsār+ya dmar por grags pa/ 'brog mi lo tsā ba man sngar dang 'dra'o// nye brgyud ni/ sangs rgyas rdo rje 'chang*/ in+d+ra bhū ti che ba/ lcam legs smin/ paṇa chen shes rab gsang ba man 'dra'o// slob dpon pad+ma badz+ra gyis rdo rje gur la brten nas sgrub thabs mtsho skyes mdzad pa'i don nyams su len pa la zab mo'i tshul dgu'i lam gyi gsal byed sbal ston dar ma 'byung gnas kyis zhus pa'i ngor rje btsun chen po grags pas mdzad pa/ mtsho skyes rdo rjes mdzad pa'i dpal kye rdo rje mar me'i rtse mo lta bu'i man ngag rgya gzhung ga ya dha ra dang 'brog mi'i 'gyur gnyis thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rdo rje 'chang*/ grub chen bi lā s+ya badz+ra/ a naṅga badz+ra/ rdo rje gdan pa dang thar rtse pa'i der yan lag med pa'i rdo rjer bsgyur/ grub chen pad+ma badz+ra/ de gnyis na mtsho skyes rdo rjer bsgyur/

rgyal chen in+d+ra bhū ti/ lcam lak+ṣ+mī ka ra/ slob dpon nag po spyod pa/ bram ze dpal 'dzin/ paṇ+ḍi ta ga ya dha ra/ 'brog mi lo tsā ba man gong dang rdo rje gdan pa'i der rgya gar du dpa' bo rdo rjer yang gsan zhes snang*/ 'dra'o// slob dpon ḍom+bi he ru kas kye rdo rje'i rgyud brtag gnyis la brten nas lhan cig skyes grub mdzad/ de nyams su len pa la lhan cig skyes pa gsum gyi lam nyams len dbu na/ de la ḍom+bi he ru kas/ zhes dang*/ zhag gsum de gnyis kyi bar nas gang tsam la sgom/ gzhan yang shes par bya'o'i mtha' can gyi brgyud pa ni/ kun mkhyen rdo rje 'chang chen/ ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro ma/ grub chen ḍom+bi he ru ka a la la badz+ra/ slob dpon nags khrod pa/ bā ra si pa zhes pa'ang byung ngo*// grub chen gar+bha ri pa/ bsod snyoms par bsgyur/ pin+da pa/ slob dpon mi thub zla bar bsgyur/ durga tsan+d+ra/ dge slong pradzñā in+d+ra ru tsiḥ rdo rje gdan pa'i der bī ra badz+ra dang thar rtse pa'i der dpa' bo rdo rje zhes 'dug pa dpyad/ 'brog mi lo tsā ba rdo rje gdan pa'i der bod du yang shes rab gsang bar gsan zer ba 'dug man sngar dang 'dra'o// smras pa/ gang zhig thos pas las bzang sdong po bskyed// thos don dpyad pas shes bya'i lo 'dab rgyas// dpyad don bsgoms pas bla med byang chub kyi// snye ma g.yur za rgyal kun bgrod gcig lam// bdag med mkha' 'gro'i zhal lung rgya bod kyi// mkhas grub dbang po du ma'i gshegs shul 'di// lan re thos pa'i blo ldan de nas bzung*// phyogs re'i gdams pa bsrel la gus pa lhod// snyan brgyud tshad ma'i 'dab stong dga' tshal las// ma nyams brgyud pa'i dbang bskur byin rlabs khrid// yid ches rgyab brten lung gi sbrang rtsi'i rgyun// blo yi bung bas gzhibs pa de tsam mo// zhes dam pa'i chos thos pa'i yi ge don gnyer gdengs can rol pa'i chu gter las/

gser chos gsung ngag rin po che'i chos skor thos pa'i brgyud rim gyi sarga ste nyer gcig pa'o// //sarba maṅga laṃ// // ༈ bal yul mchod rten nye 'dabs nas rgyal yongs sa chen zhes pa las/ slob bu tha shal pa gu rus spel ba'o//
